papers.title: A Composable Emulation Framework for Whitebox Switches.
papers.abstract: High-fidelity network emulation is indispensable for reliable operation at scale. While existing emulators are built for monolithic, blackbox switches, emerging switch architectures are chipping away at this assumption. Cloud providers routinely source device modules from different vendors and compose them together to construct disaggregated, whitebox switches. This raises novel challenges in network emulation, as we must move from building bespoke firmware-based emulators to a composable emulation framework where diverse emulators can be stitched together for high-fidelity emulation: whether for data plane, control plane, or peripheral modules (e.g., optical components). We have designed the first such framework, MirSwitch, addressing key challenges in reconciling interface contract differences across emulator modules using an adaptor-centric approach. MirSwitch can faithfully emulate a wide range of functionalities of whitebox switches, while achieving 2.2× forwarding performance improvements which are critical for forwarding emulation. We have deployed MirSwitch in our production network, which our operators have used to troubleshoot 97.5% of a total of 203 issues in a recent year.
papers.abstract_zh: 高保真网络仿真对于大规模可靠运行是必不可少的。虽然现有的仿真器是为单片、黑盒交换机构建的，但新兴的交换机架构正在削弱这一假设。云提供商通常会从不同供应商那里获取设备模块，并将它们组合在一起以构建分解的白盒交换机。这给网络仿真带来了新的挑战，因为我们必须从构建基于定制固件的仿真器转向可组合的仿真框架，在该框架中可以将不同的仿真器拼接在一起以进行高保真仿真：无论是数据平面、控制平面还是外围模块（例如光学组件）。我们设计了第一个此类框架 MirSwitch，解决了使用以适配器为中心的方法协调仿真器模块之间的接口契约差异的关键挑战。 MirSwitch 可以忠实地模拟白盒交换机的各种功能，同时实现 2.2 倍的转发性能改进，这对于转发模拟至关重要。我们在生产网络中部署了 MirSwitch，去年我们的运营商使用它解决了 203 个问题中的 97.5%。

papers.title: A Fast Solver-Free Algorithm for Traffic Engineering in Large-Scale Data Center Network.
papers.abstract:
Rapid growth of data center networks (DCNs) poses significant challenges for large-scale traffic engineering (TE). Existing acceleration strategies, which rely on commercial solvers or deep learning, face scalability issues and struggle with degrading performance or long computational time.

Unlike existing algorithms adopting parallel strategies, we propose Sequential Source-Destination Optimization (SSDO), a sequential solver-free algorithm for intra-DCN TE. SSDO decomposes the problem into subproblems, each focused on adjusting the split ratios for a specific source-destination (SD) demand while keeping others fixed. To enhance the efficiency of subproblem optimization, we design a Balanced Binary Search Method (BBSM), which identifies the most balanced split ratios among multiple solutions that minimize Maximum Link Utilization (MLU). SSDO dynamically updates the sequence of SDs based on real-time utilization, which accelerates convergence and enhances solution quality.

We evaluate SSDO primarily on Meta DCNs, and additionally on two WAN topologies as auxiliary demonstrations of generality. In a Meta topology, SSDO achieves a 65% and 60% reduction in normalized MLU compared to TEAL and POP, two state-of-the-art TE acceleration methods, while delivering a 12× speedup over POP. These results demonstrate the superior performance of SSDO in large-scale TE.
papers.abstract_zh:
数据中心网络（DCN）的快速增长给大规模流量工程（TE）带来了重大挑战。现有的加速策略依赖于商业求解器或深度学习，面临可扩展性问题，并与性能下降或计算时间过长作斗争。

与采用并行策略的现有算法不同，我们提出了顺序源-目的地优化（SSDO），这是一种用于 DCN 内 TE 的顺序无求解器算法。 SSDO 将问题分解为子问题，每个子问题都专注于调整特定源-目的地 (SD) 需求的分流比，同时保持其他问题固定。为了提高子问题优化的效率，我们设计了平衡二分搜索方法（BBSM），该方法可识别多个解决方案中最平衡的分流比，从而最小化最大链路利用率（MLU）。 SSDO根据实时利用率动态更新SD序列，从而加速收敛并提高解的质量。

我们主要在元 DCN 上评估 SSDO，另外还评估两种 WAN 拓扑作为通用性的辅助演示。在元拓扑中，与两种最先进的 TE 加速方法 TEAL 和 POP 相比，SSDO 的归一化 MLU 减少了 65% 和 60%，同时比 POP 提供了 12 倍的加速。这些结果证明了SSDO在大规模TE中的优越性能。

papers.title: A Systematic Threat Analysis and Practical Attacks on Automated Frequency Coordination Systems.
papers.abstract: The 6 GHz band, traditionally reserved for mission-critical incumbent systems such as public safety communications, utility infrastructure, and fixed satellite services, has recently been opened for Wi-Fi devices. This expansion introduces a critical coexistence challenge of ensuring that unlicensed Wi-Fi Access Points (APs) do not interfere with incumbent operations. To manage this risk, regulators mandated the use of Automated Frequency Coordination (AFC) systems that assign spectrum access to Wi-Fi APs based on their locations. In this work, we present the first systematic security analysis of AFC systems. In particular, we analyze the trust assumptions of AFC systems and uncover design lapses and deployment mishaps in this model. Our analysis reveals that the AFC's dependence on unauthenticated data sources, including GNSS/GPS and Wi-Fi-based localization (for location), DNS (for service discovery), and NTP (for time synchronization), creates practical off-path attack vectors that allow adversaries to manipulate control-plane parameters without breaking cryptographic protections between APs and AFC servers. For example, using inexpensive, off-the-shelf software-defined radios, an off-path adversary can spoof the GPS signals received by an AP, falsifying its reported location to either disable 6 GHz transmissions or cause harmful interference with incumbent services. We validate these vectors empirically on commercial APs from four major vendors and evaluate four commercial and one open-source AFC servers to measure real-world impact. We also propose potential mitigations and analyze the trade-offs between usability and security to formulate our recommendations to harden AFC deployments and 6 GHz APs.
papers.abstract_zh: 6 GHz 频段传统上保留给公共安全通信、公用事业基础设施和固定卫星服务等关键任务现有系统，最近已向 Wi-Fi 设备开放。这种扩展带来了关键的共存挑战，即确保未经许可的 Wi-Fi 接入点 (AP) 不会干扰现有运营。为了管理这一风险，监管机构强制使用自动频率协调 (AFC) 系统，该系统根据 Wi-Fi AP 的位置为其分配频谱访问权限。在这项工作中，我们首次对 AFC 系统进行系统的安全分析。特别是，我们分析了 AFC 系统的信任假设，并发现了该模型中的设计失误和部署事故。我们的分析表明，AFC 对未经身份验证的数据源的依赖，包括 GNSS/GPS 和基于 Wi-Fi 的定位（用于位置）、DNS（用于服务发现）和 NTP（用于时间同步），创建了实用的偏离路径攻击向量，允许对手在不破坏 AP 和 AFC 服务器之间的加密保护的情况下操纵控制平面参数。例如，使用廉价、现成的软件定义无线电，偏离路径的对手可以欺骗 AP 接收的 GPS 信号，伪造其报告的位置，从而禁用 6 GHz 传输或对现有服务造成有害干扰。我们在四家主要供应商的商业 AP 上凭经验验证了这些向量，并评估了四台商业服务器和一台开源 AFC 服务器以衡量现实世界的影响。我们还提出了潜在的缓解措施，并分析了可用性和安全性之间的权衡，以制定强化 AFC 部署和 6 GHz AP 的建议。

papers.title: Agentix: An Efficient Serving Engine for LLM Agents as General Programs.
papers.abstract:
Large language model (LLM) applications are evolving beyond simple chatbots into dynamic, general-purpose agentic programs, which scale LLM calls and output tokens to help AI agents reason, explore, and solve complex tasks. However, existing LLM serving systems ignore dependencies between programs and calls, missing significant opportunities for optimization. Our analysis reveals that programs submitted to LLM serving engines experience long cumulative wait times, primarily due to head-of-line blocking at both the individual LLM request and the program.

To address this, we introduce Agentix, an LLM serving system that treats programs as first-class citizens to minimize their end-to-end latencies. Agentix intercepts LLM calls submitted by programs, enriching schedulers with program-level context. We propose two scheduling algorithms—for single-threaded and distributed programs—that preempt and prioritize LLM calls based on their programs' previously completed calls. Our evaluation demonstrates that across diverse LLMs and agentic workloads, Agentix improves throughput of programs by 4-15× at the same latency compared to state-of-the-art systems, such as vLLM.
papers.abstract_zh:
大型语言模型 (LLM) 应用程序正在从简单的聊天机器人演变成动态的通用代理程序，这些程序可扩展 LLM 调用和输出令牌，以帮助 AI 代理推理、探索和解决复杂任务。然而，现有的 LLM 服务系统忽略了程序和调用之间的依赖关系，错过了重要的优化机会。我们的分析表明，提交给 LLM 服务引擎的程序会经历较长的累积等待时间，这主要是由于单个 LLM 请求和程序的队头阻塞。

为了解决这个问题，我们引入了 Agentix，这是一个法学硕士服务系统，它将项目视为一等公民，以最大限度地减少其端到端延迟。 Agentix 拦截程序提交的 LLM 调用，利用程序级上下文丰富调度程序。我们针对单线程和分布式程序提出了两种调度算法，它们根据程序先前完成的调用来抢占并优先化 LLM 调用。我们的评估表明，在不同的 LLM 和代理工作负载中，与 vLLM 等最先进的系统相比，Agentix 在相同延迟的情况下将程序吞吐量提高了 4-15 倍。

papers.title: AnyPro: Preference-Preserving Anycast Optimization based on Strategic AS-Path Prepending.
papers.abstract: Operating large-scale anycast networks is challenging because client-to-site mappings often misalign with operator’s expectation due to opaque inter-domain routing. We present AnyPro, the first system to unlock the full potential of AS-path prepending (ASPP), efficiently deriving globally optimal configurations to steer clients toward performance-optimal sites at scale. AnyPro first employs an efficient polling mechanism to identify all clients sensitive to ASPP. By analyzing the routing changes during the process, the system derives a set of ASPP constraints that guide client traffic toward the desired sites. We then formulate the anycast optimization problem as a constraint-based program and compute optimal ASPP configurations. Extensive evaluation on a global testbed with 20 PoPs demonstrates the effectiveness of AnyPro: it reduces the 90th percentile latency by 37.7% compared to baseline configurations without ASPP. Furthermore, we show that AnyPro can be integrated with PoP-level anycast optimization techniques to achieve additional performance gains.
papers.abstract_zh: 运营大规模任播网络具有挑战性，因为由于不透明的域间路由，客户端到站点的映射经常与运营商的期望不一致。我们推出 AnyPro，这是第一个释放 AS 路径预置 (ASPP) 全部潜力的系统，可有效导出全局最佳配置，以引导客户大规模实现性能最佳站点。 AnyPro 首先采用高效的轮询机制来识别所有对 ASPP 敏感的客户端。通过分析此过程中的路由变化，系统得出一组 ASPP 约束，将客户端流量引导至所需站点。然后，我们将选播优化问题表述为基于约束的程序并计算最佳 ASPP 配置。对具有 20 个 PoP 的全球测试台进行的广泛评估证明了 AnyPro 的有效性：与没有 ASPP 的基准配置相比，它将第 90 个百分点的延迟减少了 37.7%。此外，我们还表明 AnyPro 可以与 PoP 级选播优化技术集成，以实现额外的性能提升。

papers.title: Attack of the Bubbles: Straggler-Resilient Pipeline Parallelism for Large Model Training.
papers.abstract: Training large Deep Neural Network (DNN) models at scale often encounters straggler issues, mostly in communications due to network congestion, RNIC/switch defects, or topological asymmetry. Under advanced pipeline parallelism, even minor communication delays can induce significant training slowdowns. This occurs because (1) slow communication disrupts the pipeline schedule, creating cascading “bubbles” in a domino effect, and (2) current GPU kernel scheduling is susceptible to head-of-line blocking, where slow communication blocks subsequent computations, further adding to these bubbles. To address these challenges, we present PIPEMORPH, a straggler-resilient training system with two key optimizations. First, it optimally adapts the pipeline schedule in the presence of stragglers to absorb communication delays without inducing cascading bubbles, using a simple yet effective algorithm guided by an analytical model. Second, upon detecting slow communication, PIPEMORPH offloads communication operations from GPU to host memory and utilizes CPU-side RDMA for data transfer. This eliminates head-of-line blocking as subsequent computation kernels can be scheduled immediately on GPUs. Together, these optimizations effectively reduce pipeline stalls in the presence of communication stragglers, improving the training iteration time by 1.2-3.5× in our experiments under various settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 大规模训练大型深度神经网络 (DNN) 模型经常会遇到落后问题，主要是由于网络拥塞、RNIC/交换机缺陷或拓扑不对称导致的通信问题。在先进的管道并行性下，即使很小的通信延迟也会导致训练速度显着减慢。发生这种情况的原因是 (1) 缓慢的通信会扰乱管道调度，从而在多米诺骨牌效应中产生级联“气泡”，并且 (2) 当前的 GPU 内核调度容易受到队头阻塞的影响，其中缓慢的通信会阻塞后续计算，从而进一步增加这些气泡。为了应对这些挑战，我们推出了 PIPEMORPH，这是一个具有两项关键优化的落后者弹性训练系统。首先，它使用由分析模型引导的简单而有效的算法，在存在掉队者的情况下优化调整管道调度，以吸收通信延迟，而不会引起级联气泡。其次，在检测到通信缓慢时，PIPEMORPH 将通信操作从 GPU 卸载到主机内存，并利用 CPU 端 RDMA 进行数据传输。这消除了队头阻塞，因为后续计算内核可以立即在 GPU 上调度。总之，这些优化有效地减少了存在通信落后者时的管道停顿，在我们的实验中在各种设置下将训练迭代时间提高了 1.2-3.5 倍。

papers.title: AVA: Towards Agentic Video Analytics with Vision Language Models.
papers.abstract:
AI-driven video analytics has become increasingly important across diverse domains. However, existing systems are often constrained to specific, predefined tasks, limiting their adaptability in open-ended analytical scenarios. The recent emergence of Vision Language Models (VLMs) as transformative technologies offers significant potential for enabling open-ended video understanding, reasoning, and analytics. Nevertheless, their limited context windows present challenges when processing ultra-long video content, which is prevalent in real-world applications. To address this, we introduce AVA, a VLM-powered system designed for open-ended, advanced video analytics. AVA incorporates two key innovations: (1) the near real-time construction of Event Knowledge Graphs (EKGs) for efficient indexing of long or continuous video streams, and (2) an agentic retrieval-generation mechanism that leverages EKGs to handle complex and diverse queries. Comprehensive evaluations on public benchmarks, LVBench and VideoMME-Long, demonstrate that AVA achieves state-of-the-art performance, attaining 62.3% and 64.1% accuracy, respectively, significantly surpassing existing VLM and video Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems. Furthermore, to evaluate video analytics in ultra-long and open-world video scenarios, we introduce a new benchmark, AVA-100. This benchmark comprises 8 videos, each exceeding 10 hours in duration, along with 120 manually annotated, diverse, and complex question-answer pairs. On AVA-100, AVA achieves top-tier performance with an accuracy of 75.8%.

The source code of AVA is available at https://github.com/I-ESC/Project-Ava . The AVA-100 benchmark could be accessed at https://huggingface.co/datasets/iesc/Ava-100 .
papers.abstract_zh:
人工智能驱动的视频分析在不同领域变得越来越重要。然而，现有系统通常仅限于特定的预定义任务，限制了它们在开放式分析场景中的适应性。最近出现的视觉语言模型 (VLM) 作为变革性技术，为实现开放式视频理解、推理和分析提供了巨大的潜力。然而，在处理现实应用中普遍存在的超长视频内容时，它们有限的上下文窗口带来了挑战。为了解决这个问题，我们推出了 AVA，这是一种由 VLM 驱动的系统，专为开放式高级视频分析而设计。 AVA 包含两项关键创新：(1) 近实时构建事件知识图 (EKG)，用于对长或连续视频流进行高效索引；(2) 代理检索生成机制，利用 EKG 处理复杂多样的查询。对公共基准、LVBench 和 VideoMME-Long 的综合评估表明，AVA 实现了最先进的性能，分别达到 62.3% 和 64.1% 的准确率，显着超越现有的 VLM 和视频检索增强生成 (RAG) 系统。此外，为了评估超长和开放世界视频场景中的视频分析，我们引入了新的基准 AVA-100。该基准测试包括 8 个视频，每个视频时长超过 10 小时，以及 120 个手动注释的多样化且复杂的问答对。在 AVA-100 上，AVA 达到了顶级性能，准确率达到 75.8%。

AVA 的源代码可在 https://github.com/I-ESC/Project-Ava 获取。 AVA-100 基准测试可通过 https://huggingface.co/datasets/iesc/Ava-100 访问。

papers.title: BayWatch: Practical Internet-Scale Topology Monitoring with Dynamic Bayesian Estimation.
papers.abstract:
Internet topology monitoring is important for understanding topology dynamics. While a few commercial services have been provided to monitor the specified topology, academic research on Internet-scale topology monitoring still lags behind with two key limitations: 1) topology incompleteness caused by simplified assumption of uniform load-balancing responses (LBR) distribution; 2) low probing efficiency due to the lack of temporal awareness.

In this paper, we introduce BayWatch, a practical Internet-scale topology monitoring system that overcomes these limitations based on a Dynamic Bayesian Network (DBN). Leveraging the Markov property of packet forwarding, BayWatch models it as a sequence of state transitions over time within the DBN, so as to estimate the true LBR distribution and predict its temporal evolution. Internet-wide measurement results demonstrate that benefiting from the estimated LBR distribution, BayWatch can discover 2.4×/2.8× more nodes/links than the state-of-the-art algorithm, D-Miner, while the temporal awareness reduces the number of probes by 6.3× with negligible topology completeness loss. Moreover, we demonstrate that BayWatch can help detect anomalies using a real-world network outage event.
papers.abstract_zh:
互联网拓扑监控对于理解拓扑动态非常重要。虽然已经提供了一些商业服务来监控指定的拓扑，但互联网规模的拓扑监控的学术研究仍然落后，存在两个关键限制：1）由于统一负载均衡响应（LBR）分布的简化假设而导致拓扑不完整性； 2）由于缺乏时间意识导致探测效率低。

在本文中，我们介绍了 BayWatch，这是一种实用的互联网规模的拓扑监控系统，它基于动态贝叶斯网络（DBN）克服了这些限制。利用数据包转发的马尔可夫特性，BayWatch 将其建模为 DBN 内随时间推移的状态转换序列，从而估计真实的 LBR 分布并预测其时间演化。全互联网测量结果表明，受益于估计的 LBR 分布，BayWatch 可以比最先进的算法 D-Miner 发现多 2.4 倍/2.8 倍的节点/链路，而时间感知将探测数量减少 6.3 倍，拓扑完整性损失可以忽略不计。此外，我们还证明 BayWatch 可以通过真实世界的网络中断事件来帮助检测异常情况。

papers.title: BBC: Enabling BLE to Support Bluetooth Classic.
papers.abstract:
Bluetooth Classic has been the technology used by the overwhelming majority of wireless headphones. However, Bluetooth Classic is incompatible with Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), and hence cannot directly communicate with BLE devices. With the recent shift toward BLE, this incompatibility prevents using simple, energy-efficient BLE chips with Bluetooth headphones, and requires using more complex dual-mode chips to support both Bluetooth Classic and BLE.

To overcome this incompatibility, we present BBC, which enables Bluetooth-Classic connectivity on BLE chips. BBC sends and receives raw FSK bits using BLE hardware while emulating all other Bluetooth-Classic operations in the driver. By eliminating the need for Bluetooth-Classic hardware, BBC enables future devices to use BLE-only chips while maintaining the Bluetooth-Classic compatibility via emulation. It also enables new connectivity for current BLE devices to directly stream audio to Bluetooth-Classic headphones. BBC achieves a throughput of 557kbps and a packet error rate (PER) of 4.86% at the distance of 10m, and provides the same audio quality as off-the-shelf Bluetooth-Classic chips.
papers.abstract_zh:
经典蓝牙是绝大多数无线耳机使用的技术。然而，经典蓝牙与低功耗蓝牙 (BLE) 不兼容，因此无法直接与 BLE 设备通信。随着最近向 BLE 的转变，这种不兼容性阻碍了蓝牙耳机使用简单、节能的 BLE 芯片，并且需要使用更复杂的双模芯片来支持经典蓝牙和 BLE。

为了克服这种不兼容性，我们推出了 BBC，它可以在 BLE 芯片上实现经典蓝牙连接。 BBC 使用 BLE 硬件发送和接收原始 FSK 位，同时模拟驱动程序中的所有其他经典蓝牙操作。通过消除对经典蓝牙硬件的需求，BBC 使未来的设备能够使用纯 BLE 芯片，同时通过仿真保持蓝牙经典兼容性。它还为当前的 BLE 设备提供了新的连接，可以将音频直接传输到经典蓝牙耳机。 BBC 在 10m 距离内实现了 557kbps 的吞吐量和 4.86% 的数据包错误率 (PER)，并提供与现成的蓝牙经典芯片相同的音频质量。

papers.title: Bifrost: Alibaba's Next-Generation VPC Network with High-Performance Multipath Reliable Transport.
papers.abstract: Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) has become an increasingly important infrastructure-level service that provides isolated virtual networking environments for cloud tenants. In Alibaba Cloud, over 80% of tenant applications require reliable data transport, which is currently implemented in VPC networks through guest-side TCP. However, TCP often suffers significant performance degradation when facing network instabilities in production clouds, especially for tail-latency sensitive applications such as Redis and Nginx. In this paper, we present Bifrost, the next-generation VPC network in Alibaba Cloud that provides high-performance multipath reliable transport. Bifrost employs RTT-aware multipath packet spraying to bypass failures and mitigate elephant flows, ensures in-order delivery via in-place guest reordering, achieves end-to-end reliability with delayed bitmap ACKs, and performs efficient reliability state management to support large-scale deployment. Extensive evaluation shows that Bifrost reduces tail latency by up to 307× for Redis and 66× for Nginx, achieves millisecond-level failure recovery, and supports O(100k) concurrent connections per SmartNIC.
papers.abstract_zh: 虚拟私有云（VPC）已成为越来越重要的基础设施级服务，为云租户提供隔离的虚拟网络环境。在阿里云中，超过80%的租户应用需要可靠的数据传输，目前在VPC网络中通过访客侧TCP实现。然而，当生产云中面临网络不稳定时，TCP 常常会遭受显着的性能下降，特别是对于 Redis 和 Nginx 等尾延迟敏感的应用程序。在本文中，我们介绍了阿里云中的下一代 VPC 网络 Bifrost，它提供高性能多路径可靠传输。 Bifrost 采用 RTT 感知多路径数据包喷射来绕过故障并减轻大象流量，通过就地访客重新排序确保按顺序交付，通过延迟位图 ACK 实现端到端可靠性，并执行高效的可靠性状态管理以支持大规模部署。广泛评估表明，Bifrost 可为 Redis 降低高达 307 倍的尾部延迟，为 Nginx 降低高达 66 倍的尾部延迟，实现毫秒级故障恢复，并支持每个 SmartNIC 的 O(100k) 并发连接。

papers.title: BLADE: Adaptive Wi-Fi Contention Control for Next-Generation Real-Time Communication.
papers.abstract: Next-generation real-time communication (NGRTC) applications, such as cloud gaming and XR, demand consistently ultra-low latency. However, through our first large-scale measurement, we find that despite the deployment of edge servers, dedicated congestion control, and loss recovery mechanisms, cloud gaming users still experience long-tail latency in Wi-Fi networks. We further identify that Wi-Fi last-mile access points (APs) serve as the primary latency bottleneck. Specifically, short-term packet delivery droughts, caused by fundamental limitations in Wi-Fi contention control standards, are the root cause. To address this issue, we propose BLADE, an adaptive contention control algorithm that dynamically adjusts the contention windows (CW) of all Wi-Fi transmitters based on the channel contention level in a fully distributed manner. Our NS3 simulations and real-world evaluations with commercial Wi-Fi APs demonstrate that, compared to standard contention control, BLADE reduces Wi-Fi packet transmission tail latency by over 5× under heavy channel contention and significantly stabilizes MAC throughput while ensuring fast and fair convergence. Consequently, BLADE reduces the video stall rate in cloud gaming by over 90%.
papers.abstract_zh: 云游戏和 XR 等下一代实时通信 (NGRTC) 应用程序需要始终如一的超低延迟。然而，通过我们的第一次大规模测量，我们发现尽管部署了边缘服务器、专用拥塞控制和丢失恢复机制，云游戏用户仍然会在Wi-Fi网络中遇到长尾延迟。我们进一步发现 Wi-Fi 最后一英里接入点 (AP) 是主要的延迟瓶颈。具体来说，根本原因是 Wi-Fi 争用控制标准的根本限制所导致的短期数据包传输干旱。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 BLADE，这是一种自适应竞争控制算法，可以根据信道竞争级别以完全分布式的方式动态调整所有 Wi-Fi 发射器的竞争窗口 (CW)。我们的 NS3 模拟和商用 Wi-Fi AP 的实际评估表明，与标准争用控制相比，BLADE 在信道争用严重的情况下将 Wi-Fi 数据包传输尾部延迟减少了 5 倍以上，并显着稳定了 MAC 吞吐量，同时确保快速和公平的收敛。因此，BLADE将云游戏的视频卡顿率降低了90%以上。

papers.title: Bridging Storage and Execution: A Semantic Virtual Bus for On-Demand Application Streaming.
papers.abstract: Traditional application delivery requires full local installation, incurring persistent security risks from outdated versions, significant download delays. Despite advances in network throughput and latency, existing dynamic loading solutions such as Web applications and network filesystems like NFS suffer from performance degradation, functionality limitations, and intrusive application modifications. We introduce STREAMBUS, a transparent application streaming system that redefines the network as a semantic-aware virtual storage bus beneath the file system layer. Supporting deployment across diverse environments, including WiFi-dependent mobile devices, it addresses two key challenges: maintaining microsecond-level latency comparable to local storage and bridging the semantic gap between stateless remote storage and stateful execution. To achieve this, STREAMBUS combines a dual-mode transmission mechanism that synchronously serves requested blocks and asynchronously prefetches predicted blocks, with a thread-aware Markov-chain model that captures fine-grained access patterns. Evaluation shows STREAMBUS delivers near-native performance across diverse networks. On desktops, it achieves 15–40% better per-page access latency than local NVMe in common cases. On mobile devices, it typically sustains startup overheads below 40% relative to local storage, even over variable Wi-Fi connectivity. Robustness experiments demonstrate stable performance under emulated network conditions with realistic delay patterns, supporting intra-city deployments.
papers.abstract_zh: 传统的应用程序交付需要完全本地安装，过时的版本会带来持续的安全风险，严重的下载延迟。尽管网络吞吐量和延迟方面取得了进步，但现有的动态加载解决方案（例如 Web 应用程序和 NFS 等网络文件系统）仍遭受性能下降、功能限制和侵入性应用程序修改的困扰。我们推出了 STREAMBUS，这是一种透明的应用程序流系统，它将网络重新定义为文件系统层下的语义感知虚拟存储总线。它支持跨不同环境（包括依赖 WiFi 的移动设备）的部署，解决了两个关键挑战：保持与本地存储相当的微秒级延迟，以及弥合无状态远程存储和有状态执行之间的语义差距。为了实现这一目标，STREAMBUS 将同步服务请求块和异步预取预测块的双模式传输机制与捕获细粒度访问模式的线程感知马尔可夫链模型相结合。评估表明 STREAMBUS 在不同的网络中提供接近本机的性能。在桌面上，在常见情况下，它的每页访问延迟比本地 NVMe 低 15-40%。在移动设备上，即使通过可变的 Wi-Fi 连接，它通常也能将启动开销维持在本地存储的 40% 以下。鲁棒性实验证明了在具有真实延迟模式的模拟网络条件下的稳定性能，支持城市内部署。

papers.title: Building A CSFQ-Inspired Transport for Switched CXL Memory Pooling.
papers.abstract:
Emerging switched CXL memory pooling systems, albeit promising, suffer from significant performance interference due to the shared but performance-uncontrolled data path among concurrent memory streams between a host core and a remote DIMM. We systematically characterize a memory pooling appliance based on the XConn’s Apollo CXL switch, and identify three issues: intra-host contention, in-fabric congestion, and unmanaged host-remote DIMM interaction.

This paper presents a new transport layer, MemChannel , which provides the mchannel abstraction to manage end-to-end fabric bandwidth among competing memory flows and enable application-specific traffic for switched CXL memory pooling. Under the hood, our key idea is to build a Sender-Driven Fabric-Informed transport protocol—inspired by Core-Stateless Fair Queueing (CSFQ)—that admits just the right amount of CXL requests to each mchannel based on the estimated Core ↔ DIMM CXL bandwidth availability. To grapple with the ramifications of CXL-induced idiosyncrasies, MemChannel introduces a couple of techniques: time-based rate control, host-side admission control, cross-host bookkeeping, new congestion signals, rate estimation based on the fluid model, and delay-based link capacity adjustment. We build MemChannel from scratch and support unmodified applications. Our evaluations over switched memory pooling demonstrate the effectiveness of MemChannel from performance isolation, scalability, and multi-tenancy perspectives.
papers.abstract_zh:
新兴的交换式 CXL 内存池系统尽管前景广阔，但由于主机核心和远程 DIMM 之间的并发内存流之间存在共享但性能不受控制的数据路径，因此会遭受严重的性能干扰。我们系统地描述了基于 XConn 的 Apollo CXL 交换机的内存池设备的特征，并确定了三个问题：主机内争用、结构内拥塞和非托管主机远程 DIMM 交互。

本文提出了一个新的传输层 MemChannel ，它提供了 mchannel 抽象来管理竞争内存流之间的端到端结构带宽，并为交换 CXL 内存池启用特定于应用程序的流量。在幕后，我们的关键想法是构建一个发送者驱动的 Fabric-Informed 传输协议（受 Core-Stateless Fair Queuing (CSFQ) 的启发），该协议根据估计的 Core ↔ DIMM CXL 带宽可用性，允许每个 mchannel 接收适量的 CXL 请求。为了应对 CXL 引起的特性的影响，MemChannel 引入了多种技术：基于时间的速率控制、主机端准入控制、跨主机簿记、新的拥塞信号、基于流体模型的速率估计以及基于延迟的链路容量调整。我们从头开始构建 MemChannel 并支持未经修改的应用程序。我们对交换内存池的评估从性能隔离、可扩展性和多租户角度证明了 MemChannel 的有效性。

papers.title: BURST: Seeking High-performance, Interoperability and Scalability in Soft-RDMA.
papers.abstract:
Modern data centers deploy heterogeneous server pods, including a mix of commercial RDMA NICs (RNICs), legacy Ethernet NICs, and custom in-house hardware. This diversity creates significant interoperability challenges, particularly for Non-RNIC-to-RNIC (NR2R) communication, a scenario driven by emerging disaggregated workloads like LLM inference, large-scale infrastructure upgrades, and the integration of novel network protocols. Due to strict hardware dependencies, RNICs discard packets from non-compliant packets, forcing a costly fallback to TCP/IP and limiting RDMA network scaling. Existing software RDMA solutions, RXE (SoftRoCE implementation in Linux kernel), suffer from prohibitive CPU overhead, making them unsuitable for high-speed networks.

To address this, we present BURST, a high-performance, user-space software RDMA stack designed for high-speed networks. BURST operates as an independent process that maintains full compatibility with the standard RDMA Verbs API, allowing unmodified applications to run on Ethernet NICs. It integrates a lock-free DPDK data plane for line-rate packet processing, leverages Intel's DSA for reducing CPU, and features a kernel-bypass connection manager to accelerate setup. Experimental results show that BURST achieves 98.7% line-rate bandwidth on 400G NICs, delivering a 3.2-6.3x throughput improvement over kernel RXE. In production workloads, BURST accelerates LLM inference latency to 25.2% of TCP's and increases connection setup speeds by 12x compared to native RDMA CM, demonstrating its benefits for unifying communication in heterogeneous environments.
papers.abstract_zh:
现代数据中心部署异构服务器单元，包括商业 RDMA NIC (RNIC)、传统以太网 NIC 和自定义内部硬件的组合。这种多样性带来了重大的互操作性挑战，特别是对于非 RNIC 到 RNIC (NR2R) 通信，这是由新兴的分类工作负载（如 LLM 推理、大规模基础设施升级和新颖网络协议的集成）驱动的场景。由于严格的硬件依赖性，RNIC 会丢弃不合规数据包中的数据包，迫使成本高昂的回退到 TCP/IP，并限制 RDMA 网络扩展。现有的软件 RDMA 解决方案 RXE（Linux 内核中的 SoftRoCE 实现）的 CPU 开销过高，使其不适合高速网络。

为了解决这个问题，我们推出了 BURST，这是一种专为高速网络设计的高性能用户空间软件 RDMA 堆栈。 BURST 作为独立进程运行，与标准 RDMA Verbs API 保持完全兼容，允许未经修改的应用程序在以太网 NIC 上运行。它集成了用于线速数据包处理的无锁 DPDK 数据平面，利用英特尔的 DSA 来减少 CPU 占用，并具有内核旁路连接管理器来加速设置。实验结果表明，BURST 在 400G NIC 上实现了 98.7% 的线速带宽，吞吐量比内核 RXE 提高了 3.2-6.3 倍。在生产工作负载中，与本机 RDMA CM 相比，BURST 将 LLM 推理延迟加速至 TCP 的 25.2%，并将连接设置速度提高了 12 倍，展示了其在异构环境中统一通信的优势。

papers.title: CacheCatalyst: Enhancing Web Caching for the Latency-Constrained Internet.
papers.abstract: Caching is a fundamental technique for improving web performance, particularly by reducing page load time through the reuse of previously fetched resources. In this paper, we highlight the drawbacks of the current caching approach, especially in the context of high-speed networks where latency, rather than bandwidth, has become the main bottleneck for web performance. We discuss how the current design of web caching suffers from inefficiencies, particularly due to the latency involved in re-validation requests, which diminishes the potential benefits of caching. To address this inefficiency, we present CacheCatalyst, a novel solution that introduces an early cache validation procedure during the initial step of page loading. This updates the state of cached resources, enabling browsers to utilize unchanged cached content without unnecessary round trips. In addition, our approach enables an optimized form of Server Push that avoids the typical drawbacks of this mechanism. Our evaluations demonstrate that this method improves key performance metrics of page loading by an average of 40%.
papers.abstract_zh: 缓存是提高 Web 性能的一项基本技术，特别是通过重用先前获取的资源来减少页面加载时间。在本文中，我们强调了当前缓存方法的缺点，特别是在高速网络的背景下，其中延迟（而不是带宽）已成为 Web 性能的主要瓶颈。我们讨论了当前的 Web 缓存设计如何因效率低下而受到影响，特别是由于重新验证请求中涉及的延迟，这削弱了缓存的潜在优势。为了解决这种低效率问题，我们提出了 CacheCatalyst，这是一种新颖的解决方案，它在页面加载的初始步骤中引入了早期缓存验证过程。这会更新缓存资源的状态，使浏览器能够利用未更改的缓存内容，而无需不必要的往返。此外，我们的方法实现了服务器推送的优化形式，避免了该机制的典型缺点。我们的评估表明，此方法将页面加载的关键性能指标平均提高了 40%。

papers.title: CascadeNet: Generating Network Traffic with High-Fidelity Temporal Patterns.
papers.abstract: Facing the challenge of limited network trace access, the exploration of synthetic trace generation has become crucial for research. Although current methods manage to replicate the statistical characteristics of network traffic accurately, they fail to capture the temporal dynamics of network activities. This gap stems primarily from their approach to data representation. To address this issue, we propose a novel representation of network traces by aggregating network flows into time series. Built upon this data representation, we propose CascadeNet, an end-to-end framework embedded with CascadeGAN—a hierarchical generative model—to generate network traffic with high-fidelity temporal patterns while learning complex flow structures and dependencies. We also develop several techniques to facilitate the transformation from aggregated time series to timestamps. Our evaluations across four diverse IPv4 header traces show (1) CascadeNet surpasses baselines by 41%~76% on temporal distance metrics; (2) CascadeNet outperforms baselines in downstream tasks; (3) it offers remarkable scalability, reducing training time by 7.3×~25× compared to state-of-the-art method.
papers.abstract_zh: 面对有限的网络痕迹访问的挑战，合成痕迹生成的探索已成为研究的关键。尽管当前的方法能够准确地复制网络流量的统计特征，但它们无法捕获网络活动的时间动态。这种差距主要源于他们的数据表示方法。为了解决这个问题，我们通过将网络流聚合成时间序列，提出了一种新的网络轨迹表示方法。基于这种数据表示，我们提出了 CascadeNet，这是一种嵌入 CascadeGAN（分层生成模型）的端到端框架，用于生成具有高保真时间模式的网络流量，同时学习复杂的流结构和依赖关系。我们还开发了多种技术来促进从聚合时间序列到时间戳的转换。我们对四个不同 IPv4 标头跟踪的评估表明：(1) CascadeNet 在时间距离指标上超出基线 41%~76%； (2) CascadeNet 在下游任务中优于基线； (3)它提供了显着的可扩展性，与最先进的方法相比，训练时间减少了 7.3×~25×。

papers.title: cc-pipe: Breaking Systemic Bottlenecks in RPKI Data Supply Chain with Concurrent and Conflict-Free Pipelines.
papers.abstract:
While the Resource Public Key Infrastructure (RPKI) is essential for securing BGP, the high latency, limited scalability, and vulnerabilities in the data supply chain severely undermine its security guarantees and impede network operations. Within this supply chain, existing research identifies the Relying Party (RP) validation process as the primary performance bottleneck. This bottleneck originates from the standard monolithic architecture, which enforces strong consistency but incurs high latency. Previous work has pursued incremental optimizations within this architecture, yet achieving substantial gains remains difficult.

Based on extensive measurements, we identify inherent blocking within the paradigm as the root cause. To address this, we propose cc-pipe, a novel pipeline architecture that breaks the fundamental consistency—latency trade-off. By leveraging a predictive conflict graph, cc-pipe enables low-latency incremental data dissemination while preserving strong consistency guarantees. Evaluation with real-world deployment demonstrates that cc-pipe reduces average latency by up to 73.3% across all data with negligible router overhead. It also delivers significant scalability under projected future workloads, as well as robust resilience to misbehaving publication points.
papers.abstract_zh:
虽然资源公钥基础设施 (RPKI) 对于保护 BGP 至关重要，但数据供应链中的高延迟、有限的可扩展性和漏洞严重破坏了其安全保障并阻碍网络运行。在该供应链中，现有研究将依赖方 (RP) 验证流程确定为主要性能瓶颈。这个瓶颈源于标准的整体架构，它强制要求强一致性，但会产生高延迟。之前的工作已经在该架构中追求增量优化，但实现实质性收益仍然很困难。

基于广泛的测量，我们将范式中固有的阻塞确定为根本原因。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 cc-pipe，这是一种新颖的管道架构，它打破了基本的一致性——延迟权衡。通过利用预测冲突图，cc-pipe 可以实现低延迟增量数据传播，同时保持强大的一致性保证。对实际部署的评估表明，cc-pipe 将所有数据的平均延迟降低了 73.3%，而路由器开销可以忽略不计。它还在预计的未来工作负载下提供了显着的可扩展性，以及对行为不当的发布点的强大弹性。

papers.title: CCC: Re-architecting Delay-based Congestion Control in Datacenter Networks.
papers.abstract: In datacenter networks, delay-based congestion control (CC) algorithms are popular and protocols such as TIMELY and SWIFT are employed in production. However, even if delay signals are precisely measured, the congestion information deduction (CiD) may be incorrect under certain conditions, degrading the performance of CC. To address this problem, we re-architect the delay-based CC to make rate adjustments based not only on the congestion states but also the CiD trustworthiness. Based on this architecture, the CiD-sensitive congestion control (CCC) is developed. Specifically, CCC demarcates the regions, where the CiD from delay signals is untrustworthy, with the assistance of well-designed congestion criteria and inherent system inertia. When the CiD is untrustworthy, CCC constructs the probing rate adjustment rules for both the rapid response to congestion and the subsequent trustworthy CiD. Otherwise, CCC conducts the analytical rate adjustment to both reach the expected congestion state and keep the trustworthy CiD, fully leveraging the abundant information in delay signals. DPDK-based experiments and large-scale simulations confirm that CCC achieves similar good performance as INT-based CCs, including HPCC and PowerTCP, by using only delay signals, outperforming DCQCN, TIMELY, and SWIFT.
papers.abstract_zh: 在数据中心网络中，基于延迟的拥塞控制 (CC) 算法很流行，并且在生产中采用了 TIMELY 和 SWIFT 等协议。然而，即使延迟信号被精确测量，拥塞信息推导（CiD）在某些条件下也可能不正确，从而降低CC的性能。为了解决这个问题，我们重新构建了基于延迟的 CC，不仅根据拥塞状态，还根据 CiD 可信度进行速率调整。基于该架构，开发了CiD敏感拥塞控制（CCC）。具体来说，CCC 借助精心设计的拥塞标准和固有的系统惯性来划分延迟信号 CiD 不可信的区域。当CiD不可信时，CCC构建探测速率调整规则，既可以快速响应拥塞，又可以保证后续的可信CiD。否则，CCC 充分利用延迟信号中的丰富信息，进行分析速率调整，以达到预期的拥塞状态并保持可信的 CiD。基于 DPDK 的实验和大规模仿真证实，CCC 仅使用延迟信号即可实现与基于 INT 的 CC（包括 HPCC 和 PowerTCP）类似的良好性能，优于 DCQCN、TIMELY 和 SWIFT。

papers.title: CCEval: Accurately and Confidently Evaluating Performance Metrics of Congestion Control Algorithms for Datacenter Networks.
papers.abstract:
Congestion control in datacenter networks (DCNs) is a highly active research area. Typical CCA evaluation workflows contain three steps: generate experimental configurations, execute the experiments, and estimate performance metrics using results from multiple trials. However, due to variability brought by random traffic workloads and single-digit trial counts, common experimental methodologies fail to provide enough confidence to properly evaluate CCA performance.

We propose CCEval, an evaluation framework for accurately and confidently estimating performance metrics of CCAs in DCNs. The key idea is using confidence intervals and more trials to quantify and improve the accuracy and confidence of performance metrics. To this end, we propose a model-free estimation algorithm to calculate the confidence intervals and forecast the required trial count for a given accuracy, confidence level, metric, and CCA. We further design a model-based tail quantile estimation algorithm to reduce the needed trial counts significantly without losing accuracy and confidence. Extensive experiments on simulators and real-world testbeds with four CCAs on typical topologies and flow distributions show that CCEval can produce estimations of performance metrics accurately and confidently, with 1% relative margin of error and 95% confidence level, and can reduce trial counts by 75%~80% for tail quantile estimation.
papers.abstract_zh:
数据中心网络 (DCN) 中的拥塞控制是一个非常活跃的研究领域。典型的 CCA 评估工作流程包含三个步骤：生成实验配置、执行实验以及使用多次试验的结果估计性能指标。然而，由于随机流量工作负载和个位数试验计数带来的可变性，常见的实验方法无法提供足够的信心来正确评估 CCA 性能。

我们提出了 CCEval，一个评估框架，用于准确、自信地估计 DCN 中 CCA 的性能指标。关键思想是使用置信区间和更多试验来量化和提高性能指标的准确性和置信度。为此，我们提出了一种无模型估计算法来计算置信区间并预测给定精度、置信水平、指标和 CCA 所需的试验次数。我们进一步设计了一种基于模型的尾部分位数估计算法，以显着减少所需的试验次数，而不会损失准确性和置信度。在模拟器和真实测试平台上使用四个 CCA 对典型拓扑和流量分布进行的大量实验表明，CCEval 可以准确、自信地生成性能指标估计，相对误差范围为 1%，置信度为 95%，并且可以将尾分位数估计的试验次数减少 75%~80%。

papers.title: Checkmate: Zero Performance Overhead Model Checkpointing via Network Gradient Replication.
papers.abstract: This paper presents Checkmate, a system that enables per-iteration checkpointing in DNN training without any training slowdown. The traditional approach to checkpointing requires a pause in training to copy model states to a separate location, allowing the state to be restored in the event of failure. This approach fundamentally has a tradeoff between the frequency of checkpoints and the cost of a failure. We avoid this tradeoff; our key insight is that in data-parallel training, all information necessary to create a checkpoint already exists in the network as gradients. Our core contribution is a new multicast abstraction that simultaneously delivers gradients to a separate CPU-based shadow cluster. The shadow maintains a checkpoint by applying those gradients to a copy of the model. Our evaluation shows that Checkmate performs per-iteration checkpointing with training throughput comparable to an ideal no-checkpoint baseline. Checkmate achieves 5 to 34.5× more frequent checkpointing compared to state-of-the-art checkpointing systems, resulting in 80% to 97.1% reduction in repeated work per failure. At the same checkpointing frequency, Checkmate delivers 1.3× to 6.5× throughput compared to other systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了 Checkmate，这是一个在 DNN 训练中实现每次迭代检查点的系统，而不会导致任何训练速度减慢。传统的检查点方法需要暂停训练，将模型状态复制到单独的位置，以便在发生故障时恢复状态。这种方法从根本上在检查点频率和故障成本之间进行权衡。我们避免这种权衡；我们的主要见解是，在数据并行训练中，创建检查点所需的所有信息已经作为梯度存在于网络中。我们的核心贡献是一种新的多播抽象，它同时将梯度传递到基于 CPU 的单独影子集群。阴影通过将这些渐变应用于模型的副本来维护检查点。我们的评估表明，Checkmate 执行每次迭代检查点的训练吞吐量与理想的无检查点基线相当。与最先进的检查点系统相比，Checkmate 的检查点频率提高了 5 至 34.5 倍，从而将每次故障的重复工作量减少了 80% 至 97.1%。在相同的检查点频率下，Checkmate 与其他系统相比可提供 1.3 倍至 6.5 倍的吞吐量。

papers.title: Co-Designing Traffic Control with NVMe-oF for Disaggregated Storage: A Comparative Study of Switched and Switchless SAN Architectures.
papers.abstract:
Disaggregated storage is a pivotal component of today’s cluster infrastructures. With the advent of high-bandwidth server interconnects and new NVMe form factors, commodity storage appliances are becoming denser, delivering tens of millions of IOPS. This calls for today’s storage area network (SAN) fabric to expand the bandwidth capacity drastically. Industry practices tackle this issue via either (i) a scale-up approach, upgrading the per-port bandwidth in a switched SAN, or (ii) a scale-out strategy, integrating more paths in a switchless SAN. However, it is unclear which network architecture is more suitable for scaling storage disaggregation.

This paper presents a comparative study of switched and switchless SAN architectures from several angles. We begin by developing an experimental methodology that integrates both small-scale real-system prototypes and large-scale simulations, providing the flexibility needed to explore architectural trade-offs. We then characterize NVMe-oF I/O flows and co-design SAN traffic control mechanisms around these characteristics to improve I/O transmission efficiency in both settings. Our evaluation yields several key findings. First, the switchless SAN achieves throughput comparable to that of the switched SAN, despite involving additional routing hops, while simultaneously reducing latency through the use of multiple load-aware I/O paths that mitigate interference. Second, the switchless SAN reduces capital costs by obviating the need for expensive high-radix switches, scales effectively under heterogeneous I/O workloads, and avoids the single point of failure associated with top-of-rack (ToR) switches. Collectively, these results demonstrate that switchless SANs provide a compelling alternative to traditional switched designs for disaggregated storage environments.
papers.abstract_zh:
分类存储是当今集群基础设施的关键组成部分。随着高带宽服务器互连和新 NVMe 外形尺寸的出现，商品存储设备变得越来越密集，可提供数千万次 IOPS。这就需要当今的存储区域网络 (SAN) 结构大幅扩展带宽容量。行业实践通过 (i) 纵向扩展方法，升级交换 SAN 中的每端口带宽，或 (ii) 横向扩展策略，在无交换机 SAN 中集成更多路径来解决此问题。然而，尚不清楚哪种网络架构更适合扩展存储分解。

本文从多个角度对交换式和非交换式 SAN 架构进行了比较研究。我们首先开发一种集成小规模真实系统原型和大规模模拟的实验方法，提供探索架构权衡所需的灵活性。然后，我们描述 NVMe-oF I/O 流的特征，并围绕这些特征共同设计 SAN 流量控制机制，以提高两种设置中的 I/O 传输效率。我们的评估得出了几个关键发现。首先，无交换机 SAN 的吞吐量与交换 SAN 相当，尽管涉及额外的路由跳数，同时通过使用多个负载感知 I/O 路径来减少干扰，从而减少延迟。其次，无交换机 SAN 不再需要昂贵的高基数交换机，从而降低了资本成本，在异构 I/O 工作负载下有效扩展，并避免了与架顶 (ToR) 交换机相关的单点故障。总的来说，这些结果表明，无交换机 SAN 为分散存储环境提供了传统交换设计的引人注目的替代方案。

papers.title: Come Hell or Still Water: Alleviating Tail Latency in Cloud Block Store.
papers.abstract:
Maintaining low tail latency is crucial for cloud storage services. In ALIBABA CLOUD, our Elastic Block Storage (EBS), like many others, adopts layers of load balancing to avoid hot-spot I/Os, a dominant contributor to tail latency.

However, in the field, EBS has still been suffering from tail latency spikes. Through extensive analysis of production workloads, we have identified the root cause: the workload bursts caused by a small group of Virtual Disks (VDs), which fundamentally influence the tail latency of the entire cluster. We hence propose a lightweight dual-bucket throttling mechanism to effectively mitigate the issue while maintaining fairness. In addition, we discover that, even under underloaded scenarios, the tail latency remains suboptimal due to the event-loop thread model. We propose a priority-based scheduling mechanism to separate I/O-related tasks from I/O-unrelated ones. Our evaluation shows that the proposed mechanisms can reduce the tail latency by up to 97% in burst and 43% in underloaded scenarios. Our mechanisms have been deployed across dozens of clusters for more than three months, and have served hundreds of trillions of I/O requests. They reduce the P99999 tail latency of steady segments by 59.7% under burst scenarios and of all I/Os by 22% in underloaded scenarios.
papers.abstract_zh:
保持低尾部延迟对于云存储服务至关重要。在阿里巴巴云中，我们的弹性块存储（EBS）与许多其他存储一样，采用负载均衡层来避免热点 I/O，而热点 I/O 是造成尾部延迟的主要因素。

然而，在现场，EBS 仍然遭受尾部延迟峰值的困扰。通过对生产负载的大量分析，我们找到了根本原因：一小部分虚拟磁盘（VD）导致的负载爆发，从根本上影响了整个集群的尾部延迟。因此，我们提出了一种轻量级的双桶节流机制，以有效缓解该问题，同时保持公平性。此外，我们发现，即使在负载不足的情况下，由于事件循环线程模型，尾部延迟仍然不是最佳的。我们提出了一种基于优先级的调度机制，将与 I/O 相关的任务与与 I/O 无关的任务分开。我们的评估表明，所提出的机制可以在突发情况下将尾部延迟减少高达 97%，在负载不足的情况下减少 43%。我们的机制已经在数十个集群上部署了三个多月，并服务了数百万亿个 I/O 请求。它们在突发场景下将稳定段的 P99999 尾部延迟降低了 59.7%，在负载不足的情况下将所有 I/O 的尾部延迟降低了 22%。

papers.title: Controlling Arbitrary Internet Queues with Titrate.
papers.abstract:
Router buffers are critical to networks for absorbing short-lived congestion and allowing full throughput. However, excessive buffering can lead to high queuing delay, poor burst absorption, and even low throughput for queues sharing the buffer memory. Existing queue management schemes designed for Internet routers (e.g., CoDel, PIE) prevent such excessive buffering only under stringent assumptions about the queue composition (flows in the queue), while more recent approaches (e.g., L4S) require end-host collaboration. In this work, we revisit queue management for Internet routers from first principles and introduce Titrate, a closed-loop controller that senses queue dynamics and adjusts thresholds for any given queue to achieve high throughput, low latency and effective burst absorption. To balance convergence speed and stability, Titrate draws inspiration from TCP’s control loop, combining a multiplicative-increase-additive-decrease approach with an ssthresh-like variable.

We evaluate Titrate’s performance via simulation and Internet experiments. Across a wide range of realistic traffic mixes, Titrate increases minimum throughput by 39%, 14% compared to CoDel, PIE, while keeping 59% lower queuing latency compared to static-threshold baselines of on-par throughput. It also improves end-user quality of experience over static-threshold baselines. We further show that Titrate reacts swiftly to bandwidth and traffic changes and offers device-wide benefits.
papers.abstract_zh:
路由器缓冲区对于网络吸收短暂拥塞并允许完全吞吐量至关重要。然而，过多的缓冲会导致队列延迟高、突发吸收差，甚至共享缓冲存储器的队列吞吐量低。为互联网路由器设计的现有队列管理方案（例如，CoDel、PIE）仅在对队列组成（队列中的流）进行严格假设的情况下才能防止这种过度缓冲，而最新的方法（例如，L4S）需要终端主机协作。在这项工作中，我们从第一原理重新审视互联网路由器的队列管理，并引入 Titrate，这是一种闭环控制器，可以感知队列动态并调整任何给定队列的阈值，以实现高吞吐量、低延迟和有效的突发吸收。为了平衡收敛速度和稳定性，Titrate 从 TCP 的控制循环中汲取灵感，将乘法-增加-加法-减少方法与类似 ssthresh 的变量相结合。

我们通过模拟和互联网实验来评估 Titrate 的性能。在各种实际流量混合中，Titrate 将最小吞吐量提高了 39%，与 CoDel、PIE 相比提高了 14%，同时与同等吞吐量的静态阈值基线相比，排队延迟降低了 59%。它还提高了最终用户在静态阈值基线上的体验质量。我们进一步表明，Titrate 对带宽和流量变化做出快速反应，并提供设备范围内的优势。

papers.title: Cortex: Achieving Low-Latency, Cost-Efficient Remote Data Access For LLM via Semantic-Aware Knowledge Caching.
papers.abstract:
Large Language Model (LLM) agents tackle data-intensive tasks such as deep research and code generation. However, their effectiveness depends on frequent interactions with knowledge sources across remote clouds or regions. Such interactions can create non-trivial latency and cost bottlenecks. Existing caching solutions focus on exact-match queries, limiting their effectiveness for semantic knowledge reuse.

To address this challenge, we introduce Cortex, a novel cross-region knowledge caching architecture for LLM agents. At its core are two abstractions: Semantic Element (SE) and Semantic Retrieval Index (Seri). A semantic element captures the semantic embedding representation of an LLM query together with performance-aware metadata such as latency, cost, and staticity. Seri then provides two-stage retrieval: a vector similar index with semantic embedding for fast candidate selection and a lightweight LLM-powered semantic judger for precise validation. Atop these primitives, Cortex builds a new cache interface that includes a new semantic-aware cache hit definition, a cost-efficient eviction policy, and proactive prefetching. To reduce overhead, Cortex co-locates the small LLM judger with the main LLM using adaptive scheduling and resource sharing. Our evaluation demonstrates that Cortex delivers substantial performance improvements without compromising correctness. On representative search workloads, Cortex achieves up to a 3.6× increase in throughput by maintaining cache hit rates of over 85×, while preserving accuracy virtually identical to non-cached baselines. Cortex also improves throughput for coding tasks by 20×, showcasing its versatility across diverse agentic workloads.
papers.abstract_zh:
大型语言模型 (LLM) 代理处理数据密集型任务，例如深入研究和代码生成。然而，它们的有效性取决于与远程云或区域的知识源的频繁交互。此类交互可能会造成严重的延迟和成本瓶颈。现有的缓存解决方案侧重于精确匹配查询，限制了其语义知识重用的有效性。

为了应对这一挑战，我们引入了 Cortex，一种用于 LLM 代理的新型跨区域知识缓存架构。其核心是两个抽象：语义元素（SE）和语义检索索引（Seri）。语义元素捕获 LLM 查询的语义嵌入表示以及性能感知元数据（例如延迟、成本和静态性）。然后，Seri 提供两阶段检索：带有语义嵌入的向量相似索引，用于快速候选选择，以及由 LLM 支持的轻量级语义判断器，用于精确验证。在这些原语之上，Cortex 构建了一个新的缓存接口，其中包括新的语义感知缓存命中定义、经济高效的驱逐策略和主动预取。为了减少开销，Cortex 使用自适应调度和资源共享将小型 LLM 判断器与主 LLM 放在一起。我们的评估表明，Cortex 在不影响正确性的情况下提供了显着的性能改进。在代表性搜索工作负载上，Cortex 通过保持超过 85 倍的缓存命中率，同时保持与非缓存基线几乎相同的精度，将吞吐量提高了 3.6 倍。 Cortex 还将编码任务的吞吐量提高了 20 倍，展示了其在不同代理工作负载中的多功能性。

papers.title: Cost-effective and Reliable Global Internet Peering with Programmable Switches.
papers.abstract: Large-scale cloud providers always deploy peering routing system at the Internet’s peering edge to route traffic between the cloud and the Internet. Traditional router-based peering systems fail to pace up to the fast-changing application requirements, while the recent host-based approach is not cost-effective and struggles to address malicious traffic from the Internet. In this paper, we advocate for a radical new peering architecture to introduce programmable switches at the peering edge. We propose and implement a first-of-its-kind system, called Janus, to simultaneously handle inbound and outbound network traffic and significantly reduce network hardware cost. The core of Janus’s approach is to leverage a traffic dispatch module to offload most of the outbound traffic to switches to enhance system’s scalability. Janus offloads all inbound traffic to switches and redirects potential malicious traffic to the anti-DDoS service to enhance system reliability. Furthermore, Janus introduces a fast route convergence mechanism to effectively handle Internet-scale route updates. We have gradually deployed Janus at the edge of our production network over the past years. Evaluation results show that Janus can reduce the average hardware cost by 78%, as compared to existing systems while gracefully handling DDoS issues. Meanwhile, Janus can reduce the route convergence within seconds under failure scenarios, which is orders of magnitude faster than existing approaches.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型云提供商总是在互联网的对等边缘部署对等路由系统，以在云和互联网之间路由流量。传统的基于路由器的对等系统无法跟上快速变化的应用程序需求，而最近基于主机的方法不具有成本效益，并且难以解决来自互联网的恶意流量。在本文中，我们提倡采用全新的对等架构，在对等边缘引入可编程交换机。我们提出并实施了一个名为 Janus 的首创系统，可以同时处理入站和出站网络流量，并显着降低网络硬件成本。 Janus方法的核心是利用流量调度模块将大部分出站流量分流到交换机，以增强系统的可扩展性。 Janus将所有入站流量卸载到交换机，并将潜在的恶意流量重定向到反DDoS服务，以增强系统可靠性。此外，Janus引入了快速路由收敛机制，以有效处理互联网规模的路由更新。过去几年，我们逐渐在生产网络的边缘部署了 Janus。评估结果表明，与现有系统相比，Janus 可以将平均硬件成本降低 78%，同时妥善处理 DDoS 问题。同时，Janus 可以在故障情况下在几秒钟内减少路由收敛，这比现有方法快几个数量级。

papers.title: Count-Based Abstractions for Performance Verification of Contention Points.
papers.abstract: Networking researchers and engineers spend much of their time trying to understand the performance of contention points – network components where multiple incoming packet streams share the same outgoing link(s). Recently, researchers have developed new logical models for analyzing such contention points, but unfortunately, such models are expensive: They do not scale well as buffer capacities increase beyond 10s of packets, making it difficult or impossible to reason about real-world systems faithfully. In this paper, we develop a suite of effective, new abstractions for reasoning about buffers and their performance characteristics. We also show how to architect a performance analysis framework for contention points in a modular way so it can take advantage of a range of abstractions that trade performance off against precision. We evaluate our abstractions against a collection of benchmarks and demonstrate their scaling benefits.
papers.abstract_zh: 网络研究人员和工程师花费大量时间试图了解争用点的性能，即多个传入数据包流共享相同传出链路的网络组件。最近，研究人员开发了新的逻辑模型来分析此类争用点，但不幸的是，此类模型非常昂贵：当缓冲区容量增加到超过 10 个数据包时，它们就无法很好地扩展，从而很难或不可能忠实地推理现实世界的系统。在本文中，我们开发了一套有效的新抽象来推理缓冲区及其性能特征。我们还展示了如何以模块化方式构建针对争用点的性能分析框架，以便它可以利用一系列在性能与精度之间进行权衡的抽象。我们根据一系列基准评估我们的抽象，并展示它们的扩展优势。

papers.title: CrossCheck: Input Validation for WAN Control Systems.
papers.abstract:
We present CrossCheck, a system that validates inputs to the Software-Defined Networking (SDN) controller in a Wide Area Network (WAN). By detecting incorrect inputs—often stemming from bugs in the SDN control infrastructure—CrossCheck alerts operators before they trigger network outages.

Our analysis at a large-scale WAN operator identifies invalid inputs as a leading cause of major outages, and we show how CrossCheck would have prevented those incidents. We deployed CrossCheck as a shadow validation system for four weeks in a production WAN, during which it accurately detected the single incident of invalid inputs that occurred while sustaining a 0% false positive rate under normal operation, hence imposing little additional burden on operators. In addition, we show through simulation that CrossCheck reliably detects a wide range of invalid inputs (e.g., detecting demand perturbations as small as 5% with 100% accuracy) and maintains a near-zero false positive rate for realistic levels of noisy, missing, or buggy telemetry data (e.g., sustaining zero false positives with up to 30% of corrupted telemetry data).
papers.abstract_zh:
我们推出 CrossCheck，这是一个验证广域网 (WAN) 中软件定义网络 (SDN) 控制器输入的系统。通过检测不正确的输入（通常源于 SDN 控制基础设施中的错误），CrossCheck 可以在操作员触发网络中断之前发出警报。

我们对大型 WAN 运营商的分析表明，无效输入是导致重大中断的主要原因，并且我们展示了 CrossCheck 如何防止这些事件。我们在生产广域网中将 CrossCheck 作为影子验证系统部署了四个星期，在此期间，它准确地检测到发生的单个无效输入事件，同时在正常操作下保持 0% 的误报率，因此对操作员几乎没有造成额外的负担。此外，我们通过模拟表明，CrossCheck 能够可靠地检测到各种无效输入（例如，以 100% 的准确度检测小至 5% 的需求扰动），并且对于真实水平的噪声、缺失或有缺陷的遥测数据保持接近于零的误报率（例如，对高达 30% 的损坏遥测数据保持零误报）。

papers.title: CStar Gateway: Augmenting Public Cloud Infrastructure for Heterogeneous Network Function Virtualization.
papers.abstract: Major cloud providers often build NFV products by reusing existing architectures. These designs were originally developed and optimized for tenant virtual machines (VMs) that operate at network endpoints. In contrast, network function (NF) VMs function as intermediate forwarding nodes shared by multiple tenants, which have very different resource demands. Directly applying tenant-oriented designs creates mismatches between infrastructure capabilities and NF requirements. A common case arises when NF VMs serve many tenants: they typically exhaust vNIC and sessions on vSwitches well before CPU resources are saturated. At this point, NF VMs cannot accept additional traffic despite having idle CPU cycles. Providers usually address this by scaling out or scaling up NF VMs, which wastes resources and increases cost. This is just one example, where numerous other mismatches remain. To address these, we present CStar Gateway. CStar Gateway shifts NF VM multi-tenancy support from vSwitches into NF VMs, which reduces vNIC and session bottlenecks with minimal changes to the existing cloud infrastructure. CStar Gateway also identifies and redirects I/O- or CPU-intensive flows to FPGA-based NFs, increasing the service capacity. In addition, CStar Gateway takes over NF VM elasticity support from vSwitch, simplifying and accelerating the scaling process, and thereby enhancing overall system flexibility. Deployment results show that the design improves CPU and I/O utilization of NF VMs by at least 5x and reduces NF cluster capital expenditure by 71.91% to 88.57%.
papers.abstract_zh: 主要云提供商通常通过重用现有架构来构建 NFV 产品。这些设计最初是为在网络端点运行的租户虚拟机 (VM) 开发和优化的。相比之下，网络功能（NF）虚拟机充当多个租户共享的中间转发节点，其资源需求差异很大。直接应用面向租户的设计会造成基础设施功能与 NF 需求之间的不匹配。当 NF VM 为许多租户提供服务时，会出现一种常见情况：它们通常会在 CPU 资源饱和之前耗尽 vNIC 和 vSwitch 上的会话。此时，尽管 NF VM 具有空闲 CPU 周期，但仍无法接受额外流量。提供商通常通过横向扩展或纵向扩展 NF VM 来解决此问题，但这会浪费资源并增加成本。这只是一个例子，还有许多其他不匹配的情况。为了解决这些问题，我们推出了 CStar Gateway。 CStar Gateway 将 NF VM 多租户支持从 vSwitch 转移到 NF VM，从而减少了 vNIC 和会话瓶颈，同时对现有云基础设施进行了最小的更改。 CStar Gateway 还可以识别 I/O 或 CPU 密集型流量并将其重定向到基于 FPGA 的 NF，从而提高服务容量。此外，CStar Gateway接管了vSwitch的NF VM弹性支持，简化并加速了扩展过程，从而增强了整体系统的灵活性。部署结果表明，该设计将NF虚拟机的CPU和I/O利用率提高至少5倍，并将NF集群资本支出降低71.91%至88.57%。

papers.title: DDoS Detection at the Scale of One Hundred Tbps.
papers.abstract: Defending against Distributed Denial-of-Service (DDoS) attacks is a critical priority for cloud providers, who must manage ever-growing volumes of both benign and malicious traffic. While state-of-the-art DDoS detection systems leverage programmable devices to process traffic at hundreds of Gbps to Tbps on a single machine, large-scale cloud providers often handle traffic at scales approaching 100 Tbps. This massive volume—two orders of magnitude higher than the traffic handled by existing systems—motivates us to implement distributed processing across multiple servers, where new challenges are present. Specifically, naive load-balancing strategies lead to imbalanced traffic distribution and severe performance bottlenecks, while function offloading to programmable devices must balance flexibility and adaptability. In this paper, we present Canopy, a scalable DDoS detection system designed to overcome these challenges. Canopy features a dynamic load-balancing mechanism that adapts to fluctuating traffic patterns, ensuring balanced distribution across detection servers despite the mix of mice and elephant flows. Additionally, it employs a traffic compression technique at the programmable switch to significantly reduce per-server workload. These innovations enable Canopy to scale to over 100 Tbps in real-world deployments. Successfully deployed in production, Canopy has demonstrated its effectiveness in mitigating large-scale DDoS attacks.
papers.abstract_zh: 防御分布式拒绝服务 (DDoS) 攻击是云提供商的首要任务，他们必须管理不断增长的良性和恶意流量。虽然最先进的 DDoS 检测系统利用可编程设备在单台机器上处理数百 Gbps 到 Tbps 的流量，但大型云提供商通常处理接近 100 Tbps 的流量。如此巨大的流量（比现有系统处理的流量高出两个数量级）促使我们在多个服务器上实现分布式处理，这也带来了新的挑战。具体来说，简单的负载平衡策略会导致流量分配不平衡和严重的性能瓶颈，而功能卸载到可编程设备必须平衡灵活性和适应性。在本文中，我们提出了 Canopy，这是一种可扩展的 DDoS 检测系统，旨在克服这些挑战。 Canopy 具有动态负载平衡机制，可适应波动的流量模式，确保检测服务器之间的平衡分配，尽管存在老鼠和大象流量。此外，它在可编程交换机上采用流量压缩技术，可显着减少每台服务器的工作负载。这些创新使 Canopy 在实际部署中能够扩展到超过 100 Tbps。 Canopy 已成功部署在生产环境中，展示了其在缓解大规模 DDoS 攻击方面的有效性。

papers.title: Decoding RSSI Compression in RFID: Dynamic RCS Modeling and Tag-Intrinsic Power Metrics for Reliable Backscatter Networks.
papers.abstract: Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) is a foundational element of modern IoT and backscatter networks, powering inventory, localization, and battery-free sensing at scale. In this paper, we uncover RSSI compression , a power-dependent bias in reader-measured RSSI, as a critical physical-layer problem that propagates upward in the network stack, degrading MAC-layer collision resolution, network-layer link estimation, and application-layer reliability. Through carefully designed experiments, we trace this distortion to dynamic tag Radar Cross Section (RCS) behavior and introduce two novel physical-layer metrics: Interrogation Threshold Power (ITP), a channel-specific metric for accurate link-quality estimation, and Backscatter Power Index (BPI), a tag-intrinsic, environment-agnostic signature. These metrics provide high-fidelity signal information that higher layers can directly exploit for more robust collision detection, power control, localization and sensing tasks. Finally, an in-situ single-query method further reduces measurement overhead by 99.8%, while cutting channel-estimation error by 64.7%, delivering significant cross-layer performance gains in real-world backscatter networks.
papers.abstract_zh: 射频识别 (RFID) 是现代物联网和反向散射网络的基本要素，为大规模库存、定位和无电池传感提供支持。在本文中，我们发现 RSSI 压缩（读取器测量的 RSSI 中的一种与功率相关的偏差）是一个关键的物理层问题，会在网络堆栈中向上传播，从而降低 MAC 层冲突解决、网络层链路估计和应用层可靠性。通过精心设计的实验，我们将这种失真追溯到动态标签雷达截面（RCS）行为，并引入了两种新颖的物理层指标：询问阈值功率（ITP），一种用于准确估计链路质量的特定于通道的指标，以及反向散射功率指数（BPI），一种标签固有的、与环境无关的签名。这些指标提供了高保真信号信息，高层可以直接利用这些信息来实现更强大的碰撞检测、功率控制、定位和传感任务。最后，原位单查询方法进一步将测量开销减少了 99.8%，同时将信道估计误差减少了 64.7%，从而在现实世界的反向散射网络中实现了显着的跨层性能提升。

papers.title: Defeating Slow-and-Low Threats via Diffusion Model-based Generative Inference.
papers.abstract: Content Delivery Networks (CDNs) are known to be vulnerable to slow-and-low threats that exploit trusted protocols while evading threshold-based defense at the edge. Our work addresses three limitations at edge defense: constrained resources, absence of a behavior monitor, and impractical assumptions for online detection. To defeat slow-and-low threats, we propose SketchVision , a vision-inspired detection framework that redefines flow behavior monitoring and attack detection under resource-constrained settings. We introduce a vision-inspired sketch that encodes packet-level temporal patterns of all flows into a compact image, a diffusion model tailored for sketch denoising, and a generative inference pipeline to forecast mature flow states from partial observations for early detection. Implemented with eBPF-enabled data planes and diffusion-based control, SketchVision achieves robust accuracy across 19 types of slow-and-low attacks, reaching an average AUC of 0.982 and F1 score of 0.913, improving detection by up to 29% over the state-of-the-art methods, while remaining efficient for large-scale CDN edge deployment.
papers.abstract_zh: 众所周知，内容交付网络 (CDN) 很容易受到缓慢且低度的威胁的影响，这些威胁利用可信协议，同时规避边缘基于阈值的防御。我们的工作解决了边缘防御的三个限制：资源有限、缺乏行为监视器以及在线检测的不切实际的假设。为了战胜慢速和低速威胁，我们提出了 SketchVision，这是一种受视觉启发的检测框架，它重新定义了资源受限设置下的流行为监控和攻击检测。我们引入了一个受视觉启发的草图，将所有流的数据包级时间模式编码为紧凑的图像，一个为草图去噪量身定制的扩散模型，以及一个生成推理管道，用于根据部分观察预测成熟的流状态以进行早期检测。 SketchVision 通过支持 eBPF 的数据平面和基于扩散的控制来实现，在 19 种慢速和低速攻击中实现了强大的准确性，平均 AUC 为 0.982，F1 分数为 0.913，与最先进的方法相比，检测性能提高了 29%，同时保持大规模 CDN 边缘部署的效率。

papers.title: Defending against Traffic Analysis Attacks with Flexible In-Network Obfuscation.
papers.abstract: Traffic analysis attacks can exploit side channels in encrypted traffic (e.g., packet sizes) to infer user activities. Existing defenses provide weak protection, impose excessive bandwidth overhead, or require hard-to-deploy coordination. We present Securitas, a novel network traffic obfuscation framework that protects from side-channel attacks using a learning-guided mix of packet fragmentation and insertion. We implemented Securitas on a number of different data planes: Tofino switch, AMD/Xilinx FPGA, eBPF, and BMv2. Experiments show that Securitas reduces attack accuracy by up to 95.89%, while consuming 42.69× less bandwidth than prior defenses. Real-world Internet tests confirm minimal performance impact, e.g., adding 0.15s to the web page load.
papers.abstract_zh: 流量分析攻击可以利用加密流量中的侧通道（例如数据包大小）来推断用户活动。现有的防御措施提供的保护很弱，会带来过多的带宽开销，或者需要难以部署的协调。我们推出了 Securitas，这是一种新颖的网络流量混淆框架，它使用数据包分段和插入的学习引导组合来防止侧通道攻击。我们在许多不同的数据平面上实现了 Securitas：Tofino 交换机、AMD/Xilinx FPGA、eBPF 和 BMv2。实验表明，Securitas 将攻击准确率降低了 95.89%，同时消耗的带宽比之前的防御减少了 42.69 倍。真实世界的互联网测试证实对性能的影响最小，例如，网页加载时间增加 0.15 秒。

papers.title: Detecting and Diagnosing Errors in Serving Archived Web Pages.
papers.abstract:
Web archives crawl and save copies of pages from the web, enabling users to interact with web pages in the form they existed in the past. Prior to serving any archived page, an archive rewrites the page’s source so that users’ browsers fetch the page’s resources from the archive, not from the servers which originally hosted them. But, on many modern pages, an archive’s edits to crawled scripts result in a loss of fidelity, i.e., an archived copy fails to accurately mimic the original page even when the archive had crawled all resources on the page.

To help the developers of archival systems identify and fix the bugs which result in incorrect rewrites of crawled pages, we present FidEx. First, FidEx enables accurate identification of the pages on which an archive violates fidelity. It does so by tracking and comparing the execution of scripts between when a page is crawled and when its copy is loaded. In comparison to existing methods which compare the two loads using either screenshots or the errors reported by the browser, FidEx reduces the false positive rate from around 70% to less than 10%. Second, on every page on which it identifies a loss of fidelity, FidEx pinpoints which subset of the archive’s edits to the page are erroneous. Leveraging this input to fix bugs in the most widely used archival system, we reduced the fraction of archived pages which violate fidelity from 15% to 9%.
papers.abstract_zh:
网络档案从网络上抓取并保存页面的副本，使用户能够以过去存在的形式与网页进行交互。在提供任何存档页面之前，存档会重写页面的源代码，以便用户的浏览器从存档中获取页面的资源，而不是从最初托管它们的服务器获取页面的资源。但是，在许多现代页面上，存档对爬网脚本的编辑会导致保真度损失，即，即使存档已爬网页面上的所有资源，存档副本也无法准确模仿原始页面。

为了帮助档案系统的开发人员识别并修复导致爬网页面错误重写的错误，我们推出了 FidEx。首先，FidEx 能够准确识别存档违反保真度的页面。它通过跟踪和比较页面爬行和加载其副本之间脚本的执行来实现这一点。与使用屏幕截图或浏览器报告的错误来比较两个负载的现有方法相比，FidEx 将误报率从 70% 左右降低到 10% 以下。其次，在识别出保真度损失的每个页面上，FidEx 都会查明存档对该页面的编辑的哪个子集是错误的。利用此输入来修复最广泛使用的归档系统中的错误，我们将违反保真度的归档页面比例从 15% 减少到 9%。

papers.title: Di-PS: System-Algorithm Co-Design for Asynchronous and Heterogeneous Cross-cluster LLM Training at Scale.
papers.abstract:
Large language models (LLMs) have revolutionized artificial intelligence, exhibiting remarkable performance in various tasks. Training these models demands extensive computational resources, which are often economically and physically prohibitive. Cross-cluster training can balance infrastructure costs, alleviate physical and resource constraints, better match workload demands, and sustain higher efficiency through geo-distributed deployment. However, challenges arise from network variability, heterogeneous computational resources, and intrinsic training instability.

To address these issues, we present Di-PS, a novel framework for cross-cluster LLM training at scale. The core of Di-PS is the system-algorithm co-design of a parameter server paradigm, to achieve heterogeneous, asynchronous, and resilient training across decentralized clusters. We make several innovative contributions in Di-PS, including (i) an efficient parameter server design for cross-cluster communication of LLM parameters, (ii) a pseudo-gradient penalty strategy for convergence stability enhancement of asynchronous two-stage optimization, and (iii) a resilience mechanism for fault tolerance in cross-cluster training. Results from the controlled experimental setting demonstrate that Di-PS improves training efficiency by up to 4.67× over synchronous cross-cluster approaches while maintaining model quality, and achieving near-linear scalability in heterogeneous training resources. Di-PS has been deployed in the production environment, involving dynamic training scales with up to 9 clusters and more than 10,000 NPUs. At this scale, Di-PS enables successful cross-cluster training of a 100B-parameter LLM with only 6% overhead compared to single-cluster training, and effectively handles frequent failures and resource changes.
papers.abstract_zh:
大型语言模型（LLM）彻底改变了人工智能，在各种任务中表现出了卓越的性能。训练这些模型需要大量的计算资源，这在经济和物理上往往是令人望而却步的。跨集群训练可以平衡基础设施成本，缓解物理和资源限制，更好地匹配工作负载需求，并通过地理分布式部署维持更高的效率。然而，网络可变性、异构计算资源和内在训练不稳定性带来了挑战。

为了解决这些问题，我们提出了 Di-PS，这是一种用于大规模跨集群 LLM 培训的新颖框架。 Di-PS的核心是参数服务器范式的系统算法协同设计，以实现跨去中心化集群的异构、异步和弹性训练。我们在 Di-PS 中做出了多项创新贡献，包括（i）用于 LLM 参数跨集群通信的高效参数服务器设计，（ii）用于增强异步两阶段优化收敛稳定性的伪梯度惩罚策略，以及（iii）跨集群训练容错的弹性机制。受控实验设置的结果表明，Di-PS 比同步跨集群方法将训练效率提高了 4.67 倍，同时保持了模型质量，并在异构训练资源中实现了近线性可扩展性。 Di-PS已部署在生产环境中，涉及多达9个集群和超过10,000个NPU的动态训练规模。在这种规模下，Di-PS 能够成功实现 100B 参数 LLM 的跨集群训练，与单集群训练相比，开销仅为 6%，并有效处理频繁的故障和资源变更。

papers.title: Diagnosing and Repairing Distributed Routing Configurations Using Selective Symbolic Simulation.
papers.abstract: Although substantial progress has been made in automatically verifying whether distributed routing configurations comply with certain intents, diagnosing and repairing configuration errors remains manual and time-consuming. To fill this gap, we propose S2Sim, a novel system for automatic routing configuration diagnosis and repair. Our key insight is that by deriving a set of contracts that guarantees an intent-compliant variant of the erroneous configuration, we can systematically check for all contract violations in the configuration via symbolic simulation to pinpoint and repair the errors. S2Sim also introduces a series of extensions to support complex configurations (e.g., ACL, route aggregation and multi-path routing), networks (e.g., underlay and overlay networks), and intents (e.g., k-link failure tolerance). We fully implement S2Sim and evaluate its performance using real configurations from two major providers and synthesized configurations composed from their real errors and real-world topologies with different scales O(10) to O(1000). Results show that S2Sim accurately and efficiently diagnoses and repairs real configuration errors (i.e., up to 20 seconds in real networks of O(100) nodes and up to 15 minutes in synthesized networks of O(1000) nodes).
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管在自动验证分布式路由配置是否符合某些意图方面已经取得了实质性进展，但诊断和修复配置错误仍然需要手动且耗时。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了 S2Sim，一种用于自动路由配置诊断和修复的新颖系统。我们的主要见解是，通过派生一组保证错误配置的符合意图的变体的合约，我们可以通过符号模拟系统地检查配置中的所有合约违规情况，以查明并修复错误。 S2Sim 还引入了一系列扩展来支持复杂的配置（例如 ACL、路由聚合和多路径路由）、网络（例如底层和覆盖网络）和意图（例如 k-link 容错）。我们完全实现 S2Sim 并使用来自两个主要提供商的真实配置以及由其真实错误和具有不同规模 O(10) 到 O(1000) 的真实世界拓扑组成的合成配置来评估其性能。结果表明，S2Sim 能够准确、高效地诊断和修复真实配置错误（即，在 O(100) 个节点的真实网络中最多需要 20 秒，在 O(1000) 个节点的合成网络中最多需要 15 分钟）。

papers.title: DistRS: Disaggregated Reward Service for RLVR with Batch-Level Constraint.
papers.abstract:
Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a key post-training paradigm for enhancing the capabilities of large language models (LLMs). As the complexity increases and resource consumption grows, reward computation is becoming a critical workload in the RLVR training process.

We present DistRS, a disaggregated reward service framework designed to provide resource-efficient reward computation for RLVR training. Through the analysis of a real RLVR training task, we observe that the reward service faces a highly dynamic workload, motivating the need for elasticity and multi-tenancy. DistRS leverages request-level flexibility from the request-in, batch-out characteristic of reward computation to design more resource-efficient scaling and scheduling policies. Specifically, DistRS establishes a batch-level constraint for each training task that relaxes latency requirements at the request level. Building on this foundation, we design a history-based resource scaling policy and a batch-level priority-based request scheduling policy. In addition, DistRS incorporates a timeout-aware mechanism to adjust resource allocation, thereby mitigating the impact of deviations between history and actual execution. We evaluate DistRS with real-world RLVR training tasks and the results demonstrate that DistRS reduces resource consumption by up to 3.79× while incurring minimal overhead on training progress.
papers.abstract_zh:
具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已成为增强大型语言模型（LLM）能力的关键后训练范例。随着复杂性的增加和资源消耗的增加，奖励计算正成为 RLVR 训练过程中的关键工作负载。

我们提出了 DistRS，一个分类奖励服务框架，旨在为 RLVR 训练提供资源高效的奖励计算。通过对真实 RLVR 训练任务的分析，我们观察到奖励服务面临高度动态的工作负载，激发了对弹性和多租户的需求。 DistRS 利用奖励计算的请求输入、批量输出特性的请求级灵活性来设计更资源高效的扩展和调度策略。具体来说，DistRS 为每个训练任务建立了批处理级约束，放宽了请求级的延迟要求。在此基础上，我们设计了基于历史的资源扩展策略和基于批处理优先级的请求调度策略。此外，DistRS还采用了超时感知机制来调整资源分配，从而减轻历史执行与实际执行之间的偏差的影响。我们使用现实世界的 RLVR 训练任务来评估 DistRS，结果表明，DistRS 将资源消耗减少了高达 3.79 倍，同时训练进度的开销最小。

papers.title: DistVS: Large-scale Vector Search with Compute-Memory Disaggregation.
papers.abstract: Similarity-based vector search, also known as ANNS, underlies many important applications such as content search, recommender system, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). However, vector search has a high storage demand due to large datasets and incurs costly IOs for its fine-grained access to the vectors and index. We observe that a compute-memory disaggregation architecture can tackle these challenges and design the DistVS system with a three-tier storage layout. In particular, the compute servers keep the small but low-precision compressed vectors, a more capacious memory server stores larger high-precision compressed vectors along with the index, while the full-precision exact vectors are kept on SSDs. The idea is to progressively prune the vector accesses along the low-high-full precisions from the compute servers to the SSDs, aligning with the storage hierarchy of memory-network-disk with gradually larger capacity but higher IO cost. To effectively utilize the three vector previsions, we design an algorithm called PRESS to conduct vector search. To improve performance, DistVS incorporates system optimizations including asynchronous execution, RDMA IO batching, and decoupled re-ranking. We compare DistVS with state-of-the-art disk-based and distributed vector search systems and show that DistVS consistently outperforms them and usually improves their query throughput by over 40%.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于相似性的向量搜索（也称为 ANNS）是许多重要应用的基础，例如内容搜索、推荐系统和检索增强生成 (RAG)。然而，由于数据集较大，向量搜索具有很高的存储需求，并且对向量和索引的细粒度访问会产生昂贵的 IO。我们观察到计算内存分解架构可以解决这些挑战，并设计具有三层存储布局的 DistVS 系统。特别是，计算服务器保留小但低精度的压缩向量，容量更大的内存服务器存储更大的高精度压缩向量以及索引，而全精度精确向量则保存在 SSD 上。这个想法是沿着从计算服务器到SSD的低-高全精度逐步修剪向量访问，与容量逐渐增大但IO成本较高的内存-网络-磁盘的存储层次结构保持一致。为了有效地利用这三种向量预测，我们设计了一种称为 PRESS 的算法来进行向量搜索。为了提高性能，DistVS 结合了系统优化，包括异步执行、RDMA IO 批处理和解耦重排序。我们将 DistVS 与最先进的基于磁盘的分布式矢量搜索系统进行比较，结果表明，DistVS 始终优于它们，并且通常将其查询吞吐量提高 40% 以上。

papers.title: DroidSpeak: KV Cache Sharing Across Fine-tuned Model Variants.
papers.abstract:
Compound AI systems , such as agentic systems, are an emerging trend in large-scale enterprise settings, with multiple LLMs specialized for different users, tasks, and/or roles working together. In these scenarios, different models often process inputs that share the same context prefix. Although much work was done in the past to enable the reuse of prefix KV caches across inputs for a single model, how to enable one model to reuse the prefix KV caches of a different model remains an open question.

We introduce DroidSpeak, the first distributed LLM inference system that enables KV cache reuse across distributed nodes running inference of different LLMs, so long as the LLMs have the same architecture. We present the first study that aims at understanding the impact of sharing KV caches across different LLMs, and if/when such sharing affects quality. Inspired by the findings, we present DroidSpeak, which selectively recomputes a few layers of the KV cache produced by another LLM and reuses the remaining layers, with negligible quality loss. Moreover, carefully pipelining the layer-wise re-computation and the loading of reused KV cache further improves the inference performance. Experiments on diverse datasets and model pairs demonstrate that DroidSpeak achieves up to 4x throughput improvement and about 3.1× faster prefill (time to first token), with negligible loss of quality in F1 scores, Rouge-L or code similarity score, compared to the baseline which does not allow any sharing across models.
papers.abstract_zh:
复合人工智能系统（例如代理系统）是大型企业环境中的新兴趋势，多个法学硕士专门针对不同的用户、任务和/或角色一起工作。在这些场景中，不同的模型通常处理共享相同上下文前缀的输入。尽管过去已经做了很多工作来实现单个模型的跨输入重用前缀 KV 缓存，但如何使一个模型能够重用不同模型的前缀 KV 缓存仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。

我们推出了 DroidSpeak，这是第一个分布式 LLM 推理系统，只要 LLM 具有相同的架构，它就可以在运行不同 LLM 推理的分布式节点之间重用 KV 缓存。我们提出了第一项研究，旨在了解跨不同 LLM 共享 KV 缓存的影响，以及这种共享是否/何时会影响质量。受这些发现的启发，我们提出了 DroidSpeak，它有选择地重新计算另一个 LLM 生成的 KV 缓存的几层，并重用剩余的层，质量损失可以忽略不计。此外，仔细地流水线化分层重新计算和重用 KV 缓存的加载进一步提高了推理性能。对不同数据集和模型对的实验表明，与不允许跨模型共享的基线相比，DroidSpeak 的吞吐量提高了 4 倍，预填充速度（第一个令牌的时间）提高了约 3.1 倍，F1 分数、Rouge-L 或代码相似性分数的质量损失可以忽略不计。

papers.title: Enabling AI Network Cross-Layer Design and Operations with Arcadia: A Simulation Platform at Scale.
papers.abstract: The rapid evolution of Artificial Intelligence (AI) technology is fueling significant investments by hyperscalers, making AI networks crucial for large-scale training. Understanding the design impacts on AI training requires systematic, cross-layer evaluation. Production experience highlights the need for a robust simulation platform to guide network design and operations. This paper defines the platform requirements, addresses complex design challenges, and shares our experience building Arcadia, a scalable, high-fidelity simulation platform for AI Networks. It operates at the cluster level, focusing on overall cluster performance rather than individual job performance. By using our fast-forwarding, lock free, and synchronization-cost reduction mechanisms, Arcadia achieves scalability and speed, allowing us to faithfully simulate real-world-scale training clusters and plays an important role in guiding Meta's AI network evolution.
papers.abstract_zh: 人工智能 (AI) 技术的快速发展正在推动超大规模企业的大量投资，使人工智能网络对于大规模训练至关重要。了解设计对人工智能训练的影响需要系统的、跨层的评估。生产经验强调需要一个强大的仿真平台来指导网络设计和运营。本文定义了平台要求，解决了复杂的设计挑战，并分享了我们构建 Arcadia（一个可扩展的高保真人工智能网络仿真平台）的经验。它在集群级别运行，关注整体集群性能而不是单个作业性能。通过使用我们的快进、无锁和同步成本降低机制，Arcadia 实现了可扩展性和速度，使我们能够忠实地模拟真实世界规模的训练集群，并在指导 Meta 的 AI 网络演进方面发挥重要作用。

papers.title: Enabling SLO-Aware 5G Multi-Access Edge Computing with SMEC.
papers.abstract: 5G Multi-access edge computing (MEC) promises to enable latency-critical applications by bringing computational power closer to mobile devices, but our measurements on commercial MEC deployments reveal frequent SLO violations due to high tail latencies. We identify resource contention at the RAN and the edge server as the root cause, compounded by SLO-unaware schedulers. Existing SLO-aware MEC schedulers require RAN-edge coordination, making them impractical for deployment and prone to poor performance due to coordination delays, limited heterogeneous application support, and ignoring edge resource contention. This paper introduces MEC, a practical, SLO-aware resource management framework that facilitates deadline-aware scheduling through fully decoupled operations at the RAN and edge servers. Our key insight is that standard 5G protocols and application behaviors naturally provide information exploitable for SLO-aware management without extensive infrastructure or application changes. Evaluation on our 5G testbed shows that MEC achieves 90–96% SLO satisfaction versus under 6% for existing approaches, while reducing tail latency by up to 122×.
papers.abstract_zh: 5G 多接入边缘计算 (MEC) 有望通过使计算能力更接近移动设备来支持延迟关键型应用程序，但我们对商业 MEC 部署的测量表明，由于高尾延迟，经常出现 SLO 违规。我们将 RAN 和边缘服务器上的资源争用视为根本原因，并且由不了解 SLO 的调度程序加剧。现有的 SLO 感知 MEC 调度程序需要 RAN 边缘协调，这使得它们部署不切实际，并且由于协调延迟、有限的异构应用程序支持和忽略边缘资源争用而容易导致性能不佳。本文介绍了 MEC，这是一种实用的、SLO 感知的资源管理框架，它通过 RAN 和边缘服务器上的完全解耦操作来促进截止时间感知的调度。我们的主要见解是，标准 5G 协议和应用程序行为自然会提供可用于 SLO 感知管理的信息，而无需进行大量基础设施或应用程序更改。对我们 5G 测试台的评估表明，MEC 实现了 90-96% 的 SLO 满意度，而现有方法的 SLO 满意度低于 6%，同时将尾部延迟降低了高达 122 倍。

papers.title: EROICA: Online Performance Troubleshooting for Large-scale Model Training.
papers.abstract: Troubleshooting performance problems of large model training (LMT) is immensely challenging, due to unprecedented scales of modern GPU clusters, the complexity of software-hardware interactions, and the data intensity of the training process. Existing troubleshooting approaches designed for traditional distributed systems or datacenter networks fall short and can hardly apply to real-world training systems. In this paper, we present EROICA, the first online troubleshooting system that provides both fine-grained observation based on profiling, and coverage of all machines in GPU clusters, to diagnose performance issues in production, including both hardware and software problems (or the mixture of both). EROICA effectively summarizes runtime behavior patterns of LMT function executions via online profiling, and leverages differential observability to localize the root cause with minimal production impact. EROICA has been deployed as a production service for large-scale GPU clusters of ~100,000 GPUs for 1.5 years. It has diagnosed a variety of difficult performance issues with 97.5% success.
papers.abstract_zh: 由于现代 GPU 集群规模空前、软硬件交互的复杂性以及训练过程的数据强度，解决大型模型训练 (LMT) 的性能问题极具挑战性。现有的针对传统分布式系统或数据中心网络设计的故障排除方法存在缺陷，很难应用于现实世界的训练系统。在本文中，我们介绍了 EROICA，这是第一个在线故障排除系统，它既提供基于分析的细粒度观察，又覆盖 GPU 集群中的所有机器，以诊断生产中的性能问题，包括硬件和软件问题（或两者的混合）。 EROICA 通过在线分析有效总结 LMT 函数执行的运行时行为模式，并利用差异可观测性以最小的生产影响来定位根本原因。 EROICA 已作为约 100,000 个 GPU 的大规模 GPU 集群的生产服务部署了 1.5 年。它以 97.5% 的成功率诊断了各种困难的性能问题。

papers.title: Express Lane to Efficiency and Reliability: Multi-Dimensional Control in Meta's Express Backbone Network.
papers.abstract: Meta’s Express Backbone (EBB) network interconnects data centers across the globe. As such, it is one of the largest WANs in terms of capacity, traffic and global reach. EBB’s unique multi-plane Software Defined Network (SDN) architecture has passed the test of time with its flexibility, reliability and performance. Nonetheless, in parallel to its success, it has also seen an unprecedented growth in traffic demand and capacity footprint. Along with the rapid rise of AI workloads, challenges in resource utilization and failure recovery started to emerge, driving us to enhance and evolve EBB’s control design to increase its efficiency and resiliency. From our operational experiences, we realize that while foundational per-plane Traffic Engineering (TE) control offers simplicity, there still exists a gap to support the above two goals. We propose to introduce control in two additional dimensions: globally across planes and locally at individual device. Specifically, Unequal Cost Multi-Path (UCMP) enables control across planes for efficient load balancing, and Fast Re-Route (FRR) provides control across time slices for facilitating rapid detection and recovery from failures.
