We present the design, implementation, and production results of UCMP and FRR, demonstrating how EBB can adapt to AI-era demands rapidly without fundamental architectural changes.
papers.abstract_zh: Meta 的 Express Backbone (EBB) 网络互连全球的数据中心。因此，就容量、流量和全球覆盖范围而言，它是最大的广域网之一。 EBB独特的多平面软件定义网络（SDN）架构以其灵活性、可靠性和性能经受了时间的考验。尽管如此，在取得成功的同时，交通需求和运力足迹也出现了前所未有的增长。随着人工智能工作负载的快速增长，资源利用和故障恢复方面的挑战开始出现，促使我们增强和发展 EBB 的控制设计，以提高其效率和弹性。根据我们的运营经验，我们意识到，虽然基础的每平面流量工程 (TE) 控制提供了简单性，但在支持上述两个目标方面仍然存在差距。我们建议在两个额外的维度上引入控制：跨平面的全局控制和单个设备的本地控制。具体来说，不等成本多路径（UCMP）可以实现跨平面的控制，以实现高效的负载平衡，快速重路由（FRR）可以提供跨时间片的控制，以便于快速检测和从故障中恢复。我们展示了 UCMP 和 FRR 的设计、实现和生产结果，展示了 EBB 如何在不进行根本架构更改的情况下快速适应 AI 时代的需求。

papers.title: eXpressSFU: Toward Super-Scalable Video Conferencing with SmartNICs.
papers.abstract:
Video conferencing has emerged as a critical Internet application. Unlike video-on-demand services, high-quality video conferencing necessitates minimal latency, as media streams are generated, transmitted, processed, forwarded and received in real time. Our empirical analysis reveals that processing latency at the media server, particularly Selective Forwarding Units (SFUs), is the dominant barrier to scalability. Notably, cryptography, memory, and I/O operations account for approximately 79% of the media packet processing latency.

In this paper, we introduce eXpressSFU , a re-architected video conferencing system designed to significantly enhance scalability for large-scale and high-quality video conferences. By decoupling the fast-control and data planes from the slow-control plane, eXpressSFU accelerates the media packet processing pipeline through the use of emerging network technologies, such as Smart Network Interface Cards (SmartNICs). Experimental results show that our system reduces packet processing latency by a factor of 8. This improvement allows it to support 3× more concurrent users while cutting computational power consumption by up to 60%.
papers.abstract_zh:
视频会议已成为一种重要的互联网应用。与视频点播服务不同，高质量视频会议需要最小的延迟，因为媒体流是实时生成、传输、处理、转发和接收的。我们的实证分析表明，媒体服务器（尤其是选择性转发单元 (SFU)）的处理延迟是可扩展性的主要障碍。值得注意的是，加密、内存和 I/O 操作约占媒体数据包处理延迟的 79%。

在本文中，我们介绍了 eXpressSFU，这是一种重新架构的视频会议系统，旨在显着增强大规模和高质量视频会议的可扩展性。通过将快速控制平面和数据平面与慢速控制平面解耦，eXpressSFU 通过使用智能网络接口卡 (SmartNIC) 等新兴网络技术来加速媒体数据包处理管道。实验结果表明，我们的系统将数据包处理延迟降低了 8 倍。这一改进使其能够支持 3 倍以上的并发用户，同时将计算功耗降低高达 60%。

papers.title: Eywa: Automating Model-Based Testing using LLMs.
papers.abstract:
Model-based testing (MBT), whereby a model of the system under test is analyzed to generate high-coverage test cases, has been used to test protocol implementations. A key barrier to the use of MBT is the need for users to understand protocol RFCs in detail to create a compliant model.

Our new approach to MBT uses LLMs to automatically build rich models of intended protocol behavior from knowledge embedded in Request for Comments documents (RFCs), blogs, and other natural language sources. Our approach addresses key challenges with using LLMs, including hallucinations and their inability to monolithically generate complex protocol models. We realize our approach through a novel protocol testing framework EYWA, and demonstrate its effectiveness through extensive case studies of DNS and BGP, and a smaller study of SMTP. Despite minimal user effort, applying EYWA enabled the discovery of 33 unique bugs across widely used DNS, BGP, and SMTP implementations, 16 of which were previously undiscovered despite extensive prior testing with manually crafted models.
papers.abstract_zh:
基于模型的测试（MBT）已被用于测试协议实现，通过该模型分析被测系统的模型以生成高覆盖率的测试用例。使用 MBT 的一个主要障碍是用户需要详细了解协议 RFC 以创建兼容模型。

我们的 MBT 新方法使用 LLM，根据征求意见文档 (RFC)、博客和其他自然语言源中嵌入的知识，自动构建丰富的预期协议行为模型。我们的方法解决了使用法学硕士的关键挑战，包括幻觉和它们无法整体生成复杂的协议模型。我们通过新颖的协议测试框架 EYWA 实现我们的方法，并通过 DNS 和 BGP 的广泛案例研究以及 SMTP 的小型研究证明其有效性。尽管用户付出的努力很少，但应用 EYWA 在广泛使用的 DNS、BGP 和 SMTP 实现中发现了 33 个独特的错误，其中 16 个错误以前未被发现，尽管之前使用手动制作的模型进行了广泛的测试。

papers.title: EZ-SAVE: Evaluation of Easy-to-Deploy Source Address Validation Policies.
papers.abstract:
The lack of Source Address Validation (SAV) is a significant vulnerability of the Internet, which is abused in many Denial-of-Service (DoS) and other attacks. Several IETF RFCs define easy-to-deploy, non-interactive SAV designs ; the IETF is currently developing another SAV mechanism, BAR-SAV, which, as its name suggests, uses B GP, A SPA (Autonomous System Provider Authorization), and R OA (Route Origin Authorization) data. However, no comparative evaluation of the potential impact of their large-scale deployment has been done. A recent survey of network vendors and operators indicates that more efficacy data and usage guidelines are necessary to motivate their adoption.

We present EZ-SAVE , the first simulation-based analysis evaluating easy-to-deploy SAV policies. We measure both the spoofed traffic detection rates and the legitimate traffic filtering (false-positive) rates for each standard and proposed design at different adoption rates, using a realistic Internet topology and traffic engineering policies. Our results reveal several significant insights that may assist and guide the standardization process as well as developers and operators. In particular, we find that BAR-SAV proves to be the most effective design that features high spoof detection rates and low (or even zero) false-positive rates, motivating its standardization and deployment. Our results also provide operators with guidance on other SAV mechanisms that are effective for specific scenarios. In addition, our results highlight the importance of using realistic export policies for SAV evaluation.
papers.abstract_zh:
缺乏源地址验证 (SAV) 是互联网的一个重大漏洞，在许多拒绝服务 (DoS) 和其他攻击中被滥用。多个 IETF RFC 定义了易于部署的非交互式 SAV 设计； IETF目前正在开发另一种SAV机制BAR-SAV，顾名思义，它使用B GP、A SPA（自治系统提供商授权）和ROA（路由起源授权）数据。然而，尚未对其大规模部署的潜在影响进行比较评估。最近对网络供应商和运营商的一项调查表明，需要更多的功效数据和使用指南来推动其采用。

我们推出 EZ-SAVE，这是第一个基于模拟的分析，评估易于部署的 SAV 策略。我们使用现实的互联网拓扑和流量工程策略，测量不同采用率下每个标准和建议设计的欺骗流量检测率和合法流量过滤（误报）率。我们的结果揭示了一些重要的见解，可以帮助和指导标准化过程以及开发人员和运营商。特别是，我们发现 BAR-SAV 被证明是最有效的设计，具有高欺骗检测率和低（甚至零）误报率，从而推动了其标准化和部署。我们的结果还为运营商提供了针对特定场景有效的其他 SAV 机制的指导。此外，我们的结果凸显了使用现实的出口政策进行 SAV 评估的重要性。

papers.title: FalconFS: Distributed File System for Large-Scale Deep Learning Pipeline.
papers.abstract: Client-side metadata caching has long been considered an effective method for accelerating metadata operations in distributed file systems (DFSs). However, we have found that client-side state (e.g., caching) is not only ineffective but also consumes valuable memory resources in the deep learning pipelines. We thus propose FalconFS, a DFS optimized for deep learning pipelines with the stateless-client architecture. Specifically, instead of performing client-side path resolution and caching, FalconFS efficiently resolves paths on the server side using hybrid metadata indexing and lazy namespace replication . FalconFS also boosts server concurrency with concurrent request merging and provides easy deployment with VFS shortcut . Evaluations against CephFS and Lustre show that FalconFS achieves up to 5.72× throughput for small file read/write and up to 12.81× throughput for deep learning model training. FalconFS has been running in Huawei autonomous driving system's production environment with 10,000 NPUs for one year and has been open-sourced.
papers.abstract_zh: 客户端元数据缓存长期以来一直被认为是加速分布式文件系统（DFS）中元数据操作的有效方法。然而，我们发现客户端状态（例如缓存）不仅无效，而且还会消耗深度学习管道中宝贵的内存资源。因此，我们提出了 FalconFS，这是一种针对具有无状态客户端架构的深度学习管道进行优化的 DFS。具体来说，FalconFS 不是执行客户端路径解析和缓存，而是使用混合元数据索引和惰性命名空间复制在服务器端有效解析路径。 FalconFS 还通过并发请求合并提高服务器并发性，并通过 VFS 快捷方式提供轻松部署。针对 CephFS 和 Lustre 的评估表明，FalconFS 在小文件读写方面实现了高达 5.72 倍的吞吐量，在深度学习模型训练方面实现了高达 12.81 倍的吞吐量。 FalconFS已在华为自动驾驶系统1万个NPU的生产环境中运行一年，并已开源。

papers.title: FAST: An Efficient Scheduler for All-to-All GPU Communication.
papers.abstract:
All-to-All(v) communication is a critical primitive in modern machine learning workloads, particularly mixture-of-experts (MoE) models. Unfortunately, efficient scheduling is challenging due to workload skew, heterogeneous two-tier fabrics, and incast congestion, compounded by the dynamic nature of MoE workloads, where traffic shifts every few hundred milliseconds. Existing schedulers are hardly scalable, incurring seconds to hours of synthesis time, making them impractical.

We present FAST, an efficient All-to-All(v) scheduler. FAST addresses skew through intra-server rebalancing and enforces balanced, one-to-one scale-out transfers that avoid incast. Evaluated extensively on both NVIDIA H200 and AMD MI300X clusters, FAST consistently outperforms state-of-the-art solutions on skewed workloads while reducing synthesis time by orders of magnitude.
papers.abstract_zh:
All-to-All(v) 通信是现代机器学习工作负载中的关键原语，尤其是专家混合 (MoE) 模型。不幸的是，由于工作负载偏差、异构两层结构和组播拥塞，再加上 MoE 工作负载的动态特性（流量每隔几百毫秒就会发生变化），高效调度面临挑战。现有的调度程序很难扩展，需要几秒到几小时的综合时间，这使得它们不切实际。

我们推出了 FAST，一种高效的 All-to-All(v) 调度程序。 FAST 通过服务器内重新平衡解决偏差，并强制执行平衡的一对一横向扩展传输，以避免 incast。在 NVIDIA H200 和 AMD MI300X 集群上进行了广泛评估，FAST 在倾斜工作负载方面始终优于最先进的解决方案，同时将综合时间缩短了几个数量级。

papers.title: FastServe: Iteration-Level Preemptive Scheduling for Large Language Model Inference.
papers.abstract:
Large language models (LLMs) power a new generation of interactive AI applications exemplified by ChatGPT. The interactive nature of these applications demands low latency for LLM inference. Existing LLM serving systems use run-tocompletion processing for inference jobs, which suffers from head-of-line blocking and long latency.

We present FastServe, a distributed LLM serving system which exploits the autoregressive pattern of LLM inference to enable preemption at the granularity of each output token. FastServe uses preemptive scheduling to minimize latency with a novel skip-join Multi-Level Feedback Queue scheduler. Based on the new semi information-agnostic setting of LLM inference, the scheduler leverages the input length information to assign an appropriate initial queue for each arrival job to join. Queues with higher priority than the one the job joins are skipped to reduce demotions. We design an efficient GPU memory management mechanism that proactively offloads and uploads intermediate state between GPU memory and host memory for LLM inference. Evaluation shows that compared to the state-of-the-art solution vLLM, FastServe improves the throughput by up to 6.1×.
papers.abstract_zh:
大型语言模型 (LLM) 为以 ChatGPT 为代表的新一代交互式 AI 应用程序提供支持。这些应用程序的交互性质要求 LLM 推理具有低延迟。现有的 LLM 服务系统对推理作业使用从运行到完成的处理，这会受到队头阻塞和长延迟的影响。

我们提出了 FastServe，一种分布式 LLM 服务系统，它利用 LLM 推理的自回归模式来实现每个输出令牌粒度的抢占。 FastServe 使用抢占式调度，通过新颖的跳跃连接多级反馈队列调度程序来最大限度地减少延迟。基于 LLM 推理的新的半信息不可知设置，调度程序利用输入长度信息为每个要加入的到达作业分配适当的初始队列。优先级高于作业加入队列的队列将被跳过，以减少降级。我们设计了一种高效的 GPU 内存管理机制，可以主动卸载和上传 GPU 内存和主机内存之间的中间状态，以进行 LLM 推理。评估表明，与最先进的解决方案 vLLM 相比，FastServe 将吞吐量提高了 6.1 倍。

papers.title: Feedback-guided Adaptive Testing of Distributed Systems Designs.
papers.abstract:
Validating distributed systems for correctness poses significant challenges. Practitioners often rely on formal models of core system designs, which are then tested by exploring possible component interactions. Unfortunately, standard testing approaches based on random sampling of the state space are inefficient and prone to missing subtle bugs, as they lack guidance from the system's behavior.

To address this, we present Fest, a new testing system for formal models of distributed systems. Fest incorporates feedback-guided adaptive schedule generation, drawing inspiration from grey-box fuzzing, to steer exploration towards maximizing behavioral coverage and uncovering bugs more effectively. Our implementation in the P programming framework demonstrates significant improvements across 94 distributed system model configurations: up to 41× (1.5× average) improvement in behavioral coverage, 278× (15× average) improvement in scenario coverage, and 33% more bugs detected compared to existing methods. These results highlight Fest's effectiveness in ensuring the robustness of distributed systems through improved testing efficiency.
papers.abstract_zh:
验证分布式系统的正确性提出了重大挑战。从业者通常依赖核心系统设计的正式模型，然后通过探索可能的组件交互来测试这些模型。不幸的是，基于状态空间随机采样的标准测试方法效率低下，并且容易丢失细微的错误，因为它们缺乏系统行为的指导。

为了解决这个问题，我们推出了 Fest，一个用于分布式系统正式模型的新测试系统。 Fest 结合了反馈引导的自适应计划生成，从灰盒模糊测试中汲取灵感，引导探索最大化行为覆盖范围并更有效地发现错误。我们在 P 编程框架中的实现展示了 94 个分布式系统模型配置的显着改进：与现有方法相比，行为覆盖率提高了 41 倍（平均 1.5 倍），场景覆盖率提高了 278 倍（平均 15 倍），检测到的错误增加了 33%。这些结果凸显了 Fest 通过提高测试效率确保分布式系统稳健性的有效性。

papers.title: FENIX: Enabling In-Network DNN Inference with FPGA-Enhanced Programmable Switches.
papers.abstract: Machine learning (ML) is increasingly used in network data planes for advanced traffic analysis, but existing solutions (such as FlowLens, N3IC, BoS) still struggle to simultaneously achieve low latency, high throughput, and high accuracy. To address these challenges, we present FENIX, a hybrid in-network ML system that performs feature extraction on programmable switch ASICs and deep neural network inference on FPGAs. FENIX introduces a Data Engine that leverages a probabilistic token bucket algorithm to control the sending rate of feature streams, effectively addressing the throughput gap between programmable switch ASICs and FPGAs. In addition, FENIX designs a Model Engine to enable high-accuracy deep neural network inference in the network, overcoming the difficulty of deploying complex models on resource-constrained switch chips. We implement FENIX on a programmable switch platform that integrates a Tofino ASIC and a ZU19EG FPGA directly, and evaluate it on real-world network traffic datasets. Our results show that FENIX achieves microsecond-level inference latency and multi-terabit throughput with low hardware overhead, and delivers over 90% accuracy on mainstream network traffic classification tasks, outperforming the state of the art.
papers.abstract_zh: 机器学习 (ML) 越来越多地用于网络数据平面中以进行高级流量分析，但现有解决方案（例如 FlowLens、N3IC、BoS）仍然难以同时实现低延迟、高吞吐量和高精度。为了应对这些挑战，我们推出了 FENIX，这是一种混合网络内 ML 系统，可在可编程交换机 ASIC 上执行特征提取，并在 FPGA 上执行深度神经网络推理。 FENIX引入了数据引擎，利用概率令牌桶算法来控制特征流的发送速率，有效解决可编程交换机ASIC和FPGA之间的吞吐量差距。此外，FENIX还设计了模型引擎，可在网络中实现高精度深度神经网络推理，克服了在资源受限的交换芯片上部署复杂模型的困难。我们在直接集成 Tofino ASIC 和 ZU19EG FPGA 的可编程交换机平台上实现 FENIX，并在真实网络流量数据集上对其进行评估。我们的结果表明，FENIX 以较低的硬件开销实现了微秒级的推理延迟和多太比特的吞吐量，并在主流网络流量分类任务上提供了超过 90% 的准确率，超越了现有技术。

papers.title: FLARE: Anomaly Diagnostics for Divergent LLM Training in GPU Clusters of Thousand-Plus Scale.
papers.abstract: The rapid proliferation of large language models has driven the need for efficient GPU training clusters. However, it is challenging due to the frequent occurrence of training anomalies. Since existing diagnostic tools are narrowly tailored to specific issues, there are gaps in their ability to address anomalies spanning the entire training stack. In response, we introduce FLARE, a diagnostic framework designed for distributed LLM training at scale. FLARE first integrates a lightweight tracing daemon for full-stack and backend-extensible tracing. Additionally, it features a diagnostic engine that automatically diagnoses anomalies, with a focus on performance regressions. The deployment of FLARE across 6,000 GPUs has demonstrated significant improvements in pinpointing deficiencies in real-world scenarios, with continuous operation for over eight months.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型的快速增长推动了对高效 GPU 训练集群的需求。然而，由于训练异常的频繁发生，这具有挑战性。由于现有的诊断工具针对特定问题进行了狭隘的定制，因此它们解决整个训练堆栈异常的能力存在差距。为此，我们推出了 FLARE，这是一种专为大规模分布式 LLM 培训而设计的诊断框架。 FLARE 首先集成了一个轻量级跟踪守护程序，用于全堆栈和后端可扩展的跟踪。此外，它还具有自动诊断异常的诊断引擎，重点关注性能回归。在 6,000 个 GPU 上部署 FLARE 在查明现实场景中的缺陷方面取得了显着改进，并且连续运行了八个多月。

papers.title: FlexLLM: Token-Level Co-Serving of LLM Inference and Finetuning with SLO Guarantees.
papers.abstract: Finetuning large language models (LLMs) is essential for task adaptation, yet today's serving stacks isolate inference and finetuning on separate GPU clusters—wasting resources and under-utilizing hardware. We introduce FlexLLM, the first system to co-serve LLM inference and PEFT-based finetuning on shared GPUs by fusing computation at the token level. FlexLLM's static compilation optimizations— dependent parallelization and graph pruning significantly shrink activation memory, leading to end-to-end GPU memory savings by up to 80%. At runtime, a novel token-level finetuning mechanism paired with a hybrid token scheduler dynamically interleaves inference and training tokens within each co-serving iteration, meeting strict latency SLOs while maximizing utilization. In end-to-end benchmarks on LLaMA-3.1-8B, Qwen-2.5-14B, and Qwen-2.5-32B, FlexLLM maintains inference SLO compliance at up to 20 req/s, and improves finetuning throughput by 1.9-4.8× under heavy inference workloads and 2.5-6.8× under light loads, preserving over 76% of peak finetuning progress even at peak demand. FlexLLM is publicly available at https://flexllm.github.io .
papers.abstract_zh: 微调大型语言模型 (LLM) 对于任务适应至关重要，但当今的服务堆栈将推理和微调隔离在单独的 GPU 集群上，从而浪费资源且未充分利用硬件。我们推出了 FlexLLM，这是第一个通过在令牌级别融合计算来在共享 GPU 上共同提供 LLM 推理和基于 PEFT 的微调的系统。 FlexLLM 的静态编译优化——相关并行化和图形修剪显着缩小了激活内存，从而使端到端 GPU 内存节省高达 80%。在运行时，新颖的令牌级微调机制与混合令牌调度程序相结合，在每次协同服务迭代中动态交错推理和训练令牌，满足严格的延迟 SLO，同时最大限度地提高利用率。在 LLaMA-3.1-8B、Qwen-2.5-14B 和 Qwen-2.5-32B 的端到端基准测试中，FlexLLM 将推理 SLO 合规性维持在高达 20 req/s，并在重推理工作负载下将微调吞吐量提高了 1.9-4.8 倍，在轻负载下将微调吞吐量提高了 2.5-6.8 倍，即使在峰值时也能保持超过 76% 的峰值微调进度需求。 FlexLLM 可在 https://flexllm.github.io 上公开获取。

papers.title: ForestColl: Throughput-Optimal Collective Communications on Heterogeneous Network Fabrics.
papers.abstract: As modern DNN models grow ever larger, collective communications between the accelerators (allreduce, etc.) emerge as a significant performance bottleneck. Designing efficient communication schedules is challenging, given today's heterogeneous and diverse network fabrics. We present ForestColl, a tool that generates throughput-optimal schedules for any network topology. ForestColl constructs broadcast/aggregation spanning trees as the communication schedule, achieving theoretical optimality. Its schedule generation runs in polynomial time and is highly scalable. ForestColl supports any network fabric, including both switching fabrics and direct accelerator connections. We evaluated ForestColl on AMD MI250 and NVIDIA DGX A100 & H100 clusters. ForestColl shows significant improvements over the vendors' own optimized communication libraries across various settings and in LLM training. ForestColl also outperforms other state-of-the-art schedule generation techniques with both more efficient generated schedules and substantially faster generation speed.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着现代 DNN 模型变得越来越大，加速器（allreduce 等）之间的集体通信成为一个重要的性能瓶颈。鉴于当今异构且多样化的网络结构，设计高效的通信调度具有挑战性。我们推出了 ForestColl，这是一种可以为任何网络拓扑生成吞吐量最佳调度的工具。 ForestColl构建广播/聚合生成树作为通信调度，实现了理论上的最优。其调度生成在多项式时间内运行并且具有高度可扩展性。 ForestColl 支持任何网络结构，包括交换结构和直接加速器连接。我们在 AMD MI250 和 NVIDIA DGX A100 & H100 集群上评估了 ForestColl。 ForestColl 在各种设置和法学硕士培训中比供应商自己的优化通信库有了显着改进。 ForestColl 还优于其他最先进的时间表生成技术，生成的时间表更高效，生成速度也快得多。

papers.title: Fractal: Fault-Tolerant Shell-Script Distribution.
papers.abstract: This paper presents FRACTAL, a new system that offers fault tolerant distributed shell script execution for unmodified scripts. FRACTAL first distinguishes recoverable regions from side-effectful ones, and augments them with additional runtime support aimed at fault recovery. It employs precise dependency and progress tracking at the subgraph level to offer sound and efficient fault recovery. It minimizes the number of upstream regions that are re-executed during recovery and ensures exactly-once semantics upon recovery for downstream regions. Evaluation on 4- and 30-node clusters indicates average fault-free speedups of (1) >9.6x over Bash, a single-node shell-interpreter baseline, (2) >5.5x over Hadoop Streaming, a MapReduce system that supports language-agnostic third-party components, and (3) 17% over DiSh, a state-of-the-art fault-intolerant shell-script distribution system—all while recovering 7.8–16.4x faster than Hadoop Streaming in cases of faults.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了 FRACTAL，这是一个新系统，可为未修改的脚本提供容错分布式 shell 脚本执行。 FRACTAL 首先区分可恢复区域和副作用区域，并通过旨在故障恢复的额外运行时支持来增强它们。它在子图级别采用精确的依赖性和进度跟踪，以提供健全且高效的故障恢复。它最大限度地减少了恢复期间重新执行的上游区域的数量，并确保下游区域恢复时的恰好一次语义。对 4 节点和 30 节点集群的评估表明，平均无故障加速比 Bash（单节点 shell 解释器基线）高出 9.6 倍；(2) 比 Hadoop Streaming（支持与语言无关的第三方组件的 MapReduce 系统）高出 5.5 倍；(3) 比 DiSh（最先进的容错 shell 脚本分发系统）高出 17%——所有这些都在恢复的同时进行。出现故障时比 Hadoop Streaming 快 7.8–16.4 倍。

papers.title: FRCC: Towards Provably Fair and Robust Congestion Control.
papers.abstract:
Congestion control algorithms (CCAs) play a critical role in network bandwidth allocation. Recent work (from SIGCOMM 2022) showed that a large class of CCAs, including BBR, Copa, and Reno, starve flows in the presence of network jitter. Starvation occurs because CCAs coordinate fairness by encoding fair rates into congestion signals. For example, Reno's throughput scales as 1/√loss rate. Even a small amount of noise in these signals leads to large errors in inferring fair rates.

We present FRCC (Fair and Robust Congestion Controller), the first CCA that provably bounds unfairness (avoids starvation) even under network jitter. Our key insight is to encode only the flow count (or equivalently, the fair link fraction) into the congestion signals, and independently estimate the link capacity to calculate the fair rate. In this way, we bound jitter's impact on fairness. We implement FRCC in the Linux kernel and evaluate it in a variety of network conditions, including synthetic jitter, heterogeneous RTTs, and multi-bottleneck settings. FRCC closely matches the bounds predicted by our theoretical analysis, and consistently achieves fairness, even when state-of-the-art CCAs exhibit starvation.
papers.abstract_zh:
拥塞控制算法（CCA）在网络带宽分配中发挥着至关重要的作用。 Recent work (from SIGCOMM 2022) showed that a large class of CCAs, including BBR, Copa, and Reno, starve flows in the presence of network jitter.饥饿的发生是因为 CCA 通过将公平费率编码到拥塞信号中来协调公平性。例如，Reno 的吞吐量按 1/√ 丢失率缩放。即使这些信号中存在少量噪声，也会导致推断公平利率时出现较大错误。

We present FRCC (Fair and Robust Congestion Controller), the first CCA that provably bounds unfairness (avoids starvation) even under network jitter. Our key insight is to encode only the flow count (or equivalently, the fair link fraction) into the congestion signals, and independently estimate the link capacity to calculate the fair rate.通过这种方式，我们限制了抖动对公平性的影响。 We implement FRCC in the Linux kernel and evaluate it in a variety of network conditions, including synthetic jitter, heterogeneous RTTs, and multi-bottleneck settings. FRCC closely matches the bounds predicted by our theoretical analysis, and consistently achieves fairness, even when state-of-the-art CCAs exhibit starvation.

papers.title: From Bits to Tokens: Knowledge-Driven Generative Communication of Multimodal Data.
papers.abstract: Classical communication systems strive for bit-by-bit reconstruction, yet this objective often misaligns with downstream application tasks, such as perception and decision-making with sensor data. Strict bit-fidelity is especially problematic in wireless settings, where packet losses and channel dynamics undermine both efficiency and resilience. In this paper, we introduce Knowledge-Driven Communication (KDC), a framework that transmits semantic knowledge rather than raw bits by leveraging pretrained knowledge bases. KDC features a task-aware transmitter, which uses multimodal foundation models to abstract source data into tokenized embeddings and prioritize semantically critical content, enabling zero-shot adaptation without task-specific retraining. On the receiver side, KDC employs pretrained knowledge bases and incrementally updated context to reconstruct task-relevant information, enabling graceful degradation even under data loss. We implement a full KDC prototype and evaluate it over diverse data modalities and wireless networks. Experiments show that KDC consistently outperforms state-of-the-art codecs and learned baselines, achieving high task accuracy with a fraction of the transmitted data, while maintaining robustness under challenging wireless conditions.
papers.abstract_zh: 经典通信系统致力于逐位重建，但这一目标常常与下游应用任务不一致，例如利用传感器数据进行感知和决策。严格的位保真度在无线设置中尤其成问题，其中数据包丢失和信道动态会破坏效率和弹性。在本文中，我们介绍了知识驱动通信（KDC），这是一个通过利用预训练的知识库来传输语义知识而不是原始位的框架。 KDC 具有任务感知发射器，它使用多模态基础模型将源数据抽象为标记化嵌入，并对语义关键内容进行优先级排序，从而无需特定于任务的重新训练即可实现零样本适应。在接收端，KDC 使用预训练的知识库和增量更新的上下文来重建任务相关信息，即使在数据丢失的情况下也能实现优雅的降级。我们实现了完整的 KDC 原型，并通过不同的数据模式和无线网络对其进行评估。实验表明，KDC 的性能始终优于最先进的编解码器和学习基线，利用一小部分传输数据即可实现较高的任务准确性，同时在具有挑战性的无线条件下保持鲁棒性。

papers.title: From Intention to Practice: Towards Systematic Validation of NIDS Rule Enforcement.
papers.abstract: Rule-based Network Intrusion Detection Systems (NIDS) are integral to contemporary cybersecurity, relying on the rule matching mechanism to identify malicious activities within network traffic. However, there is no inherent assurance that the deployed rules are enforced as intended due to factors regarding the composition of the rules and implementation flaws of NIDS. Unfortunately, administrators lack appropriate means to validate the gap between rule definition and enforcement as existing testing approaches towards NIDS are often rule irrelevant and lack systematic methodologies. To address this issue, this paper presents NIDSFuzz , a systematic fuzzing approach designed to validate the enforcement of rules within NIDS, which is rule-oriented so that it employs tailored mutation strategies to generate test traffic based on the very ruleset deployed. In this manner, it becomes feasible to validate the targeted rulesets with guarantee of coverage. An NIDS-specific fuzzing framework is proposed, incorporating an appropriate test traffic injection method to perform fuzzing and carefully designed approaches of sanitization and analysis to effectively identify rule enforcement issues. Experimental results show that NIDSFuzz is able to uncover over 10,000 rule enforcement issues. We classified the discovered issues into different categories and explored corresponding countermeasures in terms of both rules and NIDS implementation. Moreover, performance evaluation confirms the efficiency of NIDSFuzz and comparison to other tools highlights the significant advantage of NIDSFuzz in evaluating rules of NIDS. We have made our code publicly available.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于规则的网络入侵检测系统 (NIDS) 是当代网络安全不可或缺的一部分，它依靠规则匹配机制来识别网络流量中的恶意活动。然而，由于规则的组成和 NIDS 的实施缺陷等因素，并不能保证已部署的规则按预期执行。不幸的是，管理员缺乏适当的方法来验证规则定义和执行之间的差距，因为现有的 NIDS 测试方法通常与规则无关并且缺乏系统的方法。为了解决这个问题，本文提出了 NIDSFuzz，这是一种系统模糊方法，旨在验证 NIDS 内规则的执行情况，该方法是面向规则的，因此它采用定制的变异策略来根据部署的规则集生成测试流量。通过这种方式，在保证覆盖范围的情况下验证目标规则集变得可行。提出了一种特定于 NIDS 的模糊测试框架，结合了适当的测试流量注入方法来执行模糊测试，并精心设计了清理和分析方法，以有效地识别规则执行问题。实验结果表明，NIDSFuzz 能够发现超过 10,000 个规则执行问题。我们对发现的问题进行了分类，并从规则和NIDS实施方面探讨了相应的对策。此外，性能评估证实了NIDSFuzz的效率，并且与其他工具的比较凸显了NIDSFuzz在评估NIDS规则方面的显着优势。我们已公开我们的代码。

papers.title: From Source to Solution: Tackling Packet Losses in Large-scale Cloud Gaming Systematically and Precisely.
papers.abstract: Cloud gaming requires all video frames to be delivered before a stringent delay deadline to ensure seamless gaming experience. However, meeting this requirement is challenging due to packet losses, which greatly magnifies the frame delay. Various FEC-based loss recovery schemes were recently proposed to address the packet loss issue. However, the source of such packet losses remains unrevealed. Our production measurement results from Tencent START cloud gaming platform have shown that 66.5% of packet losses are caused by network infrastructure’s preferences against UDP and network congestion. Moreover, off-the-shelf video streaming systems like WebRTC could not detect retransmission loss efficiently. These issues completely nullified the performance gain of loss recovery schemes. To address this, we design and implement LADR, which combines loss avoidance, detection, and recovery to tackle packet losses. LADR incorporates the loss-based and delay-based congestion control algorithms and adopts RACK-TLP for loss avoidance and detection. Furthermore, LADR adopts an opportunistic FEC scheme to perform loss recovery. LADR has been rolled out at Tencent START cloud gaming platform, a large-scale cloud gaming provider, for one year. Production measurement results show that LADR only suffers from 0.049% packet loss rate (-59.8% vs. existing solutions) and delivers 99.87% of video frames within 100 milliseconds.
papers.abstract_zh: 云游戏要求所有视频帧在严格的延迟期限之前交付，以确保无缝的游戏体验。然而，由于数据包丢失，大大放大了帧延迟，满足这一要求具有挑战性。最近提出了各种基于 FEC 的丢失恢复方案来解决数据包丢失问题。然而，此类数据包丢失的根源仍未揭晓。我们对腾讯START云游戏平台的生产测量结果显示，66.5%的丢包是由网络基础设施对UDP的偏好和网络拥塞造成的。此外，像 WebRTC 这样的现成视频流系统无法有效地检测重传丢失。这些问题完全抵消了丢失恢复方案的性能增益。为了解决这个问题，我们设计并实现了 LADR，它结合了丢失避免、检测和恢复来解决数据包丢失问题。 LADR融合了基于丢失和基于延迟的拥塞控制算法，并采用RACK-TLP进行丢失避免和检测。此外，LADR采用机会性FEC方案来执行丢失恢复。 LADR已在大型云游戏提供商腾讯START云游戏平台上线一年。生产测量结果表明，LADR 的丢包率仅为 0.049%（与现有解决方案相比为-59.8%），并在 100 毫秒内交付 99.87% 的视频帧。

papers.title: Geminet: Learning the Duality-based Topology-Agnostic Update Operator for Lightweight Traffic Engineering in Changing Topologies.
papers.abstract: Recently, researchers have explored ML-based Traffic Engineering (TE), leveraging neural networks to solve TE problems traditionally addressed by optimization. However, existing ML-based TE schemes remain impractical: they either fail to handle topology changes or suffer from poor scalability due to excessive computational and memory overhead. To overcome these limitations, we propose Geminet, a lightweight and scalable ML-based TE framework that can handle changing topologies. Geminet is built upon two key insights: (i) decoupling neural networks from topology by learning a topology-agnostic update operator inspired by classical iterative optimization methods (e.g., gradient descent), which depend only on a few gradient-related quantities; (ii) shifting optimization from path-level routing weights to edge-level dual variables, reducing memory consumption by leveraging the fact that edges are far fewer than paths. Evaluations on WAN and data center datasets show that Geminet significantly improves scalability. Its neural network size is only 0.04%-7% of existing schemes, while handling topology variations as effectively as HARP, a state-of-the-art ML-based TE approach, without performance degradation. When trained on large-scale topologies, Geminet consumes less than 10 GiB of memory compared to more than 80 GiB required by HARP, while achieving 18× faster convergence, demonstrating its potential for large-scale deployment.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近，研究人员探索了基于机器学习的流量工程 (TE)，利用神经网络来解决传统上通过优化解决的 TE 问题。然而，现有的基于 ML 的 TE 方案仍然不切实际：它们要么无法处理拓扑变化，要么由于过多的计算和内存开销而导致可扩展性较差。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了 Geminet，这是一种轻量级且可扩展的基于 ML 的 TE 框架，可以处理不断变化的拓扑。 Geminet 建立在两个关键见解的基础上：（i）通过学习受经典迭代优化方法（例如梯度下降）启发的拓扑不可知更新算子，将神经网络与拓扑解耦，该算子仅依赖于一些与梯度相关的量； (ii) 将优化从路径级路由权重转向边缘级双变量，利用边缘远少于路径的事实来减少内存消耗。对广域网和数据中心数据集的评估表明，Geminet 显着提高了可扩展性。其神经网络规模仅为现有方案的 0.04%-7%，同时可以像 HARP（一种最先进的基于 ML 的 TE 方法）一样有效地处理拓扑变化，而不会降低性能。在大规模拓扑上进行训练时，Geminet 消耗的内存不到 10 GiB，而 HARP 需要超过 80 GiB，同时实现了 18 倍的更快收敛速度​​，展示了其大规模部署的潜力。

papers.title: Harp: Improving VPC Network Availability via Efficient Failure Detection and Rerouting in Tencent Cloud.
papers.abstract: We present Harp, a mechanism for efficient and robust failure detection and recovery for VPC networks. Unlike previous approaches, Harp does not rely on specific hardware features or transport protocols. Instead, Harp is a lightweight software implementation that identifies feasible physical paths between each pair of communicating hosts and monitors their health states. When network failures occur, Harp can swiftly switch influenced flows from a failed path to a healthy path within a short interval. Harp has been deployed in Tencent Cloud for more than two years and has proven its effectiveness in handling network failures. According to the results from production systems, Harp can significantly reduce the VPC network's outage time by 78.71%-99.97% and essentially bypass failed paths on a sub-second timescale. We also share our experiences of how Harp efficiently detects and handles network failures when deployed in Tencent Cloud.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们推出 Harp，一种用于 VPC 网络高效、稳健的故障检测和恢复的机制。与以前的方法不同，Harp 不依赖于特定的硬件功能或传输协议。相反，Harp 是一种轻量级软件实现，可识别每对通信主机之间的可行物理路径并监视其健康状态。当网络发生故障时，Harp可以在短时间内将受影响的流量从故障路径快速切换到健康路径。 Harp已经在腾讯云部署了两年多，并证明了其在处理网络故障方面的有效性。根据生产系统的结果，Harp 可以将 VPC 网络的中断时间显着减少 78.71%-99.97%，并在亚秒级时间尺度上基本上绕过故障路径。我们还分享了Harp部署在腾讯云时如何高效检测和处理网络故障的经验。

papers.title: Harvesting Spare CPU Resources in Container Systems.
papers.abstract: Platforms like Kubernetes are widely adopted for deploying latency-sensitive cloud services in containers, and CPU resources for these containers are over-provisioned to ensure low 99th percentile tail latency under peak load. At the same time, cloud services exhibit bursty traffic patterns resulting in CPU usage variability that creates opportunity to harvest ephemerally unused CPU cores to run latency-tolerant containers. However, existing resource controls do not allow latency-sensitive containers to share unused cores without compromising their low tail latency objectives. Prior research on performance isolation is inadequate for container systems because it requires modifying applications and system software, employs offline profiling, and does not account for interference from processing container networking interrupts. We present HarvestContainers , a system that protects latency-sensitive containers from all sources of interference while harvesting their spare CPU cores to run latency-tolerant containers. Our solution dynamically determines the safe number of CPU cores to harvest and does not require rewriting applications or OS. We implement HarvestContainers integrated with Kubernetes and evaluate it experimentally. Our evaluation shows that latency-sensitive containers with microsecond-scale service level objectives can share up to 75% of their unused CPU cores while maintaining tail latency within 4% of standalone operation.
papers.abstract_zh: 像 Kubernetes 这样的平台被广泛用于在容器中部署延迟敏感的云服务，并且这些容器的 CPU 资源被过度配置，以确保峰值负载下的 99% 尾部延迟较低。与此同时，云服务呈现出突发流量模式，导致 CPU 使用率变化，从而创造了收集暂时未使用的 CPU 核心来运行延迟容忍容器的机会。然而，现有的资源控制不允许对延迟敏感的容器共享未使用的核心，而不影响其低尾延迟目标。先前对性能隔离的研究对于容器系统来说是不够的，因为它需要修改应用程序和系统软件，采用离线分析，并且没有考虑处理容器网络中断的干扰。我们推出了 HarvestContainers，这是一个系统，可以保护延迟敏感的容器免受所有干扰源的影响，同时收集其备用 CPU 核心来运行延迟容忍的容器。我们的解决方案动态确定要获取的 CPU 核心的安全数量，并且不需要重写应用程序或操作系统。我们实现了与 Kubernetes 集成的 HarvestContainers 并进行了实验评估。我们的评估表明，具有微秒级服务级别目标的延迟敏感型容器可以共享高达 75% 的未使用 CPU 内核，同时将独立操作的尾部延迟保持在 4% 以内。

papers.title: HCDN: Coordinated Stream Scheduling for Cost-Effective Live Video Delivery.
papers.abstract: Live video streaming is a major source of today's Internet traffic, yet its delivery through CDNs incurs massive bandwidth costs from both CDN edge traffic (to users) and internal traffic (between CDN nodes). To understand these costs, we conduct a large-scale measurement study of ByteDance’s global in-production live CDN. It reveals two opportunities to reduce CDN bandwidth cost: (i) lowering average edge price by incorporating cost-effective best-effort infrastructure into the CDN edge, and (ii) improving CDN tree efficiency via finer-grained stream scheduling, accounting for detailed stream characteristics such as non-uniform popularity, heterogeneous stream formats, which amplify internal traffic on cache misses in our prior CDN. To exploit these opportunities into a practical system while addressing challenges in scheduling strategy management and user quality of experience, we design, implement, and deploy HCDN. It comprises (i) an augmented CDN edge with cost-effective best-effort nodes and multihomed nodes , (ii) the OpenTiga scheduling framework, which coordinates strategies through modular orchestration and proactive client-side Quality-of-Experience (QoE) assurance, and (iii) a set of redirection-based stream scheduling strategies. Over four years of incremental deployment across more than 500 edge clusters, HCDN reduces relative bandwidth cost by 36% while incurring modest overhead and preserving QoE. We further report the deployment experience of HCDN.
papers.abstract_zh: 实时视频流是当今互联网流量的主要来源，但通过 CDN 进行传输会产生 CDN 边缘流量（到用户）和内部流量（CDN 节点之间）的大量带宽成本。为了了解这些成本，我们对字节跳动的全球生产中的直播 CDN 进行了大规模的测量研究。它揭示了降低 CDN 带宽成本的两个机会：(i) 通过将具有成本效益的尽力而为基础设施纳入 CDN 边缘来降低平均边缘价格，以及 (ii) 通过更细粒度的流调度来提高 CDN 树效率，考虑详细的流特征，例如非均匀流行度、异构流格式，这些特征会放大我们先前 CDN 中缓存未命中时的内部流量。为了将这些机会应用到实际系统中，同时解决调度策略管理和用户体验质量方面的挑战，我们设计、实施和部署 HCDN。它包括 (i) 具有成本效益的尽力而为节点和多宿主节点的增强 CDN 边缘，(ii) OpenTiga 调度框架，通过模块化编排和主动客户端体验质量 (QoE) 保证来协调策略，以及 (iii) 一组基于重定向的流调度策略。经过四年的跨 500 多个边缘集群的增量部署，HCDN 将相对带宽成本降低了 36%，同时产生适度的开销并保持 QoE。我们进一步汇报HCDN的部署经验。

papers.title: HEDGE: Traffic Engineering with Probabilistic Link Capacities.
papers.abstract: Cloud providers have adopted higher modulation formats to achieve higher data-rate wavelengths in their optical wide-area networks. However, higher modulation formats reduce signal quality margins, making wavelengths more susceptible to wavelength-specific faults (WSFs)—temporary faults that selectively affect certain wavelengths while others remain unaffected, even though they all share the same optical fiber and equipment. WSFs cause the capacity of inter-datacenter links to fluctuate, frequently disrupting traffic engineering systems. We propose HEDGE, a system that mitigates the effects of WSFs by implementing link-local resilience and global network-wide resilience against WSFs. For local resilience, HEDGE provisions inter-datacenter links with a guaranteed minimum capacity and availability target, in spite of WSFs, while using the fewest possible constituent wavelengths. For global resilience, HEDGE optimally balances throughput and availability while allocating flows on a stochastic wide-area network with fluctuating link capacities. HEDGE sustains equivalent throughput with state-of-the-art traffic engineering systems, while dropping 12.2× less network flow in worst-case scenarios and reducing disruptions to tunnel allocations by 622× in spite of a rapidly changing topology.
papers.abstract_zh: 云提供商已采用更高的调制格式，以在其光广域网中实现更高的数据速率波长。然而，更高的调制格式会降低信号质量裕度，使波长更容易受到波长特定故障 (WSF) 的影响，即选择性影响某些波长而其他波长不受影响的临时故障，即使它们都共享相同的光纤和设备。 WSF 会导致数据中心间链路的容量波动，经常扰乱流量工程系统。我们提出 HEDGE，这是一个通过实施链路本地弹性和全球网络范围内针对 WSF 的弹性来减轻 WSF 影响的系统。为了实现本地弹性，HEDGE 为数据中心间链路提供保证的最小容量和可用性目标，尽管存在 WSF，但同时使用尽可能少的组成波长。为了实现全球弹性，HEDGE 可以在吞吐量和可用性之间实现最佳平衡，同时在链路容量波动的随机广域网上分配流量。 HEDGE 与最先进的流量工程系统保持相同的吞吐量，同时在最坏情况下减少 12.2 倍的网络流量，并将隧道分配的中断减少 622 倍，尽管拓扑结构快速变化。

papers.title: HeteCCL: Synthesizing Near-Optimal Collective Communication Schedules for Heterogeneous GPU Clusters.
papers.abstract: Training large language models demands massive computing and networking resources. However, existing clusters often face shortages of homogeneous resources and vendor lock-in, forcing the use of heterogeneous hardware, which makes synchronizing training across nodes highly challenging. Current solutions to cluster heterogeneity suffer from low collective communication efficiency, with suboptimal scheduling and slow algorithm synthesis. We present HeteCCL, a unified method for generating near-optimal collective communication schedules on heterogeneous clusters. HeteCCL models the cluster topology and link bandwidth in detail, quantizes data chunks at the schedule-step level, and formulates the scheduling problem as a maximum parallel transfer problem on a weighted directed graph. To accelerate synthesis, HeteCCL encodes bandwidth and routing constraints as SMT formulas and applies counterexample-guided inductive synthesis to refine constraints and prune the search space iteratively. Experiments on heterogeneous testbeds, each consisting of 32 H20 and V100 GPUs, show that HeteCCL outperforms NCCL, TACCL, and TE-CCL, achieving up to 2.8×, 4.4×, and 2.6× higher bandwidth. It also accelerates synthesis by up to 2 orders of magnitude compared to state-of-the-art efforts, and improves end-to-end training efficiency by 23%–37%.
papers.abstract_zh: 训练大型语言模型需要大量的计算和网络资源。然而，现有集群经常面临同质资源短缺和供应商锁定，迫使使用异构硬件，这使得跨节点同步训练变得极具挑战性。当前的集群异构解决方案存在集体通信效率低、调度次优和算法合成缓慢的问题。我们提出了 HeteCCL，一种在异构集群上生成接近最优集体通信调度的统一方法。 HeteCCL 对集群拓扑和链路带宽进行详细建模，在调度步骤级别量化数据块，并将调度问题表述为加权有向图上的最大并行传输问题。为了加速综合，HeteCCL 将带宽和路由约束编码为 SMT 公式，并应用反例引导的归纳综合来细化约束并迭代地修剪搜索空间。在异构测试台（每个测试台由 32 个 H20 和 V100 GPU 组成）上进行的实验表明，HeteCCL 的性能优于 NCCL、TACCL 和 TE-CCL，带宽分别提高了 2.8 倍、4.4 倍和 2.6 倍。与最先进的技术相比，它还能将合成速度提高多达 2 个数量级，并将端到端训练效率提高 23%–37%。

papers.title: Heuristic Analysis from Source Code via Symbolic-Guided Optimization.
papers.abstract:
Large-scale systems rely on heuristics to tackle NP-hard problems such as traffic engineering, virtual machine placement, and packet scheduling. While these heuristics are efficient, they can exhibit severe performance gaps under certain workloads, which leads to outages or costly over-provisioning. This risk has motivated tools that attempt to find inputs that cause worst-case underperformance. But, to use these tools in practice, heuristic developers need to rewrite heuristics as formal mathematical models—a process that is time-consuming, error-prone, and excludes many real-world algorithms.

We introduce MetaEase, a practical general-domain analyzer that directly analyzes a heuristic’s source code and eliminates the need for formal modeling. MetaEase combines code-aware input generation with guided search to uncover worst-case scenarios efficiently, even for heuristics with randomness (e.g., various traffic engineering schemes) or non-convex behavior (e.g., bin packing for virtual machine placement).

In most cases, across five problem domains, and eight heuristics, MetaEase matched or exceeded MetaOpt, a state-of-the-art optimization-based heuristic analyzer; in the remainder, it remained competitive and often ran faster. Against black-box optimization baselines, it won in 88% of settings and ranked in the top two otherwise. MetaEase analyzed Arrow, a recent networking heuristic that none of the state-of-the-art heuristic analyzers can analyze. We revealed previously unknown performance gaps in Arrow.
papers.abstract_zh:
大型系统依靠启发式方法来解决 NP 难题，例如流量工程、虚拟机放置和数据包调度。虽然这些启发式方法很有效，但它们在某些工作负载下可能会表现出严重的性能差距，从而导致中断或代价高昂的过度配置。这种风险促使工具试图寻找导致最坏情况表现不佳的输入。但是，为了在实践中使用这些工具，启发式开发人员需要将启发式重写为正式的数学模型，这个过程非常耗时、容易出错，并且排除了许多现实世界的算法。

我们介绍 MetaEase，这是一种实用的通用领域分析器，可以直接分析启发式源代码并消除形式建模的需要。 MetaEase 将代码感知输入生成与引导搜索相结合，可以有效地发现最坏情况，甚至对于具有随机性的启发式（例如，各种流量工程方案）或非凸行为（例如，用于虚拟机放置的装箱）也是如此。

在大多数情况下，在五个问题领域和八个启发式分析中，MetaEase 匹配或超过了 MetaOpt（一种最先进的基于优化的启发式分析器）；在剩下的时间里，它仍然保持竞争力并且通常跑得更快。相对于黑盒优化基准，它在 88% 的设置中获胜，并在其他方面排名前两名。 MetaEase 分析了 Arrow，这是一种最新的网络启发式算法，没有任何最先进的启发式分析器可以对其进行分析。我们揭示了 Arrow 中以前未知的性能差距。

papers.title: Hierarchical Integration of WebAssembly in Serverless for Efficiency and Interoperability.
papers.abstract: Modern serverless systems suffer from low resource efficiency, which maps to high per-unit costs. This comes from the high isolation overhead (e.g., low resource sharing, slow startup, etc.), as well as resource wastage incurred by conservative resource scaling (e.g., keep-alive). Language runtimes such as WebAssembly (Wasm) can reduce isolation overhead without compromising security. Existing Wasm-based serverless approaches fall into one of these categories: supporting only Wasm workloads, failing to leverage existing capabilities of modern serverless and cloud platforms, or falling short of leveraging Wasm’s true potential. This work introduces a dense hierarchical architecture to securely co-locate Wasm-based applications from different customers within the same container sandbox. We show how this design preserves the container-based serving model, which allows leveraging existing platform capabilities and supporting non-Wasm-based workloads. Our system, Wasabi, leverages this architecture alongside resource-aware scaling, queuing, and overbooking to offer much higher density than state-of-the-art serverless systems with similar or better performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 现代无服务器系统面临资源效率低下的问题，这对应着单位成本高。这是由于高隔离开销（例如，低资源共享、缓慢启动等），以及保守的资源扩展（例如，保持活动）造成的资源浪费。 WebAssembly (Wasm) 等语言运行时可以在不影响安全性的情况下减少隔离开销。现有的基于 Wasm 的无服务器方法属于以下类别之一：仅支持 Wasm 工作负载，无法利用现代无服务器和云平台的现有功能，或者未能充分利用 Wasm 的真正潜力。这项工作引入了密集的分层架构，可以将来自不同客户的基于 Wasm 的应用程序安全地共置在同一容器沙箱中。我们展示了此设计如何保留基于容器的服务模型，该模型允许利用现有平台功能并支持非基于 Wasm 的工作负载。我们的系统 Wasabi 利用这种架构以及资源感知扩展、排队和超额预订，提供比具有相似或更好性能的最先进的无服务器系统更高的密度。

papers.title: HybridMesh: A Hardware-software Hybrid Approach for Accelerating Service Mesh Ingress.
papers.abstract: Service meshes have become essential for enabling microservice communication in cloud environments. Despite their benefits, they impose significant network overhead. We identify the ingress gateway, a main entry point for external traffic, has emerged as a major performance bottleneck. This overhead stems from two key limitations of current ingress gateways: (1) CPU-intensive traffic analysis and (2) a complex packet forwarding path. Our analysis shows that these inefficiencies can reduce network throughput by up to 4× while substantially increasing CPU utilization. In response, we propose HybridMesh, a hardware-software hybrid ingress gateway that leverages a SmartNIC for high-performance traffic analysis and efficient traffic routing. This process is augmented by a lightweight CPU-side proxy that provides various traffic management features not suitable for SmartNIC execution. Evaluations show that HybridMesh outperforms existing ingress gateways, achieving a 4.4× increase in HTTP throughput. Furthermore, compared to software-only and hardware-only designs, our hybrid design delivers 2.3× higher cost-effectiveness and 2.8× better power-efficiency.
papers.abstract_zh: 服务网格对于在云环境中实现微服务通信至关重要。尽管有这些好处，但它们也会带来巨大的网络开销。我们发现入口网关是外部流量的主要入口点，已成为主要的性能瓶颈。这种开销源于当前入口网关的两个关键限制：(1) CPU 密集型流量分析和 (2) 复杂的数据包转发路径。我们的分析表明，这些效率低下的情况会使网络吞吐量降低多达 4 倍，同时大幅提高 CPU 利用率。为此，我们提出了 HybridMesh，这是一种硬件软件混合入口网关，利用 SmartNIC 进行高性能流量分析和高效流量路由。此过程通过轻量级 CPU 端代理进行了增强，该代理提供了不适合 SmartNIC 执行的各种流量管理功能。评估表明，HybridMesh 的性能优于现有入口网关，HTTP 吞吐量提高了 4.4 倍。此外，与纯软件和纯硬件设计相比，我们的混合设计可提供 2.3 倍的成本效益和 2.8 倍的功效。

papers.title: HydraServe: Minimizing Cold Start Latency for Serverless LLM Serving in Public Clouds.
papers.abstract: With the proliferation of large language model (LLM) variants, developers are turning to serverless computing for cost-efficient LLM deployment. However, public cloud providers often struggle to provide performance guarantees for serverless LLM serving due to significant cold start latency caused by substantial model sizes and complex runtime dependencies. To address this problem, we present HydraServe, a serverless LLM serving system designed to minimize cold start latency in public clouds. HydraServe proactively distributes models across servers to quickly fetch them, and overlaps cold-start stages within workers to reduce startup latency. Additionally, HydraServe strategically places workers across GPUs to avoid network contention among cold-start instances. To minimize resource consumption during cold starts, HydraServe further introduces pipeline consolidation that can merge groups of workers into individual serving endpoints. Our comprehensive evaluations under diverse settings demonstrate that HydraServe reduces the cold start latency by 1.7×–4.7× and improves service level objective attainment by 1.43×–1.74× compared to baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大型语言模型 (LLM) 变体的激增，开发人员正在转向无服务器计算，以实现经济高效的 LLM 部署。然而，由于大量的模型大小和复杂的运行时依赖性导致显着的冷启动延迟，公共云提供商通常很难为无服务器 LLM 服务提供性能保证。为了解决这个问题，我们推出了 HydraServe，这是一种无服务器 LLM 服务系统，旨在最大限度地减少公共云中的冷启动延迟。 HydraServe 主动跨服务器分发模型以快速获取它们，并重叠工作线程内的冷启动阶段以减少启动延迟。此外，HydraServe 战略性地将工作人员放置在 GPU 上，以避免冷启动实例之间的网络争用。为了最大限度地减少冷启动期间的资源消耗，HydraServe 进一步引入了管道整合，可以将工作组合并到单独的服务端点中。我们在不同设置下的综合评估表明，与基线相比，HydraServe 将冷启动延迟降低了 1.7×–4.7×，并将服务水平目标实现提高了 1.43×–1.74×。

papers.title: HyperEdge: An Edge CDN Infrastructure for Cost Efficient Video Streaming.
papers.abstract: As ByteDance’s business expands, the cost of video streaming using content delivery networks (CDN) has become prohibitively high. We have discovered a sea of under-utilized edge devices with the potential to reduce content distribution cost. The unreliable performance of an edge network, however, presents deep challenges to video streaming services. In this work, we introduce HyperEdge, an edge-assisted content delivery system for video streaming. HyperEdge seamlessly integrates the robustness of a conventional CDN with the cost-efficiency of an edge network. It offers dependable streaming quality to users while minimizing traffic expenses. HyperEdge employs a centralized tracker cluster to optimize content distribution to a pool of edge devices, based on real-time monitoring. To ensure satisfactory video playback quality, we develop a novel multi-path protocol for client-edge video transmission. Having been in stable operation for six years, HyperEdge manages over a hundred thousand edge devices, serving about a hundred million users daily, and saving hundreds of millions of dollars in content delivery cost annually.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着字节跳动业务的扩张，使用内容分发网络（CDN）进行视频流传输的成本变得高得令人望而却步。我们发现大量未充分利用的边缘设备有可能降低内容分发成本。然而，边缘网络的不可靠性能给视频流服务带来了严峻的挑战。在这项工作中，我们介绍了 HyperEdge，一种用于视频流的边缘辅助内容交付系统。 HyperEdge 将传统 CDN 的稳健性与边缘网络的成本效益无缝集成。它为用户提供可靠的流媒体质量，同时最大限度地减少流量费用。 HyperEdge 采用集中式跟踪器集群，基于实时监控来优化边缘设备池的内容分发。为了确保令人满意的视频播放质量，我们开发了一种新颖的用于客户端边缘视频传输的多路径协议。 HyperEdge已稳定运行六年，管理超过十万台边缘设备，每天服务约亿用户，每年节省数亿美元的内容交付成本。

papers.title: Iceberg: Automated Verification of DNS Authoritative Engines via Just-in-Time Summarization.
papers.abstract:
As the core of DNS services, DNS authoritative engines are responsible for answering DNS queries with DNS responses, where any bugs may lead to severe consequences. While it is critical to ensure the correctness of the engine, existing solutions fail to deliver both correctness guarantees and low manual effort when applied to large and complex implementations in use. The state-of-the-art solution, DNS-V, relies on extra manual specifications for scaling verification, which still incurs a prohibitive cost.

In this paper, we present Iceberg, an automated verification framework for DNS authoritative engines that holistically reduces manual effort. To achieve this, we propose just-in-time (JIT) summarization , a refinement-proof approach that utilizes invariants from DNS zones to enable the use of automated summaries throughout verification, especially for domain-specific DNS operations. In addition, we employ a set of techniques to further scale automation, including symbolic regions, summary optimization, and stub function interposing. We apply Iceberg to four open-source DNS engines, identifying 12 new bugs while keeping manual effort low.
papers.abstract_zh:
DNS权威引擎作为DNS服务的核心，负责用DNS响应来回答DNS查询，任何错误都可能导致严重后果。虽然确保引擎的正确性至关重要，但现有的解决方案在应用于大型且复杂的实施时，无法同时提供正确性保证和低手动工作量。最先进的解决方案 DNS-V 依赖于额外的手动规范来进行扩展验证，但这仍然会产生高昂的成本。

在本文中，我们提出了 Iceberg，这是一种用于 DNS 权威引擎的自动验证框架，可从整体上减少手动工作。为了实现这一目标，我们提出了即时 (JIT) 摘要，这是一种防细化方法，利用 DNS 区域的不变量来实现在整个验证过程中使用自动摘要，特别是对于特定于域的 DNS 操作。此外，我们采用了一系列技术来进一步扩展自动化，包括符号区域、摘要优化和存根函数插入。我们将 Iceberg 应用于四个开源 DNS 引擎，识别出 12 个新错误，同时保持较低的手动工作量。

papers.title: In Link We Trust: BFT at the Speed of CFT using Switches.
papers.abstract: We introduce SwitchBFT , a novel BFT consensus protocol for data centers that matches the performance and fault tolerance guarantees of the fastest Crash Fault Tolerance (CFT) protocols. We take advantage of several unique properties of the trusted network that have emerged in modern data centers. SwitchBFT leverages packet source authentication to eliminate the overheads of cryptographic signatures, thus speeding up the fault-free scenario, and utilizes network switch programmability to enforce agreement decisions and to verify that safety is not violated, thereby offering robust performance even when some replicas are faulty. Designing a practical BFT that makes the most of these properties requires solving several challenges, such as packet losses and switch crash faults, all within the tight switch resource budget. We show that SwitchBFT outperforms state-of-the-art BFTs in scalability and performance, attaining the speed of NOPaxos, an in-switch CFT implementation.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们推出 SwitchBFT，这是一种适用于数据中心的新型 BFT 共识协议，其性能和容错保证可与最快的崩溃容错 (CFT) 协议相匹配。我们利用现代数据中心中出现的可信网络的几个独特属性。 SwitchBFT 利用数据包源身份验证来消除加密签名的开销，从而加快无故障场景的速度，并利用网络交换机可编程性来强制执行协议决策并验证安全性未被违反，从而即使在某些副本出现故障时也能提供强大的性能。设计一个能够充分利用这些特性的实用 BFT 需要解决一些挑战，例如数据包丢失和交换机崩溃故障，所有这些都在紧张的交换机资源预算范围内。我们证明 SwitchBFT 在可扩展性和性能方面优于最先进的 BFT，达到了交换机内 CFT 实现 NOPaxos 的速度。

papers.title: Iris: Expressive Traffic Analysis for the Modern Internet.
papers.abstract: In this work, we investigate the needs of modern traffic analysis, and we introduce Iris, a framework for efficiently building complex, high-performance traffic analysis applications. Iris's key contribution is a compiler that transforms user-defined traffic filters, stream transformations, and computation written in Rust into an optimized processing pipeline. The Iris compiler eliminates redundant logic across analysis tasks to generate a unified runtime that minimizes aggregate work, allowing it to scale to hundreds of concurrent workloads. Rather than restricting users to a domain-specific query language, Iris provides a flexible development environment by exposing connection- and application-layer semantics as Rust data types to user-defined functions. We show that Iris can execute hundreds of analysis tasks concurrently at 100Gbps+ on a single commodity server, and we demonstrate its flexibility through three use cases drawn from prior work.
papers.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们研究了现代流量分析的需求，并介绍了 Iris，一个用于高效构建复杂、高性能流量分析应用程序的框架。 Iris 的主要贡献是一个编译器，它将用户定义的流量过滤器、流转换和用 Rust 编写的计算转换为优化的处理管道。 Iris 编译器消除了分析任务之间的冗余逻辑，以生成统一的运行时，最大限度地减少聚合工作，使其能够扩展到数百个并发工作负载。 Iris 没有将用户限制为特定于域的查询语言，而是通过将连接层和应用程序层语义作为 Rust 数据类型公开给用户定义的函数，提供了灵活的开发环境。我们展示了 Iris 可以在单个商用服务器上以 100Gbps+ 的速度同时执行数百个分析任务，并且我们通过从先前工作中提取的三个用例展示了其灵活性。

papers.title: JITServe: SLO-aware LLM Serving with Imprecise Request Information.
papers.abstract:
The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into applications ranging from interactive chatbots to multi-agent systems has introduced a wide spectrum of service-level objectives (SLOs) for responsiveness. These include latency-sensitive requests emphasizing per-token latency in streaming chat, deadline-sensitive requests requiring rapid full responses to trigger external tools, and compound requests with evolving dependencies across multiple LLM calls. Despite—or perhaps, because of—this workload diversity and unpredictable request information (e.g., response lengths and dependencies), existing request schedulers have focused on aggregate performance, unable to ensure application-level SLO needs.

This paper presents JITServe, the first SLO-aware LLM serving system designed to maximize service goodput (e.g., the number of tokens meeting request SLOs) across diverse workloads . JITServe novelly schedules requests using imprecise request information and gradually relaxes this conservatism by refining request information estimates as generation progresses. It applies a grouped margin goodput maximization algorithm to allocate just enough serving bandwidth to satisfy each request's SLO just-in-time (JIT), maximizing residual capacity for others, while deciding the composition of requests in a batch to maximize efficiency and goodput with provable guarantees. Our evaluation across diverse realistic workloads, including chat, deep research, and agentic pipelines, shows that JITServe improves service goodput by 1.4×–6.3×, alternatively achieving 28.5%–83.2% resource savings, compared to state-of-the-art designs.
papers.abstract_zh:
将大型语言模型 (LLM) 集成到从交互式聊天机器人到多代理系统等应用程序中，引入了广泛的响应能力服务级别目标 (SLO)。其中包括强调流聊天中每个令牌延迟的延迟敏感请求、需要快速完整响应以触发外部工具的截止时间敏感请求，以及跨多个 LLM 调用不断变化的依赖关系的复合请求。尽管（或者可能由于）这种工作负载多样性和不可预测的请求信息（例如，响应长度和依赖性），现有的请求调度程序仍然专注于总体性能，无法确保应用程序级 SLO 需求。

本文介绍了 JITServe，这是第一个 SLO 感知的 LLM 服务系统，旨在最大限度地提高不同工作负载的服务吞吐量（例如，满足请求 SLO 的令牌数量）。 JITServe 新颖地使用不精确的请求信息来调度请求，并通过随着生成的进展而细化请求信息估计来逐渐放松这种保守性。它应用分组余量有效吞吐量最大化算法来分配足够的服务带宽以满足每个请求的 SLO 即时 (JIT)，最大化其他请求的剩余容量，同时决定批量请求的组成，以在可证明的保证下最大化效率和有效吞吐量。我们对各种实际工作负载（包括聊天、深入研究和代理管道）的评估表明，与最先进的设计相比，JITServe 将服务吞吐量提高了 1.4×–6.3×，或者实现了 28.5%–83.2% 的资源节省。

papers.title: KeepON: Supporting Deterministic Traffic on Standard NICs.
papers.abstract: Networked mission-critical applications (e.g., avionics control and industrial automation) demand deterministic packet transmissions to meet stringent sensing and control timing requirements. While specialized infrastructures such as TimeTriggered Ethernet and Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN) ensure deterministic data delivery across switches, end devices still require specialized NICs (e.g., TSN NICs or NVIDIA Mellanox) to eliminate endpoint indeterminism. However, deploying such NICs at every endpoint is costly and hinders compatibility with legacy systems. To address this challenge, we propose KeepON, a novel software-based driver model that enables deterministic packet transmission on commodity NICs. The core idea is to continuously transmit fixed-size placeholder packets, establishing a predictable transmission pattern. Mission-critical packets are then precisely inserted into this stream by replacing placeholders at their scheduled transmission slots, ensuring timing accuracy. The placeholder packets are efficiently dropped at the first-hop switch, avoiding negative impacts on network performance. We prototype KeepON by modifying the standard NIC driver of a Raspberry Pi, and integrate it into a real-world TSN testbed. Experimental results show that KeepON achieves up to 130× improvement in scheduling accuracy compared to the default driver, and 2.1× improvement over a hardware-based solution.
papers.abstract_zh: 网络关键任务应用（例如航空电子控制和工业自动化）需要确定性数据包传输，以满足严格的传感和控制时序要求。虽然时间触发以太网和时间敏感网络 (TSN) 等专用基础设施可确保跨交换机的确定性数据传输，但终端设备仍然需要专用 NIC（例如 TSN NIC 或 NVIDIA Mellanox）来消除端点不确定性。然而，在每个端点部署此类 NIC 成本高昂，并且会妨碍与遗留系统的兼容性。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了 KeepON，这是一种基于软件的新型驱动程序模型，可在商用 NIC 上实现确定性数据包传输。其核心思想是连续传输固定大小的占位符数据包，建立可预测的传输模式。然后，通过替换预定传输时隙中的占位符，将关键任务数据包精确地插入到该流中，从而确保定时准确性。占位符数据包在第一跳交换机处被有效丢弃，避免对网络性能产生负面影响。我们通过修改 Raspberry Pi 的标准 NIC 驱动程序对 KeepON 进行原型设计，并将其集成到现实世界的 TSN 测试台中。实验结果表明，与默认驱动程序相比，KeepON 的调度精度提高了 130 倍，比基于硬件的解决方案提高了 2.1 倍。

papers.title: KRAKENGUARD: Towards Fine-Grained eBPF Isolation.
papers.abstract:
eBPF is a powerful in-kernel virtual machine that enables dynamic, safe extensions to operating system kernels. Despite the guarantees provided by its in-kernel verifier, eBPF’s access control model remains coarse-grained, relying on broad Linux capabilities, such as CAP_BPF. Once granted, these allow unrestricted loading of eBPF programs to different kernel hooks. This poses serious security risks in multi-tenant or untrusted environments, where a compromised or malicious process can misuse eBPF to trace sensitive activity, access kernel memory, or disrupt system behavior. While existing verification ensures safety properties, it cannot enforce fine-grained constraints on what programs can do.

We present KRAKENGUARD, a trusted user-space manager that enforces fine-grained, policy-driven constraints on eBPF bytecode at load time. Using symbolic execution, it checks all program paths for compliance with policies on helper usage, memory accesses, and return values. It enables safe delegation of program loading by unprivileged processes and detects cross-program interference to ensure safe co-location of eBPF programs on the same host.

We show that KRAKENGUARD can block the misuse of restricted helpers, unauthorized memory and map access, and unsafe packet modifications in real-world eBPF programs, while also being able to detect existing CVEs. As a use case, we implement an XDP-as-a-Service application that securely runs XDP programs belonging to different tenants directly on the host interface after guaranteeing they cannot do anything malicious and that they do not interfere with each other.
papers.abstract_zh:
eBPF 是一个功能强大的内核虚拟机，可以对操作系统内核进行动态、安全的扩展。尽管内核验证器提供了保证，但 eBPF 的访问控制模型仍然是粗粒度的，依赖于广泛的 Linux 功能，例如 CAP_BPF。一旦获得授权，它们就允许将 eBPF 程序不受限制地加载到不同的内核挂钩。这在多租户或不受信任的环境中带来了严重的安全风险，在这些环境中，受损或恶意进程可能会滥用 eBPF 来跟踪敏感活动、访问内核内存或破坏系统行为。虽然现有的验证可以确保安全属性，但它无法对程序可以执行的操作实施细粒度的限制。

我们推出了 KRAKENGUARD，这是一个值得信赖的用户空间管理器，它在加载时对 eBPF 字节码实施细粒度、策略驱动的约束。使用符号执行，它检查所有程序路径是否符合帮助程序使用、内存访问和返回值的策略。它支持非特权进程对程序加载的安全委托，并检测跨程序干扰，以确保 eBPF 程序在同一主机上安全共置。

我们证明 KRAKENGUARD 可以阻止对受限助手的滥用、未经授权的内存和映射访问以及现实世界 eBPF 程序中不安全的数据包修改，同时还能够检测现有的 CVE。作为一个用例，我们实现了一个 XDP 即服务应用程序，该应用程序在保证不同租户不会执行任何恶意行为并且不会相互干扰后，直接在主机接口上安全地运行属于不同租户的 XDP 程序。

papers.title: KUBEDIRECT: Unleashing the Full Power of the Cluster Manager for Serverless Computing.
papers.abstract:
FaaS platforms rely on cluster managers like Kubernetes for resource management. Kubernetes is popular due to its extensible state-centric APIs and modular architecture. However, to scale out a burst of FaaS instances, message passing becomes the primary bottleneck as controllers have to exchange extensive state through the API Server. Existing solutions opt for a clean-slate redesign of cluster managers, at the expense of ecosystem compatibility and substantial engineering effort.

We present KUBEDIRECT, a Kubernetes-based cluster manager for FaaS. We find that there exists a common narrow waist across FaaS platforms that allows us to achieve both efficiency and external compatibility. The narrow waist has a sequential structure that obviates the need for a single source of truth, allowing us to bypass the API Server and perform lightweight direct message passing. However, our approach introduces distributed and ephemeral state across controllers, making it challenging to enforce end-to-end semantics without centralized coordination. KUBEDIRECT performs novel state management that leverages the narrow waist as a hierarchical write-back cache , ensuring consistency and convergence to the desired state. KUBEDIRECT can seamlessly integrate with Kubernetes, adding ~150 LoC per controller. KUBEDIRECT can reduce serving latency by 26.7× over Knative, and has similar performance as the state-of-the-art clean-slate platform Dirigent.
papers.abstract_zh:
FaaS 平台依赖 Kubernetes 等集群管理器进行资源管理。 Kubernetes 因其可扩展的以状态为中心的 API 和模块化架构而广受欢迎。然而，为了横向扩展 FaaS 实例的爆发，消息传递成为主要瓶颈，因为控制器必须通过 API Server 交换大量状态。现有的解决方案选择对集群管理器进行全新的重新设计，但牺牲了生态系统兼容性和大量的工程工作。

我们推出了 KUBEDIRECT，这是一个基于 Kubernetes 的 FaaS 集群管理器。我们发现FaaS平台之间存在一个共同的“窄腰”，使我们能够同时实现效率和外部兼容性。窄腰具有顺序结构，消除了对单一事实来源的需要，使我们能够绕过 API Server 并执行轻量级直接消息传递。然而，我们的方法在控制器之间引入了分布式和短暂的状态，使得在没有集中协调的情况下实施端到端语义变得具有挑战性。 KUBEDIRECT 执行新颖的状态管理，利用窄腰作为分层回写缓存，确保一致性和收敛到所需状态。 KUBEDIRECT 可以与 Kubernetes 无缝集成，为每个控制器添加约 150 个 LoC。 KUBEDIRECT can reduce serving latency by 26.7× over Knative, and has similar performance as the state-of-the-art clean-slate platform Dirigent.

papers.title: Latency-Aware Caching with Delayed Hits: From Bursty Traffic to Pipeline Architectures.
papers.abstract:
Modern computing systems rely on caching to reduce access latency and optimize resource utilization. However, in heterogeneous storage and cloud environments, non-uniform access latencies across storage tiers, network locations, and intermediary caches undermine traditional caching. Moreover, modern cache algorithms that attempt to capture multiple access patterns, recency, frequency, and burstiness, often become complex and difficult to maintain.

As a key contribution, we propose an adaptive caching architecture that treats caching strategies as a pipeline of simple, orthogonal policies, each focused on a distinct access bias. This modular design is easier to expand, debug, and integrate, and it self-adjusts the memory resources allocated to each stage to optimize overall workload performance. New heuristics can be introduced dynamically without disrupting existing behaviors.

In addition, in latency-aware caching, one often encounters the phenomenon of delayed hits, where items not yet available in the cache are requested repeatedly. We introduce the Least Bursty Used (LBU) heuristic, which retains items exhibiting high burstiness even when they are neither recent nor frequent, thereby mitigating delayed hits that degrade request latency. We embed LBU within our pipeline and derive the Recency–Frequency–Burstiness (RFB) policy, which balances resources among recency, frequency, and burstiness. Evaluations on thirteen real-world storage traces from IBM, Twitter and Meta using latencies drawn from real-life deployments show that RFB reduces average request latency by 10% compared to the best state-of-the-art alternative, while maintaining consistent performance, with a low standard deviation across bursty and non-bursty workloads.
papers.abstract_zh:
现代计算系统依靠缓存来减少访问延迟并优化资源利用率。然而，在异构存储和云环境中，跨存储层、网络位置和中间缓存的不一致访问延迟会破坏传统缓存。此外，试图捕获多种访问模式、新近度、频率和突发性的现代缓存算法通常变得复杂且难以维护。

作为一个关键贡献，我们提出了一种自适应缓存架构，它将缓存策略视为简单、正交策略的管道，每个策略都专注于不同的访问偏差。这种模块化设计更易于扩展、调试和集成，并且可以自我调整分配给每个阶段的内存资源，以优化整体工作负载性能。可以动态地引入新的启发式方法，而不会破坏现有的行为。

此外，在延迟感知缓存中，经常会遇到延迟命中的现象，即重复请求缓存中尚未可用的项目。我们引入了最少突发使用（LBU）启发式，它保留表现出高突发性的项目，即使它们既不是最近的也不频繁，从而减轻了降低请求延迟的延迟命中。我们将 LBU 嵌入到我们的管道中，并导出新近度-频率-突发性 (RFB) 策略，该策略在新近度、频率和突发性之间平衡资源。使用从实际部署中提取的延迟对来自 IBM、Twitter 和 Meta 的 13 个实际存储跟踪进行的评估表明，与最先进的替代方案相比，RFB 将平均请求延迟降低了 10%，同时保持一致的性能，并且在突发和非突发工作负载中具有较低的标准偏差。

papers.title: Law: Towards Consistent Low Latency in 802.11 Home Networks.
papers.abstract: Wireless ultra-low-latency video streaming over 802.11 WiFi networks is increasingly popular, but the latency on the Wi-Fi link is always fluctuating. With the development of CDNs and edge servers, the fluctuation of the wireless lasthop is increasingly dominating the fluctuation of the end-toend latency. In this paper, we investigate the reasons why the existing Wi-Fi link layer will have a fluctuating latency from a systematic perspective. We find that the hierarchical queueing structure, queue-agnostic rate adaptation, and delay-insensitive retry management of the existing link layer design are the main reasons to a latency spike when channel fluctuates. Thus, we propose LAtency-bounded Wi-Fi (Law), an 802.11 link layer architecture to provide a consistent low latency for the application. Law exploits the loss tolerance ability from the upper layer video streaming application and significantly avoids the latency spikes caused by the blockage in the link layer at the cost of acceptably additional packet loss. Law maintains a high goodput by carefully redesigning the queueing structure and introducing fine-grained control for each transmission opportunity. We implement the prototype of Law on OpenWiFi and test it with WebRTC – both the tail frame latency and stall rate can be significantly reduced over existing baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 通过 802.11 WiFi 网络的无线超低延迟视频流越来越受欢迎，但 Wi-Fi 链路上的延迟始终在波动。随着CDN和边缘服务器的发展，无线最后一站的波动越来越主导端到端延迟的波动。在本文中，我们从系统角度探讨了现有Wi-Fi链路层时延波动的原因。我们发现现有链路层设计的分层排队结构、与队列无关的速率自适应和对延迟不敏感的重试管理是通道波动时出现延迟峰值的主要原因。因此，我们提出了 LAtency-bounded Wi-Fi（Law），这是一种 802.11 链路层架构，可为应用程序提供一致的低延迟。 Law利用了上层视频流应用程序的丢包能力，并以可接受的额外数据包丢失为代价，显着避免了链路层阻塞引起的延迟峰值。 Law 通过仔细地重新设计排队结构并为每个传输机会引入细粒度控制来保持高吞吐量。我们在 OpenWiFi 上实现了 Law 的原型，并使用 WebRTC 对其进行了测试——尾帧延迟和停顿率都比现有基线显着降低。

papers.title: Learning to Tune Optical WANs: A Field Deployment of Noise Models in Optical Networks.
papers.abstract: Accurately modeling optical signal transmission is critical for optimizing network performance, particularly in large-scale fiber optic networks operated by Internet Service Providers. In this work, we develop a Gaussian Noise model for a New York state ISP's optical backbone. Our model accounts for all major network components, including amplifiers, fiber spans, reconfigurable optical add-drop multiplexers, and transceivers. By accurately predicting end-to-end signal-to-noise ratio, our model provides a foundation for network performance analysis and optimization. Then, we leverage hyperparameter search techniques—commonly used in machine learning—to identify amplifier gain settings that improve signal quality. By treating the model as an opaque box, we systematically search for amplifier configurations that maximize the predicted end-to-end SNR while maintaining practical network constraints. We validate our approach through a field deployment by applying optimized amplifier gain settings in a live ISP network. Our results show a significant improvement in optical signal quality, achieving a 2 dB increase in SNR on a single wavelength.
papers.abstract_zh: 准确建模光信号传输对于优化网络性能至关重要，特别是在互联网服务提供商运营的大规模光纤网络中。在这项工作中，我们为纽约州 ISP 的光骨干网开发了高斯噪声模型。我们的模型考虑了所有主要网络组件，包括放大器、光纤跨度、可重新配置的光分插复用器和收发器。通过准确预测端到端信噪比，我们的模型为网络性能分析和优化提供了基础。然后，我们利用机器学习中常用的超参数搜索技术来识别可提高信号质量的放大器增益设置。通过将模型视为不透明的盒子，我们系统地搜索放大器配置，以最大化预测的端到端 SNR，同时保持实际的网络约束。我们通过在实时 ISP 网络中应用优化的放大器增益设置来验证我们的方法。我们的结果表明光信号质量显着提高，单个波长的 SNR 提高了 2 dB。

papers.title: Lemonshark: Asynchronous DAG-BFT With Early Finality.
papers.abstract:
DAG-Rider popularized a new paradigm of DAG-BFT protocols, separating dissemination from consensus: all nodes disseminate transactions as blocks that reference previously known blocks, while consensus is reached by electing certain blocks as leaders. This design yields high throughput but confers optimal latency only to leader blocks; non-leader blocks cannot be committed independently.

We present Lemonshark, an asynchronous DAG-BFT protocol that reinterprets the DAG at a transactional level and identifies conditions where commitment is sufficient—but not necessary—for safe results, enabling nodes to finalize transactions before official commitment, without compromising correctness. Compared to the state-of-the-art asynchronous BFT protocol, Lemonshark reduces latency by up to 65%.
papers.abstract_zh:
DAG-Rider 推广了 DAG-BFT 协议的新范式，将传播与共识分开：所有节点将交易作为引用先前已知区块的区块进行传播，而共识则通过选举某些区块作为领导者来达成。这种设计可产生高吞吐量，但仅为领导块提供最佳延迟；非领导者区块不能独立提交。

我们推出了 Lemonshark，一种异步 DAG-BFT 协议，它在交易级别重新解释 DAG，并识别承诺对于安全结果来说是充分但不是必要的条件，使节点能够在正式承诺之前完成交易，而不会影响正确性。与最先进的异步 BFT 协议相比，Lemonshark 可将延迟降低高达 65%。

papers.title: Libra: Flexible Request Partitioning and Scheduling for Serving Unbalanced and Dynamic LLM Workloads.
papers.abstract:
LLM inference must meet strict latency SLOs while maximizing throughput. Yet, real-world variability in prompt and response lengths skews compute-intensive prefill and memory-bound decode phases, making both colocated (even with chunked prefill) and disaggregated deployments unable to simultaneously deliver low tail latency and high throughput.

We introduce Libra, a high performance LLM serving system that maximizes goodput under SLO constraints even when handling imbalanced and dynamic workloads. At the core of Libra is a micro-request based flexible partitioning and scheduling (FPS) abstraction. The abstraction splits each request at any token boundary into multiple cooperating segments. Libra then designs a two-level scheduling framework that balances micro-request load across unified GPU instances. The framework consists of a global scheduler that selects per-request split points, and a local scheduler on each GPU instance to form SLO-aware batches. Finally, Libra uses chunked KV cache transfers to support cross-instance micro-request execution. On real-world traces, Libra improves goodput by up to 1.91× and 1.61×, increases serving capacity from 1.15× to 3.07×, and improves serving performance by up to 74.2% in a hybrid workload under strict SLOs and A100/H100 GPUs compared to state-of-the-art colocated and disaggregated baselines.
papers.abstract_zh:
LLM 推理必须满足严格的延迟 SLO，同时最大化吞吐量。然而，现实世界中提示和响应长度的变化会影响计算密集型预填充和内存限制的解码阶段，使得共置（即使使用分块预填充）和分解部署无法同时提供低尾部延迟和高吞吐量。

我们推出 Libra，这是一种高性能 LLM 服务系统，即使在处理不平衡和动态工作负载时，也能在 SLO 约束下最大化吞吐量。 Libra 的核心是基于微请求的灵活分区和调度（FPS）抽象。该抽象将任意令牌边界处的每个请求拆分为多个协作段。然后，Libra 设计了一个两级调度框架，用于平衡统一 GPU 实例之间的微请求负载。该框架由一个全局调度程序（选择每个请求的分割点）和每个 GPU 实例上的本地调度程序（用于形成 SLO 感知批次）组成。最后，Libra 使用分块 KV 缓存传输来支持跨实例微请求执行。在实际跟踪中，与最先进的共置和分解基线相比，Libra 将吞吐量提高了高达 1.91 倍和 1.61 倍，将服务容量从 1.15 倍提高到 3.07 倍，并在严格的 SLO 和 A100/H100 GPU 下的混合工作负载中将服务性能提高了高达 74.2%。

papers.title: MAE: More Adaptive Video Encoder for Consistent Low Latency in High-Quality Real-Time Communication.
papers.abstract: Real-time communication (RTC) is integral to modern digital life. However, high-quality RTC services still experience tail latency spikes. A primary cause of this issue is the sender’s slow adaptation to network fluctuations—when network bandwidth drops, the sender needs to quickly reduce the sending rate to avoid bufferbloat. Existing solutions focus on accelerating reactions in the network, transport layer, or sender-side buffer management, but often overlook a critical component: the reaction of the video encoder. The encoder serves as the content source, where slow convergence to new bitrates can still result in bufferbloat after the encoder. With the increasing video bitrate in high-quality RTC, our measurement shows that the encoder’s reaction is critical. To address this limitation, we propose M ore A daptive E ncoder (MAE), a framework that enables encoders to dynamically adapt to network changes with finer-grained network information. On the encoder side, MAE adaptively adjusts the internal encoding parameters to quickly converge to the target bitrate without affecting the video quality. On the network side, MAE probes the internal state of current congestion control algorithms to preemptively react to potential bandwidth drops, without waiting for the late, backpressured bitrate updates. Trace-driven emulation and real-world experiments demonstrate that our solution, MAE, reduces stall rates by 86.2% while maintaining superior visual quality compared to the state of the art.
papers.abstract_zh: 实时通信 (RTC) 是现代数字生活不可或缺的一部分。然而，高质量的 RTC 服务仍然会遇到尾部延迟峰值。造成这个问题的主要原因是发送方对网络波动的适应缓慢——当网络带宽下降时，发送方需要快速降低发送速率以避免缓冲区膨胀。现有的解决方案侧重于加速网络、传输层或发送方缓冲区管理中的反应，但常常忽略一个关键组件：视频编码器的反应。编码器充当内容源，缓慢收敛到新比特率仍可能导致编码器之后的缓冲区膨胀。随着高质量 RTC 中视频比特率的增加，我们的测量表明编码器的反应至关重要。为了解决这一限制，我们提出了更多自适应编码器（MAE），该框架使编码器能够通过更细粒度的网络信息动态适应网络变化。在编码器端，MAE自适应调整内部编码参数，快速收敛到目标码率，而不影响视频质量。在网络方面，MAE 探测当前拥塞控制算法的内部状态，以先发制人地对潜在的带宽下降做出反应，而无需等待后期的背压比特率更新。跟踪驱动的仿真和真实世界的实验表明，与最先进的技术相比，我们的解决方案 MAE 可将停顿率降低 86.2%，同时保持卓越的视觉质量。

papers.title: Making Logic a First-Class Citizen in Generative ML for Networking.
papers.abstract:
Generative ML models are increasingly popular in networking for tasks such as telemetry imputation, prediction, and synthetic trace generation. Despite their capabilities, they suffer from two shortcomings: (i) their output is often visibly violating well-known networking rules, which undermines their trustworthiness; and (ii) they are difficult to control, frequently requiring retraining even for minor changes.

To address these limitations and unlock the benefits of generative models for networking, we propose a new paradigm for integrating explicit network knowledge, in the form of first-order logic rules, into ML models used for networking tasks. Rules capture well-known relationships among observed signals, e.g., that increased latency precedes packet loss. While the idea is conceptually straightforward, its realization is challenging: networking knowledge is rarely formalized into rules, and naively injecting rules into ML models often hampers their effectiveness. This paper introduces NetNomos, a multi-stage framework that (i) learns rules directly from data (e.g., measurements); (ii) filters them to select semantically meaningful ones; and (iii) enforces them through collaborative generation between an ML model and a Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT) solver.

We show that NetNomos learns diverse, meaningful rules from four real-world datasets and is 1.6–6.5× more scalable than DuoAI, a state-of-the-art (SOTA) rule-learning method. By enforcing these rules on a generic GPT-2 model, NetNomos achieves performance on par with or even surpassing specialized SOTA systems such as Zoom2Net and NetShare across three networking tasks: telemetry imputation, traffic forecasting, and synthetic data generation.
papers.abstract_zh:
生成式机器学习模型在遥测插补、预测和合成轨迹生成等任务的网络中越来越受欢迎。尽管它们的能力很强，但它们仍然存在两个缺点：（i）它们的输出经常明显违反众所周知的网络规则，这损害了它们的可信度； (ii) 它们难以控制，即使是微小的变化也经常需要重新培训。

为了解决这些限制并释放网络生成模型的优势，我们提出了一种新的范式，以一阶逻辑规则的形式将显式网络知识集成到用于网络任务的机器学习模型中。规则捕获观察到的信号之间众所周知的关系，例如，延迟增加先于数据包丢失。虽然这个想法在概念上很简单，但其实现具有挑战性：网络知识很少被形式化为规则，并且天真地将规则注入机器学习模型通常会妨碍其有效性。本文介绍了 NetNomos，这是一个多阶段框架，它 (i) 直接从数据（例如测量）中学习规则； (ii) 过滤它们以选择语义上有意义的； (iii) 通过 ML 模型和可满足性模理论 (SMT) 求解器之间的协作生成来强制执行它们。

我们证明，NetNomos 从四个现实世界的数据集中学习多样化、有意义的规则，并且比 DuoAI（一种最先进的 (SOTA) 规则学习方法）的可扩展性高 1.6-6.5 倍。通过在通用 GPT-2 模型上执行这些规则，NetNomos 在遥测估算、流量预测和合成数据生成这三个网络任务中实现了与 Zoom2Net 和 NetShare 等专业 SOTA 系统相当甚至超越的性能。

papers.title: Managing Congestion Control Heterogeneity on the Internet with Approximate Performance Isolation.
papers.abstract: The Internet hosts a diverse mix of congestion control algorithms (CCAs) optimized for specific throughput-delay tradeoffs. However, traditional queuing disciplines and AQMs struggle to manage this heterogeneity and often lead to unfairness and suboptimal performance. In this paper, we explore isolation techniques that can allow competing CCAs to make their desired throughput-delay trade-offs independent of who they compete with. More specifically, we motivate Approximate Performance Isolation between competing flows by grouping flows with similar desired throughput-delay trade-offs in the same queue. We also present Santa, a new practical and scalable multi-queue AQM built on the principles of approximate performance isolation. Santa infers each flow’s throughput-delay preferences by comparing their buffer occupancy, and shuffles aggressive ("naughty") and passive ("nice") flows into appropriate queues over time. We prototype Santa on a programmable switch to demonstrate that it is practical, scalable, and can approximate the isolation benefits of Fair Queuing (FQ) with a handful of of queues.
papers.abstract_zh: 互联网拥有多种拥塞控制算法 (CCA)，这些算法针对特定的吞吐量延迟权衡进行了优化。然而，传统的排队规则和 AQM 很难管理这种异质性，并且常常导致不公平和次优的性能。在本文中，我们探索了隔离技术，这些技术可以让竞争的 CCA 做出所需的吞吐量-延迟权衡，而与他们的竞争者无关。更具体地说，我们通过将具有相似的所需吞吐量延迟权衡的流分组到同一队列中来激励竞争流之间的近似性能隔离。我们还推出了 Santa，一种基于近似性能隔离原则构建的新型实用且可扩展的多队列 AQM。圣诞老人通过比较缓冲区占用率来推断每个流的吞吐量延迟偏好，并随着时间的推移将积极（“顽皮”）和被动（“好”）流洗牌到适当的队列中。我们在可编程交换机上对 Santa 进行原型设计，以证明它实用、可扩展，并且可以通过少量队列来近似公平队列 (FQ) 的隔离优势。

papers.title: Matryoshka: Realizing Hyperscale Data Center Network Design for the AI Era.
papers.abstract:
Over the past decade, data center networking (DCN) has undergone substantial transformation in terms of both scale and complexity. Developing a DCN entails multiple intricate steps, such as establishing physical connections, configuring logical network addressing, and defining high-level routing policies. While extensive work has focused on logical DCN design and physical deployment, a critical gap remains: materializing these designs into concrete switch configurations—a necessary step to realize the development procedure. This problem is especially acute in the AI era, as hyperscale, rapidly evolving, and highly heterogeneous AI-driven clusters place unprecedented demands on DCN design and implementation.

This paper presents Matryoshka, Meta’s production-scale DCN design system that bridges this gap. Matryoshka employs an intent-based, model-driven approach to systematically compile high-level DCN design intents into working switch configurations. Operational for over six years, Matryoshka has supported orders-of-magnitude growth in Meta’s DCN infrastructure, guiding the design nearly 900 DCNs across 18 distinct types, including the latest 100K-GPU supercluster for AI training. We share our experience in building and operating Matryoshka, highlighting how it empowers the rapid design and evolution of AI clusters nowadays.
papers.abstract_zh:
在过去的十年中，数据中心网络 (DCN) 在规模和复杂性方面都经历了巨大的转变。开发DCN需要多个复杂的步骤，例如建立物理连接、配置逻辑网络寻址以及定义高级路由策略。虽然大量工作集中在逻辑 DCN 设计和物理部署上，但仍然存在一个关键差距：将这些设计具体化为具体的交换机配置——这是实现开发过程的必要步骤。这个问题在人工智能时代尤其严重，因为超大规模、快速发展和高度异构的人工智能驱动集群对DCN设计和实施提出了前所未有的要求。

本文介绍了 Matryoshka，Meta 的生产规模 DCN 设计系统弥补了这一差距。 Matryoshka 采用基于意图的模型驱动方法，系统地将高级 DCN 设计意图编译为工作交换机配置。 Matryoshka 运行六年多来，支持 Meta DCN 基础设施的数量级增长，指导设计 18 种不同类型的近 900 个 DCN，包括用于 AI 训练的最新 100K-GPU 超级集群。我们分享我们在构建和运营俄罗斯套娃方面的经验，重点介绍它如何支持当今人工智能集群的快速设计和演进。

papers.title: Medley: Optimizing Midgress Bandwidth for Commercial Live Streaming CDNs.
papers.abstract:
The rapid expansion of live streaming services in recent years has introduced new cost challenges for Content Delivery Networks (CDNs).
