Unlike conventional Video on Demand (VoD) streaming, where CDNs can utilize the off-peak hours to preload video content on edge nodes, live streaming requires real-time delivery across CDN nodes before reaching end users, significantly increasing midgress bandwidth costs for service providers. Characteristics such as real-time content generation and consumption, strict requirements for service quality, and systems that need to scale with diverse resources to support the increase in large-scale users, make it difficult to optimize live-streaming midgress traffic with traditional DNS-based and redirection-based methods.

At ByteDance, we have successfully implemented a substream-based CDN architecture to minimize midgress bandwidth for our commercial live streaming services. By dividing a video stream into multiple sub-streams and assigning each to a different edge node, the system can substantially reduce midgress traffic while adapting to the increasing scale of the system and live-stream users. We present Medley, a production-grade substream delivery system, and validate its efficacy through a large-scale, real-world deployment. Running on one of the largest live streaming platforms, Medley handled up to 0.85 million concurrent viewing requests per minute during peak hours. Our evaluations show that Medley reduces midgress costs by 76.83%, while maintaining consistent Quality of Experience (QoE).
papers.abstract_zh:
近年来直播服务的快速扩张给内容分发网络（CDN）带来了新的成本挑战。与传统的视频点播 (VoD) 流媒体不同，传统的视频点播 (VoD) 流媒体可以利用非高峰时段在边缘节点上预加载视频内容，实时流媒体直播需要在到达最终用户之前跨 CDN 节点进行实时传输，从而显着增加了服务提供商的中间带宽成本。实时内容生成和消费、对服务质量的严格要求以及系统需要通过多种资源扩展以支持大规模用户的增长等特点，使得传统的基于DNS和重定向的方法难以优化直播中间流量。

在字节跳动，我们成功实现了基于子流的 CDN 架构，以最大程度地减少商业直播服务的中间带宽。通过将视频流划分为多个子流并将每个子流分配给不同的边缘节点，系统可以大幅减少中间流量，同时适应系统规模和直播用户的不断增长。我们推出了 Medley，一种生产级子流传输系统，并通过大规模的实际部署验证了其功效。 Medley 在最大的直播平台之一上运行，在高峰时段每分钟处理高达 85 万个并发观看请求。我们的评估表明，Medley 将中期成本降低了 76.83%，同时保持了一致的体验质量 (QoE)。

papers.title: MirrorNet: High-fidelity and Scalable Network Emulation for Software-defined WAN.
papers.abstract: Operating a large-scale WAN reliably is becoming increasingly challenging due to the surge in traffic volumes, and the growing complexity of both software and hardware. In this paper, we introduce MirrorNet, our production-grade emulation framework designed to mirror a software-based WAN. Unlike traditional emulators and simulators that access only a partial set of network information, MirrorNet functions as a comprehensive twin of the production network, encompassing the controller, data plane, and network traffic. Our key challenge lies in striking a balance between the requirements for a fine-grained and high-fidelity emulation, scalability, and resource efficiency. To address these, we have developed a multi-faceted approach: i) we employ an incremental storage and replay method to reconstruct the historical production network at a second-by-second level; ii) we propose a network update strategy that maintains consistent alignment between the emulation and production networks; and iii) we design a custom orchestrator capable of rapidly deploying one or more large-scale emulation networks, which can operate concurrently to expedite testing. MirrorNet has been deployed in TWAN for over 2 years and integral in our daily WAN management tasks, aiding in troubleshooting, parameter tuning, testing, and capacity assessment.
papers.abstract_zh: 由于流量激增以及软件和硬件的复杂性不断增加，可靠地运营大规模 WAN 变得越来越具有挑战性。在本文中，我们介绍了 MirrorNet，这是我们的生产级仿真框架，旨在镜像基于软件的 WAN。与仅访问部分网络信息集的传统仿真器和仿真器不同，MirrorNet 充当生产网络的综合双胞胎，包含控制器、数据平面和网络流量。我们的主要挑战在于在细粒度和高保真仿真、可扩展性和资源效率的要求之间取得平衡。为了解决这些问题，我们开发了一种多方面的方法：i）我们采用增量存储和重放的方法来重建历史生产网络的秒级； ii）我们提出了一种网络更新策略，以保持仿真网络和生产网络之间的一致一致性； iii) 我们设计了一种定制编排器，能够快速部署一个或多个大规模仿真网络，该网络可以同时运行以加快测试速度。 MirrorNet 已在 TWAN 中部署超过 2 年，并成为我们日常 WAN 管理任务的一部分，有助于故障排除、参数调整、测试和容量评估。

papers.title: Mitigating CPU Frontend for Complex Data Plane Applications.
papers.abstract: The functionality and requirement of modern networks are becoming increasingly complex, giving rise to Complex Data Plane Applications (CDPA) with rich semantics but often limited performance. However, many existing optimizations fail to improve the performance of CDPAs. This is because CDPAs usually come with excessively large code size, which is often two orders of magnitude larger than today's L1 instruction cache (I-cache) size, causing the CPU to frequently stall on accessing instructions, thus presenting a distinct performance profile that bounds on CPU frontend. This paper proposes NanoPL, an I-cache-friendly new execution model that shuffles the packet processing logic to efficiently mitigate CPU frontend for CDPAs. Stemming from the common execution pattern of CDPAs, NanoPL analyzes its code to ensure semantic consistency after shuffling. By collecting performance profile of CDPAs over underlying traffic, NanoPL partitions CDPAs into execution stages and conducts I-cache-friendly shuffling policy. Experiments show that NanoPL can achieve 17.2%~30.2% higher throughput over real world CDPAs due to the reduction of I-cache misses by up to 86.4%.
papers.abstract_zh: 现代网络的功能和要求变得越来越复杂，从而产生了具有丰富语义但性能往往有限的复杂数据平面应用程序（CDPA）。然而，许多现有的优化无法提高 CDPA 的性能。这是因为 CDPA 通常具有过大的代码大小，通常比当今的 L1 指令缓存 (I-cache) 大小大两个数量级，导致 CPU 在访问指令时频繁停滞，从而呈现出限制 CPU 前端的独特性能特征。本文提出了 NanoPL，这是一种 I-cache 友好的新执行模型，它对数据包处理逻辑进行重组，以有效减轻 CDPA 的 CPU 前端问题。源于 CDPA 的常见执行模式，NanoPL 分析其代码以确保改组后的语义一致性。通过收集 CDPA 在底层流量上的性能概况，NanoPL 将 CDPA 划分为执行阶段并执行 I-cache 友好的混洗策略。实验表明，NanoPL 的吞吐量比实际 CDPA 高出 17.2%~30.2%，因为 I-cache 未命中减少了高达 86.4%。

papers.title: MoCE: A Mixture-of-Context Aware Experts Framework for Troubleshooting Internet-scale Services.
papers.abstract:
Modern Internet-scale services need to rapidly identify root causes of customer impacting incidents and remediate them. While there are many algorithms (including LLM-assisted solutions) for root cause analysis, these have significant limitations in terms of coverage , extensibility , and scalability due to the diversity of incidents that can occur at Internet-scale and the complexity of telemetry analysis. We argue the need for a paradigm shift in root cause analysis to depart from algorithm development to a systems approach.

To this end, we introduce a mixture of context-aware experts framework where each “expert” represents a root-cause hypothesis exploration. To enable rapid development of new experts and allow computational reuse across the ensemble for scalability, we design an abstraction that allows us to express an expert as a dataflow DAG combining relational, stateful and statistical operations. To ensure scalability and extensibility, we develop a lazy DAG runtime system that lazily schedules execution of DAG nodes. We implement this idea in MoCE and demonstrate its value using a mix of real-world incident data from four large application analytics providers and synthetically generated incidents. We show many existing and novel approaches can be expressed succinctly in our framework. We find that MoCE achieves high RCA accuracy (>95%) across diverse incidents compared to 34% for the closest single expert (including prior works) achieving high coverage. We also show the value of the mixture paradigm and the lazy DAG runtime using controlled experiments.
papers.abstract_zh:
现代互联网规模的服务需要快速识别影响客户的事件的根本原因并进行补救。虽然有许多用于根本原因分析的算法（包括法学硕士辅助解决方案），但由于互联网规模上可能发生的事件的多样性以及遥测分析的复杂性，这些算法在覆盖范围、可扩展性和可伸缩性方面具有显着的局限性。我们认为根本原因分析需要进行范式转变，从算法开发转向系统方法。

为此，我们引入了上下文感知专家混合框架，其中每个“专家”代表了根本原因假设探索。为了实现新专家的快速开发并允许跨整体的计算重用以实现可扩展性，我们设计了一个抽象，允许我们将专家表示为结合关系、状态和统计操作的数据流 DAG。为了确保可扩展性和可扩展性，我们开发了一个惰性 DAG 运行时系统，可以延迟调度 DAG 节点的执行。我们在 MoCE 中实现了这一想法，并使用来自四个大型应用程序分析提供商的真实事件数据和综合生成的事件的组合来证明其价值。我们展示了许多现有的和新颖的方法可以在我们的框架中简洁地表达。我们发现 MoCE 在不同事件中实现了较高的 RCA 准确度 (>95%)，而最接近的单个专家（包括之前的工作）实现高覆盖率的准确度为 34%。我们还使用受控实验展示了混合范例和惰性 DAG 运行时的价值。

papers.title: MORP4: A Dynamic Network Telescope.
papers.abstract: A network telescope passively monitors traffic reaching Internet address space that is not assigned to any hosts but is advertised to the global routing system. This traffic is by definition unsolicited . For more than two decades, network telescopes have enabled research breakthroughs by allowing global visibility into a wide range of Internet phenomena. However, telescopes are afflicted by two main issues: progressive erosion, due to the increasing scarcity and commercial value of address space, and blacklisting. To overcome these issues, we propose MORP4, a programmable data-plane framework implementing a “dynamic” network telescope. MORP4 accurately and adaptively tracks unused space of an organization’s network with configurable time and space granularity and captures only traffic directed towards unused addresses at line rate. We provide an implementation in P4 and Python/C++, and deploy it on a Tofino switch. We show that it can detect unused IPv4 address space at the finest granularity (/32) while operating at line rate as well as providing an effective approach for operating a telescope in the IPv6 domain.
papers.abstract_zh: 网络望远镜被动地监视到达互联网地址空间的流量，该地址空间未分配给任何主机，而是通告给全球路由系统。根据定义，这种流量是未经请求的。二十多年来，网络望远镜通过让全球了解各种互联网现象实现了研究突破。然而，望远镜受到两个主要问题的困扰：由于地址空间的稀缺性和商业价值的日益增加而逐渐受到侵蚀，以及列入黑名单。为了克服这些问题，我们提出了 MORP4，这是一种实现“动态”网络望远镜的可编程数据平面框架。 MORP4 以可配置的时间和空间粒度准确、自适应地跟踪组织网络的未使用空间，并仅捕获以线速指向未使用地址的流量。我们提供了 P4 和 Python/C++ 的实现，并将其部署在 Tofino 交换机上。我们证明，它可以以最细粒度 (/32) 检测未使用的 IPv4 地址空间，同时以线速运行，并为在 IPv6 域中操作望远镜提供有效的方法。

papers.title: Morphe: High-Fidelity Generative Video Streaming with Vision Foundation Model.
papers.abstract:
Video streaming is a fundamental Internet service, while the quality still cannot be guaranteed especially in poor network conditions such as bandwidth-constrained and remote areas. Existing works mainly work towards two directions: traditional pixel-codec streaming nearly approaches its limit and is hard to step further in compression; the emerging neural-enhanced or generative streaming usually fall short in latency and visual fidelity, hindering their practical deployment.

Inspired by the recent success of vision foundation model (VFM), we strive to harness the powerful video understanding and processing capacities of VFM to achieve generalization, high fidelity and loss resilience for real-time video streaming with even higher compression rate. We present Morphe, the first revolutionized paradigm that enables VFM-based end-to-end generative video streaming towards this goal. Specifically, Morphe employs joint training of visual tokenizers and variable-resolution spatiotemporal optimization under simulated network constraints. Additionally, a robust streaming system is constructed that leverages intelligent packet dropping to resist real-world network perturbations. Extensive evaluation demonstrates that Morphe achieves comparable visual quality while saving 62.5% bandwidth compared to H.265, and accomplishes real-time, loss-resilient video delivery in challenging network environments, representing a milestone in VFM-enabled multimedia streaming solutions.
papers.abstract_zh:
视频流是互联网的基础服务，但在带宽受限、偏远地区等网络条件较差的情况下，视频质量仍难以保证。现有的工作主要致力于两个方向：传统的像素编解码器流几乎接近其极限，在压缩方面难以进一步发展；新兴的神经增强或生成流通常在延迟和视觉保真度方面不足，阻碍了它们的实际部署。

受视觉基础模型（VFM）最近成功的启发，我们努力利用 VFM 强大的视频理解和处理能力，以更高的压缩率实现实时视频流的泛化、高保真度和抗损失能力。我们推出了 Morphe，这是第一个革命性的范例，它使基于 VFM 的端到端生成视频流能够实现这一目标。具体来说，Morphe 在模拟网络约束下采用视觉分词器和可变分辨率时空优化的联合训练。此外，还构建了一个强大的流媒体系统，利用智能丢包来抵御现实世界的网络扰动。广泛的评估表明，与 H.265 相比，Morphe 实现了可比的视觉质量，同时节省了 62.5% 的带宽，并在具有挑战性的网络环境中实现了实时、防丢包的视频传输，这是支持 VFM 的多媒体流解决方案的一个里程碑。

papers.title: Mortise: Auto-tuning Congestion Control to Optimize QoE via Network-Aware Parameter Optimization.
papers.abstract: Congestion control algorithms (CCAs) critically shape the tradeoff among throughput, latency, and loss, directly impacting user Quality of Experience (QoE). However, most existing CCAs use static, heuristically chosen parameter settings that fail to adapt to dynamic network states, resulting in suboptimal QoE. Our key observation is that the optimal CCA parameter configuration depends on real-time network states. To bridge this gap, we propose Mortise, a real-time, network-aware adaptation framework that dynamically tunes rule-based CCA parameters to maximize QoE. To address the challenges in modeling the complex parameter-QoE relationship, Mortise introduces a QoS tradeoff proxy to decompose parameter optimization into two steps: it first infers the application's preferred QoS tradeoff from real-time QoE gradients and then derives the corresponding parameter settings via control-theoretic analysis. Implemented atop TCP and evaluated in both emulated and production environments, Mortise outperforms state-of-the-art solutions, enhancing the QoE of file downloading service by up to 73% and QoE of video streaming service by up to 167% in real-world scenarios, with minimal deployment overhead.
papers.abstract_zh: 拥塞控制算法 (CCA) 至关重要地影响吞吐量、延迟和丢失之间的权衡，直接影响用户体验质量 (QoE)。然而，大多数现有 CCA 使用静态、启发式选择的参数设置，无法适应动态网络状态，导致 QoE 不佳。我们的主要观察结果是，最佳 CCA 参数配置取决于实时网络状态。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了 Mortise，这是一种实时、网络感知的适应框架，可以动态调整基于规则的 CCA 参数以最大化 QoE。为了解决复杂参数-QoE关系建模的挑战，Mortise引入了QoS权衡代理，将参数优化分解为两个步骤：首先从实时QoE梯度推断应用程序的首选QoS权衡，然后通过控制理论分析得出相应的参数设置。 Mortise 在 TCP 之上实施，并在模拟和生产环境中进行评估，其性能优于最先进的解决方案，在现实场景中将文件下载服务的 QoE 提高高达 73%，将视频流服务的 QoE 提高高达 167%，同时部署开销极低。

papers.title: MuxTune: Efficient Multi-Task LLM Fine-Tuning in Multi-Tenant Datacenters via Spatial-Temporal Backbone Multiplexing.
papers.abstract: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) is widely applied as the backend of fine-tuning APIs for large language model (LLM) customization in datacenters. Service providers deploy separate instances for individual PEFT tasks, giving rise to prominent resource inefficiencies, including (1) GPU underutilization from small-scale, PEFT-native operators and (2) device stalls from communication delays and data dependencies in parallelized execution. To address these issues, this paper presents MuxTune, a fine-tuning system that enables resource-efficient concurrent execution of multiple PEFT tasks. The key idea is to multiplex the backbone across independent tasks in a spatial-temporal manner for improved utilization and reduced stalls. Building on flexible, modularized backbone sharing via unified PEFT representations, MuxTune proposes hierarchical co-scheduling scheme with task, operator, and data-level optimizations. Specifically, it fuses tasks through a hybrid of spatial and temporal multiplexing, and orchestrates multi-task operator execution in two-tiered hybrid parallelism. Additionally, MuxTune employs chunk-based data alignment to mitigate inter-task ineffective tokens. Experimental results demonstrate that MuxTune achieves up to 2.33× higher throughput and 5.29× memory reduction compared to three state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 参数高效微调 (PEFT) 被广泛用作数据中心大型语言模型 (LLM) 定制微调 API 的后端。服务提供商为各个 PEFT 任务部署单独的实例，导致显着的资源效率低下，包括 (1) 小规模、PEFT 原生运营商的 GPU 利用率不足，以及 (2) 由于并行执行中的通信延迟和数据依赖性而导致设备停顿。为了解决这些问题，本文提出了 MuxTune，这是一种微调系统，可以实现多个 PEFT 任务的资源高效并发执行。关键思想是以时空方式跨独立任务复用主干，以提高利用率并减少停顿。 MuxTune 通过统一的 PEFT 表示建立在灵活、模块化的主干共享基础上，提出了具有任务、操作员和数据级优化的分层协同调度方案。具体来说，它通过空间和时间复用的混合来融合任务，并以两层混合并行方式协调多任务运算符的执行。此外，MuxTune 采用基于块的数据对齐来减少任务间的无效令牌。实验结果表明，与三个最先进的基准相比，MuxTune 的吞吐量提高了 2.33 倍，内存减少了 5.29 倍。

papers.title: Net-P4ct: Enhanced WAN Bandwidth Fair Sharing Using P4 Programmable Switches.
papers.abstract: At growing internet companies like ByteDance, Wide Area Network (WAN) bandwidth sharing across diverse services with varying SLO requirements is a fundamental challenge. Conventional host-based enforcement systems, where agents identify and throttle traffic at the server end, face practical challenges such as "blind spot" traffic, kernel-dependent operational complexity, and significant server resource overhead. To address these issues, we present Net-P4ct, an in-network bandwidth enforcement system using P4 programmable switches. Net-P4ct improves both bandwidth guarantees and fair sharing by shifting dynamic QoS control into the switch data plane. Specifically, it achieves broader traffic coverage by combining host-side traffic tagging with a P4-switch pipeline, where service classification and QoS class assignment are performed. Based on observed traffic metrics, a centralized control plane determines real-time policy updates according to the max-min fair bandwidth allocation. We demonstrate the system's benefits including improved bandwidth utilization, reduced operational complexity, and lower per-byte processing cost. Net-P4ct has been deployed in ByteDance's production WAN for nearly a year, and we hope to share our experience with the community.
papers.abstract_zh: 对于像字节跳动这样的成长型互联网公司来说，在具有不同 SLO 要求的不同服务之间共享广域网 (WAN) 带宽是一项根本挑战。传统的基于主机的执行系统，其中代理在服务器端识别并限制流量，面临着实际挑战，例如“盲点”流量、依赖于内核的操作复杂性以及显着的服务器资源开销。为了解决这些问题，我们推出了 Net-P4ct，这是一种使用 P4 可编程交换机的网络内带宽强制系统。 Net-P4ct 通过将动态 QoS 控制转移到交换机数据平面来提高带宽保证和公平共享。具体来说，它通过将主机端流量标记与 P4 交换机管道相结合来实现更广泛的流量覆盖，在 P4 交换机管道中执行服务分类和 QoS 类分配。根据观察到的流量指标，集中控制平面根据最大-最小公平带宽分配确定实时策略更新。我们展示了该系统的优势，包括提高带宽利用率、降低操作复杂性以及降低每字节处理成本。 Net-P4ct已经在字节跳动的生产广域网中部署了近一年的时间，我们希望与社区分享我们的经验。

papers.title: Observability Is Eating Your Cores: Fine-Grained Analysis of Microservice Metrics with IPU-Hosted Sketches.
papers.abstract: Observability has become mission-critical for troubleshooting cloud-native technology. However, today's observability fails to meet the demands of cloud-native environments, either resulting in crippling complexity and high costs for collecting and storing huge data volumes, or sacrificing events coverage by sampling at coarse time granularity. We present μView, which stands out from conventional cloud monitors by incorporating a lightweight observability data-plane on Infrastructure Processing Units (IPUs). Our novel architecture leverages the proximity of IPUs to the monitored services to tackle observability bloat. Crucially, μView's data-plane applies streaming data sketching techniques to continuously process and analyze microservice's metrics at fine time resolution, without hurting application performance. We show for several use cases that by anticipating SLO violations μView can help (i) narrow the focus on informative observability data, and (ii) trigger useful signals about service performance, thus enabling timely proactive actions. Our code and artifacts are available at: https://github.com/sands-lab/uview .
papers.abstract_zh: 可观察性已成为云原生技术故障排除的关键任务。然而，当今的可观测性无法满足云原生环境的需求，要么导致收集和存储大量数据的复杂性和高昂成本，要么通过粗时间粒度采样而牺牲事件覆盖率。我们推出 μView，它通过在基础设施处理单元 (IPU) 上集成轻量级可观测数据平面，从传统云监视器中脱颖而出。我们新颖的架构利用 IPU 与受监控服务的接近性来解决可观测性膨胀问题。至关重要的是，μView 的数据平面应用流数据草图技术以精细的时间分辨率连续处理和分析微服务的指标，而不会损害应用程序性能。我们通过几个用例证明，通过预测 SLO 违规，μView 可以帮助 (i) 缩小对信息性可观测性数据的关注范围，以及 (ii) 触发有关服务性能的有用信号，从而实现及时的主动行动。我们的代码和工件可在以下位置获取：https://github.com/sands-lab/uview。

papers.title: Octopus: Enhancing CXL Memory Pods via Sparse Topology.
papers.abstract:
The Compute Express Link (CXL) interconnect enables compute "pods" that pool memory across servers to reduce cost and improve efficiency. These pods also facilitate pairwise communication whose needs conflict with pooling. Importantly, existing pod designs are small or require indirection through expensive switches. These conventional designs implicitly assume that pods must fully connect all servers to all CXL pooling devices.

This paper breaks with this conventional wisdom by introducing Octopus pods. Octopus directly connects servers to low-port-count CXL pooling devices (e.g., 4 ports) yet scales to large pods without switches by constructing a sparse CXL topology in which each pooling device connects to a carefully chosen subset of servers. Octopus explicitly balances "overlap", where two servers connect to the same pooling device: overlap reduces pooling efficiency but enables low-latency communication. Octopus resolves this tension by grouping servers into "islands" with low-latency intra-island communication and interconnecting islands to favor pooling.

We build a three-server CXL pod prototype and simulate scaled pods with 96 servers under measured device characteristics and physical constraints (1.5m copper cables). On hardware, Octopus RPCs are 3.2× faster than in-rack RDMA and 2.4× faster than CXL switches. In simulation, Octopus achieves net server cost savings of 3–5.4% whereas CXL switches result in a net cost increase.
papers.abstract_zh:
Compute Express Link (CXL) 互连支持跨服务器共享内存的计算“pod”，以降低成本并提高效率。这些 Pod 还促进了与池化需求相冲突的成对通信。重要的是，现有的 Pod 设计很小或者需要通过昂贵的交换机进行间接连接。这些传统设计隐含地假设 Pod 必须将所有服务器完全连接到所有 CXL 池设备。

本文通过介绍章鱼荚打破了这种传统观念。 Octopus 直接将服务器连接到低端口数 CXL 池设备（例如 4 个端口），但通过构建稀疏 CXL 拓扑（其中每个池设备连接到精心选择的服务器子集），无需交换机即可扩展到大型 Pod。 Octopus 明确平衡“重叠”，即两台服务器连接到同一池设备：重叠会降低池效率，但可实现低延迟通信。 Octopus 通过将服务器分组为具有低延迟岛内通信的“孤岛”，并将孤岛互连以利于池化，从而解决了这种紧张局势。

我们构建了一个三服务器 CXL Pod 原型，并在测量的设备特性和物理约束（1.5m 铜缆）下模拟具有 96 个服务器的扩展 Pod。在硬件上，Octopus RPC 比机架内 RDMA 快 3.2 倍，比 CXL 交换机快 2.4 倍。在模拟中，Octopus 实现了 3-5.4% 的净服务器成本节省，而 CXL 交换机则导致净成本增加。

papers.title: Offloading Cloud Network Services at Production Scale with SONiC DASH SmartSwitch.
papers.abstract:
To support stateful cloud network services, Microsoft Azure has operated several generations of offloading solutions over the past decade. While these systems improved performance, operating them at hyperscale revealed three persistent lessons: (i) overly flexible programming models hinder hardware acceleration, (ii) appliance-style DPU pools inflate physical footprint and complicate deployment, and (iii) vendor-specific SDKs slow down service iteration.

We present SONiC DASH SmartSwitch that addresses these lessons with three key designs: (1) the DASH pipeline as an immutable and hardware-friendly programming model; (2) the uni-box SmartSwitch that converges NPU and DPU resources within a single T1 switch; and (3) a community-driven development model with P4 behavior specifications. SONiC DASH SmartSwitch has been deployed in Microsoft Azure at scale. It achieves 1.53Tbps throughput, 19.2M CPS, and 256M concurrent connections for network services, while improving power efficiency by ~1.8× and space efficiency by ~2.7× compared to the previous generation.
papers.abstract_zh:
为了支持有状态的云网络服务，Microsoft Azure 在过去十年中运行了几代卸载解决方案。虽然这些系统提高了性能，但超大规模的运行暴露了三个长期的教训：(i) 过于灵活的编程模型阻碍了硬件加速，(ii) 设备式 DPU 池扩大了物理占用空间并使部署复杂化，(iii) 特定于供应商的 SDK 减慢了服务迭代。

我们推出 SONiC DASH SmartSwitch，通过三个关键设计来解决这些问题：(1) DASH 管道作为不可变且硬件友好的编程模型； (2) uni-box SmartSwitch，将 NPU 和 DPU 资源融合在单个 T1 交换机内； (3)具有P4行为规范的社区驱动的开发模型。 SONiC DASH SmartSwitch 已在 Microsoft Azure 中大规模部署。与上一代产品相比，它实现了 1.53Tbps 吞吐量、19.2M CPS 和 256M 并发连接数，同时电源效率提高了约 1.8 倍，空间效率提高了约 2.7 倍。

papers.title: OneSidedMW: Managing Disaggregated Memory Efficiently, Flexibly, and Securely with RNIC Offloading.
papers.abstract:
RDMA-based memory disaggregation is gaining popularity in modern datacenters to improve memory efficiency. However, existing memory management approaches for the disaggregated memory (DM) architecture face a critical tradeoff: they either suffer from poor memory utilization due to coarse-grained allocation, or encounter significant challenges in terms of performance, memory node CPU overhead, security vulnerabilities, and limited flexibility.

In this paper, we present OneSidedMW, a novel system that combines two advanced RDMA features—RDMA NIC (RNIC) offloading and memory windows—to provide fine-grained and highly efficient one-sided memory management primitives for DM. Specifically, it leverages RNIC offloading to perform MW binding and unbinding operations, achieving remote memory allocation and deallocation without involving the memory node’s CPU. To demonstrate the efficiency of OneSidedMW, we evaluate it over two representative DM systems: swap-based systems and disaggregated key-value stores. OneSidedMW achieves up to 10.6× better performance in disaggregated key-value stores and up to 32.3% performance improvement in swap-based systems, compared with the state-of-the-art approaches.
papers.abstract_zh:
基于 RDMA 的内存分解在现代数据中心中越来越受欢迎，以提高内存效率。然而，现有的分解内存（DM）架构的内存管理方法面临着一个关键的权衡：它们要么由于粗粒度分配而导致内存利用率低下，要么在性能、内存节点CPU开销、安全漏洞和有限的灵活性方面遇到重大挑战。

在本文中，我们提出了 OneSidedMW，这是一种新颖的系统，它结合了两种先进的 RDMA 功能——RDMA NIC (RNIC) 卸载和内存窗口——为 DM 提供细粒度且高效的单侧内存管理原语。具体来说，它利用RNIC卸载来执行MW绑定和解除绑定操作，实现远程内存分配和释放，而不涉及内存节点的CPU。为了证明 OneSidedMW 的效率，我们通过两个代表性的 DM 系统对其进行了评估：基于交换的系统和分解的键值存储。与最先进的方法相比，OneSidedMW 在分类键值存储中实现了高达 10.6 倍的性能提升，在基于交换的系统中实现了高达 32.3% 的性能提升。

papers.title: OpenOptics: Enabling Open Research and Implementation of Optical Data Center Networks.
papers.abstract: Optical data center networks (DCNs) are emerging as a promising design for cloud infrastructure. However, existing optical DCN architectures operate as closed ecosystems, tying software solutions to specific optical hardware. We introduce OpenOptics, an open research and development framework that decouples software from hardware, allowing them to evolve independently. OpenOptics features: (1) a time-flow table abstraction as a common interface between optical hardware and software, (2) a unified workflow and user-friendly API for implementing various optical DCNs with simple Python scripts, and (3) a backend system that re-architects queue management to support the time-flow tables and provides rich infrastructure services for diverse applications. Built on programmable switches, OpenOptics achieves a record-breaking minimum optical circuit duration of 2 µs using commodity devices. We validate OpenOptics’ generality by implementing six optical architectures and seven routing schemes on an optical testbed and conducting benchmarks on a 108-ToR setup, showcasing its efficiency. Additionally, case studies highlight novel research opportunities enabled by OpenOptics.
papers.abstract_zh: 光数据中心网络 (DCN) 正在成为一种很有前景的云基础设施设计。然而，现有的光学 DCN 架构作为封闭的生态系统运行，将软件解决方案与特定的光学硬件绑定在一起。我们推出 OpenOptics，这是一个开放式研发框架，可将软件与硬件解耦，使它们能够独立发展。 OpenOptics 具有以下特点：(1) 时间流表抽象作为光学硬件和软件之间的通用接口；(2) 统一的工作流程和用户友好的 API，用于通过简单的 Python 脚本实现各种光学 DCN；(3) 后端系统重新架构队列管理以支持时间流表，并为不同的应用程序提供丰富的基础设施服务。 OpenOptics 基于可编程开关构建，使用商用设备实现了 2 µs 的破纪录的最短光路持续时间。我们通过在光学测试台上实施六种光学架构和七种路由方案并在 108-ToR 设置上进行基准测试来验证 OpenOptics 的通用性，展示其效率。此外，案例研究强调了 OpenOptics 带来的新颖研究机会。

papers.title: OSCAR: O(1)-Step Convergence and Readily-deployable Congestion Control.
papers.abstract: Datacenter CCs typically target full bandwidth utilization and minimal queueing delay and strive to converge to these targets as quickly as possible. State-of-the-art CCs exhibit different convergence speeds, with the fastest ones converging in O (1) steps, which means reaching the target in constant time regardless of network conditions. However, their reliance on network features makes them not readily deployable. For instance, precise-INT-based CCs, such as HPCC and PowerTCP, achieve O (1)-step convergence through MIMD operations based on precise congestion information from the lengthy INT header, which is challenging to support for high-speed commodity hardware. Our key insight is that delay and delay gradient can exhibit precision comparable to INT, enabling O (1)-step convergence without specialized network features. Based on this insight, we propose OSCAR, the first O (1)-Step Convergence And Readily-deployable CC. OSCAR introduces novel techniques to accurately estimate the delay gradient with minimal overhead, eliminate overreaction in MIMD updates, and coordinate independent control loops to converge to one target. Testbed evaluations demonstrate OSCAR can rapidly converge to the fair share under real-world noise. In large-scale simulations with realistic workloads, OSCAR consistently outperforms precise-INT-based CCs by 12%-48% on average FCT and 40%-74% on tail FCT.
papers.abstract_zh: 数据中心 CC 通常以充分利用带宽和最小排队延迟为目标，并努力尽快收敛到这些目标。最先进的 CC 表现出不同的收敛速度，最快的收敛速度为 O (1) 步，这意味着无论网络条件如何，都能在恒定时间内达到目标。然而，它们对网络功能的依赖使得它们不易部署。例如，基于精确INT的CC，如HPCC和PowerTCP，通过基于来自冗长INT标头的精确拥塞信息的MIMD操作来实现O(1)步收敛，这对于支持高速商用硬件来说是一个挑战。我们的主要见解是，延迟和延迟梯度可以表现出与 INT 相当的精度，无需专门的网络功能即可实现 O (1) 步收敛。基于这一见解，我们提出了 OSCAR，第一个 O (1) 步收敛和易于部署的 CC。 OSCAR 引入了新技术，以最小的开销准确估计延迟梯度，消除 MIMD 更新中的过度反应，并协调独立的控制环路以收敛到一个目标。测试台评估表明 OSCAR 可以在现实世界噪声下快速收敛到公平份额。在具有实际工作负载的大规模模拟中，OSCAR 的平均 FCT 性能始终优于基于精确 INT 的 CC 12%-48%，尾部 FCT 性能高 40%-74%。

papers.title: Over-Threshold Multiparty Private Set Intersection for Collaborative Network Intrusion Detection.
papers.abstract: An important function of collaborative network intrusion detection is to analyze the network logs of the collaborators for joint IP addresses. However, sharing IP addresses in plain is sensitive and may be even subject to privacy legislation as it is personally identifiable information. In this paper, we present the privacy-preserving collection of IP addresses. We propose a single collector, over-threshold private set intersection protocol. In this protocol N participants identify the IP addresses that appear in at least t participant's sets without revealing any information about other IP addresses. Using a novel hashing scheme, we reduce the computational complexity of the previous state-of-the-art solution from O(M(N logM/t) 2t ) to O(t 2 M(binomNt)), where M denotes the dataset size. This reduction makes it practically feasible to apply our protocol to real network logs. We test our protocol using joint networks logs of multiple institutions. Additionally, we present two deployment options: a collusion-safe deployment, which provides stronger security guarantees at the cost of increased communication overhead, and a non-interactive deployment, which assumes a non-colluding collector but offers significantly lower communication costs and applicable to many use cases of collaborative network intrusion detection similar to ours.
papers.abstract_zh: 协作网络入侵检测的一个重要功能是分析协作者的网络日志以获取联合IP地址。然而，以普通方式共享 IP 地址是敏感的，甚至可能受到隐私立法的约束，因为它是个人身份信息。在本文中，我们提出了 IP 地址的隐私保护集合。我们提出了一个单一收集器、超阈值私有集交叉协议。在此协议中，N 个参与者识别出现在至少 t 个参与者集合中的 IP 地址，而不泄露有关其他 IP 地址的任何信息。使用新颖的哈希方案，我们将之前最先进解决方案的计算复杂度从 O(M(N logM/t) 2t ) 降低到 O(t 2 M(binomNt))，其中 M 表示数据集大小。这种减少使得将我们的协议应用于真实的网络日志实际上是可行的。我们使用多个机构的联合网络日志来测试我们的协议。此外，我们还提供了两种部署选项：防共谋部署，以增加通信开销为代价提供更强的安全保证；非交互式部署，假设非共谋收集器，但通信成本显着降低，适用于与我们类似的协作网络入侵检测的许多用例。

papers.title: PD3: Prefetching Data with DPUs for Disaggregated Memory.
papers.abstract: We introduce PD3, a memory disaggregation solution that "avoids" cache misses, via prefetching, on compute servers and thus all their associated overhead. Unlike a traditional prefetcher that may pollute the cache or miss preloading opportunities due to false positives and false negatives, PD3 prevents mis-predictions with network support and minimal yet critical application information. Enabling PD3 is data processing units or DPUs, which allow (1) parsing user requests before they are processed by the compute server, (2) fetching data from remote memory on the shortest path, (3) offloading expensive RDMA and DMA operations from the host, and (4) incorporating application knowledge to faithfully predict cache misses and take actions accordingly. Designing PD3 requires reconciling DPU resource constraints and scaling requirements of cloud data systems, as well as achieving high efficiency with a myriad of performance optimizations. Our experimental results on real hardware, applications, and workloads show that with nominal compute-local memory, PD3 eliminates the performance gap between memory-disaggregated applications and their monolithic counterparts.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们引入 PD3，这是一种内存分解解决方案，可通过预取在计算服务器上“避免”缓存缺失，从而避免所有相关开销。传统的预取器可能会污染缓存或因误报和漏报而错过预加载机会，而 PD3 与此不同，PD3 通过网络支持和最少但关键的应用程序信息来防止错误预测。支持 PD3 的是数据处理单元或 DPU，它允许 (1) 在计算服务器处理用户请求之前解析用户请求，(2) 以最短路径从远程内存获取数据，(3) 从主机卸载昂贵的 RDMA 和 DMA 操作，以及 (4) 结合应用程序知识来准确预测缓存未命中并采取相应措施。设计PD3需要协调DPU资源限制和云数据系统的扩展要求，并通过无数的性能优化来实现高效率。我们对真实硬件、应用程序和工作负载的实验结果表明，使用标称计算本地内存，PD3 消除了内存分解应用程序与其整体对应应用程序之间的性能差距。

papers.title: Phantora: Maximizing Code Reuse in Simulation-based Machine Learning System Performance Estimation.
papers.abstract:
Modern machine learning (ML) training workloads place substantial demands on both computational and communication resources. Consequently, accurate performance estimation has become increasingly critical for guiding system design decisions, such as the selection of parallelization strategies, cluster configurations, and hardware provisioning. Existing simulation-based performance estimation requires reimplementing the ML framework in a simulator, which demands significant manual effort and is hard to maintain as ML frameworks evolve rapidly.

This paper introduces Phantora, a hybrid GPU cluster simulator designed for performance estimation of ML training workloads. Phantora executes unmodified ML frameworks as is within a distributed, containerized environment. Each container emulates the behavior of a GPU server in a large-scale cluster, while Phantora intercepts and simulates GPU- and communication-related operations to provide high-fidelity performance estimation. We call this approach hybrid simulation of ML systems, in contrast to traditional methods that simulate static workloads. The primary advantage of hybrid simulation is that it allows direct reuse of ML framework source code in simulation, avoiding the need for reimplementation. Our evaluation shows that Phantora provides accuracy comparable to static workload simulation while supporting three state-of-the-art LLM training frameworks out-of-the-box. In addition, Phantora operates on a single GPU, eliminating the need for the resource-intensive trace collection and workload extraction steps required by traditional trace-based simulators. Phantora is open-sourced at https://github.com/QDelta/Phantora .
papers.abstract_zh:
现代机器学习 (ML) 训练工作负载对计算和通信资源提出了大量要求。因此，准确的性能估计对于指导系统设计决策（例如并行化策略的选择、集群配置和硬件配置）变得越来越重要。现有的基于模拟的性能估计需要在模拟器中重新实现 ML 框架，这需要大量的手动工作，并且随着 ML 框架的快速发展而难以维护。

本文介绍了 Phantora，这是一种混合 GPU 集群模拟器，专为 ML 训练工作负载的性能评估而设计。 Phantora 在分布式容器化环境中执行未经修改的机器学习框架。每个容器模拟大规模集群中 GPU 服务器的行为，而 Phantora 拦截并模拟与 GPU 和通信相关的操作，以提供高保真性能估计。与模拟静态工作负载的传统方法相比，我们将这种方法称为机器学习系统的混合模拟。混合仿真的主要优点是它允许在仿真中直接重用 ML 框架源代码，从而避免重新实现的需要。我们的评估表明，Phantora 提供了与静态工作负载模拟相当的准确性，同时支持三种最先进的开箱即用的 LLM 培训框架。此外，Phantora 在单个 GPU 上运行，无需传统基于跟踪的模拟器所需的资源密集型跟踪收集和工作负载提取步骤。 Phantora 在 https://github.com/QDelta/Phantora 上开源。

papers.title: Pilot Execution: Simulating Failure Recovery In Situ for Production Distributed Systems.
papers.abstract:
Modern distributed systems rely on failure recovery to ensure availability and correctness—ironically, recovery itself often introduces severe and irreversible failures. In this paper, we first study 75 real-world recovery failures to understand common pitfalls in the recovery mechanisms. We find that the challenges primarily arise from cross-component interactions, which are difficult to expose in traditional approaches.

To address this gap, we introduce pilot execution, a new execution model that simulates dry-runs of recovery actions in production distributed systems to enable safe and predictable failure recovery. It enables systems and operators to observe recovery action effects before applying them, reducing the risk of cascading failures and unintended side effects.

We realize pilot execution with PILOT, an analysis framework with a runtime library that makes pilot execution easy to adopt. We evaluate PILOT on five large-scale distributed systems and show that PILOT uncovers 17 out of 20 recovery failures with modest overhead. Our use of PILOT also exposes an unknown recovery bug in the latest version of HBase.
papers.abstract_zh:
现代分布式系统依靠故障恢复来确保可用性和正确性——讽刺的是，恢复本身常常会带来严重且不可逆转的故障。在本文中，我们首先研究了 75 个现实世界的恢复失败，以了解恢复机制中的常见陷阱。我们发现挑战主要来自跨组件交互，这在传统方法中很难暴露。

为了解决这一差距，我们引入了试点执行，这是一种新的执行模型，可以模拟生产分布式系统中恢复操作的空运行，以实现安全且可预测的故障恢复。它使系统和操作员能够在应用恢复操作之前观察其效果，从而降低级联故障和意外副作用的风险。

我们使用 PILOT 来实现试点执行，PILOT 是一个带有运行时库的分析框架，使试点执行易于采用。我们在五个大型分布式系统上评估 PILOT，结果表明 PILOT 以适度的开销发现了 20 个恢复故障中的 17 个。我们对 PILOT 的使用还暴露了最新版本 HBase 中的未知恢复错误。

papers.title: PlanB: Efficient Software IPv6 Lookup with Linearized B+-Tree.
papers.abstract:
IP lookup via Longest Prefix Match (LPM) is critical for packet forwarding. Unfortunately, conventional lookup algorithms are inefficient for IPv6 Forwarding Information Bases (FIBs), which are characterized by a set of long prefixes with diverse lengths. We observe that LPM inherently represents a two-dimensional (2D) search problem over both prefix values and prefix lengths, but existing algorithms mostly treat LPM as two separate levels of one-dimensional (1D) searches, causing poor lookup performance and high memory overhead.

This paper presents PlanB, a novel scheme for high-speed IPv6 lookup. We transform the 2D LPM into an equivalent 1D search problem over elementary intervals, unifying the search across prefix value and lengths. We then adapt the flat-array B-tree structure to the needs of LPM to propose linearized B+-tree , based on which we introduce an efficient search algorithm tailored to the properties of the transformed space. To maximize performance, we integrate PlanB with vectorization, batching, branch-free logic, and loop unrolling to fully exploit CPU parallelism. Extensive evaluation shows that PlanB achieves single-core performance of 390 Million Lookups Per Sec (MLPS) with real-world IPv6 FIBs on AMD processor, and scales to full-12-core performance of 3.4 Billion Lookups Per Sec (BLPS). This is 1.6×∼14× higher than state-of-the-art software-based schemes (PopTrie, CP-Trie, Neurotrie and HBS).
papers.abstract_zh:
通过最长前缀匹配 (LPM) 进行 IP 查找对于数据包转发至关重要。不幸的是，传统的查找算法对于 IPv6 转发信息库 (FIB) 来说效率低下，因为 IPv6 转发信息库的特点是一组长度不同的长前缀。我们观察到，LPM 本质上代表了前缀值和前缀长度上的二维 (2D) 搜索问题，但现有算法大多将 LPM 视为两个独立级别的一维 (1D) 搜索，导致查找性能差和内存开销高。

本文提出了 PlanB，一种用于高速 IPv6 查找的新颖方案。我们将 2D LPM 转换为基本区间上的等效一维搜索问题，统一了前缀值和长度的搜索。然后，我们将平面数组 B 树结构适应 LPM 的需要，提出线性化 B+ 树，在此基础上，我们引入了一种针对变换空间属性的高效搜索算法。为了最大限度地提高性能，我们将 PlanB 与矢量化、批处理、无分支逻辑和循环展开相集成，以充分利用 CPU 并行性。广泛的评估表明，PlanB 在 AMD 处理器上通过实际 IPv6 FIB 实现了每秒 3.9 亿次查找 (MLPS) 的单核性能，并可扩展到每秒 34 亿次查找 (BLPS) 的全 12 核性能。这比最先进的基于软件的方案（PopTr​​ie、CP-Trie、Neurotrie 和 HBS）高 1.6×∼14×。

papers.title: PlanetServe: A Decentralized, Scalable, and Privacy-Preserving Overlay for Democratizing Large Language Model Serving.
papers.abstract: While significant progress has been made in research and development on open-source and cost-efficient large-language models (LLMs), serving scalability remains a critical challenge, particularly for small organizations and individuals seeking to deploy and test their LLM innovations. Inspired by peer-to-peer networks that leverage decentralized overlay nodes to increase throughput and availability, we propose PlanetServe, an LLM serving overlay that harnesses computing resources from decentralized contributors. We identify four key research problems inherent to enabling such a decentralized infrastructure: 1) overlay network organization; 2) LLM communication privacy; 3) overlay forwarding for resource efficiency; and 4) verification of serving quality. This work presents the first systematic study of these fundamental problems in the context of decentralized LLM serving. Evaluation results from a prototype implemented on a set of decentralized nodes demonstrate that PlanetServe achieves a latency reduction of over 50% compared to the baseline design without overlay forwarding. Furthermore, the security features introduce minimal overhead to serving latency and throughput. We believe this work pioneers a new direction for democratizing and scaling future AI serving capabilities.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然开源和经济高效的大语言模型 (LLM) 的研究和开发取得了重大进展，但服务可扩展性仍然是一个严峻的挑战，特别是对于寻求部署和测试其 LLM 创新的小型组织和个人而言。受到利用分散式覆盖节点来提高吞吐量和可用性的点对点网络的启发，我们提出了 PlanetServe，这是一种 LLM 服务覆盖层，可利用分散式贡献者的计算资源。我们确定了实现这种去中心化基础设施所固有的四个关键研究问题：1）覆盖网络组织； 2）LLM通讯隐私； 3）覆盖转发以提高资源效率； 4) 服务质量验证。这项工作首次在分散的法学硕士服务背景下系统地研究了这些基本问题。在一组去中心化节点上实施的原型的评估结果表明，与没有覆盖转发的基准设计相比，PlanetServe 实现了超过 50% 的延迟减少。此外，安全功能将服务延迟和吞吐量的开销降至最低。我们相信这项工作为未来人工智能服务能力的民主化和扩展开辟了新方向。

papers.title: PolicyCache: Intra-flow Learning in Congestion Control.
papers.abstract: TCP congestion control (CC) schemes must balance fast responsiveness, adaptability to diverse network conditions, and low computational overhead. Existing approaches fall short: heuristic-based algorithms are lightweight but brittle, learning-based schemes provide high responsiveness yet struggle with generalization, and exploration-based methods adapt well but converge slowly. We present PolicyCache, the first CC algorithm based on intra-flow learning , where both training and execution of the policy are confined to a single flow. Unlike prior inter-flow learning, this paradigm avoids cross-environment generalization pitfalls while maintaining high responsiveness. PolicyCache leverages a lightweight, non-parametric tree-based model coupled with online exploration and dynamic model switching to enable rapid and robust adaptation. We provide convergence analysis of PolicyCache and have built a fully functional Linux prototype. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that PolicyCache consistently achieves high throughput, low latency, and fairness across diverse emulated and real-world networks, while incurring minimal overhead. These results establish intra-flow learning as a practical and effective new direction for congestion control.
papers.abstract_zh: TCP 拥塞控制 (CC) 方案必须平衡快速响应性、对不同网络条件的适应性和低计算开销。现有方法存在不足：基于启发式的算法轻量级但脆弱，基于学习的方案提供高响应性但难以泛化，基于探索的方法适应良好但收敛缓慢。我们提出了PolicyCache，这是第一个基于流内学习的CC算法，其中策略的训练和执行都限制在单个流中。与之前的流间学习不同，这种范式避免了跨环境泛化陷阱，同时保持了高响应能力。 PolicyCache 利用轻量级、非参数的基于树的模型以及在线探索和动态模型切换来实现快速、稳健的适应。我们提供了PolicyCache的收敛分析，并构建了一个功能齐全的Linux原型。广泛的评估表明，PolicyCache 在不同的模拟和现实网络中始终如一地实现高吞吐量、低延迟和公平性，同时产生最小的开销。这些结果确立了流内学习作为拥塞控制实用且有效的新方向。

papers.title: Predict, Prune, Play: Efficient Video Playback Optimization Under Device Diversity and Drift.
papers.abstract:
Video-streaming platforms tune dozens of playback parameters across thousands of client devices. Our measurements from Amazon Prime Video show that device-specific tuning can enhance stream quality. Yet traditional tuning techniques like Bayesian optimization become prohibitively expensive due to the large configuration space and the constant emergence of new device types.

We introduce AZEEM, a scalable recommendation system leveraging few-shot prediction to rapidly identify promising configurations for new devices. The key insight behind AZEEM is that devices exhibit performance similarities that enable predictions from limited observations. Trained on offline data of device-playback configuration interactions, AZEEM efficiently narrows down the search space to a small set of configurations likely to contain optimal or near-optimal candidates. Additionally, AZEEM addresses temporal distribution shift—where the best-performing configurations change over time—by recommending a small, robust set of candidates rather than a single configuration. Evaluations using large-scale real-world datasets show that AZEEM reduces exploration cost by 5.8−13.6× and improves stream quality compared to state-of-the-art Bayesian optimization and multi-armed bandit approaches, enabling effective device-specific optimization at scale. We deploy AZEEM on a subset of Amazon Prime Video’s production traffic, where it achieved a relative QoE improvement of 2.7% on average and 10.6% at the 90th percentile over an existing treatment tuning system.
papers.abstract_zh:
视频流平台可在数千个客户端设备上调整数十个播放参数。我们对 Amazon Prime Video 的测量表明，特定于设备的调整可以提高流媒体质量。然而，由于配置空间较大和新设备类型的不断出现，贝叶斯优化等传统调整技术变得异常昂贵。

我们推出了 AZEEM，这是一种可扩展的推荐系统，利用少量预测来快速识别新设备的有前景的配置。 AZEEM 背后的关键见解是，设备表现出相似的性能，可以根据有限的观察进行预测。通过设备播放配置交互的离线数据进行训练，AZEEM 有效地将搜索空间缩小到可能包含最佳或接近最佳候选的一小组配置。此外，AZEEM 通过推荐一组小型、稳健的候选配置而不是单一配置来解决时间分布变化（即性能最佳配置随时间变化）。使用大规模现实世界数据集的评估表明，与最先进的贝叶斯优化和多臂老虎机方法相比，AZEEM 将探索成本降低了 5.8−13.6 倍，并提高了流质量，从而实现了大规模的有效的特定于设备的优化。我们在 Amazon Prime Video 制作流量的一个子集上部署了 AZEEM，与现有的处理调整系统相比，它的 QoE 平均提高了 2.7%，在第 90 个百分点上提高了 10.6%。

papers.title: PrvTel: Lightweight Models for Private and Accurate Telemetry Data Retention.
papers.abstract: Network operators rely on telemetry for performance and security analysis, but long-term retention at scale remains difficult due to privacy requirements, resource constraints, and the need for high-fidelity query answers. We present PrvTel, a framework for privacy-preserving telemetry retention. Instead of storing raw records, PrvTel learns a compact generative model using a domain-specialized variational autoencoder. It combines field-aware encodings for NetFlow and cloud telemetry with a correlation-aware objective to preserve cross-field dependencies. To enforce differential privacy (DP) without sacrificing utility, PrvTel injects structure-aware noise before training, rather than during gradient updates. We prove that PrvTel satisfies DP based on post-processing theorem. Across six real-world datasets and one synthetic workload, PrvTel improves query accuracy by up to 60% over prior DP-compliant generative baselines and reduces ownership cost by up to 50× compared to lossless retention.
papers.abstract_zh: 网络运营商依靠遥测进行性能和安全分析，但由于隐私要求、资源限制以及对高保真查询答案的需求，大规模长期保留仍然很困难。我们提出了 PrvTel，一个用于保护隐私的遥测保留框架。 PrvTel 不存储原始记录，而是使用领域专用变分自动编码器学习紧凑的生成模型。它将 NetFlow 和云遥测的现场感知编码与相关感知目标相结合，以保留跨领域依赖性。为了在不牺牲实用性的情况下实施差分隐私 (DP)，PrvTel 在训练之前而不是在梯度更新期间注入结构感知噪声。我们根据后处理定理证明PrvTel满足DP。在六个真实数据集和一个合成工作负载中，PrvTel 的查询准确性比之前符合 DP 的生成基线提高了 60%，并且与无损保留相比，拥有成本降低了 50 倍。

papers.title: QCON: Seamless QoE-Aware 5G Streaming via Multi-Connectivity.
papers.abstract: Mobile real-time video streaming (RTS) applications—cloud gaming and AR/VR—require consistent high throughput and low latency to satisfy user Quality of Experience (QoE), yet today’s wireless links fluctuate wildly. While multi-path solutions seem promising to tackle such single-link fluctuations, existing transport-level solutions require multiple cellular subscriptions, which most users don’t have. In this paper, we leverage 5G multi-connectivity, which allows simultaneous connection to multiple base stations (e.g., 5G and 4G) and is already deployed in commercial networks. However, our measurements show RTS applications still suffer from single-link fluctuations due to operators’ deliberate policies restricting multi-connectivity to conserve 4G backup links regardless of application demands. To optimize application QoE while respecting operator policies, we present QCON, a QoE-driven multi-connectivity solution that efficiently utilizes backup links based on precise application QoE. For practical deployment, we design QoE Monitor to infer application QoE within the RAN and develop multi-link scheduling to optimize both QoE and radio resource efficiency. We also design priority-based re-injection utilizing RAN link recovery mechanism to prevent video stalls. Our prototype implementation of QCON on a RAN intelligent controller within an Open-RAN testbed demonstrates 2.1× improvements of bitrates, enhancing tail frame rates by 4-5× with efficient backup link use compared to existing multi-link scheduling schemes.
papers.abstract_zh: 移动实时视频流 (RTS) 应用（云游戏和 AR/VR）需要一致的高吞吐量和低延迟来满足用户体验质量 (QoE)，但当今的无线链路波动很大。虽然多路径解决方案似乎有望解决此类单链路波动问题，但现有的传输级解决方案需要多个蜂窝订阅，而大多数用户都没有。在本文中，我们利用 5G 多重连接，它允许同时连接到多个基站（例如 5G 和 4G），并且已经在商业网络中部署。然而，我们的测量显示，RTS 应用程序仍然遭受单链路波动的影响，因为运营商有意限制多连接以保留 4G 备份链路，而不管应用程序需求如何。为了在尊重运营商策略的同时优化应用程序 QoE，我们推出了 QCON，这是一种 QoE 驱动的多连接解决方​​案，可基于精确的应用程序 QoE 高效利用备份链路。对于实际部署，我们设计了 QoE 监视器来推断 RAN 内的应用 QoE，并开发多链路调度来优化 QoE 和无线资源效率。我们还利用 RAN 链路恢复机制设计基于优先级的重新注入，以防止视频停顿。与现有的多链路调度方案相比，我们在 Open-RAN 测试台内的 RAN 智能控制器上实现的 QCON 原型实现表明，比特率提高了 2.1 倍，尾部帧速率提高了 4-5 倍，并且有效使用了备份链路。

papers.title: Queue-Mem: Energy-Efficient Hardware Storage for Advanced Network Function Acceleration.
papers.abstract:
General-purpose CPU servers have been widely used to deploy Network Functions (NFs) thanks to their high flexibility and simplicity of deployment. Due to their high energy consumption, best practices advocate for only processing packet headers on CPU cores while temporary storing the corresponding packet payloads on either network interface cards or external RDMA-enabled memory.

We show that the seemingly minor decision of where to store a packet payload greatly impacts overall energy consumption in state-of-the-art NF systems operating at terabit-per-second speeds. In fact, we show that if one could ideally store packet payloads on today's hardware switches , while processing headers externally, one could reduce energy use by 1.8× to 10.9× compared to current practices.

In this paper, we introduce Queue-Mem, a general-purpose, energy-efficient storage solution to enhance NF deployment that is amenable for implementation with various existing hardware switches. Building Queue-Mem involves addressing significant challenges associated with payload storage, as hardware switches lack such functionality. By carefully exploiting the buffer queues of existing switches, we are the first ones to build and showcase a robust, energy-efficient packet processing pipeline capable of handling terabit-per-second speeds and supporting advanced per-flow network functions, all while using just a single commodity server connected to an ASIC switch.
papers.abstract_zh:
通用CPU服务器因其高度灵活性和部署简单性而被广泛用于部署网络功能（NF）。由于能耗较高，最佳实践主张仅在 CPU 内核上处理数据包标头，同时将相应的数据包有效负载临时存储在网络接口卡或支持 RDMA 的外部内存上。

我们表明，在以每秒太比特的速度运行的最先进的 NF 系统中，存储数据包有效负载的位置看似很小的决定会极大地影响整体能耗。事实上，我们表明，如果能够在当今的硬件交换机上理想地存储数据包有效负载，同时在外部处理标头，则与当前实践相比，可以将能源消耗减少 1.8 倍至 10.9 倍。

在本文中，我们介绍了 Queue-Mem，这是一种通用、节能的存储解决方案，用于增强 NF 部署，适合使用各种现有硬件交换机实施。构建队列内存涉及解决与有效负载存储相关的重大挑战，因为硬件交换机缺乏此类功能。通过仔细利用现有交换机的缓冲队列，我们​​率先构建并展示了强大、节能的数据包处理管道，能够处理太比特每秒的速度并支持高级的每流网络功能，同时仅使用连接到 ASIC 交换机的单个商用服务器。

papers.title: R-TCP: A Framework to Optimize TCP Performance Over Rate-Limiting Networks.
papers.abstract: Many mobile operators provide subscription plans that include a data quota for full-speed access, beyond which the service will be throttled to a low data rate — rate-limited service. This is designed to control costs and to motivate users to upgrade. Our recent measurements in a country-scale service suggested that the proportion of TCP flows subjected to rate limiting can be as high as 28%. More importantly, TCP flows under rate limiting can exhibit excessive retransmission rates, exceeding 20% in many cases. The extra bandwidth costs incurred by the retransmissions for large service providers are very significant, not to mention bandwidth wastage. This work develops a novel R-TCP framework to mitigate the excessive retransmissions problems in various TCP designs (e.g., Cubic and BBR) under rate limiting networks. R-TCP is specifically designed and optimized for sender-side kernel implementation with minimal overheads. It has been implemented into Linux where extensive experiments in real-world networks and applications show that it can substantially reduce excessive retransmissions by up to 88% with negligible tradeoff in goodput and application-layer performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 许多移动运营商提供的订阅计划包括全速访问的数据配额，超出该配额，服务将被限制为低数据速率——速率受限服务。此举旨在控制成本并激励用户升级。我们最近对国家级服务的测量表明，受到速率限制的 TCP 流量比例可能高达 28%。更重要的是，速率限制下的 TCP 流可能会出现过高的重传率，在许多情况下超过 20%。对于大型服务提供商来说，重传所产生的额外带宽成本非常巨大，更不用说带宽浪费了。这项工作开发了一种新颖的 R-TCP 框架，以减轻速率限制网络下各种 TCP 设计（例如 Cubic 和 BBR）中的过度重传问题。 R-TCP 专为发送方内核实现而设计和优化，开销最小。它已在 Linux 中实现，在现实网络和应用程序中进行的大量实验表明，它可以大幅减少高达 88% 的过度重传，而对吞吐量和应用层性能的影响可以忽略不计。

papers.title: RASC: Enhancing Observability & Programmability in Smart Spaces.
papers.abstract: While RPCs form the bedrock of systems stacks, we posit that IoT device collections in smart spaces like homes, warehouses, and office buildings—which are all “user-facing”—require a more expressive abstraction. Orthogonal to prior work, which improved the reliability of IoT communication, our work focuses on improving the observability and programmability of IoT actions. We present the RASC (Request-Acknowledge-Start-Complete) abstraction, which provides acknowledgments at critical points after an IoT device action is initiated. RASC is a better fit for IoT actions, which naturally vary in length spatially (across devices) and temporally (across time, for a given device). RASC also enables the design of several new features: predicting action completion times accurately, detecting failures of actions faster, allowing fine-grained dependencies in programming, and scheduling. RASC is intended to be implemented atop today’s available RPC mechanisms, rather than as a replacement. We integrated RASC into a popular and open-source IoT framework called Home Assistant. Our trace-driven evaluation finds that RASC meets latency SLOs, especially for long actions that last O(mins), which are common in smart spaces. Our scheduling policies for home automations (e.g., routines) outperform state-of-the-art counterparts by 10%-55%.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然 RPC 构成了系统堆栈的基石，但我们认为家庭、仓库和办公楼等智能空间中的物联网设备集合（这些都是“面向用户的”）需要更具表现力的抽象。与之前提高物联网通信可靠性的工作正交，我们的工作重点是提高物联网操作的可观察性和可编程性。我们提出了 RASC（请求-确认-开始-完成）抽象，它在物联网设备操作启动后的关键点提供确认。 RASC 更适合 IoT 操作，其长度自然会在空间（跨设备）和时间（对于给定设备，跨时间）发生变化。 RASC 还支持多种新功能的设计：准确预测操作完成时间、更快地检测操作失败、允许编程和调度中的细粒度依赖关系。 RASC 旨在在当今可用的 RPC 机制之上实现，而不是作为替代品。我们将 RASC 集成到一个名为 Home Assistant 的流行开源物联网框架中。我们的跟踪驱动评估发现，RASC 满足延迟 SLO，尤其是持续 O（分钟）的长操作，这在智能空间中很常见。我们的家庭自动化调度策略（例如例程）比最先进的同类策略高出 10%-55%。

papers.title: REAL: Emulating Control Plane at Simulator's Cost.
papers.abstract: Validating control plane behavior and ensuring policy compliance in modern, large-scale networks is a critical challenge. Simulation-based approaches offer low computational and memory costs, but their level of abstraction fails to capture vendor-specific device behaviors, limiting their accuracy for real-world validation. In contrast, control plane emulation provides high fidelity by using unmodified router containers that preserve these vendor-specific details, but its excessive computational and memory requirements make it impractical for large networks. In this paper, we present REAL, a lightweight runtime that emulates control planes using unmodified router containers but at the cost of simulation-based approaches. REAL achieves this by simulating a lightweight data plane to accelerate boot-up, employing a two-phase scheduling policy to minimize cache inefficiencies during convergence, and enabling iterative convergence to reduce peak memory usage by partitioning the network. Our evaluation shows that REAL emulates a 1,000-node network 4× faster than state-of-the-art simulation while preserving vendor-specific behaviors, and can scale to 4,500 nodes on four commodity servers by shaving 8.3× memory.
papers.abstract_zh: 验证控制平面行为并确保现代大型网络中的策略合规性是一项严峻的挑战。基于仿真的方法提供较低的计算和内存成本，但其抽象级别无法捕获特定于供应商的设备行为，从而限制了其在现实世界验证的准确性。相比之下，控制平面仿真通过使用未修改的路由器容器来保留这些特定于供应商的详细信息，从而提供高保真度，但其过多的计算和内存要求使其对于大型网络来说不切实际。在本文中，我们提出了 REAL，这是一种轻量级运行时，它使用未修改的路由器容器来模拟控制平面，但代价是基于模拟的方法。 REAL 通过模拟轻量级数据平面来加速启动、采用两阶段调度策略来最大限度地减少收敛过程中缓存的低效率，以及通过分区网络实现迭代收敛来减少峰值内存使用来实现这一目标。我们的评估表明，REAL 模拟 1,000 节点网络的速度比最先进的模拟快 4 倍，同时保留供应商特定的行为，并且可以通过削减 8.3 倍内存在四台商用服务器上扩展到 4,500 个节点。

papers.title: Remembrall: Leaning into Memory for Accurate Video Analytics on System-on-Chip GPUs.
papers.abstract: Continually retraining models has emerged as a primary technique to enable high-accuracy video analytics on edge devices. Yet, existing systems employ such adaptation by relying on the spare compute resources that traditional (memory-constrained) edge servers afford. In contrast, mobile edge devices such as drones and dashcams offer a fundamentally different resource profile: weak(er) compute with abundant unified memory pools. We present Remembrall, a continuous learning system for the mobile edge's System-on-Chip GPUs. Our driving insight is that visually distinct scenes that require retraining exhibit substantial overlap in model embeddings; if captured into a base model on device memory, specializing to each new scene can become lightweight, requiring very few samples. To practically realize this approach, Remembrall presents new, compute-efficient techniques to (1) select high-utility data samples for retraining specialized models, (2) update the base model without complete retraining, and (3) time-share compute resources between retraining and live inference for maximal accuracy. Across diverse workloads, Remembrall lowers retraining costs by 2.8-10× compared to existing systems, resulting in 18-45% higher accuracies.
papers.abstract_zh: 持续再训练模型已成为在边缘设备上实现高精度视频分析的主要技术。然而，现有系统通过依赖传统（内存受限）边缘服务器提供的备用计算资源来采用这种适应。相比之下，无人机和行车记录仪等移动边缘设备提供了根本不同的资源配置：具有丰富的统一内存池的弱计算。我们推出了 Remembrall，这是一种用于移动边缘片上系统 GPU 的持续学习系统。我们的深刻见解是，需要重新训练的视觉上不同的场景在模型嵌入中表现出大量重叠；如果捕获到设备内存上的基本模型中，则专门针对每个新场景可以变得轻量级，只需要很少的样本。为了实际实现这种方法，Remembrall 提出了新的、计算高效的技术，以 (1) 选择高实用性数据样本来重新训练专用模型，(2) 在不完全重新训练的情况下更新基础模型，以及 (3) 在重新训练和实时推理之间分时共享计算资源，以实现最大准确度。在不同的工作负载中，与现有系统相比，Remembrall 将再训练成本降低了 2.8-10 倍，从而将准确率提高了 18-45%。

papers.title: Remote TCP Connection Offload and Applications.
papers.abstract:
Layer 7 load balancers (L7LBs) play an important role in per-request server selection within long-lived connections and transport- or application-layer protocol translation. However, L7LBs introduce substantial CPU and network overhead.

We present XO, which enables an L7LB to offload transport-layer and application request processing to backend servers at request granularity. XO outperforms conventional L7LBs by 27–365% in throughput through efficient utilization of server CPU and network resources. We apply XO to two real-world applications, Ceph and nginx, improving throughput by up to 135% and 300%, respectively.
papers.abstract_zh:
第 7 层负载均衡器 (L7LB) 在​​长期连接和传输层或应用程序层协议转换中的每个请求服务器选择中发挥着重要作用。然而，L7LB 引入了大量的 CPU 和网络开销。

我们提出了 XO，它使 L7LB 能够按请求粒度将传输层和应用程序请求处理卸载到后端服务器。通过有效利用服务器 CPU 和网络资源，XO 的吞吐量比传统 L7LB 高出 27-365%。我们将 XO 应用于两个实际应用程序：Ceph 和 nginx，分别将吞吐量提高了 135% 和 300%。

papers.title: RLBoost: Harvesting Preemptible Cloud Resources for Cost-Efficient Reinforcement Learning on LLMs.
papers.abstract:
Reinforcement learning (RL) has become essential for unlocking advanced reasoning capabilities in large language models (LLMs). RL workflows involve interleaving rollout and training stages with fundamentally different resource requirements. Rollout typically dominates overall execution time, yet scales efficiently through multiple independent instances. In contrast, training requires tightly-coupled GPUs with full-mesh communication. Existing RL frameworks fall into two categories: co-located and disaggregated architectures. Co-located frameworks fail to address this resource tension by forcing both stages to share the same GPUs. Disaggregated architectures, without modifications of well-established RL algorithms, suffer from resource under-utilization. Meanwhile, preemptible GPU resources, i.e., spot instances on public clouds and spare capacity in production clusters, present significant cost-saving opportunities for accelerating RL workflows, if efficiently harvested for rollout.

In this paper, we present RLBoost, a framework for cost-efficient RL training that harvests preemptible GPU resources. Our key insight is that rollout's stateless and embarrassingly parallel nature aligns perfectly with preemptible and often fragmented resources. To efficiently utilize these resources despite frequent and unpredictable availability changes, RLBoost adopts a hybrid architecture with three key techniques: (1) adaptive rollout offload to dynamically adjust workloads on the reserved (on-demand) cluster, (2) pull-based weight transfer that quickly provisions newly available instances, and (3) token-level response collection and migration for efficient preemption handling and continuous load balancing. Extensive experiments show RLBoost increases training throughput by 1.51x-1.97x while improving cost efficiency by 28%-49% compared to using only on-demand GPU resources. RLBoost is open-sourced at https://github.com/Terra-Flux/PolyRL .
papers.abstract_zh:
强化学习 (RL) 已成为解锁大型语言模型 (LLM) 高级推理能力的关键。强化学习工作流程涉及交错的推出和训练阶段，资源需求根本不同。转出通常主导整个执行时间，但可以通过多个独立实例有效扩展。相比之下，训练需要具有全网状通信的紧密耦合 GPU。现有的强化学习框架分为两类：共置架构和分解架构。共置框架无法通过强制两个阶段共享相同的 GPU 来解决这种资源紧张问题。如果不对成熟的 RL 算法进行修改，则分解的架构会遭受资源利用不足的问题。与此同时，可抢占的 GPU 资源（即公共云上的现货实例和生产集群中的备用容量）如果能够有效地进行部署，则可以为加速 RL 工作流程提供显着的成本节约机会。

在本文中，我们提出了 RLBoost，这是一种经济高效的 RL 训练框架，可获取可抢占的 GPU 资源。我们的主要见解是，推出的无状态和令人尴尬的并行性质与可抢占且经常分散的资源完美契合。为了在频繁且不可预测的可用性变化的情况下有效利用这些资源，RLBoost 采用了具有三种关键技术的混合架构：(1) 自适应转出卸载，用于动态调整预留（按需）集群上的工作负载；(2) 基于拉动的权重转移，可快速配置新的可用实例；(3) 令牌级响应收集和迁移，以实现高效的抢占处理和持续负载平衡。大量实验表明，与仅使用按需 GPU 资源相比，RLBoost 将训练吞吐量提高了 1.51 倍-1.97 倍，同时将成本效率提高了 28%-49%。 RLBoost 在 https://github.com/Terra-Flux/PolyRL 上开源。

papers.title: RollPacker: Taming Long-Tail Rollouts for RL Post-Training with Tail Batching.
papers.abstract:
Reinforcement Learning (RL) is a pivotal post-training technique for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, synchronous RL post‑training frequently suffers from significant GPU underutilization—often referred to as pipeline "bubbles"—caused by imbalanced response lengths within rollout steps. Many RL systems attempt to alleviate this problem by relaxing synchronization, but this can compromise training accuracy.

In this paper, we introduce tail batching, a novel rollout scheduling strategy for synchronous RL. Tail batching systematically consolidates prompts leading to long-tail responses into a few designated "long rounds", ensuring that the majority of rollout steps ("short rounds") contain only balanced, short responses. By strategically reordering execution, this approach dramatically reduces GPU idle time and accelerates RL training without sacrificing on-policy accuracy. We present RollPacker, a system that fully harnesses the benefits of tail batching through holistic optimizations across all three RL stages: elastic parallelism adaptation for rollout, dynamic resource allocation and scheduling for reward, and stream-based training. Cluster deployment on up to 128 H800 GPUs demonstrates that RollPacker achieves an end-to-end training speedup of 2.03× to 2.56× over veRL, and up to 2.24× speedup compared to RLHFuse across the Qwen2.5 family of LLMs. The code is available at https://github.com/Farrrrland/RollPacker .
papers.abstract_zh:
强化学习（RL）是增强大型语言模型（LLM）推理能力的关键后训练技术。然而，同步强化学习后训练经常会遇到 GPU 利用率严重不足的问题（通常称为管道“气泡”），这是由于推出步骤中的响应长度不平衡造成的。许多强化学习系统试图通过放松同步来缓解这个问题，但这可能会影响训练的准确性。

在本文中，我们介绍了尾批处理，这是一种新颖的同步强化学习调度策略。尾批处理系统地将导致长尾响应的提示合并到几个指定的“长轮”中，确保大多数推出步骤（“短轮”）仅包含平衡的短响应。通过策略性地重新排序执行，这种方法可显着减少 GPU 空闲时间并加速 RL 训练，而不会牺牲策略准确性。我们推出了 RollPacker，这是一个通过所有三个 RL 阶段的整体优化来充分利用尾批处理优势的系统：用于推出的弹性并行自适应、动态资源分配和奖励调度以及基于流的训练。在多达 128 个 H800 GPU 上的集群部署表明，RollPacker 在 Qwen2.5 系列 LLM 中实现了比 veRL 2.03 倍到 2.56 倍的端到端训练加速，与 RLHFuse 相比高达 2.24 倍的加速。代码可在 https://github.com/Farrrrland/RollPacker 获取。

papers.title: Secure Vickrey Auctions for Online Advertising.
papers.abstract:
Online advertising is an essential part of the web ecosystem. When a user’s browser lands on a webpage, advertisers bid for the ad space. An auction algorithm (e.g., Vickrey/second-price auction) is executed to determine the winner and the price; ideally, only this information is revealed, and everything else (i.e., the losing bids and the bidder identities) is kept private. However, achieving these privacy goals under a malicious security model, while operating under stringent performance requirements for online advertising, is challenging.

Obsidian enables secure Vickrey auctions for online advertising with three ideas: a new Multiparty Computation (MPC)-friendly encoding scheme that decouples bid values from bidders’ identities; a novel use of function secret sharing to shift the cost of encoding validation to an offline phase; and a lightweight ring signature scheme to anonymously verify bidders. Obsidian outperforms generic MPC and homomorphic encryption approaches by orders of magnitude. Moreover, it also surpasses the state-of-the-art system, Addax, which is tailored to ad auctions under a weaker (covert) threat model and leaks more information.
papers.abstract_zh:
在线广告是网络生态系统的重要组成部分。当用户的浏览器登陆网页时，广告商会对广告空间进行出价。执行拍卖算法（例如，Vickrey/二价拍卖）来确定获胜者和价格；理想情况下，仅披露此信息，而其他所有信息（即失败的投标和投标人身份）均保密。然而，在恶意安全模型下实现这些隐私目标，同时在严格的在线广告性能要求下运行，是具有挑战性的。

Obsidian 通过三个想法实现在线广告的安全 Vickrey 拍卖：一种新的多方计算 (MPC) 友好编码方案，可将投标价值与投标人身份分离；函数秘密共享的新颖使用将编码验证的成本转移到离线阶段；以及用于匿名验证投标人的轻量级环签名方案。 Obsidian 的性能优于通用 MPC 和同态加密方法几个数量级。此外，它还超越了最先进的系统 Addax，该系统专为较弱（隐蔽）威胁模型下的广告拍卖而定制，并泄露了更多信息。

papers.title: ServeGen: Workload Characterization and Generation of Large Language Model Serving in Production.
papers.abstract:
With the widespread adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs), serving LLM inference requests has become an increasingly important task, attracting active research advancements. Practical workloads play an essential role in this process: they are critical for motivating and benchmarking serving techniques and systems. However, the existing understanding of real-world LLM serving workloads is limited due to the lack of a comprehensive workload characterization. Prior analyses remain insufficient in scale and scope, thus failing to fully capture intricate workload characteristics.

In this paper, we fill the gap with an in-depth characterization of LLM serving workloads collected from our worldwide cloud LLM serving service, covering not only language models but also emerging multimodal and reasoning models, unveiling important new findings in each case. Moreover, based on our findings, we propose ServeGen, a principled framework for generating realistic LLM serving workloads by composing them on a per-client basis. Practical use cases validate that ServeGen achieves more accurate performance benchmarking compared to naive workload generation, and reveals new design implications that could otherwise be overlooked. ServeGen is open-sourced at https://github.com/alibaba/ServeGen .
papers.abstract_zh:
随着大型语言模型 (LLM) 的广泛采用，服务 LLM 推理请求已成为一项日益重要的任务，吸引了积极的研究进展。实际工作负载在此过程中发挥着重要作用：它们对于激励和基准测试服务技术和系统至关重要。然而，由于缺乏全面的工作负载特征，现有对现实世界 LLM 服务工作负载的理解是有限的。先前的分析在规模和范围上仍然不足，因此未能完全捕捉复杂的工作负载特征。

在本文中，我们通过对从全球云 LLM 服务服务收集的 LLM 服务工作负载的深入描述来填补这一空白，不仅涵盖语言模型，还涵盖新兴的多模式和推理模型，在每种情况下都揭示了重要的新发现。此外，根据我们的发现，我们提出了 ServeGen，这是一个原则框架，用于通过根据每个客户组合来生成实际的 LLM 服务工作负载。实际用例验证了 ServeGen 与原始工作负载生成相比实现了更准确的性能基准测试，并揭示了可能被忽视的新设计含义。 ServeGen 在 https://github.com/alibaba/ServeGen 上开源。

papers.title: SketchPipe: Toward Accurate Sketch-based Network Measurement on Multi-Pipeline Switches with Splitless Sketch Placement.
papers.abstract: Sketches compactly measure traffic statistics with limited resource usage and are compatible with high-speed multi-pipeline switches. Existing solutions place sketches on multi-pipeline switches via array-split placement that splits each sketch array into several identical slices and places each slice on a specific pipeline. However, they incur two issues that drop measurement accuracy: (1) Different slices in different pipelines redundantly measure the same flows, wasting scarce switch resources. (2) Some slices receive much higher traffic loads than other slices. Hence, the data of different slices are highly varied, making their analysis inaccurate. We propose SketchPipe, a framework that offers accurate sketch-based measurement for multi-pipeline switches. The key ideas are two-fold. First, SketchPipe places each sketch array exclusively on a pipeline. Second, it caches the flow keys of normal packets while using synthetic state packets to asynchronously transfer cached keys to sketch arrays. As such, it avoids splitting arrays to enable accurate measurement while avoiding affecting normal packet processing. Our experiments on 12.8 Tbps Tofino2 switches show that SketchPipe improves accuracy by up to two orders of magnitude for various sketches and network monitoring applications.
papers.abstract_zh: 草图可以在有限的资源使用情况下紧凑地测量流量统计数据，并且与高速多管道交换机兼容。现有的解决方案通过阵列分割放置将草图放置在多管道交换机上，将每个草图阵列分割成多个相同的片，并将每个片放置在特定的管道上。然而，它们会带来两个降低测量精度的问题：（1）不同管道中的不同切片冗余地测量相同的流，浪费稀有的交换机资源。 (2) 某些切片比其他切片承受更高的流量负载。因此，不同切片的数据差异很大，导致分析不准确。我们提出了 SketchPipe，这是一个为多管道开关提供基于草图的精确测量的框架。关键思想有两个方面。首先，SketchPipe 将每个草图数组专门放置在管道上。其次，它缓存普通数据包的流密钥，同时使用合成状态数据包将缓存的密钥异步传输到草图数组。这样，它可以避免分裂阵列以实现精确测量，同时避免影响正常的数据包处理。我们在 12.8 Tbps Tofino2 交换机上进行的实验表明，SketchPipe 将各种草图和网络监控应用程序的准确性提高了两个数量级。

papers.title: Skyline: A Cloud Centric Internet Monitoring Engine.
papers.abstract: Cloud providers depend on the public Internet to connect tenants and their clients, yet Internet faults are a leading cause of cloud outages: in our organization, more than 60% of network incidents happen in the Internet and account for close to 80% of user-impacting events. Effectively monitoring the Internet is challenging for cloud providers because they lack direct control and visibility into Internet internals. Our key insight is to treat coverage as a first-class goal and decompose the monitoring requirements into three coverage dimensions — traffic direction , incident lifecycle , and tenant granularity —then resolve each independently. We present Skyline, a cloud-centric Internet monitoring system that addresses all coverage dimensions at scale by combining purpose-built dataplane hooks with lightweight software control to minimize resource overhead, shorten reaction time, and preserve non-intrusiveness. Skyline has been deployed for more than two years. In 2025, it identified over 2,000 incidents with very high precision and recall over confirmed issues, thereby significantly improving the reliability of our cloud network.
papers.abstract_zh: 云提供商依靠公共互联网来连接租户及其客户，但互联网故障是云中断的主要原因：在我们的组织中，超过 60% 的网络事件发生在互联网上，并占影响用户事件的近 80%。有效监控互联网对于云提供商来说是一项挑战，因为他们缺乏对互联网内部结构的直接控制和可见性。我们的主要见解是将覆盖范围视为首要目标，并将监控需求分解为三个覆盖维度——流量方向、事件生命周期和租户粒度——然后独立解决每个维度。我们推出了 Skyline，这是一种以云为中心的互联网监控系统，通过将专用数据平面挂钩与轻量级软件控制相结合，可大规模解决所有覆盖范围问题，从而最大程度地减少资源开销、缩短反应时间并保持非侵入性。 Skyline 已经部署两年多了。到 2025 年，它以非常高的精度识别了 2,000 多个事件，并对已确认的问题进行了召回，从而显着提高了我们云网络的可靠性。

papers.title: SLATE: Service Layer Traffic Engineering.
papers.abstract: In microservice-based applications, requests flow between many microservice instances across potentially multiple geodistributed clusters. Today, the routing of requests is limited to simple load balancing, or extensions that spill requests to nearby clusters. We argue that the problem is more subtle, and that there are significant opportunities for improvement by viewing microservice request routing as a global traffic engineering problem. We present Service Layer Traffic Engineering (SLATE), a system that optimizes request routing in microservice deployments that span multiple clusters to minimize average latency and bandwidth cost. SLATE tackles challenges unique to the service layer, including multiple request traffic classes, multi-hop call trees, and service latency profiles. To achieve this, SLATE takes a unique hybrid approach combining global optimization and local exploration. SLATE outperforms state-of-the-art global load balancing by up to 18.3× in average latency and reduces egress bandwidth cost by up to 2.64× in a Kubernetes deployment of an open-source benchmark application, and shows resilient performance against dynamic changes due to its hybrid optimization approach. Our system is completely transparent to the application and can be seamlessly plugged into existing L7 proxy deployments, specifically Envoy.
papers.abstract_zh: 在基于微服务的应用程序中，请求在可能跨多个地理分布式集群的许多微服务实例之间流动。如今，请求的路由仅限于简单的负载平衡或将请求溢出到附近集群的扩展。我们认为，这个问题更加微妙，并且通过将微服务请求路由视为全局流量工程问题，存在重大的改进机会。我们推出服务层流量工程 (SLATE)，这是一个系统，可优化跨多个集群的微服务部署中的请求路由，以最大限度地减少平均延迟和带宽成本。 SLATE 解决了服务层特有的挑战，包括多个请求流量类别、多跳调用树和服务延迟配置文件。为了实现这一目标，SLATE 采用了一种独特的混合方法，将全局优化和局部探索相结合。在开源基准应用程序的 Kubernetes 部署中，SLATE 的平均延迟优于最先进的全局负载平衡高达 18.3 倍，并将出口带宽成本降低高达 2.64 倍，并且由于其混合优化方法，展现出针对动态变化的弹性性能。我们的系统对应用程序完全透明，可以无缝插入现有的 L7 代理部署，特别是 Envoy。

papers.title: Slowpoke: End-to-end Throughput Optimization Modeling for Microservice Applications.
papers.abstract: Slowpoke is a new system to accurately quantify the effects of hypothetical optimizations on end-to-end throughput for microservice applications, without relying on tracing or a priori knowledge of the call graph. Microservice operators can use Slowpoke to ask what-if performance analysis questions of the form "What throughput could my retail application sustain if I optimized the shopping cart service from 10K req/s to 20K req/s?" . Given a target service and its hypothetical optimization, Slowpoke employs a performance model that determines how to selectively slow down non-target services to preserve the relative effect of the optimization. It then performs profiling experiments to predict the end-to-end throughput, as if the optimization had been implemented. Applied to four real-world microservice applications, Slowpoke accurately quantifies optimization effects with a root mean squared error of only 2.07%. It is also effective in more complex scenarios, e.g., predicting throughput after scaling optimizations or when bottlenecks arise from mutex contention. Evaluated in large-scale deployments of 45 nodes and 108 synthetic benchmarks, Slowpoke further demonstrates its scalability and coverage of a wide range of microservice characteristics.
papers.abstract_zh: Slowpoke 是一个新系统，可以准确量化假设优化对微服务应用程序端到端吞吐量的影响，而无需依赖跟踪或调用图的先验知识。微服务运营商可以使用 Slowpoke 提出假设性能分析问题，其形式为“如果我将购物车服务从 10K 请求/秒优化到 20K 请求/秒，我的零售应用程序可以维持多少吞吐量？” 。给定目标服务及其假设的优化，Slowpoke 采用性能模型来确定如何有选择地减慢非目标服务以保持优化的相对效果。然后，它执行分析实验来预测端到端吞吐量，就好像优化已经实施一样。 Slowpoke 应用于四个真实的微服务应用，准确量化了优化效果，均方根误差仅为 2.07%。它在更复杂的场景中也很有效，例如，在扩展优化后或当互斥锁争用出现瓶颈时预测吞吐量。在 45 个节点和 108 个综合基准的大规模部署中进行评估，Slowpoke 进一步展示了其可扩展性和对广泛微服务特性的覆盖。

papers.title: SmartNIC-Enabled Live Migration for Storage-Optimized VMs with PYROCUMULUS.
papers.abstract: Cloud providers offer storage-optimized VMs equipped with locally attached storage to meet the high performance requirements of cloud users. Live migration (LM) is crucial for such VMs to improve availability and manageability. However, providers do not enable LM for storage-optimized VMs. Host-managed LM suffers from high resource overheads and varied user performance, while offloading LM to SoC SmartNICs or disks cannot reliably accomplish LM in a reasonable time. The fundamental challenges are (1) consistency, demanding a high resource budget, and (2) network contention, preventing LM from converging. We propose Pyrocumulus , an LM approach on FPGA SmartNICs, enabling SLA-aware, fast, and low-overhead LM for storage-optimized VMs. We exploit hardware customizability and efficient network accessibility of the FPGA SmartNIC with LM protocol, architecture, and algorithm designs. Results from our FPGA SmartNIC prototype show that Pyrocumulus reduces user latency variances during LM up to 12.4×, lowers LM time by up to 19.6×, and saves cost up to 3×, while only taking 0.9%/3.8% compute/memory overhead of a mid-end FPGA SmartNIC.
papers.abstract_zh: 云提供商提供配备本地连接存储的存储优化虚拟机，以满足云用户的高性能要求。实时迁移 (LM) 对于此类虚拟机提高可用性和可管理性至关重要。但是，提供商不会为存储优化的虚拟机启用 LM。主机管理的 LM 面临资源开销高和用户性能变化的问题，而将 LM 卸载到 SoC SmartNIC 或磁盘无法在合理的时间内可靠地完成 LM。根本挑战是 (1) 一致性，需要较高的资源预算，以及 (2) 网络争用，阻碍 LM 收敛。我们提出了 Pyrocumulus，这是一种基于 FPGA SmartNIC 的 LM 方法，可为存储优化的虚拟机提供 SLA 感知、快速且低开销的 LM。我们利用 FPGA SmartNIC 的硬件可定制性和高效网络可访问性以及 LM 协议、架构和算法设计。我们的 FPGA SmartNIC 原型的结果表明，Pyrocumulus 将 LM 期间的用户延迟差异降低了 12.4 倍，将 LM 时间缩短了 19.6 倍，并节省了 3 倍的成本，而仅占用中端 FPGA SmartNIC 的 0.9%/3.8% 的计算/内存开销。

papers.title: Sparse Checkpointing for Fast and Reliable MoE Training.
papers.abstract:
As large language models scale, training them requires thousands of GPUs over extended durations—making frequent failures an inevitable reality. While checkpointing remains the primary fault-tolerance mechanism, existing methods fall short when applied to Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models. Due to their substantially larger training state, MoE models exacerbate checkpointing overheads, often causing costly stalls or prolonged recovery that severely degrade training efficiency.

We present MoEvement, a distributed, in-memory checkpointing system tailored for MoE models. MoEvement is built on three key ideas: (1) sparse checkpointing , which incrementally snapshots subsets of experts across iterations to reduce overhead; (2) a sparse-to-dense checkpoint conversion mechanism that incrementally reconstructs consistent dense checkpoints from sparse snapshots; and (3) upstream logging of activations and gradients at pipeline-stage boundaries, enabling localized recovery without re-executing unaffected workers. Evaluations across diverse MoE models with up to 64 experts show that MoEvement reduces checkpointing overhead by up to 4× and recovery overhead by up to 31× compared to state-of-the-art approaches, sustaining ETTR ≥ 0.94 even under frequent failures (MTBF as low as 10 minutes) and delivering up to 8× overall training speedup, all without compromising synchronous training semantics. Overall, MoEvement offers a scalable, practical fault-tolerance solution for the next generation of sparsely activated models.
papers.abstract_zh:
随着大型语言模型规模的扩大，训练它们需要在较长时间内使用数千个 GPU，这使得频繁失败成为不可避免的现实。虽然检查点仍然是主要的容错机制，但现有方法在应用于专家混合 (MoE) 模型时存在不足。由于其训练状态要大得多，MoE 模型会加剧检查点开销，通常会导致代价高昂的停顿或长时间的恢复，从而严重降低训练效率。

我们推出了 MoEvement，这是一种专为 MoE 模型量身定制的分布式内存检查点系统。 MoEvement 建立在三个关键思想之上：(1) 稀疏检查点，它在迭代中增量快照专家子集以减少开销； （2）稀疏到密集检查点转换机制，从稀疏快照增量重建一致的密集检查点； (3) 上游记录管道阶段边界处的激活和梯度，从而实现局部恢复，而无需重新执行未受影响的工作程序。对多达 64 名专家的不同 MoE 模型进行的评估表明，与最先进的方法相比，MoEvement 将检查点开销减少了高达 4 倍，将恢复开销减少了高达 31 倍，即使在频繁故障的情况下也能维持 ETTR ≥ 0.94（MTBF 低至 10 分钟），并提供高达 8 倍的整体训练加速，所有这些都不会影响同步训练语义。总体而言，MoEvement 为下一代稀疏激活模型提供了可扩展、实用的容错解决方案。

papers.title: SPLIDT: Partitioned Decision Trees for Scalable Stateful Inference at Line Rate.
papers.abstract:
Machine learning (ML) is increasingly being deployed in programmable data planes (switches and SmartNICs) to enable real-time traffic analysis, security monitoring, and in-network decision-making. Decision trees (DTs) are particularly well-suited for these tasks due to their interpretability and compatibility with data-plane architectures, i.e., match-action tables (MATs). However, existing in-network DT implementations are constrained by the need to compute all input features upfront, forcing models to rely on a small, fixed set of features per flow. This significantly limits model accuracy and scalability under stringent hardware resource constraints.

We present SPLIDT, a system that rethinks DT deployment in the data plane by enabling partitioned inference over sliding windows of packets. SPLIDT introduces two key innovations: (1) it groups individual subtrees of a DT into partitions and allows each subtree to have its own feature set, and (2) it leverages an in-band control channel (via recirculation) to reuse data-plane resources (both stateful registers and match keys) across partitions at line rate. These insights allow SPLIDT to scale the number of stateful features a model can use without exceeding hardware limits. To support this architecture, SPLIDT incorporates a custom training and design-space exploration (DSE) framework that jointly optimizes feature allocation, tree partitioning, and DT model depth. Evaluation across multiple real-world datasets shows that SPLIDT achieves higher accuracy while supporting up to 5x more stateful features than prior approaches (e.g., NetBeacon and Leo). It maintains the same low time-to-detection (TTD) as these systems, while scaling to millions of flows with minimal recirculation overhead (≤ 0.05%).
papers.abstract_zh:
机器学习 (ML) 越来越多地部署在可编程数据平面（交换机和 SmartNIC）中，以实现实时流量分析、安全监控和网络内决策。决策树（DT）由于其可解释性以及与数据平面架构（即匹配动作表（MAT））的兼容性而特别适合这些任务。然而，现有的网络内 DT 实现受到需要预先计算所有输入特征的限制，迫使模型依赖于每个流的一小部分固定特征。在严格的硬件资源限制下，这极大地限制了模型的准确性和可扩展性。

我们提出了 SPLIDT，这是一个通过在数据包滑动窗口上启用分区推理来重新思考数据平面中 DT 部署的系统。 SPLIDT 引入了两项关键创新：(1) 它将 DT 的各个子树分组为分区，并允许每个子树拥有自己的功能集，(2) 它利用带内控制通道（通过再循环）以线速跨分区重用数据平面资源（有状态寄存器和匹配密钥）。这些见解使 SPLIDT 能够在不超出硬件限制的情况下扩展模型可以使用的有状态特征的数量。为了支持该架构，SPLIDT 结合了自定义训练和设计空间探索 (DSE) 框架，该框架联合优化特征分配、树分区和 DT 模型深度。对多个真实世界数据集的评估表明，SPLIDT 实现了更高的准确度，同时支持的状态特征比之前的方法（例如 NetBeacon 和 Leo）多出 5 倍。它保持与这些系统相同的低检测时间 (TTD)，同时以最小的再循环开销 (≤ 0.05%) 扩展到数百万个流。

papers.title: Starfish: A Topology-Routing Co-Design for Small-Scale Data Centers.
papers.abstract:
Most data centers today operate at scales much smaller than hyperscalers, i.e., hosting only hundreds to a few thousand servers, yet their design has received disproportionately little attention in the literature. Leaf-spine is nearly ubiquitous in small-scale data centers, but presents a fundamental tradeoff: provisioning full non-blocking capacity is costly, while oversubscription reduces cost but under-serves bursty, skewed workloads.
