Recent expander-based designs could, in theory, offer better performance but face substantial deployment hurdles, including lacking a practical routing scheme.

We introduce Starfish, a topology-routing co-design tailored to small-scale data centers, that delivers high performance, fault tolerance, and ease of deployment. Starfish’s topology, DRing, increases per-server egress capacity by spreading servers across all switches, reduces latency–even under failure scenarios–by exposing diverse near-shortest paths, and eases deployment by organizing switches into uniform blocks. Starfish’s routing leverages structural properties of DRing and effectively adapts to traffic patterns using standard hardware and protocols. Notably, Starfish’s routing also generalizes to expander-based topologies.

Evaluation shows that Starfish supports 56% more traffic on average than leaf-spine built with the same equipment across real-world traces. This demonstrates that small-scale data centers today can realistically achieve higher performance with their existing equipment. Starfish’s routing also enables an expander-based design to support 52% more traffic on average than leaf-spine. More broadly, this work takes a first step towards a distinct design space for small-scale data centers.
papers.abstract_zh:
如今，大多数数据中心的运营规模比超大规模数据中心小得多，即仅托管数百到数千台服务器，但其设计在文献中却很少受到关注。叶脊在小型数据中心中几乎无处不在，但存在一个基本的权衡：提供完整的非阻塞容量成本高昂，而超额订阅可以降低成本，但无法满足突发性、倾斜的工作负载的需求。理论上，最近基于扩展器的设计可以提供更好的性能，但面临巨大的部署障碍，包括缺乏实用的路由方案。

我们推出了 Starfish，这是一种专为小型数据中心量身定制的拓扑路由协同设计，可提供高性能、容错性和易于部署性。 Starfish 的拓扑 DRing 通过将服务器分布在所有交换机上来增加每台服务器的出口容量，通过公开不同的近最短路径来减少延迟（即使在故障情况下），并通过将交换机组织成统一的块来简化部署。 Starfish 的路由利用 DRing 的结构特性，并使用标准硬件和协议有效地适应流量模式。值得注意的是，Starfish 的路由也推广到基于扩展器的拓扑。

评估显示，与使用相同设备构建的 Leaf Spine 相比，Starfish 在现实世界中支持的流量平均多出 56%。这表明当今的小型数据中心实际上可以利用现有设备实现更高的性能。 Starfish 的路由还支持基于扩展器的设计，与 Leaf-Spine 相比，平均支持多 52% 的流量。更广泛地说，这项工作向小型数据中心的独特设计空间迈出了第一步。

papers.title: Stimpack: An Adaptive Rendering Optimization System for Scalable Cloud Gaming.
papers.abstract: In distributed multimedia applications, content is often delivered to users in a degraded form due to network-induced lossy compression. Real-time and interactive use cases like cloud gaming, which render content on the fly, require low latency and are hosted at resource-constrained edge servers. We present a new insight: when rendered content is delivered over a network with lossy compression, high-quality rendering can be ineffective in improving user-perceived quality, leading to a poor return on computing resources. Leveraging this observation, we built Stimpack, a novel system that adaptively optimizes game rendering quality by balancing server-side rendering costs against user-perceived quality. The system uses a mechanism that quantifies the efficiency of resource usage to maximize overall system utility in multi-user scenarios. Our open-sourced implementation and extensive evaluations show that Stimpack achieves up to 24% higher service quality and serves twice as many users with the same resources compared to baselines. A user study further validates that Stimpack provides a measurably better user experience.
papers.abstract_zh: 在分布式多媒体应用中，由于网络引起的有损压缩，内容通常以降级形式交付给用户。实时和交互式用例（例如云游戏）可以动态呈现内容，需要低延迟，并且托管在资源有限的边缘服务器上。我们提出了一个新的见解：当渲染内容通过有损压缩的网络交付时，高质量渲染可能无法有效提高用户感知的质量，从而导致计算资源回报率较低。利用这一观察结果，我们构建了 Stimpack，这是一种新颖的系统，可通过平衡服务器端渲染成本与用户感知的质量来自适应优化游戏渲染质量。该系统使用一种量化资源使用效率的机制，以最大限度地提高多用户场景中的整体系统效用。我们的开源实施和广泛的评估表明，与基线相比，Stimpack 的服务质量提高了 24%，并且在相同资源下服务的用户数量是原来的两倍。用户研究进一步证实 Stimpack 提供了明显更好的用户体验。

papers.title: Supercharging Packet-level Network Simulation of Large Model Training via Memoization and Fast-Forwarding.
papers.abstract:
Packet-level discrete-event simulation (PLDES) is a prevalent tool for evaluating detailed performance of large model training. Although PLDES offers high fidelity and generality, its slow performance has plagued networking practitioners. Existing optimization techniques either simplify the network model, resulting in large errors; or execute it in parallel using multiple processors, with an upper bound on speedup.

This paper explores an alternative optimization direction that reduces the computational loads of PLDES while maintaining high fidelity. Our key insight is that, in distributed LLM training, packet-level traffic behaviors often exhibit repetitive contention patterns and steady-states where flow rates stabilize, ignoring these redundant discrete events speeds up the simulation considerably and the error is negligible. We realize this idea by proposing Wormhole, a user-transparent PLDES kernel capable of automatically memoization for unsteady-states and skipping for steady-states. Wormhole adopts network partitioning, state memoization and reuse, and rate-based steady-state identification to accurately determine the periods of each flow’s steady-state, while maintaining simulation consistency after fast-forwarding. Experiments demonstrate that Wormhole can achieve a 744× speedup over the original ns-3 (510× for MoE workload), with a bounded error of <1%. Applying current multithreading parallel techniques and Wormhole together allows a 1012× speedup, reducing the simulation time for one GPT-13B training under 128 GPUs from 9 hours to 5 minutes.
papers.abstract_zh:
数据包级离散事件仿真 (PLDES) 是评估大型模型训练详细性能的流行工具。尽管 PLDES 提供高保真度和通用性，但其缓慢的性能一直困扰着网络从业者。现有的优化技术要么简化网络模型，导致误差较大；要么简化网络模型，导致误差较大。或者使用多个处理器并行执行它，并有加速上限。

本文探索了一种替代优化方向，可减少 PLDES 的计算负载，同时保持高保真度。我们的主要见解是，在分布式 LLM 训练中，数据包级流量行为通常表现出重复的争用模式和流量稳定的稳态，忽略这些冗余离散事件可显着加快模拟速度，并且误差可以忽略不计。我们通过提出 Wormhole 来实现这个想法，这是一个用户透明的 PLDES 内核，能够自动记忆非稳态并跳过稳态。 Wormhole采用网络划分、状态记忆和重用以及基于速率的稳态识别来准确确定每个流的稳态周期，同时在快进后保持模拟一致性。实验表明，与原始 ns-3 相比，Wormhole 可以实现 744 倍的加速（MoE 工作负载为 510 倍），且有限误差 <1%。将当前的多线程并行技术和 Wormhole 结合在一起，可以实现 1012 倍的加速，将 128 个 GPU 下一次 GPT-13B 训练的模拟时间从 9 小时缩短到 5 分钟。

papers.title: SwiftEP: Accelerating MoE Inference with Buffer Fusion and TMA Offloading.
papers.abstract:
Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly rely on Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures to scale computation efficiently. Expert Parallelism (EP), which distributes experts across GPUs, introduces all-to-all communication overhead during the dispatch and combine phases, especially in the prefill stage, which dominates the inference performance. Existing communication libraries, such as DeepEP, suffer from excessive GPU SM utilization and underutilized interconnect bandwidth, limiting prefill performance.

In this paper, we identify two root causes: redundant buffer copies and inefficient intra-server transfers over NVLink. To address these, we propose SwiftEP, an all-to-all communication library tailored for MoE prefill, combining buffer fusion and Tensor Memory Accelerator (TMA) offloading . Buffer fusion eliminates redundant staging copies, enabling true zero-copy communication, while TMA offloading maximizes NVLink utilization and supports efficient multicast/reduce operations. SwiftEP further incorporates RDMA scatter-gather lists, QP transmission parallelization, and CUDA IPC to handle dynamic token placement and inter-GPU memory access. Evaluation on 16- and 32-GPU clusters shows that SwiftEP achieves up to 119.7% higher algorithm bandwidth, reduces SM occupancy by up to 66.7%, and improves request serving capacity by 21.2% compared to DeepEP.
papers.abstract_zh:
大型语言模型 (LLM) 越来越依赖混合专家 (MoE) 架构来有效扩展计算。专家并行（EP）将专家分布在 GPU 上，在调度和组合阶段引入了所有到所有的通信开销，特别是在预填充阶段，该阶段决定了推理性能。现有的通信库（例如 DeepEP）存在 GPU SM 利用率过高和互连带宽未充分利用的问题，从而限制了预填充性能。

在本文中，我们确定了两个根本原因：冗余缓冲区副本和通过 NVLink 的服务器内传输效率低下。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了 SwiftEP，这是一个专为 MoE 预填充量身定制的全方位通信库，结合了缓冲区融合和张量内存加速器 (TMA) 卸载。缓冲区融合消除了冗余的暂存副本，从而实现了真正的零复制通信，而 TMA 卸载则最大限度地提高了 NVLink 利用率并支持高效的多播/归约操作。 SwiftEP 进一步结合了 RDMA 分散收集列表、QP 传输并行化和 CUDA IPC，以处理动态令牌放置和 GPU 间内存访问。对16和32GPU集群的评估表明，与DeepEP相比，SwiftEP的算法带宽提高了119.7%，SM占用率降低了66.7%，请求服务能力提高了21.2%。

papers.title: SYMI: Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Training via Model and Optimizer State Decoupling.
papers.abstract:
Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have become a widely-adopted solution to continue scaling model sizes without a corresponding linear increase in compute. During MoE model training, each input token is dynamically routed to a subset of experts—sparsely-activated feed-forward networks—within each transformer layer. The distribution of tokens assigned to each expert varies widely and rapidly over the course of training. To handle the wide load imbalance across experts, current systems are forced to either drop tokens assigned to popular experts, degrading convergence, or frequently rebalance resources allocated to each expert based on popularity, incurring high state migration overheads.

To break this performance-accuracy tradeoff, we introduce SYMI, an adaptive MoE training system. The key insight of SYMI is to decouple the placement of expert parameters from their large optimizer state. SYMI statically partitions the optimizer of each expert across all training nodes. Meanwhile, SYMI dynamically adjusts the placement of expert parameters by repurposing existing weight updates, avoiding migration overheads. In doing so, SYMI right-sizes the GPU resources allocated to each expert, on a per-iteration basis, with minimal overhead. Compared to state-of-the-art MoE training systems, DeepSpeed and FlexMoE, SYMI is able to achieve a 30.5% and 25.9% faster time-to-convergence, respectively.
papers.abstract_zh:
专家混合 (MoE) 模型已成为一种广泛采用的解决方案，可在不相应线性增加计算量的情况下继续扩展模型大小。在 MoE 模型训练期间，每个输入令牌都会动态路由到每个变压器层内的专家子集（稀疏激活的前馈网络）。在训练过程中，分配给每位专家的令牌分布变化很大且迅速。为了处理专家之间广泛的负载不平衡问题，当前系统被迫放弃分配给热门专家的令牌，从而降低收敛性，或者根据受欢迎程度频繁重新平衡分配给每个专家的资源，从而产生高昂的状态迁移开销。

为了打破这种性能与准确性的权衡，我们引入了 SYMI，一种自适应 MoE 训练系统。 SYMI 的关键见解是将专家参数的放置与其大型优化器状态分离。 SYMI 在所有训练节点上静态划分每个专家的优化器。同时，SYMI 通过重新利用现有权重更新来动态调整专家参数的放置，避免迁移开销。在此过程中，SYMI 在每次迭代的基础上以最小的开销调整分配给每个专家的 GPU 资源的大小。与最先进的 MoE 训练系统 DeepSpeed 和 FlexMoE 相比，SYMI 的收敛时间分别快了 30.5% 和 25.9%。

papers.title: SYMPHONY: Enabling Compute-Memory Disaggregation in LLM Serving Systems.
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) power AI applications such as chatbots and agents, which maintain conversational state across multiple turns. Serving these workloads is inherently stateful: each request generates a KV cache storing token-level state. Existing systems either recompute caches or offload them to host memory—both approaches incur high latency, cause load imbalance, and limit scalability. We present SYMPHONY, a disaggregated memory management layer that decouples compute from KV cache storage while meeting strict latency requirements. To enable disaggregation, SYMPHONY employs advisory requests—prefetching hints derived from user interactions or workload structure—to move caches off the critical path and enable fine-grained, request-level load balancing. Since these predictive signals are often unreliable, SYMPHONY introduces two key techniques: priority-based KV cache management, which allocates memory based on neural network structure and request priority, and cooperative memory management, which dynamically coordinates GPU memory with the serving framework. Evaluations on LLaMA models with ShareGPT and Burst-GPT workloads show that SYMPHONY reduces end-to-end latency by 2.4× over vLLM and serves 4× more requests with minimal latency increase.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 为聊天机器人和代理等人工智能应用程序提供支持，这些应用程序可以在多个回合中保持对话状态。为这些工作负载提供服务本质上是有状态的：每个请求都会生成一个存储令牌级状态的 KV 缓存。现有系统要么重新计算缓存，要么将它们卸载到主机内存，这两种方法都会导致高延迟，导致负载不平衡，并限制可扩展性。我们推出了 SYMPHONY，这是一个分解的内存管理层，可将计算与 KV 缓存存储解耦，同时满足严格的延迟要求。为了实现分解，SYMPHONY 采用咨询请求（从用户交互或工作负载结构中派生的预取提示）将缓存移出关键路径，并实现细粒度的请求级负载平衡。由于这些预测信号通常不可靠，SYMPHONY 引入了两项关键技术：基于优先级的 KV 缓存管理（根据神经网络结构和请求优先级分配内存）和协作内存管理（动态协调 GPU 内存与服务框架）。对具有 ShareGPT 和 Burst-GPT 工作负载的 LLaMA 模型的评估表明，SYMPHONY 比 vLLM 将端到端延迟减少了 2.4 倍，并以最小的延迟增加服务了 4 倍的请求。

papers.title: SyncWise: Error-Aware Time Synchronization for Reconfigurable Data Center Networks.
papers.abstract: Time synchronization is critical for emerging reconfigurable data center networks (RDCNs) built on optical circuit switches (OCSes), where accurate identification of dynamic optical circuits is required for reliable data transmission. As circuit durations shrink to the microsecond and sub-microsecond range, sync accuracy demands become increasingly stringent. Yet, this problem has been largely overlooked, both practically and theoretically, with no general, easily integrable solutions or established accuracy limits. We present SyncWise, the first sync protocol customized for RDCNs that closes these gaps. SyncWise formalizes the synchronization problem for RDCNs, models errors through an RDCN-specific analysis of error sources, and leverages this error model to guide the “wise” selection of optimal sync parents. SyncWise achieves provably optimal performance and is prototyped on a testbed with an OCS and Intel Tofino2 switches. Large-scale simulations demonstrate that SyncWise is the first protocol to attain sub-10 ns maximum sync error, ensuring reliable RDCN fabrics and outperforming the most accurate protocols in traditional DCNs by a large margin.
papers.abstract_zh: 时间同步对于基于光路交换机 (OCS) 的新兴可重构数据中心网络 (RDCN) 至关重要，其中需要准确识别动态光路以实现可靠的数据传输。随着电路持续时间缩小到微秒和亚微秒范围，同步精度要求变得越来越严格。然而，这个问题在实践和理论上都被很大程度上忽视了，没有通用的、易于积分的解决方案或既定的精度限制。我们推出了 SyncWise，这是第一个为 RDCN 定制的同步协议，可以弥补这些差距。 SyncWise 形式化了 RDCN 的同步问题，通过特定于 RDCN 的错误源分析对错误进行建模，并利用此错误模型来指导“明智”选择最佳同步父级。 SyncWise 实现了经过验证的最佳性能，并在使用 OCS 和 Intel Tofino2 交换机的测试台上进行了原型设计。大规模仿真表明，SyncWise 是第一个达到低于 10 ns 最大同步误差的协议，确保了可靠的 RDCN 结构，并大幅优于传统 DCN 中最准确的协议。

papers.title: Syntra: Synthesizing Cross-Layer Controllers for Low-Latency Video Streaming.
papers.abstract: Modern applications such as low-latency video streaming demand tight coordination across multiple control dimensions, including bitrate selection, congestion control, frame skipping, and forward error correction (FEC). These dimensions interact in complex ways, making existing heuristic approaches difficult to design, tune, and generalize. This paper presents Syntra, an automated tool that synthesizes joint controllers from a symbolic model of the system and a declarative performance objective. Syntra formulates control as a partially observable game, performs bounded-horizon minimax search (similar to Chess engines) to synthesize strategies, and distills them into an efficient, interpretable policy via imitation learning. Synthesized controllers incorporate novel strategies that exploit the synergy between control dimensions to consistently outperform existing designs in our evaluation.
papers.abstract_zh: 低延迟视频流等现代应用需要跨多个控制维度的紧密协调，包括比特率选择、拥塞控制、跳帧和前向纠错 (FEC)。这些维度以复杂的方式相互作用，使得现有的启发式方法难以设计、调整和推广。本文介绍了 Syntra，这是一种自动化工具，可根据系统的符号模型和声明性性能目标合成联合控制器。 Syntra 将控制制定为部分可观察的游戏，执行有界极小极大搜索（类似于国际象棋引擎）来综合策略，并通过模仿学习将其提炼为高效、可解释的策略。综合控制器采用了新颖的策略，利用控制维度之间的协同作用，在我们的评估中始终优于现有设计。

papers.title: The GOODPUT System: A Machine Learning-Driven Optimization Framework for Dynamic Spectrum Control in Heterogeneous WLANs.
papers.abstract: Rapid proliferation of wireless devices is leading to spectrum scarcity, particularly in the unlicensed 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz bands. This paper describes a method to optimize goodput (useful communication throughput) in spectrum-constrained scenarios via access point (AP) channel assignments, channel bonding decisions, and wireless device (station) to AP mappings. Goodput demand prediction and real-time spectrum sensing are used to formulate goodput-maximizing mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) problem instances, which are optimally and efficiently solved to produce network configuration decisions. Our approach is compatible with existing IEEE 802.11 protocols (with primary emphasis on IEEE 802.11ax), commercial access points, modern wireless stations, and legacy infrastructures. A prototype of the system was evaluated and compared with the best existing solutions; it increases goodput by 17.1% relative to multi-AP loadbalancing, by 19.3% compared to a machine-learning-based AP selection, and by 47.9% relative to the static RSSI-based methods widely used in existing systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 无线设备的快速扩散导致频谱稀缺，特别是在未经许可的 2.4 GHz 和 5 GHz 频段。本文描述了一种在频谱受限的情况下通过接入点 (AP) 信道分配、信道绑定决策和无线设备（站）到 AP 映射来优化有效吞吐量（有用通信吞吐量）的方法。有效吞吐量需求预测和实时频谱感知用于制定有效吞吐量最大化混合整数线性规划 (MILP) 问题实例，并对其进行优化和有效解决以产生网络配置决策。我们的方法与现有的 IEEE 802.11 协议（主要侧重于 IEEE 802.11ax）、商业接入点、现代无线站和传统基础设施兼容。对系统原型进行了评估，并与现有的最佳解决方案进行了比较；与多 AP 负载平衡相比，它的吞吐量提高了 17.1%，与基于机器学习的 AP 选择相比，吞吐量提高了 19.3%，与现有系统中广泛使用的基于静态 RSSI 的方法相比，吞吐量提高了 47.9%。

papers.title: Themis: Detecting Distributed Concurrency Bugs through RPC-Driven Race-Directed Test Generation and Fuzzing.
papers.abstract: Distributed concurrency bugs occur when concurrent execution flows, at least one of which is triggered by inter-node communication such as remote procedure calls (RPCs), access the same shared variable or object in conflicting ways, causing incorrect behavior under certain interleavings. Existing work for detecting distributed concurrency bugs focuses on dynamic approaches, thus suffering from limited coverage. This paper proposes Themis, a novel approach that uses static analysis to detect potential races, applies LLM-based test generation, and employs directed fuzzing to refine input parameters for detecting distributed concurrency bugs. We have implemented a prototype of Themis and evaluated it on eight real-world distributed systems. Themis detects 198 new violations corresponding to 52 new bugs.
papers.abstract_zh: 当并发执行流（至少其中之一是由远程过程调用 (RPC) 等节点间通信触发）以冲突方式访问同一共享变量或对象时，就会出现分布式并发错误，从而导致在某些交错下出现不正确的行为。现有的分布式并发错误检测工作主要集中在动态方法上，因此覆盖范围有限。本文提出了 Themis，这是一种新颖的方法，它使用静态分析来检测潜在的竞争，应用基于 LLM 的测试生成，并采用定向模糊测试来细化输入参数以检测分布式并发错误。我们已经实现了 Themis 的原型，并在八个现实世界的分布式系统上对其进行了评估。 Themis 检测到 198 个新违规，对应 52 个新错误。

papers.title: Themis: Scheduling-Aware Buffer Management for HBM-Based Hybrid Buffers.
papers.abstract:
Packet buffers are critical for absorbing congestion and sustaining throughput in high-speed routers. As link rates escalate, on-chip SRAM alone can no longer provide sufficient capacity. To address this, modern routers widely adopt hybrid buffer architectures that augment limited on-chip SRAM with large off-chip DRAM. Despite this architectural promise, existing hybrid Buffer Management (BM) schemes severely undermine router performance. They simply redirect packets that would otherwise be dropped into DRAM, which leads to priority inversion and head-of-line blocking: as packets buffered in DRAM age into the highest-priority packets, SRAM must stall until they are retrieved, wasting bandwidth and degrading throughput. Worse still, existing BM schemes ignore DRAM's access characteristics, further constraining its limited bandwidth and reducing overall performance dramatically.

We present Themis, a hybrid buffer management scheme that fully exploits SRAM's high bandwidth and DRAM's large capacity. Its core principle is scheduling-aware packet placement, which ensures packets with the earliest departure time are preferentially stored in SRAM to maximize its bandwidth utilization. To achieve this, Themis proactively migrates buffered packets between SRAM and DRAM, reserving SRAM space for imminent, high-priority traffic. Themis is compatible with diverse scheduling algorithms and supports dynamic changes to the scheduling policy. It also organizes DRAM storage according to scheduling order, mapping consecutively departing packets to contiguous addresses. This unlocks effective off-chip bandwidth, and accelerates packet migration. Themis is hardware-friendly and its FPGA and ASIC prototypes achieve low overhead and high frequency. Large-scale simulations show that Themis improves end-to-end performance by up to 2.8×.
papers.abstract_zh:
数据包缓冲区对于吸收拥塞和维持高速路由器的吞吐量至关重要。随着链路速率的提升，仅片上 SRAM 已无法提供足够的容量。为了解决这个问题，现代路由器广泛采用混合缓冲区架构，用大型片外 DRAM 增强有限的片上 SRAM。尽管有这样的架构承诺，但现有的混合缓冲区管理 (BM) 方案严重损害了路由器的性能。它们只是将原本会被丢弃到 DRAM 中的数据包进行重定向，这会导致优先级反转和队头阻塞：当 DRAM 中缓冲的数据包老化为最高优先级数据包时，SRAM 必须停止运行，直到它们被检索，从而浪费带宽并降低吞吐量。更糟糕的是，现有的BM方案忽略了DRAM的访问特性，进一步限制了其有限的带宽并大幅降低了整体性能。

我们提出了 Themis，一种混合​​缓冲区管理方案，充分利用了 SRAM 的高带宽和 DRAM 的大容量。其核心原理是调度感知的数据包放置，确保最早出发时间的数据包优先存储在SRAM中，以最大化其带宽利用率。为了实现这一目标，Themis 主动在 SRAM 和 DRAM 之间迁移缓冲数据包，为即将到来的高优先级流量保留 SRAM 空间。 Themis兼容多种调度算法，支持动态改变调度策略。它还根据调度顺序组织 DRAM 存储，将连续离开的数据包映射到连续的地址。这释放了有效的片外带宽，并加速了数据包迁移。 Themis 硬件友好，其 FPGA 和 ASIC 原型实现了低开销和高频率。大规模模拟表明，Themis 将端到端性能提高了 2.8 倍。

papers.title: Towards Performance Robustness for Microservices.
papers.abstract:
Microservices are foundational to modern distributed applications, enabling modular design and scalability. However, they face performance variability due to environmental factors like workload burstiness, resource contention, and shared dependencies. Existing microservice controllers, such as autoscalers and admission controllers, struggle to ensure good performance, often causing several Service Level Objective (SLO) violations. We argue that this is because controller decision-making is uninformed, lacking guidance about robustness to environmental factors.

We propose the concept of run-time "performance robustness certificates" (PERCs) to address this limitation. A PERC provides statistical bounds on tail latencies of specific request types under a range of environmental perturbations. We show how to leverage a queueing-theoretic model of microservice performance to quickly derive actionable {PeRC}s. We introduce Galileo, a framework that integrates PERCs with two state-of-the-art learned controllers to guide robust actions toward meeting SLOs. Experimental results with real-world benchmarks validate the effectiveness of PERCs in ensuring robust microservice performance.
papers.abstract_zh:
微服务是现代分布式应用程序的基础，支持模块化设计和可扩展性。然而，由于工作负载突发性、资源争用和共享依赖性等环境因素，它们面临着性能变化。现有的微服务控制器（例如自动缩放器和准入控制器）很难确保良好的性能，通常会导致多次违反服务级别目标 (SLO)。我们认为这是因为控制器决策不知情，缺乏对环境因素稳健性的指导。

我们提出运行时“性能稳健性证书”（PERC）的概念来解决这一限制。 PERC 提供了在一系列环境扰动下特定请求类型的尾部延迟的统计界限。我们展示了如何利用微服务性能的排队理论模型来快速导出可操作的 {PeRC}。我们引入了 Galileo，这是一个将 PERC 与两个最先进的学习控制器集成在一起的框架，以指导实现 SLO 的稳健行动。真实世界基准的实验结果验证了 PERC 在确保稳健的微服务性能方面的有效性。

papers.title: TurboTest: Learning When Less is Enough through Early Termination of Internet Speed Tests.
papers.abstract: Internet speed tests are indispensable for users, ISPs, and policymakers, but their static flooding-based design imposes growing costs: a single high-speed test can transfer hundreds of MB, and collectively, platforms like Ookla, M-Lab, and Fast.com generate petabytes of traffic each month. Reducing this burden requires deciding when a test can be stopped early without sacrificing accuracy. We frame this as an optimal stopping problem and show that existing heuristics—static thresholds, BBR pipe-full signals, or throughput stability rules from Fast.com and FastBTS—capture only a narrow slice of the achievable accuracy—savings trade-off. This paper introduces TURBOTEST, a systematic framework for speed test termination that sits atop existing platforms. The key idea is to decouple throughput prediction (Stage~1) from test termination (Stage~2): Stage~1 trains a regressor to estimate final throughput from partial measurements, while Stage~2 trains a classifier to decide when sufficient evidence has accumulated to stop. Leveraging richer transport-level features (RTT, retransmissions, congestion window) alongside throughput, TURBOTEST exposes a single tunable parameter ε for accuracy tolerance and includes a fallback mechanism for high-variability cases. Evaluation on 1 million M-Lab NDT speed tests (2024–2025) shows that TURBOTEST achieves 1.8-4.4× higher data savings than an approach based on BBR signals while reducing median error. These results demonstrate that adaptive ML-based termination can deliver accurate, efficient, and deployable speed tests at scale.
papers.abstract_zh: 互联网速度测试对于用户、ISP 和政策制定者来说是不可或缺的，但其基于静态洪泛的设计带来了越来越高的成本：一次高速测试可以传输数百 MB，而 Ookla、M-Lab 和 Fast.com 等平台每月总共会产生 PB 的流量。减轻这种负担需要决定何时可以在不牺牲准确性的情况下提前停止测试。我们将此视为最佳停止问题，并表明现有的启发式方法（静态阈值、BBR 满管信号或来自 Fast.com 和 FastBTS 的吞吐量稳定性规则）仅捕获了可实现的精度和节省权衡中的一小部分。本文介绍了 TURBOTEST，这是一个位于现有平台之上的速度测试终止系统框架。关键思想是将吞吐量预测（Stage~1）与测试终止（Stage~2）解耦：Stage~1 训练回归器以根据部分测量估计最终吞吐量，而 Stage~2 训练分类器来决定何时积累足够的证据来停止。利用更丰富的传输级功能（RTT、重传、拥塞窗口）以及吞吐量，TURBOTEST 公开了单个可调参数 ε 以实现精度容差，并包括针对高可变性情况的回退机制。对 100 万次 M-Lab NDT 速度测试（2024-2025 年）的评估表明，TURBOTEST 比基于 BBR 信号的方法节省了 1.8-4.4 倍的数据，同时减少了中值误差。这些结果表明，基于 ML 的自适应终止可以大规模提供准确、高效且可部署的速度测试。

papers.title: Uber's Failover Architecture: Reconciling Reliability and Efficiency in Hyperscale Microservice Infrastructure.
papers.abstract: Operating a global, real-time platform at Uber’s scale requires infrastructure that is both resilient and cost-efficient. Historically, reliability was ensured through a costly 2× capacity model—each service provisioned to handle global traffic independently across two regions—leaving half the fleet idle. We present Uber’s Failover Architecture (UFA), which replaces the uniform 2× model with a differentiated architecture aligned to business criticality. Critical services retain failover guarantees, while non-critical services opportunistically use failover buffer capacity reserved for critical services during steady state. During rare “full-peak” failovers, non-critical services are selectively preempted and rapidly restored, with differentiated Service-Level Agreements (SLAs) using on-demand capacity. Automated safeguards, including dependency analysis and regression gates, ensure critical services continue to function even while non-critical services are unavailable. The quantitative impact is significant: UFA reduces steady-state provisioning from 2× to 1.3×, raising utilization from 20% toward 30% while sustaining 99.97% availability. To date, UFA has hardened over 4,000 unsafe dependencies, eliminated 575K CPU cores, and projected to reduce over one million cores from a baseline of about 4 million cores.
papers.abstract_zh: 运营 Uber 规模的全球实时平台需要既具有弹性又具有成本效益的基础设施。从历史上看，可靠性是通过昂贵的 2 倍容量模型来确保的——每项服务都配置为跨两个区域独立处理全球流量——导致一半的机队闲置。我们介绍 Uber 的故障转移架构 (UFA)，它用与业务关键性相一致的差异化架构取代了统一的 2× 模型。关键服务保留故障转移保证，而非关键服务则机会性地使用在稳定状态期间为关键服务保留的故障转移缓冲区容量。在罕见的“全峰值”故障转移期间，非关键服务会被选择性抢占并快速恢复，并使用按需容量提供差异化​​的服务级别协议 (SLA)。自动化保护措施（包括依赖性分析和回归门）可确保关键服务即使在非关键服务不可用时也能继续运行。定量影响是显着的：UFA 将稳态配置从 2 倍减少到 1.3 倍，将利用率从 20% 提高到 30%，同时维持 99.97% 的可用性。迄今为止，UFA 已强化了 4,000 多个不安全依赖项，消除了 575K 个 CPU 核心，并预计从约 400 万个核心的基准上减少超过 100 万个核心。

papers.title: Unleashing The Potential of Datacenter SSDs by Taming Performance Variability.
papers.abstract: Storage disaggregation is widely adopted in today's datacenters to improve disk utilization. However, efficiently disaggregating SSDs remains a challenge because of their high performance variability. This is due to differences in flash characteristics, such as wear and model version; read/write interference; and SSD-internal operations like garbage collection. Existing systems can only manage these types of variability in isolation. We propose Sandook, a rack-scale block storage system that instead holistically manages them together to unlock higher performance. Sandook achieves this through a logically centralized architecture that can integrate multiple scheduling policies and respond effectively at both short and long timescales. It adaptively steers I/O to the best available SSDs, using techniques that enable greater routing flexibility for both reads and writes. Sandook does not require any special storage or network hardware. Our evaluation demonstrates that Sandook is capable of delivering the full performance potential of SSDs. It achieves a 30%–82% raw I/O throughput improvement over existing systems that tackle a single source of performance variability while maintaining sub-millisecond tail latency. For unmodified applications sharing a pool of SSDs, Sandook achieves a 12–94% improvement in end-to-end performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 当今的数据中心广泛采用存储分解来提高磁盘利用率。然而，由于 SSD 的性能变化很大，有效分解 SSD 仍然是一个挑战。这是由于闪存特性存在差异，例如磨损情况和型号版本；读/写干扰；以及 SSD 内部操作，例如垃圾收集。现有系统只能单独管理这些类型的可变性。我们提出了 Sandook，这是一种机架级块存储系统，可以对它们进行整体管理以释放更高的性能。 Sandook 通过逻辑集中的架构实现了这一目标，该架构可以集成多种调度策略，并在短期和长期范围内有效响应。它使用为读取和写入提供更大路由灵活性的技术，自适应地将 I/O 引导至最佳可用 SSD。 Sandook 不需要任何特殊的存储或网络硬件。我们的评估表明 Sandook 能够发挥 SSD 的全部性能潜力。与现有系统相比，它的原始 I/O 吞吐量提高了 30%–82%，解决了性能变化的单一来源，同时保持了亚毫秒级尾部延迟。对于共享 SSD 池的未经修改的应用程序，Sandook 的端到端性能提高了 12-94%。

papers.title: UNUM: A New Framework for Network Control.
papers.abstract:
Modern network control tasks, such as congestion control and adaptive bitrate streaming, require accurate state estimation to adapt to heterogeneous and dynamic network conditions. Current approaches, whether manually engineered or machine learning (ML)-based, often rely on instantaneous or running-average metrics, resulting in imprecise approximations of the true network state. This hinders their ability to capture latent factors, such as application workloads or path dynamics, and adapt to non-stationary environments.

We present Unum, a new framework powered by a unified network state embedder leveraging Transformers' self-attention mechanism and diverse training datasets to learn rich, latent state representations. Unum processes historical RTT-timescale network statistics, models complete current state, and predicts future states using pre-trained embeddings from diverse network scenarios. We develop techniques to augment state-of-the-art controllers with Unum embeddings. Through experiments over real and synthetic settings, we show that using Unum state embeddings improves control performance across tasks, including congestion control and adaptive bitrate streaming.
papers.abstract_zh:
现代网络控制任务，例如拥塞控制和自适应比特率流，需要精确的状态估计以适应异构和动态的网络条件。当前的方法，无论是手动设计的还是基于机器学习 (ML) 的，通常依赖于瞬时或运行平均指标，导致对真实网络状态的近似不精确。这阻碍了它们捕获潜在因素（例如应用程序工作负载或路径动态）以及适应非静态环境的能力。

我们提出了 Unum，这是一个由统一网络状态嵌入器提供支持的新框架，利用 Transformer 的自注意力机制和多样化的训练数据集来学习丰富的潜在状态表示。 Unum 处理历史 RTT 时间尺度网络统计数据，对完整的当前状态进行建模，并使用来自不同网络场景的预训练嵌入来预测未来状态。我们开发技术来通过 Unum 嵌入来增强最先进的控制器。通过对真实和合成设置的实验，我们表明使用 Unum 状态嵌入可以提高跨任务的控制性能，包括拥塞控制和自适应比特率流。

papers.title: UpFuzz: Detecting Data Format Incompatibility Bugs during Distributed Storage System Upgrade.
papers.abstract:
Data format incompatibility is a significant cause of cloud incidents during distributed system upgrades, often resulting in severe consequences such as data corruption and service unavailability. A majority of such bugs are only discovered post-release, largely due to the lack of automated testing techniques tailored specifically for the upgrade process. Traditional automated test generation methods face a unique challenge when applied to upgrade testing: the high cost associated with upgrading distributed storage systems due to system initialization. Therefore, the accurate selection of potential failure-inducing tests from the extensive pool of automatically generated tests becomes critical.

In this work, we address this problem by proposing a novel approach to prioritize upgrade tests through analyzing data format properties over transitively persisted states : program states that are persisted to disk, directly or indirectly, through chains of memory copies by the old version, and eventually read by the new version after upgrade. Because data format incompatibility bugs happen due to translation errors of such states across versions, transitively persisted states satisfying unique data format properties related to changed data formats are particularly essential for testing.

We build a likely invariant analysis engine that captures such properties as feedback for seed test selection in UPFUZZ, the automated testing engine for the distributed storage system upgrade procedure. UPFUZZ has detected 15 previously unknown upgrade failures caused by data format incompatibilities in the latest stable versions of Cassandra, HBase, and HDFS; developers have confirmed 8 of them. 7 are triggered exclusively with UPFUZZ’s data format analysis. The detected bugs have severe consequences, with 6 crashing the cluster and 4 causing data loss or corruption.
papers.abstract_zh:
数据格式不兼容是分布式系统升级过程中发生云事件的重要原因，往往会导致数据损坏、服务不可用等严重后果。大多数此类错误只是在发布后才发现，很大程度上是由于缺乏专门针对升级过程定制的自动化测试技术。传统的自动化测试生成方法在应用于升级测试时面临着独特的挑战：由于系统初始化而升级分布式存储系统的相关成本很高。因此，从大量自动生成的测试中准确选择潜在的引发故障的测试变得至关重要。

在这项工作中，我们通过提出一种新颖的方法来解决这个问题，通过分析数据格式属性而不是传递持久状态来确定升级测试的优先级：程序状态通过旧版本的内存副本链直接或间接地持久保存到磁盘，并最终在升级后由新版本读取。由于数据格式不兼容错误是由于跨版本的此类状态的转换错误而发生的，因此满足与更改的数据格式相关的唯一数据格式属性的传递持久状态对于测试尤为重要。

我们构建了一个可能不变的分析引擎，它捕获诸如 UPFUZZ 中种子测试选择的反馈等属性，UPFUZZ 是分布式存储系统升级过程的自动测试引擎。 UPFUZZ 在 Cassandra、HBase 和 HDFS 的最新稳定版本中检测到了 15 个以前未知的因数据格式不兼容而导致的升级失败；开发商已确认其中8个。 7 是通过 UPFUZZ 的数据格式分析专门触发的。检测到的错误会造成严重后果，其中 6 个导致集群崩溃，4 个导致数据丢失或损坏。

papers.title: Wallet: Confidential Serverless Computing.
papers.abstract:
Although serverless computing offers compelling cost and deployment simplicity advantages, a significant challenge remains in securely managing sensitive data as it flows through the network of ephemeral function executions in serverless computing environments within untrusted clouds. While Confidential Virtual Machines (CVMs) offer a promising secure execution environment, their integration with serverless architectures currently faces fundamental limitations in key areas: security , performance , and resource efficiency .

We present WALLET, a lightweight confidential computing system for secure serverless deployments. By employing nested confidential execution and a decoupled guest OS within CVMs, WALLET runs each function in a minimal "trustlet", significantly improving security through a reduced Trusted Computing Base (TCB). Furthermore, by leveraging a data-centric I/O architecture built upon a lightweight LibOS, WALLET optimizes network communication to address performance and resource efficiency challenges.

Our evaluation shows that compared to CVM-based deployments, WALLET has a 4.3× smaller TCB, improves end-to-end latency (15–93%), achieves higher function density (up to 907×), and reduces inter-function communication (up to 27×) and function chaining latency (16.7-30.2×); thus, WALLET offers a practical system design for confidential serverless computing.
papers.abstract_zh:
尽管无服务器计算提供了令人信服的成本和部署简单性优势，但当敏感数据流经不受信任的云中的无服务器计算环境中的临时功能执行网络时，安全管理敏感数据仍然存在重大挑战。虽然机密虚拟机 (CVM) 提供了一个有前途的安全执行环境，但它们与无服务器架构的集成目前在安全、性能和资源效率等关键领域面临根本限制。

我们推出了 WALLET，这是一种用于安全无服务器部署的轻量级机密计算系统。通过在 CVM 内采用嵌套机密执行和解耦来宾操作系统，WALLET 在最小的“trustlet”中运行每个功能，通过减少可信计算基础 (TCB) 显着提高安全性。此外，通过利用基于轻量级 LibOS 构建的以数据为中心的 I/O 架构，WALLET 优化了网络通信，以应对性能和资源效率挑战。

我们的评估表明，与基于 CVM 的部署相比，WALLET 的 TCB 减小了 4.3 倍，改善了端到端延迟（15-93%），实现了更高的功能密度（高达 907 倍），并减少了功能间通信（高达 27 倍）和功能链延迟（16.7-30.2 倍）；因此，WALLET 为机密无服务器计算提供了实用的系统设计。

papers.title: Who Watches the Watchers? On the Reliability of Softwarizing Cloud Application Management.
papers.abstract: Modern cloud applications are increasingly managed by software programs, often named “operators,” which automate laborious, human-based operations. While operator programs largely prevent human mistakes, their own reliability has unprecedented impact on managed applications. This paper discusses the emerging challenges of operator program reliability on cloud-native platforms like Kubernetes. Our work is grounded in a rigorous analysis of 412 real-world failures of thirteen Kubernetes operators. We find that challenges of operator reliability come from the multifold complexity of an operator’s interactions with its managed applications, environment, and user interface. Among these, operators’ interactions with managed applications are the largest contributor to real-world operator failures, but they are largely overlooked—these interactions are often ad hoc and lack well-defined interfaces. We advocate to rethink the management interface of cloud applications and demonstrate this urgent need by showing the prevalence of defects in existing operators. Specifically, we develop a simple testing tool to exercise interactions between operators and the managed cloud applications, which discovered 86 new bugs in six popular Kubernetes operators.
papers.abstract_zh: 现代云应用程序越来越多地由软件程序进行管理，这些软件程序通常被称为“操作员”，这些软件程序可以自动执行繁重的、基于人的操作。虽然操作员程序在很大程度上可以防止人为错误，但其自身的可靠性对托管应用程序具有前所未有的影响。本文讨论了 Kubernetes 等云原生平台上操作程序可靠性的新挑战。我们的工作基于对 13 个 Kubernetes 操作员的 412 次实际故障的严格分析。我们发现运营商可靠性的挑战来自于运营商与其托管应用程序、环境和用户界面交互的多重复杂性。其中，操作员与托管应用程序的交互是导致现实操作失败的最大因素，但它们在很大程度上被忽视了——这些交互通常是临时的，并且缺乏明确定义的接口。我们主张重新思考云应用的管理界面，并通过展示现有运营商普遍存在的缺陷来展示这一迫切需求。具体来说，我们开发了一个简单的测试工具来练习 Operator 和托管云应用程序之间的交互，该工具在 6 个流行的 Kubernetes Operator 中发现了 86 个新错误。

papers.title: XLL: Cross-Layer Logging for Data Deduplication in Consensus-Based Storage.
papers.abstract: Modern distributed storage systems exhibit cross-layer data duplication, writing data to disk once during a consensus phase and again during a local database logging phase. The result is poor performance and significant write amplification. To remedy this cross-layer redundancy, we design and implement Cross-Layer Log (XLL), a shared log built upon the principle of key-value separation. We use XLL to deduplicate updates within a distributed key-value store (TiKV), leading to a 5.5x increase in write throughput while reducing write amplification by 73%. We also demonstrate the effectiveness of our crash recovery protocol in maintaining data integrity.
papers.abstract_zh: 现代分布式存储系统表现出跨层数据复制，在共识阶段将数据写入磁盘一次，在本地数据库日志记录阶段再次将数据写入磁盘。结果是性能不佳并且写入放大显着。为了弥补这种跨层冗余，我们设计并实现了跨层日志（XLL），这是一种基于键值分离原则构建的共享日志。我们使用 XLL 对分布式键值存储 (TiKV) 中的更新进行重复数据删除，从而使写入吞吐量提高 5.5 倍，同时将写入放大减少 73%。我们还展示了我们的崩溃恢复协议在维护数据完整性方面的有效性。

papers.title: ZipLLM: Efficient LLM Storage via Model-Aware Synergistic Data Deduplication and Compression.
papers.abstract:
Modern model hubs, such as Hugging Face, store tens of petabytes of LLMs, with fine-tuned variants vastly outnumbering base models and dominating storage consumption. Existing storage reduction techniques—such as deduplication and compression—are either LLM-oblivious or not compatible with each other, limiting data reduction effectiveness.

Our large-scale characterization study across all publicly available Hugging Face LLM repositories reveals several key insights: (1) fine-tuned models within the same family exhibit highly structured, sparse parameter differences suitable for delta compression; (2) bitwise similarity enables LLM family clustering; and (3) tensor-level deduplication is better aligned with model storage workloads, achieving high data reduction with low metadata overhead. Building on these insights, we design BitX, an effective, fast, lossless delta compression algorithm that compresses the XORed difference between fine-tuned and base LLMs. We build ZipLLM, a model storage reduction pipeline that unifies tensor-level deduplication and lossless BitX compression. By synergizing deduplication and compression around LLM family clustering, ZipLLM reduces model storage consumption by 54%, over 20% higher than state-of-the-art deduplication and compression approaches.
papers.abstract_zh:
现代模型中心（例如 Hugging Face）可存储数十 PB 的 LLM，其中经过微调的变体数量远远超过基本模型，并且占据了存储消耗的主导地位。现有的存储缩减技术（例如重复数据删除和压缩）要么忽略了 LLM，要么彼此不兼容，从而限制了数据缩减的有效性。

我们对所有公开的 Hugging Face LLM 存储库进行的大规模表征研究揭示了几个关键见解：（1）同一系列中的微调模型表现出适合增量压缩的高度结构化、稀疏参数差异； (2) 按位相似性实现LLM家族聚类； （3）张量级重复数据删除与模型存储工作负载更好地保持一致，以低元数据开销实现高数据缩减。基于这些见解，我们设计了 BitX，这是一种有效、快速、无损的增量压缩算法，可压缩微调和基础 LLM 之间的异或差异。我们构建了 ZipLLM，这是一个模型存储缩减管道，它统一了张量级重复数据删除和无损 BitX 压缩。通过围绕 LLM 系列集群协同重复数据删除和压缩，ZipLLM 将模型存储消耗降低了 54%，比最先进的重复数据删除和压缩方法高出 20% 以上。

papers.title: ZOC: Elastic and Cost-Efficient Virtual SmartNIC Architecture for Cloud Physical Machines.
papers.abstract: DPU-based SmartNICs are reshaping cloud infrastructure by offloading core I/O functions, enabling cloud physical machines that support both bare-metal and virtualized environments. However, large-scale deployments face practical challenges—including operational inconsistency across heterogeneous fleets, limited resource elasticity, and performance bottlenecks caused by slow-path processing. We present ZOC, a software-defined virtual SmartNIC architecture that transforms general-purpose servers equipped with commodity NICs into full-featured cloud physical machines. ZOC delivers compatibility with existing infrastructure and provides a user experience on par with DPU-based nodes—without requiring any specialized hardware. At its core, ZOC integrates a passthrough NIC and dynamically provisioned host resources into a dedicated service VM, forming an elastic and programmable acceleration platform. Built upon this foundation, it introduces an efficient cross-domain device abstraction that exposes standardized I/O devices to the host, enabling seamless access to cloud storage and VPC networks. Extensive evaluation shows that ZOC achieves superior cost efficiency, eliminates slow-path bottlenecks, and provides high maintainability. Deployed in a major cloud, ZOC serves diverse public and private cloud services as a production-ready complement to existing DPU-based solutions.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于 DPU 的 SmartNIC 正在通过卸载核心 I/O 功能来重塑云基础设施，使云物理机能够同时支持裸机和虚拟化环境。然而，大规模部署面临实际挑战，包括异构队列之间的操作不一致、资源弹性有限以及慢路径处理造成的性能瓶颈。我们推出了 ZOC，一种软件定义的虚拟 SmartNIC 架构，可将配备商用 NIC 的通用服务器转变为功能齐全的云物理机。 ZOC 提供与现有基础设施的兼容性，并提供与基于 DPU 的节点同等的用户体验，而无需任何专门的硬件。 ZOC的核心是将直通网卡和动态配置的主机资源集成到专用服务虚拟机中，形成弹性、可编程的加速平台。在此基础上，它引入了高效的跨域设备抽象，将标准化的 I/O 设备暴露给主机，从而实现对云存储和 VPC 网络的无缝访问。广泛的评估表明，ZOC实现了卓越的成本效率，消除了慢路径瓶颈，并提供了高可维护性。 ZOC 部署在主要云中，提供多种公共和私有云服务，作为对现有基于 DPU 的解决方案的生产就绪补充。

papers.title: ZooRoute: Enhancing Cloud-Scale Network Reliability via Candidate Path Provisioning and Overlay Proactive Rerouting.
papers.abstract:
Failures are inevitable in production-scale cloud networks, making reliability a critical concern for both cloud service providers (CSPs) and their tenants. Existing network failure recovery solutions either fail to provide timely failover or require underlay upgrades, forcing tenants to deploy their own high availability systems with additional CapEX & OpEx. However, most tenants lack the expertise or willingness to invest in such systems but are highly sensitive to service disruptions. This motivates CSPs to assume the responsibility of fast and deterministic failure recovery as a cloud service.

In this work, we present ZooRoute, a tenant-transparent, underlay-agnostic network failure recovery service in Alibaba Cloud. ZooRoute leverages the overlay layer and enables failure bypass by modifying outer source ports during VXLAN tunnel encapsulation. A set of source port candidates per destination IP are maintained by proactive probing between tunnel endpoints to guarantee one-shot deterministic traffic reroute onto healthy paths. However, scaling such design at planet-scale cloud infra brings challenges such as probing overhead at hypervisors, memory consumption at Tofino gateways, and service disruptions at stateful middleboxes, which we address with a range of novel techniques. Deployed in Alibaba Cloud for 26 months, ZooRoute has significantly improved network reliability, reducing cumulative outage time by 93.19% and masking 98.21% of failures from tenant awareness.
papers.abstract_zh:
在生产规模的云网络中，故障是不可避免的，这使得可靠性成为云服务提供商 (CSP) 及其租户的关键问题。现有的网络故障恢复解决方案要么无法提供及时的故障转移，要么需要底层升级，迫使租户部署自己的高可用性系统，并增加额外的资本支出和运营支出。然而，大多数租户缺乏投资此类系统的专业知识或意愿，但对服务中断高度敏感。这促使 CSP 承担起云服务快速、确定性故障恢复的责任。

在这项工作中，我们提出了 ZooRoute，这是阿里云中租户透明、底层不可知的网络故障恢复服务。 ZooRoute 利用覆盖层，通过在 VXLAN 隧道封装期间修改外部源端口来实现故障旁路。通过隧道端点之间的主动探测来维护每个目标 IP 的一组候选源端口，以保证一次性确定性流量重新路由到健康路径上。然而，在全球范围内扩展此类设计会带来一些挑战，例如虚拟机管理程序的探测开销、Tofino 网关的内存消耗以及有状态中间盒的服务中断，我们通过一系列新技术来解决这些问题。 ZooRoute在阿里云部署26个月，网络可靠性显着提升，累计宕机时间减少93.19%，屏蔽98.21%的故障租户感知。

papers.title: A Layered Formal Methods Approach to Answering Queue-related Queries.
papers.abstract: Queue dynamics introduce significant uncertainty in network management tasks such as debugging, performance monitoring, and analysis. Despite numerous queue-monitoring techniques, many networks today continue to collect only per-port packet counts (e.g., using SNMP). Although queue lengths are correlated with packet counts, deriving the precise correlation between them is very challenging since packet counts do not specify many quantities (e.g., packet arrival order) which affect queue lengths. This paper presents QuASI, a system that can answer many queue-related queries using only coarse-grained per-port packet counts. QuASI checks whether there exists a packet trace that is consistent with the packet counts and satisfies a query. To scale on large problem instances, QuASI relies on a layered approach and on a novel enqueue-rate abstraction, which is lossless for the class of queries that QuASI answers. The first layer employs a novel and efficient algorithm that generates a cover-set of abstract traces, constructs representative abstract traces from the cover-set, and efficiently checks each representative abstract trace by leveraging a known result on (0,1)-matrix existence. The first layer guarantees no false negatives: if the first layer says "No", there is no packet trace consistent with the observed packet counts that makes the query true. If it says "Yes", further verification is needed, which the second layer resolves using an SMT solver. As a result, QuASI has no false positives and no false negatives. Our evaluations show that QuASI is up to 10 6 X faster than state-of-the-art, and can answer non-trivial queries about queue metrics (e.g., queue length) using minute-granularity packet counts. Our work is the first step toward more practical formal performance analysis under given measurements.
papers.abstract_zh: 队列动态给调试、性能监控和分析等网络管理任务带来了显着的不确定性。尽管有许多队列监控技术，但当今许多网络仍然只收集每个端口的数据包计数（例如，使用 SNMP）。尽管队列长度与数据包计数相关，但导出它们之间的精确相关性非常具有挑战性，因为数据包计数没有指定影响队列长度的许多数量（例如数据包到达顺序）。本文介绍了 QuASI，这是一个仅使用粗粒度的每端口数据包计数即可回答许多与队列相关的查询的系统。 QuASI 检查是否存在与数据包计数一致并满足查询的数据包跟踪。为了扩展大型问题实例，QuASI 依赖于分层方法和新颖的排队速率抽象，这对于 QuASI 回答的查询类别是无损的。第一层采用新颖且高效的算法，生成抽象迹线的覆盖集，从覆盖集构造代表性抽象迹线，并通过利用（0,1）矩阵存在性的已知结果来有效地检查每个代表性抽象迹线。第一层保证没有漏报：如果第一层说“否”，则不存在与观察到的数据包计数一致的数据包跟踪，从而使查询为真。如果显示“是”，则需要进一步验证，第二层使用 SMT 求解器进行解析。因此，QuASI 没有误报，也没有漏报。我们的评估表明，QuASI 的速度比最先进的技术快 10 6 倍，并且可以使用分钟粒度数据包计数来回答有关队列指标（例如队列长度）的重要查询。我们的工作是在给定测量下进行更实用的正式性能分析​​的第一步。

papers.title: Accelerating Design Space Exploration for LLM Training Systems with Multi-experiment Parallel Simulation.
papers.abstract: The rapid expansion of large language models (LLMs) requires the development of extensive GPU clusters, with companies deploying clusters with tens to hundreds of thousands of GPUs. This growth significantly expands the design space for LLM training systems, requiring thorough exploration of different parallelization strategies, communication parameters, congestion control, fabric topology, etc. Current methods require up to 10k simulation experiments to identify optimal configurations, with inadequate exploration leading to significant degradation of training performance. In this paper, we tackle the overlooked problem of efficiently conducting parallel simulation experiments for design space exploration. Our analysis and experiments show that Single-process Multi-experiment (SPME) achieves superior performance by reducing scheduling overhead and optimizing resource utilization, yet remains insufficient for current AI cluster scales. To enhance SPME’s efficacy, we introduce Multiverse, a novel GPU-based AI training simulator. Multiverse leverages the computing throughput of GPUs efficiently with optimizations such as a pull-based synchronization, highfidelity intra-server communication, and a kernel-fusion technique. Extensive experiments validate the accuracy and efficiency of Multiverse, demonstrating less than 3.0% discrepancy with real-world LLM training on clusters of up to 54,000 GPUs, achieving 43.1−73.2X speedup over state-of-the-art CPU-based simulators in various use cases.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的快速扩展需要开发大量的GPU集群，企业部署的集群有数万到数十万个GPU。这种增长显着扩展了 LLM 训练系统的设计空间，需要对不同的并行化策略、通信参数、拥塞控制、结构拓扑等进行彻底探索。当前的方法需要多达 10k 的模拟实验来确定最佳配置，探索不充分会导致训练性能显着下降。在本文中，我们解决了为设计空间探索有效进行并行仿真实验的被忽视的问题。我们的分析和实验表明，单进程多实验（SPME）通过减少调度开销和优化资源利用率实现了卓越的性能，但对于当前的人工智能集群规模来说仍然不足。为了增强 SPME 的功效，我们引入了 Multiverse，这是一种基于 GPU 的新型 AI 训练模拟器。 Multiverse 通过基于拉动的同步、高保真服务器内通信和内核融合技术等优化，有效地利用 GPU 的计算吞吐量。大量实验验证了 Multiverse 的准确性和效率，证明与在多达 54,000 个 GPU 的集群上进行的真实 LLM 训练的差异不到 3.0%，在各种用例中比最先进的基于 CPU 的模拟器实现了 43.1−73.2 倍的加速。

papers.title: Achieving Wire-Latency Storage Systems by Exploiting Hardware ACKs.
papers.abstract: We present Juneberry, a low-latency communication framework for storage systems. Different from existing RPC frameworks, Juneberry provides a fast path for storage requests: they can be committed with a single round trip and server CPU bypass, thus delivering extremely low latency; the execution of these requests is performed asynchronously on the server CPU. Juneberry achieves it by relying on our proposed Ordered Queue abstraction, which exploits NICs’ hardware ACKs as commit signals of requests while ensuring linearizability of the whole system. Juneberry also supports durability by placing requests in persistent memory (PM). We implement Juneberry using commodity RDMA NICs and integrate it into two storage systems: Memcached (a widely used in-memory caching system) and PMemKV (a PM-based persistent key-value store). Evaluation shows that compared with RPC, Juneberry can significantly lower their latency under write-intensive workloads.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们推出了 Juneberry，一种用于存储系统的低延迟通信框架。与现有的 RPC 框架不同，Juneberry 为存储请求提供了快速路径：它们可以通过单次往返和服务器 CPU 旁路来提交，从而提供极低的延迟；这些请求的执行在服务器 CPU 上异步执行。 Juneberry 通过依赖我们提出的有序队列抽象来实现这一目标，该抽象利用 NIC 的硬件 ACK 作为请求的提交信号，同时确保整个系统的线性化。 Juneberry 还通过将请求放入持久内存 (PM) 来支持持久性。我们使用商用 RDMA NIC 实现 Juneberry，并将其集成到两个存储系统中：Memcached（广泛使用的内存缓存系统）和 PMemKV（基于 PM 的持久键值存储）。评估表明，与 RPC 相比，Juneberry 可以显着降低写入密集型工作负载下的延迟。

papers.title: AsTree: An Audio Subscription Architecture Enabling Massive-Scale Multi-Party Conferencing.
papers.abstract: While operating a multi-party video conferencing system (Lark) globally, we find that audio subscription alone may pose considerable challenges to the network, especially when scaling towards massive scales. Traditional strategy of subscribing to all remote participants suffers from issues such as signaling storm, excessive bandwidth and resource consumption on both server and client sides. Aimed at enhanced scalability, we share our design of AsTree, an audio subscription architecture. By a cascading tree topology and media plane-based audio selection, AsTree dramatically reduces the number of signaling messages and audio streams to forward. Practical deployment in Lark reduces audio and video stall ratios by more than 30% and 50%. We also receive 40% less negative client reviews, strongly proving the value of AsTree.
papers.abstract_zh: 在全球范围内运营多方视频会议系统（Lark）时，我们发现仅音频订阅就可能对网络构成相当大的挑战，尤其是在大规模扩展时。传统的订阅所有远程参与者的策略存在信令风暴、服务器和客户端带宽过多以及资源消耗等问题。为了增强可扩展性，我们分享了 AsTree（音频订阅架构）的设计。通过级联树形拓扑和基于媒体平面的音频选择，AsTree 极大地减少了要转发的信令消息和音频流的数量。 Practical deployment in Lark reduces audio and video stall ratios by more than 30% and 50%.我们收到的负面客户评论也减少了 40%，有力地证明了 AsTree 的价值。

papers.title: AutoCCL: Automated Collective Communication Tuning for Accelerating Distributed and Parallel DNN Training.
papers.abstract: The collective communication libraries are pivotal in optimizing the performance of distributed and parallel deep neural network (DNN) training. Most network optimizations are under the assumption that these libraries are well-tuned, ignoring their low-level parameter selection. In this paper, we present a novel automated tuning method AutoCCL that significantly improves communication performance without incurring additional costs. One of the primary challenges we tackle is the state explosion in searching for the optimal configuration. To overcome this, we decouple implementation-related parameters from those sensitive to the search space size and propose a divide-and-conquer algorithm, minimizing the requirement for exhaustive trials. We further propose an online tuning approach that accounts for communication-computation interference to enhance accuracy in finding optimal configurations, while hiding tuning overhead within early iterations of training jobs. We implement AutoCCL atop NCCL, a leading and widely-used communication library provided by NVIDIA. Our evaluation on both a 2-node cluster (16 A40 GPUs, intra-node NVLink, inter-node 2× 400Gbps InfiniBand) and a 4-node cluster (32 A40 GPUs, intra-node PCIe, inter-node 100Gbps InfiniBand) demonstrates that AutoCCL achieves 1.24-1.29× and 1.15-1.22× speedups on microbenchmarks compared to NCCL and another SOTA NCCL tuner, respectively, and up to 1.80× and 1.49× with concurrent computation. End-to-end evaluations on three large language models and one vision model show 1.07-1.32× improvements in periteration training time.
papers.abstract_zh: 集体通信库对于优化分布式并行深度神经网络 (DNN) 训练的性能至关重要。大多数网络优化都是假设这些库经过良好调整，忽略了它们的低级参数选择。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的自动调整方法 AutoCCL，它可以显着提高通信性能，而不会产生额外的成本。我们解决的主要挑战之一是寻找最佳配置时的状态爆炸。为了克服这个问题，我们将与实现相关的参数与对搜索空间大小敏感的参数解耦，并提出了一种分而治之的算法，最大限度地减少了详尽试验的要求。我们进一步提出了一种在线调整方法，该方法考虑了通信计算干扰，以提高寻找最佳配置的准确性，同时隐藏训练作业早期迭代中的调整开销。我们在 NCCL 之上实现 AutoCCL，NCCL 是 NVIDIA 提供的领先且广泛使用的通信库。我们对 2 节点集群（16 个 A40 GPU、节点内 NVLink、节点间 2× 400Gbps InfiniBand）和 4 节点集群（32 个 A40 GPU、节点内 PCIe、节点间 100Gbps InfiniBand）的评估表明，与微基准测试相比，AutoCCL 在微基准上实现了 1.24-1.29 倍和 1.15-1.22 倍的加速NCCL 和另一个 SOTA NCCL 调谐器，并发计算分别高达 1.80× 和 1.49×。对三种大型语言模型和一种视觉模型的端到端评估显示，迭代训练时间提高了 1.07-1.32 倍。

papers.title: Beehive: A Scalable Disaggregated Memory Runtime Exploiting Asynchrony of Multithreaded Programs.
papers.abstract: The Microsecond (µs)-scale I/O fabrics raise a tension between the programming productivity and performance, especially in disaggregated memory systems. The multithreaded synchronous programming model is popular in developing memory-disaggregated applications due to its intuitive program logic. However, our key insight is that although thread switching can effectively mitigate µs-scale latency, it leads to poor data locality and non-trivial scheduling overhead, leaving significant opportunities to improve the performance further. This paper proposes a memory-disaggregated framework, Beehive , which improves the remote access throughput by exploiting the asynchrony within each thread. To improve the programming usability, Beehive allows the programmers to develop applications in the conventional multithreaded synchronous model and automatically transforms the code into pararoutine (a newly proposed computation and scheduling unit) based asynchronous code via the Rust compiler. Beehive outperforms the state-of-the-art memory-disaggregated frameworks, i.e., Fastswap, Hermit, and AIFM, by 4.26×, 3.05×, and 1.58× on average.
papers.abstract_zh: 微秒 (μs) 级 I/O 结构提高了编程效率和性能之间的矛盾，尤其是在分解内存系统中。多线程同步编程模型由于其直观的程序逻辑而在开发内存分解应用程序中很流行。然而，我们的主要见解是，虽然线程切换可以有效地减轻微秒级的延迟，但它会导致较差的数据局部性和不小的调度开销，从而为进一步提高性能留下了重要的机会。本文提出了一种内存分解框架 Beehive，它通过利用每个线程内的异步性来提高远程访问吞吐量。为了提高编程可用性，Beehive 允许程序员在传统的多线程同步模型中开发应用程序，并通过 Rust 编译器自动将代码转换为基于 pararoutine（新提出的计算和调度单元）的异步代码。 Beehive 的性能平均优于最先进的内存分解框架（即 Fastswap、Hermit 和 AIFM）4.26 倍、3.05 倍和 1.58 倍。

papers.title: BFTBrain: Adaptive BFT Consensus with Reinforcement Learning.
papers.abstract: This paper presents BFTBrain, a reinforcement learning (RL) based Byzantine fault-tolerant (BFT) system that provides significant operational benefits: a plug-and-play system suitable for a broad set of hardware and network configurations, and adjusts effectively in real-time to changing fault scenarios and workloads. BFTBrain adapts to system conditions and application needs by switching between a set of BFT protocols in real-time. Two main advances contribute to BFTBrain’s agility and performance. First, BFTBrain is based on a systematic, thorough modeling of metrics that correlate the performance of the studied BFT protocols with varying fault scenarios and workloads. These metrics are fed as features to BFTBrain’s RL engine in order to choose the best-performing BFT protocols in real-time. Second, BFTBrain coordinates RL in a decentralized manner which is resilient to adversarial data pollution, where nodes share local metering values and reach the same learning output by consensus. As a result, in addition to providing significant operational benefits, BFTBrain improves throughput over fixed protocols by 18% to 119% under dynamic conditions and outperforms state-of-the-art learning based approaches by 44% to 154%.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了 BFTBrain，这是一种基于强化学习 (RL) 的拜占庭容错 (BFT) 系统，可提供显着的运营优势：即插即用系统，适用于广泛的硬件和网络配置，并可以实时有效地调整以适应不断变化的故障场景和工作负载。 BFTBrain 通过在一组 BFT 协议之间实时切换来适应系统条件和应用需求。 BFTBrain 的敏捷性和性能有两项主要进步。首先，BFTBrain 基于系统、彻底的指标建模，将所研究的 BFT 协议的性能与不同的故障场景和工作负载相关联。这些指标作为特征输入 BFTBrain 的 RL 引擎，以便实时选择性能最佳的 BFT 协议。其次，BFTBrain 以去中心化的方式协调强化学习，这种方式能够抵御对抗性数据污染，其中节点共享本地计量值并通过共识达到相同的学习输出。因此，除了提供显着的运营优势外，BFTBrain 在动态条件下将固定协议的吞吐量提高了 18% 至 119%，并且比最先进的基于学习的方法提高了 44% 至 154%。

papers.title: Building an Elastic Block Storage over EBOFs Using Shadow Views.
papers.abstract: The EBOF (Ethernet-Bunch-Of-Flash) has emerged as an enticing and promising disaggregated storage platform due to its streamlined I/O processing, high scalability, and substantial energy/cost-efficiency improvement. An EBOF applies a smart-sender dumb-receiver design philosophy and provides backward-compatible storage volumes to expedite system deployment. Yet, the static and opaque internal I/O processing pipeline lacks resource allocation, I/O scheduling, and traffic orchestration capabilities, entailing bandwidth waste, workload non-adaptiveness, and performance interference. This paper presents the design and implementation of a distributed telemetry system (called shadow view) to tackle the above challenges and facilitate the effective use of an EBOF. We model an EBOF as a two-layer multi-switch architecture and develop a view development protocol to construct the EBOF running snapshot and expose internal execution statistics at runtime. Our design is motivated by the observation that fast data center networks make the overheads of inter-server communication and synchronization negligible. We demonstrate the effectiveness of shadow view by building a block storage (dubbed Flint) atop EBOFs. The enhanced I/O data plane allows us to develop new three techniques–an elastic volume manager, a view-enabled bandwidth auction mechanism, and an eIO scheduler. Our evaluations using the Fungible FS1600 EBOF show that a Flint volume achieves 9.3/9.2 GB/s read/write bandwidth with no latency degradation, significantly outperforming the defacto EBOF volume. It achieves up to 2.9× throughput improvements when running an object store. Flint is tenant-aware and remote target-aware, delivering efficient multi-tenancy and workload adaptiveness.
papers.abstract_zh: EBOF（以太网闪存束）由于其简化的 I/O 处理、高可扩展性以及显着的能源/成本效率改进，已成为一种诱人且有前途的分类存储平台。 EBOF采用智能发送器哑接收器设计理念，并提供向后兼容的存储卷以加快系统部署。然而，静态且不透明的内部I/O处理管道缺乏资源分配、I/O调度和流量编排能力，导致带宽浪费、工作负载不适应性和性能干扰。本文介绍了分布式遥测系统（称为影子视图）的设计和实现，以解决上述挑战并促进 EBOF 的有效使用。我们将 EBOF 建模为两层多交换机架构，并开发视图开发协议来构建 EBOF 运行快照并在运行时公开内部执行统计信息。我们的设计动机是观察到快速的数据中心网络使服务器间通信和同步的开销可以忽略不计。我们通过在 EBOF 上构建块存储（称为 Flint）来演示影子视图的有效性。增强的 I/O 数据平面使我们能够开发三种新技术——弹性卷管理器、支持视图的带宽拍卖机制和 eIO 调度程序。我们使用 Fungible FS1600 EBOF 进行的评估表明，Flint 卷可实现 9.3/9.2 GB/s 读/写带宽，并且没有延迟下降，明显优于实际的 EBOF 卷。运行对象存储时，它的吞吐量提高了 2.9 倍。 Flint 具有租户感知和远程目标感知能力，可提供高效的多租户和工作负载适应性。

papers.title: Building Massive MIMO Baseband Processing on a Single-Node Supercomputer.
papers.abstract: The rising deployment of massive MIMO coupled with the wide adoption of virtualized radio access networks (vRAN) poses an unprecedented computational demand on the baseband processing, hardly met by existing vRAN hardware substrates. The single-node supercomputer, an emerging computing platform, offers scalable computation and communication capabilities, making it a promising target to hold and run the baseband pipeline. However, realizing this is non-trivial due to the mismatch between (a) the diverse execution granularities and incongruent parallel degrees of different stages along the software processing pipeline and (b) the underlying evolving irregular hardware parallelism at runtime. This paper closes the gap by designing and implementing MegaStation–an application-platform co-designed system that effectively harnesses the computing power of a single-node supercomputer for processing massive MIMO baseband. Our key insight is that one can adjust the execution granularity and reconstruct the baseband processing pipeline on the fly based on the monitored hardware parallelism status. Inspired by dynamic instruction scheduling, MegaStation models the single-node supercomputer as a tightly coupled microprocessor and employs a scoreboarding-like algorithm to orchestrate "baseband processing" instructions over GPU-instantiated executors. Our evaluations using the GigaIO FabreX demonstrate that MegaStation achieves up to 66.2% lower tail frame processing latency and 4× higher throughput than state-of-the-art solutions. MegaStation is a scalable and adaptive solution that can meet today’s vRAN requirements.
papers.abstract_zh: 大规模 MIMO 的不断部署，加上虚拟化无线接入网络 (vRAN) 的广泛采用，对基带处理提出了前所未有的计算需求，而现有的 vRAN 硬件基板很难满足。单节点超级计算机是一种新兴的计算平台，提供可扩展的计算和通信能力，使其成为保持和运行基带管道的有希望的目标。然而，实现这一点并非易事，因为（a）软件处理管道上不同阶段的不同执行粒度和不一致的并行度与（b）运行时底层不断发展的不规则硬件并行性之间的不匹配。本文通过设计和实现 MegaStation 来弥补这一差距，MegaStation 是一个应用平台共同设计的系统，可有效利用单节点超级计算机的计算能力来处理大规模 MIMO 基带。我们的主要见解是，可以根据监控的硬件并行状态动态调整执行粒度并重建基带处理管道。受动态指令调度的启发，MegaStation 将单节点超级计算机建模为紧密耦合的微处理器，并采用类似记分板的算法在 GPU 实例化的执行器上编排“基带处理”指令。我们使用 GigaIO FabreX 进行的评估表明，与最先进的解决方案相比，MegaStation 的尾帧处理延迟降低了 66.2%，吞吐量提高了 4 倍。 MegaStation 是一种可扩展、自适应的解决方案，可以满足当今的 vRAN 要求。

papers.title: ByteCheckpoint: A Unified Checkpointing System for Large Foundation Model Development.
papers.abstract: Checkpointing to preserve training states is crucial during the development of Large Foundation Models (LFMs), for training resumption upon various failures or changes in GPU resources and parallelism configurations. In addition, saved checkpoints are dispatched to evaluation tasks or transferred across different training stages (e.g., from pre-training to post-training). All these scenarios require resharding distributed checkpoints from one parallelism to another. In production environments, different LFMs are trained with various frameworks and storage backends, depending on model sizes and training scales. A high performance checkpointing system is needed to enable efficient checkpoint management at scale throughout the lifecycle of LFM development. We introduce ByteCheckpoint, an industrial-grade checkpointing system for large-scale LFM training. ByteCheckpoint features: a parallelism-agnostic checkpoint representation that enables efficient load-time checkpoint resharding; a generic checkpoint saving/loading workflow to accommodate multiple training frameworks and support different storage backends; full-stack optimizations to ensure high I/O efficiency and scalability; a suite of monitoring tools to streamline large-scale performance analysis and bottleneck detection. Compared to existing open-source checkpointing systems [51, 57], ByteCheckpoint significantly reduces runtime checkpoint stalls, achieving an average reduction of 54.20×. For saving and loading times, ByteCheckpoint achieves improvements of up to 9.96× and 8.80×, respectively.
papers.abstract_zh: 在大型基础模型 (LFM) 的开发过程中，用于保留训练状态的检查点至关重要，以便在 GPU 资源和并行配置发生各种故障或变化时恢复训练。此外，保存的检查点被分配给评估任务或在不同的训练阶段（例如，从训练前到训练后）转移。所有这些场景都需要将分布式检查点从一种并行性重新分片到另一种并行性。在生产环境中，根据模型大小和训练规模，不同的 LFM 使用不同的框架和存储后端进行训练。需要高性能检查点系统来在 LFM 开发的整个生命周期中实现大规模的高效检查点管理。我们推出了 ByteCheckpoint，这是一种用于大规模 LFM 训练的工业级检查点系统。 ByteCheckpoint 功能：与并行性无关的检查点表示，可实现高效的加载时检查点重新分片；通用检查点保存/加载工作流程，以适应多个训练框架并支持不同的存储后端；全栈优化，保证高I/O效率和可扩展性；一套监控工具，用于简化大规模性能分析和瓶颈检测。与现有的开源检查点系统[51, 57]相比，ByteCheckpoint 显着减少了运行时检查点停顿，平均减少了 54.20 倍。对于保存和加载时间，ByteCheckpoint 分别实现了高达 9.96 倍和 8.80 倍的改进。

papers.title: CATO: End-to-End Optimization of ML-Based Traffic Analysis Pipelines.
papers.abstract: Machine learning has shown tremendous potential for improving the capabilities of network traffic analysis applications, often outperforming simpler rule-based heuristics. However, ML-based solutions remain difficult to deploy in practice. Many existing approaches only optimize the predictive performance of their models, overlooking the practical challenges of running them against network traffic in real time. This is especially problematic in the domain of traffic analysis, where the efficiency of the serving pipeline is a critical factor in determining the usability of a model. In this work, we introduce CATO, a framework that addresses this problem by jointly optimizing the predictive performance and the associated systems costs of the serving pipeline. CATO leverages recent advances in multi-objective Bayesian optimization to efficiently identify Pareto-optimal configurations, and automatically compiles end-to-end optimized serving pipelines that can be deployed in real networks. Our evaluations show that compared to popular feature optimization techniques, CATO can provide up to 3600× lower inference latency and 3.7× higher zero-loss throughput while simultaneously achieving better model performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 机器学习在提高网络流量分析应用程序的能力方面表现出了巨大的潜力，通常优于更简单的基于规则的启发式方法。然而，基于机器学习的解决方案在实践中仍然难以部署。许多现有方法仅优化其模型的预测性能，而忽略了实时针对网络流量运行模型的实际挑战。这在流量分析领域尤其成问题，其中服务管道的效率是确定模型可用性的关键因素。在这项工作中，我们引入了 CATO，这是一个通过联合优化服务管道的预测性能和相关系统成本来解决此问题的框架。 CATO 利用多目标贝叶斯优化的最新进展来有效识别帕累托最优配置，并自动编译可部署在实际网络中的端到端优化服务管道。我们的评估表明，与流行的特征优化技术相比，CATO 可以提供高达 3600 倍的低推理延迟和高 3.7 倍的零丢失吞吐量，同时实现更好的模型性能。

papers.title: CEGS: Configuration Example Generalizing Synthesizer.
papers.abstract: Network configuration synthesis promises to increase the efficiency of network management by reducing human involvement. However, despite significant advances in this field, existing synthesizers still require much human effort in drafting configuration templates or coding in a domain-specific language. We argue that the main reason for this is that a core capability is missing for current synthesizers: identifying and following configuration examples in configuration manuals and generalizing them to arbitrary topologies. In this work, we fill this capability gap with two recent advancements in artificial intelligence: graph neural networks (GNNs) and large language models (LLMs). We build CEGS, which can automatically identify appropriate configuration examples, follow and generalize them to fit target network scenarios. CEGS features a GNN-based Querier to identify relevant examples from device documentations, a GNN-based Classifier to generalize the example to arbitrary topology, and an efficient LLM-driven synthesis method to quickly and correctly synthesize configurations that comply with the intents. Evaluations of real-world networks and complex intents show that CEGS can automatically synthesize correct configurations for a network of 1094 devices without human involvement. In contrast, the state-of-the-art LLM-based synthesizer are more than 30 times slower than CEGS on average, even when human experts are in the loop.
papers.abstract_zh: 网络配置综合有望通过减少人工参与来提高网络管理的效率。然而，尽管该领域取得了重大进展，现有的合成器仍然需要大量的人力来起草配置模板或使用特定于领域的语言进行编码。我们认为，造成这种情况的主要原因是当前合成器缺少核心功能：识别并遵循配置手册中的配置示例，并将它们推广到任意拓扑。在这项工作中，我们通过人工智能的两项最新进展填补了这一能力差距：图神经网络（GNN）和大型语言模型（LLM）。我们构建了 CEGS，它可以自动识别适当的配置示例，遵循并概括它们以适应目标网络场景。 CEGS 具有基于 GNN 的查询器，用于从设备文档中识别相关示例；基于 GNN 的分类器，用于将示例推广到任意拓扑；以及高效的 LLM 驱动的合成方法，用于快速、正确地合成符合意图的配置。对现实世界网络和复杂意图的评估表明，CEGS 可以自动为包含 1094 个设备的网络合成正确的配置，而无需人工参与。相比之下，最先进的基于 LLM 的合成器平均比 CEGS 慢 30 倍以上，即使是在人类专家参与的情况下也是如此。

papers.title: CellReplay: Towards accurate record-and-replay for cellular networks.
papers.abstract: The inherent variability of real-world cellular networks makes it hard to evaluate, reproduce, and debug the performance of networked applications running on these networks. A common approach is to record and replay a trace of observed cellular network performance. However, we show that the state-of-the-art record-and-replay technique produces empirically inaccurate results that can cause evaluation bias. This paper presents the design and implementation of CellReplay, a tool that records the time-varying performance of a live cellular network into traces using preset workloads and faithfully replays the observed performance for other workloads through an emulated network interface. The key challenge in achieving high accuracy is to replay varying network behavior in a way that captures its sensitivity to the workload. CellReplay records network behavior under two predefined workloads simultaneously and interpolates upon replay for other workloads. Across various challenging network conditions, our evaluation shows that real-world networked applications (e.g., web browsing or video streaming) running on CellReplay achieve similar performance (e.g., page load time or bitrate selection) to their live network counterparts, with significantly reduced error compared to the prior method.
papers.abstract_zh: 现实世界蜂窝网络固有的可变性使得评估、重现和调试在这些网络上运行的网络应用程序的性能变得困难。一种常见的方法是记录并重放观察到的蜂窝网络性能的痕迹。然而，我们表明，最先进的记录和重放技术会产生经验上不准确的结果，可能导致评估偏差。本文介绍了 CellReplay 的设计和实现，该工具使用预设工作负载将实时蜂窝网络随时间变化的性能记录到轨迹中，并通过模拟网络接口忠实地重播其他工作负载观察到的性能。实现高精度的关键挑战是以捕获其对工作负载敏感性的方式重放不同的网络行为。 CellReplay 同时记录两个预定义工作负载下的网络行为，并在重播时对其他工作负载进行插值。在各种具有挑战性的网络条件下，我们的评估表明，在 CellReplay 上运行的现实网络应用程序（例如网页浏览或视频流）可实现与其实时网络对应程序相似的性能（例如页面加载时间或比特率选择），并且与之前的方法相比，错误显着减少。

papers.title: ClubHeap: A High-Speed and Scalable Priority Queue for Programmable Packet Scheduling.
papers.abstract: While PIFO is a powerful priority queue abstraction to support programmable packet scheduling in network devices, the efficient implementation of PIFO faces multiple challenges in performance and scalability. The existing solutions all fall short of certain requirements. In this paper, we propose ClubHeap to address the problem. On the one hand, we develop a novel hardware-friendly heap data structure to support faster PIFO queue operations that can schedule a flow in every clock cycle, reaching the theoretical lower bound; on the other hand, the optimized hardware architecture reduces the circuit complexity and thus enables a higher clock frequency. The end result is the best scheduling performance in its class. Combined with its inherently better scalability and flexibility, ClubHeap is an ideal solution to be built in programmable switches and SmartNICs to support various scheduling algorithms. We build an FPGA-based hardware prototype and conduct a thorough evaluation by comparing ClubHeap with the other state-of-the-art solutions. ClubHeap also allows graceful trade-offs between throughput and resource consumption through parameter adjustments, making it adaptable on different target devices.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然 PIFO 是一种强大的优先级队列抽象，可支持网络设备中的可编程数据包调度，但 PIFO 的高效实施面临着性能和可扩展性方面的多重挑战。现有的解决方案都达不到一定的要求。在本文中，我们提出 ClubHeap 来解决这个问题。一方面，我们开发了一种新颖的硬件友好堆数据结构，以支持更快的 PIFO 队列操作，可以在每个时钟周期调度一个流，达到理论下限；另一方面，优化的硬件架构降低了电路复杂度，从而实现了更高的时钟频率。最终结果是同类产品中最佳的调度性能。结合其固有的更好的可扩展性和灵活性，ClubHeap 是内置于可编程交换机和 SmartNIC 中以支持各种调度算法的理想解决方案。我们构建了一个基于 FPGA 的硬件原型，并通过将 ClubHeap 与其他最先进的解决方案进行比较来进行彻底的评估。 ClubHeap还允许通过参数调整在吞吐量和资源消耗之间进行优雅的权衡，使其能够适应不同的目标设备。

papers.title: DISC: Backpressure Mitigation In Multi-tier Applications With Distributed Shared Connection.
papers.abstract: Most data-center applications are based on a multi-tier architecture, involving either coarse-grained software components (e.g., traditional 3-tier web applications) or fine-grained ones (e.g., microservices). Such applications are prone to the backpressure problem, which introduces a strong performance coupling between tiers, thus degrading scalability and resource consumption. This problem is due to the fact that, on the response path towards the initial client, a significant fraction of the payloads in the messages exchanged between tiers correspond to “final” data that are simply relayed (i.e., without further modifications) from a backend tier such as a database. This traffic results in additional pressure on the intermediate and frontend tiers. To address this problem, we introduce DISC, a system allowing several tiers within a multi-tier chain to jointly act as endpoints of the same TCP connection. This enables the selective bypass of one or several tiers on the response path. Unlike existing solutions, DISC is (1) flexible — it accommodates arbitrary multi-tier topologies and heterogeneous application-level protocols, (2) fine-grained — it allows multiple tiers to be involved in the generation and emission of a given response message (e.g., to decouple the network path of the response headers and footers from the path of the response body), (3) and non-intrusive — it requires only minor and localized/modular modifications to the code base of legacy applications and is transparent for external clients. Evaluation results with several micro- and macro-benchmarks show that DISC can reduce the cumulative CPU load on servers by up to 41.5%, decrease the average and tail latencies respectively by up to 74.1% and 5.71×, and also improve the request rate by up to 45%.
papers.abstract_zh: 大多数数据中心应用程序都基于多层架构，涉及粗粒度软件组件（例如传统的三层 Web 应用程序）或细粒度软件组件（例如微服务）。此类应用程序很容易出现背压问题，从而在层之间引入强烈的性能耦合，从而降低可扩展性和资源消耗。这个问题的原因是，在通往初始客户端的响应路径上，层之间交换的消息中的有效负载的很大一部分对应于从后端层（例如数据库）简单中继（即，没有进一步修改）的“最终”数据。这种流量会给中间层和前端层带来额外的压力。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了 DISC，该系统允许多层链中的多个层共同充当同一 TCP 连接的端点。这使得能够选择性地绕过响应路径上的一层或多层。与现有解决方案不同，DISC 具有以下特点：(1) 灵活 — 它适应任意多层拓扑和异构应用程序级协议；(2) 细粒度 — 它允许多个层参与给定响应消息的生成和发送（例如，将响应标头和页脚的网络路径与响应正文的路径解耦）；(3) 且非侵入性 — 它只需要对遗留应用程序的代码库进行较小的本地化/模块化修改，并且是透明的对于外部客户。多个微观和宏观基准的评估结果表明，DISC可以将服务器上的累积CPU负载降低高达41.5%，将平均延迟和尾延迟分别降低高达74.1%和5.71倍，并将请求率提高高达45%。

papers.title: Dissecting and Streamlining the Interactive Loop of Mobile Cloud Gaming.
papers.abstract: With cloud-side computing and rendering, mobile cloud gaming (MCG) is expected to deliver high-quality gaming experiences to budget mobile devices. However, our measurement on representative MCG platforms reveals that even under good network conditions, all platforms exhibit high interactive latency of 112–403 ms, from a user-input action to its display response, that critically affects users’ quality of experience. Moreover, jitters in network latency often lead to significant fluctuations in interactive latency. In this work, we collaborate with a commercial MCG platform to conduct the first in-depth analysis on the interactive latency of cloud gaming. We identify VSync, the synchronization primitive of Android graphics pipeline, to be a key contributor to the excessive interactive latency; as many as five VSync events are intricately invoked, which serialize the complex graphics processing logic on both the client and cloud sides. To address this, we design an end-to-end VSync regulator, dubbed LoopTailor, which minimizes VSync events by decoupling game rendering from the lengthy cloud-side graphics pipeline and coordinating cloud game rendering directly with the client. We implement LoopTailor on the collaborated platform and commodity Android devices, reducing the interactive latency (by ∼34%) to stably below 100 ms.
papers.abstract_zh: 借助云端计算和渲染，移动云游戏（MCG）有望为廉价移动设备提供高质量的游戏体验。然而，我们对代表性MCG平台的测量表明，即使在良好的网络条件下，所有平台从用户输入操作到显示响应都表现出112-403毫秒的高交互延迟，这严重影响了用户的体验质量。此外，网络延迟的抖动通常会导致交互延迟的显着波动。在这项工作中，我们与商业MCG平台合作，首次对云游戏的交互延迟进行了深入分析。我们认为 VSync（Android 图形管道的同步原语）是导致交互延迟过大的关键因素；错综复杂地调用了多达5个VSync事件，将客户端和云端复杂的图形处理逻辑序列化。为了解决这个问题，我们设计了一个名为 LoopTailor 的端到端 VSync 调节器，它通过将游戏渲染与冗长的云端图形管道解耦并直接与客户端协调云游戏渲染来最大限度地减少 VSync 事件。我们在协作平台和商用 Android 设备上实施了 LoopTailor，将交互延迟（约 34%）降低到稳定在 100 毫秒以下。

papers.title: Eden: Developer-Friendly Application-Integrated Far Memory.
papers.abstract: Far memory systems are a promising way to address the resource stranding problem in datacenters. Far memory systems broadly fall into two categories. On one hand, paging-based systems use hardware guards at the granularity of pages to intercept remote accesses, which require no application changes but incur significant faulting overhead. On the other hand, app-integrated systems use software guards on data objects and apply application-specific optimizations to avoid faulting overheads, but these systems require significant application redesign and/or suffer from overhead on local accesses. We propose Eden, a new approach to far memory that combines hardware guards with a small number of software guards in the form of programmer annotations, to achieve performance similar to app-integrated systems with minimal developer effort. Eden is based on the insight that applications generate most of their page faults at a small number of code locations, and those locations are easy to find programmatically. By adding hints to such locations, Eden can notify the pager about upcoming memory accesses to customize read-ahead and memory reclamation. We show that Eden achieves 19.4–178% higher performance than Fastswap for memory-intensive applications including DataFrame and memcached. Eden achieves performance comparable to AIFM with almost 100× fewer code changes.
papers.abstract_zh: 远存储系统是解决数据中心资源搁浅问题的一种有前途的方法。远记忆系统大致分为两类。一方面，基于分页的系统使用页面粒度的硬件防护来拦截远程访问，这不需要更改应用程序，但会产生大量的故障开销。另一方面，应用程序集成系统对数据对象使用软件防护，并应用特定于应用程序的优化以避免故障开销，但这些系统需要大量的应用程序重新设计和/或遭受本地访问开销。我们提出了 Eden，一种新的远内存方法，它将硬件防护与少量以程序员注释形式的软件防护相结合，以最少的开发人员工作实现与应用程序集成系统类似的性能。 Eden 基于这样的见解：应用程序在少数代码位置生成大部分页面错误，并且这些位置很容易通过编程方式找到。通过向这些位置添加提示，Eden 可以通知分页器即将进行的内存访问，以自定义预读和内存回收。我们表明，对于 DataFrame 和 memcached 等内存密集型应用程序，Eden 的性能比 Fastswap 高出 19.4-178%。 Eden 的性能可与 AIFM 相媲美，而代码更改量却减少了近 100 倍。

papers.title: Efficient Direct-Connect Topologies for Collective Communications.
papers.abstract: We consider the problem of distilling efficient network topologies for collective communications. We provide an algorithmic framework for constructing direct-connect topologies optimized for the latency vs. bandwidth trade-off associated with the workload. Our approach synthesizes many different topologies and communication schedules for a given cluster size and degree, then identifies the best option for a given workload. Our algorithms start from small, optimal base topologies and associated schedules, using techniques that can be iteratively applied to derive much larger topologies and schedules. Additionally, we incorporate well-studied large-scale graph topologies into our algorithmic framework by producing efficient communication schedules for them using a novel polynomial-time algorithm. Our evaluation uses multiple testbeds and large-scale simulations to demonstrate significant performance benefits from our derived topologies and schedules.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们考虑为集体通信提炼有效网络拓扑的问题。我们提供了一个算法框架，用于构建针对与工作负载相关的延迟与带宽权衡进行优化的直连拓扑。我们的方法针对给定的集群大小和程度综合了许多不同的拓扑和通信调度，然后确定给定工作负载的最佳选择。我们的算法从小型的、最佳的基本拓扑和相关的调度开始，使用可迭代应用的技术来导出更大的拓扑和调度。此外，我们通过使用新颖的多项式时间算法为它们生成有效的通信时间表，将经过充分研究的大规模图拓扑合并到我们的算法框架中。我们的评估使用多个测试台和大规模模拟来证明我们派生的拓扑和时间表带来的显着性能优势。

papers.title: Efficient Multi-WAN Transport for 5G with OTTER.
papers.abstract: In the ongoing cloudiﬁcation of 5G, software network functions (NFs) are replacing ﬁxed-function network hardware, allowing 5G network operators to leverage the beneﬁts of cloud computing. The migration of NFs and their management to the cloud causes 5G trafﬁc to traverse an operator’s wide-area network (WAN) to the cloud WAN that hosts the datacenters (DCs) running 5G NFs and applications. However, achieving end-to-end (E2E) performance for 5G trafﬁc across two WANs is hard. Placing 5G ﬂows across two WANs with different performance and reliability characteristics, edge and DC resource constraints, and interference from other ﬂows is different and more challenging than single-WAN trafﬁc engineering. We address this challenge and show that orchestrating E2E paths across a multi-WAN overlay allows us to achieve average 13% more throughput, 15% less RTT, 45% less jitter, or reduce average loss from 0.06% to under 0.001%. We implement our multi-WAN 5G ﬂow placement in a scalable optimization prototype that allocates 26%–45% more bytes on the network than greedy baselines while also satisfying the service demands of more ﬂows.
papers.abstract_zh: 在正在进行的 5G 云化过程中，软件网络功能 (NF) 正在取代固定功能网络硬件，使 5G 网络运营商能够充分利用云计算的优势。 NF 及其管理向云的迁移导致 5G 流量穿过运营商的广域网 (WAN) 到达托管运行 5G NF 和应用程序的数据中心 (DC) 的云 WAN。然而，跨两个广域网实现 5G 流量的端到端 (E2E) 性能非常困难。将 5G 流放置在具有不同性能和可靠性特征、边缘和 DC 资源限制以及来自其他流的干扰的两个 WAN 上是不同的，并且比单 WAN 流量工程更具挑战性。我们解决了这一挑战，并表明，跨多 WAN 覆盖编排 E2E 路径使我们能够平均提高 13% 的吞吐量、减少 15% 的 RTT、减少 45% 的抖动，或将平均损耗从 0.06% 降低到 0.001% 以下。我们在可扩展的优化原型中实现了多 WAN 5G 流布局，该原型在网络上分配的字节数比贪婪基线多 26%–45%，同时还满足更多流的服务需求。
