papers.abstract: Recent years have witnessed the wide adoption of RDMA in the cloud to accelerate first-party workloads and achieve cost savings by freeing up CPU cycles. Now cloud providers are working towards supporting RDMA in general-purpose guest VMs to benefit third-party workloads. To this end, cloud providers must provide strong performance isolation so that the RDMA workloads of one tenant do not adversely impact the RDMA performance of another tenant. Despite many efforts on network performance isolation in the public cloud, we find that RDMA brings unique challenges due to its complex NIC microarchitecture resources (e.g., the NIC cache). In this paper, we aim to systematically understand the impact of RNIC microarchitecture resources on performance isolation. We present a model that represents how RDMA operations use RNIC resources. Using this model, we develop a test suite to evaluate RDMA performance isolation solutions. Our test suite can break all existing solutions in various scenarios. Our results are acknowledged and reproduced by one of the largest RDMA NIC vendors. Finally, based on the test results, we summarize new insights on designing future RDMA performance isolation solutions.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来，RDMA 在云中得到广泛采用，以加速第一方工作负载并通过释放 CPU 周期来节省成本。现在，云提供商正在努力在通用来宾虚拟机中支持 RDMA，以使第三方工作负载受益。为此，云提供商必须提供强大的性能隔离，以便一个租户的 RDMA 工作负载不会对另一租户的 RDMA 性能产生不利影响。尽管在公共云中的网络性能隔离方面做出了很多努力，但我们发现 RDMA 由于其复杂的 NIC 微架构资源（例如 NIC 缓存）而带来了独特的挑战。在本文中，我们旨在系统地了解RNIC微架构资源对性能隔离的影响。我们提出了一个模型来表示 RDMA 操作如何使用 RNIC 资源。使用该模型，我们开发了一个测试套件来评估 RDMA 性能隔离解决方案。我们的测试套件可以打破各种场景下的所有现有解决方案。我们的结果得到了最大的 RDMA NIC 供应商之一的认可和复制。最后，根据测试结果，我们总结了设计未来 RDMA 性能隔离解决方案的新见解。

papers.title: Understanding the impact of host networking elements on traffic bursts.
papers.abstract: Conventional host networking features various traffic shaping layers (e.g., buffers, schedulers, and pacers) with complex interactions and wide implications for performance metrics. These interactions can lead to large bursts at various time scales. Understanding the nature of traffic bursts is important for optimal resource provisioning, congestion control, buffer sizing, and traffic prediction but is challenging due to the complexity and feature velocity in host networking. We develop Valinor, a traffic measurement framework that consists of eBPF hooks and measurement modules in a programmable network. Valinor offers visibility into traffic burstiness over a wide span of timescales (nanosecond- to secondscale) at multiple vantage points. We deploy Valinor to analyze the burstiness of various classes of congestion control algorithms, qdiscs, Linux process scheduling, NIC packet scheduling, and hardware offloading. Our analysis counters the assumption that burstiness is primarily a function of the application layer and preserved by protocol stacks, and highlights the pronounced role of lower layers in the formation and suppression of bursts. We also show the limitations of canonical burst countermeasures (e.g., TCP pacing and qdisc scheduling) due to the intervening nature of segmentation offloading and fixed-function NIC scheduling. Finally, we demonstrate that, far from a universal invariant, burstiness varies significantly across host stacks. Our findings underscore the need for a measurement framework such as Valinor for regular burst analysis.
papers.abstract_zh: 传统的主机网络具有各种流量整形层（例如缓冲区、调度程序和定步器），具有复杂的交互作用和对性能指标的广泛影响。这些相互作用可能导致不同时间尺度的大爆发。了解流量突发的本质对于优化资源配置、拥塞控制、缓冲区大小和流量预测非常重要，但由于主机网络的复杂性和功能速度而具有挑战性。我们开发了 Valinor，这是一个流量测量框架，由可编程网络中的 eBPF 挂钩和测量模块组成。 Valinor 可以在多个有利位置提供大范围时间尺度（纳秒到秒尺度）内流量突发性的可见性。我们部署 Valinor 来分析各类拥塞控制算法、qdisc、Linux 进程调度、NIC 数据包调度和硬件卸载的突发性。我们的分析反驳了突发性主要是应用层的函数并由协议栈保存的假设，并强调了较低层在突发的形成和抑制中的显着作用。我们还展示了由于分段卸载和固定功能 NIC 调度的干预性质而导致的规范突发对策（例如 TCP 调步和 qdisc 调度）的局限性。最后，我们证明，突发性在主机堆栈之间存在显着差异，远非普遍的不变量。我们的研究结果强调需要像 Valinor 这样的测量框架来进行定期突发分析。

papers.title: Unlocking unallocated cloud capacity for long, uninterruptible workloads.
papers.abstract: Cloud providers auction off unallocated resources at a low cost to avoid keeping hardware idle. One such mechanism is Harvest VMs (HVMs). These VMs grow and shrink as the unallocated resources in a server change. While HVMs are larger in size and less prone to eviction compared to other low-cost VMs, their resource variations severely slow down long-running, uninterruptible (hard to checkpoint/migrate) workloads. We characterize HVMs from a major cloud provider and discover large spatial variations in their stability and resources. We leverage this diversity by predicting which HVMs will be stable enough to run tasks without preemptions. We use the predictions to inform scheduling and resource acquisition decisions. Our evaluation with real workloads shows that we can reduce mean and tail (90th percentile) job completion times by 27% and 44% respectively, at 75% lower cost than regular VMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 云提供商以较低的成本拍卖未分配的资源，以避免硬件闲置。其中一种机制是 Harvest VM (HVM)。这些虚拟机随着服务器中未分配资源的变化而增长和收缩。虽然与其他低成本虚拟机相比，HVM 的规模较大且不易被逐出，但其资源变化严重减慢了长时间运行的不间断（难以检查点/迁移）工作负载的速度。我们对主要云提供商的 HVM 进行了特征分析，发现其稳定性和资源存在巨大的空间差异。我们通过预测哪些 HVM 将足够稳定来运行任务而无需抢占，从而利用这种多样性。我们使用预测来通知调度和资源获取决策。我们对实际工作负载的评估表明，我们可以将平均和尾部（第 90 个百分位）作业完成时间分别缩短 27% 和 44%，而成本比常规虚拟机低 75%。

papers.title: VeCare: Statistical Acoustic Sensing for Automotive In-Cabin Monitoring.
papers.abstract: On average, every 10 days a child dies from in-vehicle heatstroke. The life-threatening situation calls for an automatic Child Presence Detection (CPD) solution to prevent these tragedies. In this paper, we present VECARE, the first CPD system that leverages existing in-car audio without any hardware changes. To achieve so, we explore the fundamental properties of acoustic reflection signals and develop a novel paradigm of statistical acoustic sensing, which allows to detect motion, track breathing, and estimate speed in a unified model. Based on this, we build an accurate and robust CPD system by introducing a set of techniques that overcome multiple challenges concerning sound interference and sensing coverage. We implement VECARE using commodity speakers and a single microphone and conduct experiments with infant simulators and adults, as well as 15 young children for the real-world in-car study. The results demonstrate that VECARE achieves an average detection rate of 98.8% with a false alarm rate of 2.1% for 15 children in various cars, boosting the coverage by over 2.3× compared to state-of-the-art and achieving whole-car detection with no blind spot.
papers.abstract_zh: 平均每 10 天就有一名儿童死于车内中暑。这种危及生命的情况需要自动儿童存在检测 (CPD) 解决方案来防止这些悲剧发生。在本文中，我们介绍了 VECARE，这是第一个利用现有车载音频而无需更改任何硬件的 CPD 系统。为了实现这一目标，我们探索了声学反射信号的基本特性，并开发了一种新的统计声学传感范例，它允许在统一模型中检测运动、跟踪呼吸和估计速度。在此基础上，我们引入了一套克服声音干扰和传感覆盖等多重挑战的技术，构建了一个准确、鲁棒的 CPD 系统。我们使用商用扬声器和单个麦克风实施 VECARE，并使用婴儿模拟器和成人以及 15 名幼儿进行实验，以进行真实的车内研究。结果表明，VECARE对各类车内15名儿童的平均检测率为98.8%，误报率为2.1%，覆盖范围较现有技术提高2.3倍以上，实现全车无盲点检测。

papers.title: Waverunner: An Elegant Approach to Hardware Acceleration of State Machine Replication.
papers.abstract: State machine replication (SMR) is a core mechanism for building highly available and consistent systems. In this paper, we propose Waverunner, a new approach to accelerate SMR using FPGA-based SmartNICs. Our approach does not implement the entire SMR system in hardware; instead, it is a hybrid software/hardware system. We make the observation that, despite the complexity of SMR, the most common routine—the data replication—is actually simple. The complex parts (leader election, failure recovery, etc.) are rarely used in modern datacenters where failures are only occasional. These complex routines are not performance critical; their software implementations are fast enough and do not need acceleration. Therefore, our system uses FPGA assistance to accelerate data replication, and leaves the rest to the traditional software implementation of SMR. Our Waverunner approach is beneficial in both the common and the rare case situations. In the common case, the system runs at the speed of the network, with a 99th percentile latency of 1.8 μs achieved without batching on minimum-size packets at network line rate (85.5 Gbps in our evaluation). In rare cases, to handle uncommon situations such as leader failure and failure recovery, the system uses traditional software to guarantee correctness, which is much easier to develop and maintain than hardware-based implementations. Overall, our experience confirms Waverunner as an effective and practical solution for hardware accelerated SMR—achieving most of the benefits of hardware acceleration with minimum added complexity and implementation effort.
papers.abstract_zh: 状态机复制（SMR）是构建高可用和一致系统的核心机制。在本文中，我们提出了 Waverunner，这是一种使用基于 FPGA 的 SmartNIC 来加速 SMR 的新方法。我们的方法并没有在硬件中实现整个SMR系统；相反，它是一个混合软件/硬件系统。我们观察到，尽管 SMR 很复杂，但最常见的例程——数据复制——实际上很简单。现代数据中心很少使用复杂的部分（领导者选举、故障恢复等），因为故障只是偶尔发生。这些复杂的例程对性能并不至关重要；他们的软件实现速度足够快，不需要加速。因此，我们的系统使用FPGA辅助来加速数据复制，剩下的交给SMR的传统软件实现。我们的 Waverunner 方法对于常见和罕见的情况都是有益的。在常见情况下，系统以网络速度运行，在不以网络线路速率（我们的评估中为 85.5 Gbps）对最小尺寸数据包进行批处理的情况下，实现了 1.8 μs 的 99% 延迟。在极少数情况下，为了处理领导者故障和故障恢复等罕见情况，系统使用传统软件来保证正确性，这比基于硬件的实现更容易开发和维护。总体而言，我们的经验证实 Waverunner 是一种有效且实用的硬件加速 SMR 解决方案，以最小的复杂性和实施工作增加实现了硬件加速的大部分优势。

papers.title: xBGP: Faster Innovation in Routing Protocols.
papers.abstract: Internet Service Providers use routers from multiple vendors that support standardized routing protocols. Network operators deploy new services by tuning these protocols. Unfortunately, while standardization is necessary for interoperability, this is a slow process. As a consequence, new features appear very slowly in routing protocols. We propose a new implementation model for BGP, called xBGP, that enables ISPs to innovate by easily deploying BGP extensions in their multivendor network. We define a vendor-neutral xBGP API which can be supported by any BGP implementation and an eBPF Virtual Machine that allows executing extension code within these BGP implementations. We demonstrate the feasibility of our approach by extending both FRRouting and BIRD. We demonstrate seven different use cases showing the benefits that network operators can obtain using xBGP programs. We propose a verification toolchain that enables operators to compile and verify the safety properties of xBGP programs before deploying them. Our testbed measurements show that the performance impact of xBGP is reasonable compared to native code.
papers.abstract_zh: 互联网服务提供商使用来自多个供应商的支持标准化路由协议的路由器。网络运营商通过调整这些协议来部署新服务。不幸的是，虽然标准化对于互操作性是必要的，但这是一个缓慢的过程。因此，路由协议中新功能的出现速度非常缓慢。我们提出了一种名为 xBGP 的新 BGP 实施模型，使 ISP 能够通过在其多供应商网络中轻松部署 BGP 扩展来进行创新。我们定义了一个供应商中立的 xBGP API，任何 BGP 实现都可以支持它，并且 eBPF 虚拟机允许在这些 BGP 实现中执行扩展代码。我们通过扩展 FRRouting 和 BIRD 来证明我们方法的可行性。我们演示了七个不同的用例，展示了网络运营商使用 xBGP 程序可以获得的好处。我们提出了一个验证工具链，使运营商能够在部署 xBGP 程序之前编译和验证其安全属性。我们的测试台测量表明，与本机代码相比，xBGP 对性能的影响是合理的。

papers.title: Zeus: Understanding and Optimizing GPU Energy Consumption of DNN Training.
papers.abstract: Training deep neural networks (DNNs) is becoming increasingly more resource- and energy-intensive every year. Unfortunately, existing works primarily focus on optimizing DNN training for faster completion, often without considering the impact on energy efficiency. In this paper, we observe that common practices to improve training performance can often lead to inefficient energy usage. More importantly, we demonstrate that there is a tradeoff between energy consumption and performance optimization. To this end, we propose Zeus, an optimization framework to navigate this tradeoff by automatically finding optimal job- and GPU-level configurations for recurring DNN training jobs. Zeus uses an online exploration-exploitation approach in conjunction with just-in-time energy profiling, averting the need for expensive offline measurements, while adapting to data drifts over time. Our evaluation shows that Zeus can improve the energy efficiency of DNN training by 15.3%–75.8% for diverse workloads.
papers.abstract_zh: 训练深度神经网络 (DNN) 每年变得越来越消耗资源和能源。不幸的是，现有的工作主要集中在优化 DNN 训练以更快地完成，通常没有考虑对能源效率的影响。在本文中，我们观察到提高训练表现的常见做法往往会导致能源使用效率低下。更重要的是，我们证明了能源消耗和性能优化之间存在权衡。为此，我们提出了 Zeus，这是一个优化框架，通过自动为重复的 DNN 训练作业找到最佳的作业和 GPU 级配置来实现这种权衡。 Zeus 将在线探索开发方法与即时能量分析相结合，避免了昂贵的离线测量的需要，同时适应数据随时间的变化。我们的评估表明，对于不同的工作负载，Zeus 可以将 DNN 训练的能源效率提高 15.3%–75.8%。

papers.title: μMote: Enabling Passive Chirp De-spreading and μW-level Long-Range Downlink for Backscatter Devices.
papers.abstract: The downlink range of backscatter devices is commonly considered to be very limited, compared to tremendous long-range and low-power backscatter uplink designs that leverage the chirp spread spectrum (CSS) principle. Recently, some efforts are devoted to enhancing the downlink, but they are unable to achieve long-range receiving and low power consumption simultaneously. In this paper, we propose µMote, a µW-level long-range receiver for backscatter devices. µMote achieves the first passive chirp de-spreading scheme for negative SINR in long-range receiving scenarios. Further, without consuming external energy, µMote magnifies the demodulated signal by accumulating temporal energy of the signal itself in a resonator container, and meanwhile it preserves signal information during this signal accumulation. µMote then leverages a µW-level sampling-less decoding scheme to discriminate symbols, avoiding the high-power ADC-sampling. We prototype µMote with COTS components, and conduct extensive experiments. The result shows that µMote spends an overall power consumption of 62.07µW to achieve a 400m receiving range at a 2kbps data rate with 1% BER, under −2dB SINR
papers.abstract_zh: 与利用线性调频扩频 (CSS) 原理的远距离、低功耗反向散射上行链路设计相比，反向散射设备的下行链路范围通常被认为非常有限。最近，一些努力致力于增强下行链路，但无法同时实现远距离接收和低功耗。在本文中，我们提出了 µMote，一种用于反向散射设备的 µW 级远程接收器。 µMote 实现了第一个在远距离接收场景中针对负 SINR 的无源线性调频解扩方案。此外，在不消耗外部能量的情况下，μMote通过在谐振器容器中积累信号本身的时间能量来放大解调信号，同时在信号积累过程中保留信号信息。 µMote 然后利用 µW 级无采样解码方案来区分符号，避免高功率 ADC 采样。我们使用 COTS 组件制作 µMote 原型，并进行大量实验。结果表明，μMote 的总功耗为 62.07μW，在 2kbps 数据速率和 1% BER、−2dB SINR 下实现了 400m 的接收范围

papers.title: A Case for Task Sampling based Learning for Cluster Job Scheduling.
papers.abstract: The ability to accurately estimate job runtime properties allows a scheduler to effectively schedule jobs. State-of-the-art online cluster job schedulers use history-based learning, which uses past job execution information to estimate the runtime properties of newly arrived jobs. However, with fast-paced development in cluster technology (in both hardware and software) and changing user inputs, job runtime properties can change over time, which lead to inaccurate predictions. In this paper, we explore the potential and limitation of real-time learning of job runtime properties, by proactively sampling and scheduling a small fraction of the tasks of each job. Such a task-sampling-based approach exploits the similarity among runtime properties of the tasks of the same job and is inherently immune to changing job behavior. Our analytical and experimental analysis of 3 production traces with different skew and job distribution shows that learning in space can be substantially more accurate. Our simulation and testbed evaluation on Azure of the two learning approaches anchored in a generic job scheduler using 3 production cluster job traces shows that despite its online overhead, learning in space reduces the average Job Completion Time (JCT) by 1.28x, 1.56x, and 1.32x compared to the prior-art history-based predictor. Finally, we show how sampling-based learning can be extended to schedule DAG jobs and achieve similar speedups over the prior-art history-based predictor.
papers.abstract_zh: 准确估计作业运行时属性的能力使调度程序能够有效地调度作业。最先进的在线集群作业调度程序使用基于历史的学习，它使用过去的作业执行信息来估计新到达作业的运行时属性。然而，随着集群技术（硬件和软件）的快速发展和用户输入的变化，作业运行时属性可能会随着时间的推移而变化，从而导致预测不准确。在本文中，我们通过主动采样和调度每个作业的一小部分任务，探索实时学习作业运行时属性的潜力和局限性。这种基于任务采样的方法利用了同一作业的任务的运行时属性之间的相似性，并且本质上不受作业行为变化的影响。我们对具有不同偏差和工作分配的 3 个生产轨迹进行分析和实验分析表明，空间学习可以更加准确。我们在 Azure 上使用 3 个生产集群作业跟踪对固定在通用作业调度程序中的两种学习方法进行模拟和测试台评估，结果表明，尽管有在线开销，但与现有技术的基于历史的预测器相比，空间学习将平均作业完成时间 (JCT) 减少了 1.28 倍、1.56 倍和 1.32 倍。最后，我们展示了如何扩展基于采样的学习来调度 DAG 作业，并实现比现有技术基于历史的预测器类似的加速。

papers.title: Accelerating Collective Communication in Data Parallel Training across Deep Learning Frameworks.
papers.abstract: This work develops new techniques within Horovod, a generic communication library supporting data parallel training across deep learning frameworks. In particular, we improve the Horovod control plane by implementing a new coordination scheme that takes advantage of the characteristics of the typical data parallel training paradigm, namely the repeated execution of collectives on the gradients of a fixed set of tensors. Using a caching strategy, we execute Horovod’s existing coordinator-worker logic only once during a typical training run, replacing it with a more efficient decentralized orchestration strategy using the cached data and a global intersection of a bitvector for the remaining training duration. Next, we introduce a feature for end users to explicitly group collective operations, enabling finer grained control over the communication buffer sizes. To evaluate our proposed strategies, we conduct experiments on a world-class supercomputer — Summit. We compare our proposals to Horovod’s original design and observe 2x performance improvement at a scale of 6000 GPUs; we also compare them against tf.distribute and torch.DDP and achieve 12% better and comparable performance, respectively, using up to 1536 GPUs; we compare our solution against BytePS in typical HPC settings and achieve about 20% better performance on a scale of 768 GPUs. Finally, we test our strategies on a scientific application (STEMDL) using up to 27,600 GPUs (the entire Summit) and show that we achieve a near-linear scaling of 0.93 with a sustained performance of 1.54 exaflops (with standard error +- 0.02) in FP16 precision.
papers.abstract_zh: 这项工作在 Horovod 中开发了新技术，Horovod 是一个通用通信库，支持跨深度学习框架的数据并行训练。特别是，我们通过实施一种新的协调方案来改进 Horovod 控制平面，该方案利用典型数据并行训练范例的特征，即在一组固定张量的梯度上重复执行集合。使用缓存策略，我们在典型的训练运行期间仅执行一次 Horovod 现有的协调器-工作逻辑，并在剩余的训练时间内使用缓存数据和位向量的全局交集将其替换为更高效的去中心化编排策略。接下来，我们引入一项功能，供最终用户显式地对集体操作进行分组，从而实现对通信缓冲区大小的更细粒度的控制。为了评估我们提出的策略，我们在世界一流的超级计算机 Summit 上进行了实验。我们将我们的建议与 Horovod 的原始设计进行比较，并观察到在 6000 个 GPU 的规模上性能提高了 2 倍；我们还将它们与 tf.distribute 和 torch.DDP 进行比较，并使用多达 1536 个 GPU 分别实现了 12% 的更好和可比的性能；我们将我们的解决方案与典型 HPC 设置中的 BytePS 进行比较，并在 768 个 GPU 的规模上实现约 20% 的性能提升。最后，我们使用多达 27,600 个 GPU（整个 Summit）在科学应用程序 (STEMDL) 上测试我们的策略，结果表明我们在 FP16 精度下实现了 0.93 的近线性缩放，并具有 1.54 exaflops 的持续性能（标准误差 +- 0.02）。

papers.title: An edge-queued datagram service for all datacenter traffic.
papers.abstract: Modern datacenters support a wide range of protocols and in-network switch enhancements aimed at improving performance. Unfortunately, most new and legacy protocols and enhancements often don’t coexist gracefully because they inevitably interact via queuing in the network. In this paper we describe EQDS, a new datagram service for datacenters that moves almost all of the queuing out of the core network and into the sending host. This enables it to support multiple (conflicting) higher layer protocols, while only sending packets into the network when decided by a receiver-driven credit scheme. EQDS can speed-up legacy TCP and RDMA stacks and enable transport protocol evolution, while benefiting from future switch enhancements without needing to modify higher layer stacks. We show through simulation and multiple implementations that EQDS can reduce FCT of legacy TCP by 2x, improve the NVMeOF throughput by 30%, and safely run TCP alongside RDMA on the same network.
papers.abstract_zh: 现代数据中心支持多种旨在提高性能的协议和网络内交换机增强功能。不幸的是，大多数新的和遗留的协议和增强功能通常不能优雅地共存，因为它们不可避免地通过网络中的排队进行交互。在本文中，我们描述了 EQDS，这是一种用于数据中心的新数据报服务，它将几乎所有队列从核心网络移至发送主机。这使其能够支持多个（冲突的）高层协议，同时仅在接收器驱动的信用方案决定时才将数据包发送到网络中。 EQDS 可以加速传统 TCP 和 RDMA 堆栈并实现传输协议演进，同时受益于未来的交换机增强功能，而无需修改更高层堆栈。我们通过仿真和多次实现表明，EQDS 可以将传统 TCP 的 FCT 降低 2 倍，将 NVMeOF 吞吐量提高 30%，并在同一网络上与 RDMA 一起安全地运行 TCP。

papers.title: Aquila: A unified, low-latency fabric for datacenter networks.
papers.abstract: Datacenter workloads have evolved from the data intensive, loosely-coupled workloads of the past decade to more tightly coupled ones, wherein ultra-low latency communication is essential for resource disaggregation over the network and to enable emerging programming models. We introduce Aquila , an experimental datacenter network fabric built with ultra-low latency support as a first-class design goal, while also supporting traditional datacenter traffic. Aquila uses a new Layer 2 cell-based protocol, GNet, an integrated switch, and a custom ASIC with low-latency Remote Memory Access (RMA) capabilities co-designed with GNet. We demonstrate that Aquila is able to achieve under 40 microseconds tail fabric Round Trip Time (RTT) for IP traffic and sub-10 microseconds RMA execution time across hundreds of host machines, even in the presence of background throughput-oriented IP traffic. This translates to more than 5x reduction in tail latency for a production quality key-value store running on a prototype Aquila network.
papers.abstract_zh: 数据中心工作负载已经从过去十年的数据密集型、松散耦合工作负载演变为更紧密耦合的工作负载，其中超低延迟通信对于网络上的资源分解和启用新兴编程模型至关重要。我们推出 Aquila，这是一种实验性的数据中心网络结构，以超低延迟支持作为一流的设计目标，同时还支持传统的数据中心流量。 Aquila 使用新的基于第 2 层单元的协议 GNet、集成交换机以及与 GNet 共同设计的具有低延迟远程内存访问 (RMA) 功能的定制 ASIC。我们证明，即使存在以吞吐量为导向的后台 IP 流量，Aquila 也能够在数百台主机上实现低于 40 微秒的尾部结构往返时间 (RTT) 和低于 10 微秒的 RMA 执行时间。这意味着在原型 Aquila 网络上运行的生产质量键值存储的尾部延迟减少了 5 倍以上。

papers.title: Automated Verification of Network Function Binaries.
papers.abstract: Formally verifying the correctness of software network functions (NFs) is necessary for network reliability, yet existing techniques require full source code and mandate the use of specific data structures. We describe an automated technique to verify NF binaries, making verification usable by network operators even on proprietary code. To solve the key challenge of bridging the abstraction levels of NF implementations and specifications without special-casing a set of data structures, we observe that data structures used by NFs can be modeled as maps, and introduce a universal type to specify both NFs and their data structures, the "ghost map". In addition, we observe that the interactions between an NF and its environment are sufficient to infer control flow and types, removing the requirement for source code. We implement our technique in Klint, a tool with which we verify, in minutes, that 7 NF binaries satisfy their specifications, without limiting developers' choices of data structures. The specifications are written in Python and use maps to model state. Klint can also verify an entire NF binary stack, all the way down to the NIC driver, using a minimal operating system. Operators can thus verify NF binaries, without source code or debug symbols, without requiring developers to use specific programming languages or data structures, and without trusting any software except Klint.
papers.abstract_zh: 正式验证软件网络功能（NF）的正确性对于网络可靠性是必要的，但现有技术需要完整的源代码并强制使用特定的数据结构。我们描述了一种验证 NF 二进制文件的自动化技术，使网络运营商甚至可以在专有代码上使用验证。为了解决桥接 NF 实现和规范的抽象级别而不对一组数据结构进行特殊处理的关键挑战，我们观察到 NF 使用的数据结构可以建模为映射，并引入一种通用类型来指定 NF 及其数据结构，即“幽灵映射”。此外，我们观察到 NF 与其环境之间的交互足以推断控制流和类型，从而消除了对源代码的需求。我们在 Klint 中实现了我们的技术，使用该工具我们可以在几分钟内验证 7 个 NF 二进制文件是否满足其规范，而不会限制开发人员对数据结构的选择。这些规范是用 Python 编写的，并使用映射来建模状态。 Klint 还可以使用最小的操作系统验证整个 NF 二进制堆栈，一直到 NIC 驱动程序。因此，操作员可以验证 NF 二进制文件，无需源代码或调试符号，无需开发人员使用特定的编程语言或数据结构，并且无需信任除 Klint 之外的任何软件。

papers.title: Backdraft: a Lossless Virtual Switch that Prevents the Slow Receiver Problem.
papers.abstract: Virtual switches, used for end-host networking, drop packets when the receiving application is not fast enough to consume them. This is called the slow receiver problem, and it is important because packet loss hurts tail communication latency and wastes CPU cycles, resulting in application-level performance degradation. Further, solving this problem is challenging because application throughput is highly variable over short timescales as it depends on workload, memory contention, and OS thread scheduling. This paper presents Backdraft, a new lossless virtual switch that addresses the slow receiver problem by combining three new components: (1) Dynamic Per-Flow Queuing (DPFQ) to prevent HOL blocking and provide on-demand memory usage; (2) Doorbell queues to reduce CPU overheads; (3) A new overlay network to avoid congestion spreading. We implemented Backdraft on top of BESS and conducted experiments with real applications on a 100 Gbps cluster with both DCTCP and Homa, a state-of-the-art congestion control scheme. We show that an application with Backdraft can achieve up to 20x lower tail latency at the 99 th percentile.
papers.abstract_zh: 用于终端主机网络的虚拟交换机会在接收应用程序速度不够快而无法消耗数据包时丢弃数据包。这称为慢接收器问题，这一点很重要，因为数据包丢失会损害尾部通信延迟并浪费 CPU 周期，从而导致应用程序级性能下降。此外，解决这个问题具有挑战性，因为应用程序吞吐量在短时间内变化很大，因为它取决于工作负载、内存争用和操作系统线程调度。本文介绍了 Backdraft，一种新的无损虚拟交换机，它通过组合三个新组件来解决接收速度慢的问题：(1) 动态每流队列 (DPFQ)，以防止 HOL 阻塞并提供按需内存使用； (2)门铃队列，减少CPU开销； (3)新的覆盖网络以避免拥塞扩散。我们在 BESS 之上实现了 Backdraft，并在使用 DCTCP 和 Homa（一种最先进的拥塞控制方案）的 100 Gbps 集群上进行了实际应用实验。我们证明，具有 Backdraft 的应用程序可以在第 99 个百分位数处实现高达 20 倍的尾延迟降低。

papers.title: Backpressure Flow Control.
papers.abstract: Effective congestion control for data center networks is becoming increasingly challenging with a growing amount of latency-sensitive traffic, much fatter links, and extremely bursty traffic. Widely deployed algorithms, such as DCTCP and DCQCN, are still far from optimal in many plausible scenarios, particularly for tail latency. Many operators compensate by running their networks at low average utilization, dramatically increasing costs. In this paper, we argue that we have reached the practical limits of end-to-end congestion control. Instead, we propose, implement, and evaluate a new congestion control architecture called Backpressure Flow Control (BFC). BFC provides per-hop per-flow flow control, but with bounded state, constant-time switch operations, and careful use of buffers and queues. We demonstrate BFC’s feasibility by implementing it on Tofino2, a state-of-the-art P4-based programmable hardware switch. In simulation, we show that BFC achieves near optimal throughput and tail latency behavior even under challenging conditions such as high network load and incast cross traffic. Compared to deployed end-to-end schemes, BFC achieves 2.3 - 60× lower tail latency for short flows and 1.6 - 5× better average completion time for long flows.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着对延迟敏感的流量不断增加、链路变得越来越宽以及流量极其突发，数据中心网络的有效拥塞控制变得越来越具有挑战性。广泛部署的算法（例如 DCTCP 和 DCQCN）在许多可能的场景中仍然远非最佳，特别是对于尾部延迟。许多运营商通过以较低的平均利用率运行网络来补偿，这大大增加了成本。在本文中，我们认为我们已经达到了端到端拥塞控制的实际极限。相反，我们提出、实施和评估一种称为背压流控制（BFC）的新拥塞控制架构。 BFC 提供每跳每流的流量控制，但具有有界状态、恒定时间切换操作以及对缓冲区和队列的谨慎使用。我们通过在 Tofino2（一种最先进的基于 P4 的可编程硬件交换机）上实施 BFC 来证明其可行性。在仿真中，我们表明，即使在高网络负载和组播交叉流量等具有挑战性的条件下，BFC 也能实现接近最佳的吞吐量和尾部延迟行为。与已部署的端到端方案相比，BFC 的短流尾部延迟降低了 2.3 - 60 倍，长流的平均完成时间提高了 1.6 - 5 倍。

papers.title: Bluebird: High-performance SDN for Bare-metal Cloud Services.
papers.abstract: The bare-metal cloud service is a type of IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service) that offers dedicated server hardware to customers along with access to other shared infrastructure in the cloud, including network and storage. This paper presents our experiences in designing, implementing, and deploying Bluebird, the high-performance network virtualization system for the bare-metal cloud service on Azure. Bluebird's data plane is built using high-performance programmable switch ASICs. This design allows us to ensure the high performance, scale, and custom forwarding capabilities necessary for network virtualization on Azure. Bluebird employs a few well-established technical principles in the control plane that ensure scalability and high availability, including route caching, device abstraction, and architectural decoupling of switch-local agents from a remote controller. The Bluebird system has been running on Azure for more than two years. During this time, it has served thousands of bare-metal tenant nodes and delivered full line-rate NIC speed of bare-metal servers of up to 100Gb/s while ensuring less than 1µs of maximum latency at each Bluebird-enabled SDN switch. We share our experiences of running bare-metal services on Azure, along with the P4 data plane program used in the Bluebird-enabled switches.
papers.abstract_zh: 裸机云服务是一种 IaaS（基础设施即服务），为客户提供专用服务器硬件以及对云中其他共享基础设施（包括网络和存储）的访问。本文介绍了我们在设计、实施和部署 Bluebird（用于 Azure 上裸机云服务的高性能网络虚拟化系统）方面的经验。 Bluebird 的数据平面采用高性能可编程交换机 ASIC 构建。这种设计使我们能够确保 Azure 上网络虚拟化所需的高性能、规模和自定义转发功能。 Bluebird 在控制平面中采用了一些成熟的技术原理，以确保可扩展性和高可用性，包括路由缓存、设备抽象以及交换机本地代理与远程控制器的架构解耦。 Bluebird系统已经在Azure上运行了两年多。在此期间，它已为数千个裸机租户节点提供服务，并提供高达 100Gb/s 的裸机服务器全线速 NIC 速度，同时确保每个支持 Bluebird 的 SDN 交换机的最大延迟低于 1μs。我们分享在 Azure 上运行裸机服务的经验，以及支持 Bluebird 的交换机中使用的 P4 数据平面程序。

papers.title: Buffer-based End-to-end Request Event Monitoring in the Cloud.
papers.abstract: Request latency is a crucial concern for modern cloud providers. Due to various causes in hosts and networks, requests can suffer from request latency anomalies (RLAs), which may violate the Service-Level Agreement for tenants. However, existing performance monitoring tools have incomplete coverage and inconsistent semantics for monitoring requests, resulting in the difficulty to accurately diagnose RLAs. This paper presents BufScope, a high-coverage request event monitoring system, which aims to capture most RLA-related events with consistent request-level semantics in the end-to-end datapath of request. BufScope models the datapath of request as a buffer chain and defines RLA-related events based on different properties of buffers, so as to end-to-end monitor the root causes of RLA. To achieve consistent semantics for captured events, BufScope designs a concise request-level semantic injection mechanism to make events captured in networks have the victim requests' ID, and offloads the realization to SmartNICs for low overhead . We have implemented BufScope on commodity SmartNICs and programmable switches. Evaluation results show that BufScope can diagnose 95% RLAs with <0.07% network bandwidth overhead and <1% application throughput decline.
papers.abstract_zh: 请求延迟是现代云提供商面临的一个重要问题。由于主机和网络的各种原因，请求可能会出现请求延迟异常（RLA），这可能违反租户的服务级别协议。然而，现有的性能监控工具对监控请求的覆盖不完全、语义不一致，导致难以准确诊断RLA。本文提出了BufScope，一个高覆盖率的请求事件监控系统，旨在捕获请求的端到端数据路径中具有一致的请求级语义的大多数RLA相关事件。 BufScope将请求的数据路径建模为缓冲链，并根据缓冲区的不同属性定义RLA相关事件，从而端到端监控RLA的根本原因。为了使捕获的事件实现一致的语义，BufScope设计了一种简洁的请求级语义注入机制，使网络中捕获的事件具有受害者请求的ID，并将实现卸载到SmartNIC以降低开销。我们已在商用 SmartNIC 和可编程交换机上实施了 BufScope。评估结果表明，BufScope 可以诊断 95% 的 RLA，网络带宽开销 <0.07%，应用程序吞吐量下降 <1%。

papers.title: C2DN: How to Harness Erasure Codes at the Edge for Efficient Content Delivery.
papers.abstract: Content Delivery Networks (CDNs) deliver much of the world’s web and video content to users from thousands of clusters deployed at the “edges” of the Internet. Maintaining consistent performance in this large distributed system is challenging. Through analysis of month-long logs from over 2000 clusters of a large CDN, we study the patterns of server unavailability. For a CDN with no redundancy, each server unavailability causes a sudden loss in performance as the objects previously cached on that server are not accessible, which leads to a miss ratio spike. The state-of-the-art mitigation technique used by large CDNs is to replicate objects across multiple servers within a cluster. We find that although replication reduces miss ratio spikes, spikes remain a performance challenge. We present C2DN, the first CDN design that achieves a lower miss ratio, higher availability, higher resource efficiency, and close-to-perfect write load balancing. The core of our design is to introduce erasure coding into the CDN architecture and use the parity chunks to re-balance the write load across servers. We implement C2DN on top of open-source production software and demonstrate that compared to replication-based CDNs, C2DN obtains 11% lower byte miss ratio, eliminates unavailability-induced miss ratio spikes, and reduces write load imbalance by 99%.
papers.abstract_zh: 内容交付网络 (CDN) 通过部署在互联网“边缘”的数千个集群向用户交付全球大部分网络和视频内容。在这个大型分布式系统中保持一致的性能具有挑战性。通过分析大型 CDN 的 2000 多个集群长达一个月的日志，我们研究了服务器不可用的模式。对于没有冗余的 CDN，每台服务器不可用都会导致性能突然下降，因为之前缓存在该服务器上的对象无法访问，从而导致未命中率峰值。大型 CDN 使用的最先进的缓解技术是在集群内的多个服务器之间复制对象。我们发现，尽管复制减少了未命中率峰值，但峰值仍然是性能挑战。我们推出了 C2DN，这是第一个实现更低的丢失率、更高的可用性、更高的资源效率和近乎完美的写入负载平衡的 CDN 设计。我们设计的核心是将纠删码引入CDN架构中，并使用奇偶校验块来重新平衡服务器之间的写入负载。我们在开源生产软件之上实现了 C2DN，并证明与基于复制的 CDN 相比，C2DN 的字节丢失率降低了 11%，消除了不可用性引起的丢失率峰值，并将写入负载不平衡减少了 99%。

papers.title: Cetus: Releasing P4 Programmers from the Chore of Trial and Error Compiling.
papers.abstract: Programmable switches are widely deployed in Alibaba's edge networks. To enable the processing of packets at line rate, our programmers use P4 language to offload network functions onto these switches. As we were developing increasingly more complex offloaded network functions, we realized that our development needs to follow a certain set of constraints in order to fit the P4 programs into available hardware resources. Not adhering to these constraints results in fitting issues, making the program uncompilable. Therefore, we decide to build a system (called Cetus) that automatically converts an uncompilable P4 program into a functionally identical but compilable P4 program. In this paper, we share our experience in the building and using of Cetus at Alibaba. Our design insights for this system come from our investigation of the past fitting issues of our production P4 programs. We found that the long dependency chains between actions in our production P4 programs are creating difficulties for the programs to comply with the hardware resources of programmable switching ASICs, resulting in the majority of our fitting issues. Guided by this finding, we designed the core approach of Cetus to efficiently synthesize a compilable program by shortening the lengthy dependency chains. We have been using Cetus in our production P4 program development for one year, and it has effectively decreased our P4 development workload by two orders of magnitude (from O (day) to O (min)). In this paper we share several real cases addressed by Cetus, along with its performance evaluation.
papers.abstract_zh: 可编程交换机广泛部署在阿里巴巴的边缘网络中。为了能够以线速处理数据包，我们的程序员使用 P4 语言将网络功能卸载到这些交换机上。当我们开发越来越复杂的卸载网络功能时，我们意识到我们的开发需要遵循一组特定的约束，以便将 P4 程序适应可用的硬件资源。不遵守这些约束会导致拟合问题，从而使程序无法编译。因此，我们决定构建一个系统（称为Cetus），自动将不可编译的P4程序转换为功能相同但可编译的P4程序。在本文中，我们分享了阿里巴巴Cetus的构建和使用经验。我们对该系统的设计见解来自于我们对生产 P4 程序过去的安装问题的调查。我们发现，我们的生产 P4 程序中的操作之间的长依赖链给程序遵守可编程交换 ASIC 的硬件资源带来了困难，从而导致了我们的大多数适配问题。在这一发现的指导下，我们设计了 Cetus 的核心方法，通过缩短冗长的依赖链来有效地合成可编译的程序。我们在生产 P4 程序开发中使用 Cetus 已经一年了，它有效地将我们的 P4 开发工作量减少了两个数量级（从 O（天）到 O（分钟））。在本文中，我们分享了 Cetus 解决的几个真实案例及其性能评估。

papers.title: Characterizing Physical-Layer Transmission Errors in Cable Broadband Networks.
papers.abstract: Packet loss rate in a broadband network is an important quality of service metric. Previous work that characterizes broadband performance does not separate packet loss caused by physical layer transmission errors from that caused by congestion. In this work, we investigate the physical layer transmission errors using data provided by a regional cable ISP. The data were collected from 77K+ devices that spread across 394 hybrid-fiber-coaxial (HFC) network segments during a 16-month period. We present a number of findings that are relevant to network operations and network research. We estimate that physical-layer errors can contribute to 12% to 25% of packet loss in the cable ISPs measured by the FCC’s Measuring Broadband America project. The average error loss rates of different HFC network segments vary by more than six orders of magnitude, from O (10−6%) to O (1%). Users in persistently high-error-rate networks do not report more trouble tickets than other users.
papers.abstract_zh: 宽带网络中的丢包率是一个重要的服务质量指标。先前描述宽带性能的工作并未将物理层传输错误引起的数据包丢失与拥塞引起的数据包丢失区分开来。在这项工作中，我们使用区域有线 ISP 提供的数据来调查物理层传输错误。这些数据是在 16 个月内从遍布 394 个混合光纤同轴 (HFC) 网段的 77,000 多个设备收集的。我们提出了许多与网络运营和网络研究相关的发现。根据 FCC 的测量宽带美国项目的测量，我们估计物理层错误可能导致有线 ISP 中 12% 到 25% 的数据包丢失。不同HFC网段的平均错误丢失率相差六个数量级以上，从O(10−6%)到O(1%)。错误率持续较高的网络中的用户报告的故障单并不比其他用户多。

papers.title: Check-N-Run: a Checkpointing System for Training Deep Learning Recommendation Models.
papers.abstract: Checkpoints play an important role in training long running machine learning (ML) models. Checkpoints take a snapshot of an ML model and store it in a non-volatile memory so that they can be used to recover from failures to ensure rapid training progress. In addition, they are used for online training to improve inference prediction accuracy with continuous learning. Given the large and ever-increasing model sizes, checkpoint frequency is often bottlenecked by the storage write bandwidth and capacity. When checkpoints are maintained on remote storage, as is the case with many industrial settings, they are also bottlenecked by network bandwidth. We present Check-N-Run, a scalable checkpointing system for training large ML models at Facebook. While Check-N-Run is applicable to long running ML jobs, we focus on checkpointing recommendation models which are currently the largest ML models with Terabytes of model size. Check-N-Run uses two primary techniques to address the size and bandwidth challenges. First, it applies differential checkpointing, which tracks and checkpoints the modified part of the model. Differential checkpointing is particularly valuable in the context of recommendation models where only a fraction of the model (stored as embedding tables) is updated on each iteration. Second, Check-N-Run leverages quantization techniques to significantly reduce the checkpoint size, without degrading training accuracy. These techniques allow Check-N-Run to reduce the required write bandwidth by 6-17x and the required capacity by 2.5-8xon real-world models at Facebook, and thereby significantly improve checkpoint capabilities while reducing the total cost of ownership.
papers.abstract_zh: 检查点在训练长期运行的机器学习 (ML) 模型中发挥着重要作用。检查点拍摄 ML 模型的快照并将其存储在非易失性存储器中，以便它们可用于从故障中恢复，以确保快速的训练进度。此外，它们还用于在线训练，通过持续学习来提高推理预测的准确性。鉴于模型规模庞大且不断增加，检查点频率通常受到存储写入带宽和容量的瓶颈。当检查点维护在远程存储上时（就像许多工业设置的情况一样），它们也会受到网络带宽的瓶颈。我们推出了 Check-N-Run，这是一个可扩展的检查点系统，用于在 Facebook 训练大型 ML 模型。虽然 Check-N-Run 适用于长时间运行的 ML 作业，但我们专注于检查点推荐模型，这是目前最大的 ML 模型，模型大小为 TB。 Check-N-Run 使用两种主要技术来解决大小和带宽挑战。首先，它应用差异检查点，跟踪和检查模型的修改部分。差异检查点在推荐模型的上下文中特别有价值，其中每次迭代仅更新模型的一小部分（存储为嵌入表）。其次，Check-N-Run 利用量化技术显着减小检查点大小，而不会降低训练准确性。这些技术使 Check-N-Run 能够将 Facebook 真实模型所需的写入带宽降低 6-17 倍，将所需容量降低 2.5-8 倍，从而显着提高检查点功能，同时降低总体拥有成本。

papers.title: cISP: A Speed-of-Light Internet Service Provider.
papers.abstract: Low latency is a requirement for a variety of interactive network applications. The Internet, however, is not optimized for latency. We thus explore the design of wide-area networks that move data at nearly the speed of light in vacuum. Our cISP design augments the Internet’s fiber with free-space microwave wireless connectivity over paths very close to great-circle paths. cISP addresses the fundamental challenge of simultaneously providing ultra-low latency while accounting for numerous practical factors ranging from transmission tower availability to packet queuing. We show that instantiations of cISP across the United States and Europe would achieve mean latencies within 5% of that achievable using great-circle paths at the speed of light, over medium and long distances. Further, using experiments conducted on a nearly-speed-of-light algorithmic trading network, together with an analysis of trading data at its end points, we show that microwave networks are reliably faster than fiber networks even in inclement weather. Finally, we estimate that the economic value of such networks would substantially exceed their expense.
papers.abstract_zh: 低延迟是各种交互式网络应用的要求。然而，互联网并未针对延迟进行优化。因此，我们探索了在真空中以接近光速移动数据的广域网的设计。我们的 cISP 设计通过非常接近大圆路径的路径上的自由空间微波无线连接增强了互联网光纤。 cISP 解决了同时提供超低延迟的基本挑战，同时考虑了从传输塔可用性到数据包排队等众多实际因素。我们表明，美国和欧洲的 cISP 实例将在中长距离上以光速使用大圆路径实现的平均延迟控制在 5% 以内。此外，通过在接近光速的算法交易网络上进行的实验，以及对其端点交易数据的分析，我们表明，即使在恶劣天气下，微波网络也确实比光纤网络更快。最后，我们估计此类网络的经济价值将大大超过其费用。

papers.title: Closed-loop Network Performance Monitoring and Diagnosis with SpiderMon.
papers.abstract: Performance monitoring and diagnosis are essential for data centers. The emergence of programmable switches has led to the development of a slew of monitoring systems, but most of them do not explicitly target posterior diagnosis. On one hand, “query-driven” monitoring systems must be pre-configured with a static query, but it is difficult to achieve high coverage because the right query for posterior diagnosis may not be known in advance. On the other hand, “blanket” monitoring systems have high coverage as they always collect telemetry data from all switches, but they collect excessive data. SpiderMon is a system that co-designs monitoring and posterior diagnosis in a closed loop to achieve low overhead and high coverage simultaneously, by leveraging “wait-for” relations to guide its operations. We evaluate SpiderMon in both Tofino hardware and BMv2 software switches and show that SpiderMon diagnoses performance problems accurately and quickly with low overhead.
papers.abstract_zh: 性能监控和诊断对于数据中心至关重要。可编程开关的出现导致了一系列监测系统的发展，但其中大多数并没有明确针对事后诊断。一方面，“查询驱动”的监控系统必须预先配置静态查询，但很难实现高覆盖率，因为事后诊断的正确查询可能无法提前知道。另一方面，“全面”监控系统覆盖率高，因为它们总是从所有交换机收集遥测数据，但它们收集的数据过多。 SpiderMon是一个在闭环中共同设计监控和事后诊断的系统，通过利用“等待”关系来指导其操作，同时实现低开销和高覆盖率。我们在 Tofino 硬件和 BMv2 软件交换机中评估 SpiderMon，结果表明 SpiderMon 能够以较低的开销准确、快速地诊断性能问题。

papers.title: CloudCluster: Unearthing the Functional Structure of a Cloud Service.
papers.abstract: In their quest to provide customers with good tools to manage cloud services, cloud providers are hampered by having very little visibility into cloud service functionality; a provider often only knows where VMs of a service are placed, how the virtual networks are configured, how VMs are provisioned, and how VMs communicate with each other. In this paper, we show that, using the VM-to-VM traffic matrix, we can unearth the functional structure of a cloud service and use it to aid cloud service management. Leveraging the observation that cloud services use well-known design patterns for scaling ( e.g. , replication, communication locality), we show that clustering the VM-to-VM traffic matrix yields the functional structure of the cloud service. Our clustering algorithm, CloudCluster, must overcome challenges imposed by scale (cloud services contain tens of thousands of VMs) and must be robust to orders-of-magnitude variability in traffic volume and measurement noise. To do this, CloudCluster uses a novel combination of feature scaling, dimensionality reduction, and hierarchical clustering to achieve clustering with over 92% homogeneity and completeness. We show that CloudCluster can be used to explore opportunities to reduce cost for customers, identify anomalous traffic and potential misconfigurations.
papers.abstract_zh: 在寻求为客户提供管理云服务的良好工具的过程中，云提供商因对云服务功能的了解很少而受到阻碍；提供商通常只知道服务的虚拟机放置在哪里、如何配置虚拟网络、如何供应虚拟机以及虚拟机之间如何通信。在本文中，我们表明，使用虚拟机到虚拟机的流量矩阵，我们可以挖掘云服务的功能结构，并用它来帮助云服务管理。利用云服务使用众所周知的扩展设计模式（例如复制、通信局部性）的观察，我们表明对虚拟机到虚拟机流量矩阵进行集群可以产生云服务的功能结构。我们的集群算法 CloudCluster 必须克服规模带来的挑战（云服务包含数万个虚拟机），并且必须对流量和测量噪声的数量级变化具有鲁棒性。为此，CloudCluster 使用特征缩放、降维和分​​层聚类的新颖组合来实现同质性和完整性超过 92% 的聚类。我们展示了 CloudCluster 可用于探索降低客户成本、识别异常流量和潜在错误配置的机会。

papers.title: Cocktail: A Multidimensional Optimization for Model Serving in Cloud.
papers.abstract: With a growing demand for adopting ML models for a variety of application services, it is vital that the frameworks serving these models are capable of delivering highly accurate predictions with minimal latency along with reduced deployment costs in a public cloud environment. Despite high latency, prior works in this domain are crucially limited by the accuracy offered by individual models. Intuitively, model ensembling can address the accuracy gap by intelligently combining different models in parallel. However, selecting the appropriate models dynamically at runtime to meet the desired accuracy with low latency at minimal deployment cost is a nontrivial problem. Towards this, we propose Cocktail, a cost effective ensembling-based model serving framework. Cocktail comprises of two key components: (i) a dynamic model selection framework, which reduces the number of models in the ensemble, while satisfying the accuracy and latency requirements; (ii) an adaptive resource management (RM) framework that employs a distributed proactive autoscaling policy combined with importance sampling, to efficiently allocate resources for the models. The RM framework leverages transient virtual machine (VM) instances to reduce the deployment cost in a public cloud. A prototype implementation of Cocktail on the AWS EC2 platform and exhaustive evaluations using a variety of workloads demonstrate that {Cocktail} can reduce deployment cost by 1.45x, while providing 2x reduction in latency and satisfying the target accuracy for up to 96% of the requests, when compared to state-of-the-art model-serving frameworks.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着各种应用程序服务采用机器学习模型的需求不断增长，服务这些模型的框架必须能够以最小的延迟提供高度准确的预测，并降低公共云环境中的部署成本，这一点至关重要。尽管延迟很高，但该领域的先前工作受到各个模型提供的准确性的严重限制。直观地说，模型集成可以通过智能地并行组合不同模型来解决准确性差距。然而，在运行时动态选择适当的模型以满足所需的精度、低延迟和最小的部署成本是一个不小的问题。为此，我们提出了 Cocktail，一种具有成本效益的基于集成的模型服务框架。 Cocktail 由两个关键组件组成：(i) 动态模型选择框架，减少集成中模型的数量，同时满足精度和延迟要求； (ii) 自适应资源管理 (RM) 框架，采用分布式主动自动缩放策略与重要性采样相结合，为模型有效分配资源。 RM 框架利用瞬态虚拟机 (VM) 实例来降低公共云中的部署成本。 AWS EC2 平台上 Cocktail 的原型实现以及使用各种工作负载的详尽评估表明，与最先进的模型服务框架相比，{Cocktail} 可以将部署成本降低 1.45 倍，同时将延迟降低 2 倍，并满足高达 96% 的请求的目标准确性。

papers.title: Collie: Finding Performance Anomalies in RDMA Subsystems.
papers.abstract: High-speed RDMA networks are getting rapidly adopted in the industry for their low latency and reduced CPU overheads. To verify that RDMA can be used in production, system administrators need to understand the set of application workloads that can potentially trigger abnormal performance behaviors (e.g., unexpected low throughput, PFC pause frame storm). We design and implement Collie, a tool for users to systematically uncover performance anomalies in RDMA subsystems without the need to access hardware internal designs. Instead of individually testing each hardware device (e.g., NIC, memory, PCIe), Collie is holistic, constructing a comprehensive search space for application workloads. Collie then uses simulated annealing to drive RDMA-related performance and diagnostic counters to extreme value regions to find workloads that can trigger performance anomalies. We evaluate Collie on combinations of various RDMA NIC, CPU, and other hardware components. Collie found 15 new performance anomalies. All of them are acknowledged by the hardware vendors. 7 of them are already fixed after we reported them. We also present our experience in using Collie to avoid performance anomalies for an RDMA RPC library and an RDMA distributed machine learning framework.
papers.abstract_zh: 高速 RDMA 网络因其低延迟和降低的 CPU 开销而在业界迅速采用。为了验证 RDMA 是否可以在生产中使用，系统管理员需要了解可能触发异常性能行为（例如意外的低吞吐量、PFC 暂停帧风暴）的一组应用程序工作负载。我们设计并实现了 Collie，这是一种工具，用户可以系统地发现 RDMA 子系统中的性能异常，而无需访问硬件内部设计。 Collie 不是单独测试每个硬件设备（例如 NIC、内存、PCIe），而是整体性的，为应用程序工作负载构建全面的搜索空间。然后，Collie 使用模拟退火将 RDMA 相关性能和诊断计数器驱动到极值区域，以查找可能触发性能异常的工作负载。我们根据各种 RDMA NIC、CPU 和其他硬件组件的组合来评估 Collie。柯利牧羊犬发现了 15 种新的表现异常现象。所有这些都得到了硬件供应商的认可。在我们报告后，其中 7 个已修复。我们还介绍了使用 Collie 避免 RDMA RPC 库和 RDMA 分布式机器学习框架性能异常的经验。

papers.title: Configanator: A Data-driven Approach to Improving CDN Performance.
papers.abstract: The web serving protocol stack is constantly evolving to tackle the technological shifts in networking infrastructure and website complexity. As a result of this evolution, web servers can use a plethora of protocols and configuration parameters to address a variety of realistic network conditions. Yet, today, despite the significant diversity in end-user networks and devices, most content providers have adopted a “one-size-fits-all” approach to configuring the networking stack of their user-facing web servers (or at best employ moderate tuning). In this paper, we demonstrate that the status quo results in sub-optimal performance and argue for a novel framework that extends existing CDN architectures to provide programmatic control over a web server’s configuration parameters. We designed a data-driven framework, Configanator, that leverages data across connections to identify their network and device characteristics, and learn the optimal configuration parameters to improve end-user performance. We evaluate Configanator on five traces, including one from a global content provider, and evaluate the performance improvements for real users through two live deployments. Our results show that Configanator improves tail (p95) web performance by 32-67% across diverse websites and networks.
papers.abstract_zh: Web 服务协议栈不断发展，以应对网络基础设施和网站复杂性的技术转变。由于这种演变，Web 服务器可以使用大量协议和配置参数来解决各种实际的网络条件。然而，如今，尽管最终用户网络和设备存在显着差异，但大多数内容提供商都采用了“一刀切”的方法来配置其面向用户的 Web 服务器的网络堆栈（或者最多采用适度的调整）。在本文中，我们证明了现状导致性能不佳，并提出了一种新颖的框架来扩展现有的 CDN 架构，以提供对 Web 服务器配置参数的编程控制。我们设计了一个数据驱动框架 Configanator，它利用跨连接的数据来识别其网络和设备特征，并学习最佳配置参数以提高最终用户性能。我们根据五项跟踪评估 Configanator，其中一项来自全球内容提供商，并通过两次实时部署评估真实用户的性能改进。我们的结果表明，Configanator 将不同网站和网络的尾部 (p95) Web 性能提高了 32-67%。

papers.title: CurvingLoRa to Boost LoRa Network Throughput via Concurrent Transmission.
papers.abstract: LoRaWAN has emerged as an appealing technology to connect IoT devices but it functions without explicit coordination among transmitters, which can lead to many packet collisions as the network scales. State-of-the-art work proposes various approaches to deal with these collisions, but most functions only in high signal-to-interference ratio (SIR) conditions and thus does not scale to real scenarios where weak receptions are easily buried by stronger receptions from nearby transmitters. In this paper, we take a fresh look at LoRa’s physical layer, revealing that its underlying linear chirp modulation fundamentally limits the capacity and scalability of concurrentLoRa transmissions. We show that by replacing linear chirps with their non-linear counterparts, we can boost the throughput of concurrent LoRa transmissions and empower the LoRa receiver to successfully receive weak transmissions in the presence of strong colliding signals. Such a non-linear chirp design further enables the receiver to demodulate fully aligned collision symbols — a case where none of the existing approaches can deal with. We implement these ideas in a holistic LoRaWAN stack based on the USRP N210 software-defined radio platform. Our head-to-head comparison with two state-of-the-art research systems and a standard LoRaWAN base-line demonstrates that CurvingLoRa improves the network throughput by 1.6–7.6× while simultaneously sacrificing neither power efficiency nor noise resilience
papers.abstract_zh: LoRaWAN 已成为连接物联网设备的一项颇具吸引力的技术，但它的运行无需发射器之间的明确协调，随着网络规模的扩大，这可能会导致许多数据包冲突。最先进的工作提出了各种方法来处理这些冲突，但大多数仅在高信号干扰比（SIR）条件下起作用，因此无法扩展到实际场景中，在这种情况下，弱接收很容易被附近发射器的较强接收所掩盖。在本文中，我们重新审视 LoRa 的物理层，揭示其底层线性调频调制从根本上限制了并发 LoRa 传输的容量和可扩展性。我们表明，通过用非线性对应物替换线性线性调频信号，我们可以提高并发 LoRa 传输的吞吐量，并使 LoRa 接收器能够在存在强冲突信号的情况下成功接收弱传输。这种非线性调频脉冲设计进一步使接收器能够解调完全对齐的冲突符号——现有方法都无法处理这种情况。我们在基于 USRP N210 软件定义无线电平台的整体 LoRaWAN 堆栈中实现了这些想法。我们与两个最先进的研究系统和标准 LoRaWAN 基线的头对头比较表明，CurvingLoRa 将网络吞吐量提高了 1.6–7.6 倍，同时既不牺牲功率效率，也不牺牲噪声恢复能力

papers.title: Data-Parallel Actors: A Programming Model for Scalable Query Serving Systems.
papers.abstract: We present data-parallel actors (DPA) , a programming model for building distributed query serving systems. Query serving systems are an important class of applications characterized by low-latency data-parallel queries and frequent bulk data updates; they include data analytics systems like Apache Druid, full-text search engines like ElasticSearch, and time series databases like InfluxDB. They are challenging to build because they run at scale and need complex distributed functionality like data replication, fault tolerance, and update consistency. DPA makes building these systems easier by allowing developers to construct them from purely single-node components while automatically providing these critical properties. In DPA, we view a query serving system as a collection of stateful actors, each encapsulating a partition of data. DPA provides parallel operators that enable consistent, atomic, and fault-tolerant parallel updates and queries over data stored in actors. We have used DPA to build a new query serving system, a simplified data warehouse based on the single-node database MonetDB, and enhance existing ones, such as Druid, Solr, and MongoDB, adding missing user-requested features such as load balancing and elasticity. We show that DPA can distribute a system in 10× less than typical implementations in current systems) while achieving state-of-the-art performance and adding rich functionality.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了数据并行参与者（DPA），这是一种用于构建分布式查询服务系统的编程模型。查询服务系统是一类重要的应用程序，其特点是低延迟的数据并行查询和频繁的批量数据更新；它们包括 Apache Druid 等数据分析系统、ElasticSearch 等全文搜索引擎以及 InfluxDB 等时间序列数据库。它们的构建具有挑战性，因为它们大规模运行并且需要复杂的分布式功能，例如数据复制、容错和更新一致性。 DPA 允许开发人员从纯粹的单节点组件构建这些系统，同时自动提供这些关键属性，从而使构建这些系统变得更加容易。在 DPA 中，我们将查询服务系统视为有状态参与者的集合，每个参与者封装了一个数据分区。 DPA 提供并行运算符，可以对 Actor 中存储的数据进行一致、原子和容错的并行更新和查询。我们使用DPA构建了一个新的查询服务系统，一个基于单节点数据库MonetDB的简化数据仓库，并增强了现有的系统，例如Druid、Solr和MongoDB，添加了缺少的用户请求的功能，例如负载平衡和弹性。我们证明，DPA 可以用 <1K 行代码（比当前系统中的典型实现少 10 倍以上）来分发系统，同时实现最先进的性能并添加丰富的功能。

papers.title: Decentralized cloud wide-area network traffic engineering with BLASTSHIELD.
papers.abstract: Cloud networks are increasingly managed by centralized software defined controllers. Centralized traffic engineering controllers achieve higher network throughput than decentralized implementations, but are a single point of failure in the network. Large scale networks require controllers with isolated fault domains to contain the blast radius of faults. In this work, we present BLASTSHIELD, Microsoft’s software-defined decentralized WAN traffic engineering system. BLASTSHIELD slices the WAN into smaller fault domains, each managed by its own slice controller. Slice controllers independently engineer traffic in their slices to maximize global network throughput without relying on hierarchical or central coordination. BLASTSHIELD is fully deployed in Microsoft’s WAN and carries a majority of the backbone traffic. BLASTSHIELD achieves similar network throughput as the previous generation centralized controller and reduces traffic loss from controller failures by 60%.
papers.abstract_zh: 云网络越来越多地由集中式软件定义控制器进行管理。集中式流量工程控制器比分散式实施实现了更高的网络吞吐量，但却是网络中的单点故障。大规模网络需要具有隔离故障域的控制器来遏制故障的爆炸半径。在这项工作中，我们展示了 BLASTSHIELD，微软的软件定义的去中心化 WAN 流量工程系统。 BLASTSHIELD 将 WAN 分割成更小的故障域，每个故障域都由自己的切片控制器管理。切片控制器独立地设计其切片中的流量，以最大化全局网络吞吐量，而不依赖于分层或中央协调。 BLASTSHIELD 完全部署在 Microsoft 的 WAN 中并承载大部分骨干流量。 BLASTSHIELD 实现了与上一代集中式控制器相似的网络吞吐量，并将控制器故障造成的流量损失减少了 60%。

papers.title: Detecting Ephemeral Optical Events with OpTel.
papers.abstract: Degradation or failure events in optical backbone networks affect the service level agreements for cloud services. It is critical to detect and troubleshoot these events promptly to minimize their impact. Existing telemetry systems rely on arcane tools (e.g., SNMP) and vendor-specific controllers to collect optical data, which affects both the flexibility and scale of these systems. As a result, they fail to collect the required data on time to detect and troubleshoot degradation or failure events in a timely fashion. This paper presents the design and implementation of OpTel, an optical telemetry system, that uses a centralized vendor-agnostic controller to collect optical data in a streaming fashion. More specifically, it offers flexible vendor-agnostic interfaces between the optical devices and the controller and offloads data-management tasks (e.g., creating a queryable database) from the devices to the controller. As a result, OpTel enables the collection of fine-grained optical telemetry data at the one-second granularity. It has been running in Tencent's optical backbone network for the past six months. The fine-grained data collection enables the detection of short-lived events (i.e., ephemeral events). Compared to existing telemetry systems, OpTel accurately detects 2x more optical events. It also enables troubleshooting of these optical events in a few seconds, which is orders of magnitude faster than the state-of-the-art.
papers.abstract_zh: 光骨干网络中的退化或故障事件会影响云服务的服务级别协议。及时检测并排除这些事件以最大程度地减少其影响至关重要。现有的遥测系统依靠神秘的工具（例如 SNMP）和供应商特定的控制器来收集光学数据，这会影响这些系统的灵活性和规模。因此，他们无法按时收集所需的数据来及时检测退化或故障事件并对其进行故障排除。本文介绍了 OpTel（一种光学遥测系统）的设计和实现，该系统使用与供应商无关的集中式控制器以流式传输方式收集光学数据。更具体地说，它在光学设备和控制器之间提供灵活的与供应商无关的接口，并将数据管理任务（例如，创建可查询的数据库）从设备卸载到控制器。因此，OpTel 能够以一秒的粒度收集细粒度的光学遥测数据。它已在腾讯的光骨干网络中运行了六个月。细粒度的数据收集能够检测短暂事件（即短暂事件）。与现有遥测系统相比，OpTel 检测光学事件的准确度高出 2 倍。它还可以在几秒钟内排除这些光学事件的故障，这比最先进的技术快了几个数量级。

papers.title: Differential Network Analysis.
papers.abstract: Networks are constantly changing. To avoid outages, operators need to know whether prospective changes in a network's control plane will cause undesired changes in end-to-end forwarding behavior. For example, which pairs of end hosts are reachable before a configuration change but unreachable after the change? Control plane verifiers are ill-suited for answering such questions because they operate on a single snapshot to check its "compliance" with "explicitly specified" properties, instead of quantifying the "differences" in "affected" end-to-end forwarding behaviors. We argue for a new control plane analysis paradigm that makes differences first class citizens. Differential Network Analysis (DNA) takes control plane changes, incrementally computes control and data plane state, and outputs consequent differences in end-to-end behavior. We break the computation into three stages---control plane simulation, data plane modeling, and property checking---and leverage differential dataflow programming frameworks, incremental data plane verification, and customized graph algorithms, respectively, to make each stage incremental. Evaluations using both real and synthetic control plane changes demonstrate that DNA can compute the resulting differences in reachability in a few seconds---up to 3 orders of magnitude faster than state-of-the-art control plane verifiers.
papers.abstract_zh: 网络在不断变化。为了避免中断，运营商需要知道网络控制平面的预期变化是否会导致端到端转发行为发生意外的变化。例如，哪些终端主机对在配置更改之前可以访问，但在更改之后就无法访问？控制平面验证器不适合回答此类问题，因为它们对单个快照进行操作以检查其与“明确指定”属性的“合规性”，而不是量化“受影响的”端到端转发行为中的“差异”。我们主张一种新的控制平面分析范式，使差异成为一等公民。差分网络分析 (DNA) 获取控制平面更改，增量计算控制和数据平面状态，并输出端到端行为的后续差异。我们将计算分为控制平面模拟、数据平面建模和属性检查三个阶段，并分别利用差分数据流编程框架、增量数据平面验证和定制图算法，使每个阶段都是增量的。使用真实和合成控制平面变化进行的评估表明，DNA 可以在几秒钟内计算出可达性的差异，比最先进的控制平面验证器快 3 个数量级。

papers.title: DispersedLedger: High-Throughput Byzantine Consensus on Variable Bandwidth Networks.
papers.abstract: The success of blockchains has sparked interest in large-scale deployments of Byzantine fault tolerant (BFT) consensus protocols over wide area networks. A central feature of such networks is variable communication bandwidth across nodes and across time. We present DispersedLedger, an asynchronous BFT protocol that provides near-optimal throughput in the presence of such variable network bandwidth. The core idea of DispersedLedger is to enable nodes to propose, order, and agree on blocks of transactions without having to download their full content. By enabling nodes to agree on an ordered log of blocks, with a guarantee that each block is available within the network and unmalleable, DispersedLedger decouples bandwidth-intensive block downloads at different nodes, allowing each to make progress at its own pace. We build a full system prototype and evaluate it on real-world and emulated networks. Our results on a geo-distributed wide-area deployment across the Internet shows that DispersedLedger achieves 2x better throughput and 74% reduction in latency compared to HoneyBadger, the state-of-the-art asynchronous protocol.
papers.abstract_zh: 区块链的成功引发了人们对在广域网上大规模部署拜占庭容错（BFT）共识协议的兴趣。此类网络的一个核心特征是跨节点和跨时间的可变通信带宽。我们提出了 DispersedLedger，这是一种异步 BFT 协议，可在存在此类可变网络带宽的情况下提供接近最佳的吞吐量。 DispersedLedger 的核心思想是使节点能够提议、订购和商定交易块，而无需下载其完整内容。通过使节点能够就区块的有序日志达成一致，并保证每个区块在网络中可用且不可延展，DispersedLedger 解耦了不同节点上的带宽密集型区块下载，允许每个区块按照自己的节奏取得进展。我们构建了一个完整的系统原型，并在现实世界和模拟网络上对其进行评估。我们对跨互联网的地理分布式广域部署的结果表明，与最先进的异步协议 HoneyBadger 相比，DispersedLedger 的吞吐量提高了 2 倍，延迟降低了 74%。

papers.title: Donar: Anonymous VoIP over Tor.
papers.abstract: We present DONAR, a system enabling anonymous VoIP with good quality-of-experience (QoE) over Tor. No individual Tor link can match VoIP networking requirements. DONAR bridges this gap by spreading VoIP traffic over several links. It combines active performance monitoring, dynamic link selection, adaptive traffic scheduling, and redundancy at no extra bandwidth cost. DONAR enables high QoE: latency remains under 360 ms for 99% of VoIP packets during most (86%) 5-minute and 90-minute calls.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们推出了 DONAR，这是一个通过 Tor 实现匿名 VoIP 且具有良好体验质量 (QoE) 的系统。没有任何单独的 Tor 链路能够满足 VoIP 网络要求。 DONAR 通过将 VoIP 流量分散到多个链路上来弥补这一差距。它结合了主动性能监控、动态链路选择、自适应流量调度和冗余，无需额外的带宽成本。 DONAR 可实现高 QoE：在大多数 (86%) 5 分钟和 90 分钟通话期间，99% 的 VoIP 数据包的延迟保持在 360 毫秒以下。

papers.title: Dynamic Scheduling of Approximate Telemetry Queries.
papers.abstract: Network telemetry systems provide critical visibility into the state of networks. While significant progress has been made by leveraging programmable switch hardware to scale these systems to high and time-varying traffic workloads, less attention has been paid towards efficiently utilizing limited hardware resources in the face of dynamics such as the composition of traffic as well as the number and types of queries running at a given point in time. Both these dynamics have implications on resource requirements and query accuracy. In this paper, we argue that this dynamics problem motivates reframing telemetry systems as resource schedulers---a significant departure from state-of-the-art. More concretely, rather than statically partition queries across hardware and software platforms, telemetry systems ought to decide on their own and at runtime when and for how long to execute the set of active queries on the data plane. To this end, we propose an efficient approximation and scheduling algorithm that exposes accuracy and latency tradeoffs with respect to query execution to reduce hardware resource usage. We evaluate our algorithm by building DynATOS, a hardware prototype built around a reconfigurable approach to ASIC programming. We show that our approach is more robust than state-of-the-art methods to traffic dynamics and can execute dynamic workloads comprised of multiple concurrent and sequential queries of varied complexities on a single switch while meeting per-query accuracy and latency goals.
papers.abstract_zh: 网络遥测系统提供对网络状态的重要可见性。虽然利用可编程交换机硬件将这些系统扩展到高且时变的流量工作负载方面已经取得了重大进展，但在面对动态（例如流量的组成以及在给定时间点运行的查询的数量和类型）时，对有效利用有限的硬件资源的关注较少。这两种动态都会对资源需求和查询准确性产生影响。在本文中，我们认为这个动态问题促使将遥测系统重新构建为资源调度程序——这与最先进的技术有很大的不同。更具体地说，遥测系统不应在硬件和软件平台上静态地划分查询，而应在运行时自行决定在数据平面上执行一组活动查询的时间和时长。为此，我们提出了一种有效的近似和调度算法，该算法公开了查询执行方面的准确性和延迟权衡，以减少硬件资源的使用。我们通过构建 DynATOS 来评估我们的算法，DynATOS 是一种围绕可重新配置的 ASIC 编程方法构建的硬件原型。我们表明，我们的方法比最先进的流量动态方法更强大，并且可以在单个交换机上执行由多个并发和顺序查询组成的不同复杂性的动态工作负载，同时满足每个查询的准确性和延迟目标。

papers.title: Efficient Scheduling Policies for Microsecond-Scale Tasks.
papers.abstract: Datacenter operators today strive to support microsecond-latency applications while also using their limited CPU resources as efficiently as possible. To achieve this, several recent systems allow multiple applications to run on the same server, granting each a dedicated set of cores and reallocating cores across applications over time as load varies. Unfortunately, many of these systems do a poor job of navigating the tradeoff between latency and efficiency, sacrificing one or both, especially when handling tasks as short as 1 μ s. While the implementations of these systems (threading libraries, network stacks, etc.) have been heavily optimized, the policy choices that they make have received less scrutiny. Most systems implement a single choice of policy for allocating cores across applications and for load-balancing tasks across cores within an application. In this paper, we use simulations to compare these different policy options and explore which yield the best combination of latency and efficiency. We conclude that work stealing performs best among load-balancing policies, multiple policies can perform well for core allocations, and, surprisingly, static core allocations often outperform reallocation with small tasks. We implement the best-performing policy choices by building on Caladan, an existing core-allocating system, and demonstrate that they can yield efficiency improvements of up to 13-22% without degrading (median or tail) latency.
papers.abstract_zh: 如今，数据中心运营商努力支持微秒级延迟的应用程序，同时尽可能高效地利用有限的 CPU 资源。为了实现这一目标，最近的几个系统允许多个应用程序在同一服务器上运行，为每个应用程序授予一组专用的核心，并随着负载变化而在应用程序之间重新分配核心。不幸的是，这些系统中的许多系统在处理延迟和效率之间的权衡方面做得很差，牺牲了其中一个或两者，特别是在处理短至 1 μs 的任务时。虽然这些系统（线程库、网络堆栈等）的实现已经过大量优化，但它们做出的策略选择受到的审查较少。大多数系统都实现单一策略选择，用于跨应用程序分配核心以及应用程序内跨核心的负载平衡任务。在本文中，我们使用模拟来比较这些不同的策略选项，并探索哪种策略可以产生延迟和效率的最佳组合。我们得出的结论是，工作窃取在负载平衡策略中表现最好，多个策略可以在核心分配中表现良好，并且令人惊讶的是，静态核心分配通常优于小任务的重新分配。我们通过在现有核心分配系统 Caladan 的基础上实施性能最佳的策略选择，并证明它们可以将效率提高高达 13-22%，而不会降低（中值或尾部）延迟。

papers.title: Ekya: Continuous Learning of Video Analytics Models on Edge Compute Servers.
papers.abstract: Video analytics applications use edge compute servers for processing videos. Compressed models that are deployed on the edge servers for inference suffer from data drift where the live video data diverges from the training data. Continuous learning handles data drift by periodically retraining the models on new data. Our work addresses the challenge of jointly supporting inference and retraining tasks on edge servers, which requires navigating the fundamental tradeoff between the retrained model’s accuracy and the inference accuracy. Our solution Ekya balances this tradeoff across multiple models and uses a micro-profiler to identify the models most in need of retraining. Ekya’s accuracy gain compared to a baseline scheduler is 29% higher, and the baseline requires 4× more GPU resources to achieve the same accuracy as Ekya.
papers.abstract_zh: 视频分析应用程序使用边缘计算服务器来处理视频。部署在边缘服务器上用于推理的压缩模型会受到数据漂移的影响，其中实时视频数据与训练数据存在偏差。持续学习通过定期根据新数据重新训练模型来处理数据漂移。我们的工作解决了在边缘服务器上联合支持推理和再训练任务的挑战，这需要在再训练模型的准确性和推理准确性之间进行基本权衡。我们的解决方案 Ekya 平衡了多个模型之间的这种权衡，并使用微分析器来识别最需要重新训练的模型。与基线调度程序相比，Ekya 的准确度增益高出 29%，并且基线需要多 4 倍的 GPU 资源才能达到与 Ekya 相同的准确度。

papers.title: Elixir: A High-performance and Low-cost Approach to Managing Hardware/Software Hybrid Flow Tables Considering Flow Burstiness.
papers.abstract: Hardware/software hybrid flow table is common in modern commodity network devices, such as NFV servers, smart NICs and SDN/OVS switches. The overall forwarding performance of the network device and the required CPU resources are considerably affected by the method of how to split the flow table between hardware and software. Previous works usually leverage the traffic skewness for flow table splitting, e.g. offloading top 10% largest flows to the hardware can save up to ~90% CPU resources. However, the widely-existing bursty flows bring more challenges to flow table splitting. In particular, we need to identify the proper flows and proper timing to exchange the flows between hardware and software by considering flow burstiness, so as to maximize the overall performance with low overhead. In this paper we present Elixir, a high-performance and low-cost approach to managing hardware/software hybrid flow tables on commodity devices. The core idea of Elixir includes three parts, namely, combining sampling-based and counter-based mechanisms for flow rate measurement, separating the replacement of large flows and bursty flows, as well as decoupling the flow rate identification window and the flow replacement window. We have implemented Elixir prototypes on both Mellanox ConnectX-5 NIC and Barefoot Wedge100BF-32X/65X P4 Switch, with a software library on top of DPDK. Our experiments based on real-world data traces demonstrate that, compared with the state-of-the-art solutions, Elixir can save up to ~50% software CPU resources while keeping the tail forwarding latency ~97.6% lower.
papers.abstract_zh: 硬件/软件混合流表在现代商用网络设备中很常见，例如 NFV 服务器、智能 NIC 和 SDN/OVS 交换机。流表在硬件和软件之间的分割方式对网络设备的整体转发性能和所需的CPU资源有很大的影响。以前的工作通常利用流量偏度来进行流表分割，例如将前 10% 的最大流量卸载到硬件可以节省高达约 90% 的 CPU 资源。然而，广泛存在的突发流给流表分裂带来了更多的挑战。特别是，我们需要考虑流量突发性来确定硬件和软件之间交换流量的适当流量和适当时机，从而以较低的开销最大化整体性能。在本文中，我们介绍了 Elixir，一种高性能且低成本的方法，用于管理商用设备上的硬件/软件混合流表。 Elixir的核心思想包括三个部分，即基于采样和基于计数器的流量测量机制相结合、大流和突发流的替换分离、以及流量识别窗口和流替换窗口的解耦。我们在 Mellanox ConnectX-5 NIC 和 Barefoot Wedge100BF-32X/65X P4 交换机上实现了 Elixir 原型，并在 DPDK 之上提供了软件库。我们基于真实世界数据跟踪的实验表明，与最先进的解决方案相比，Elixir 可以节省高达约 50% 的软件 CPU 资源，同时将尾部转发延迟降低约 97.6%。

papers.title: Enabling In-situ Programmability in Network Data Plane: From Architecture to Language.
papers.abstract: In-situ programmability refers to the capability for network devices to update data plane functions and protocol processing logic at runtime without interrupting the services, driven by dynamic and interactive network operations towards autonomous networks. The existing programmable switch architecture (e.g., PISA) and programming language (e.g., P4) were designed for monolithic and static implementation, which requires a complete programming and deployment cycle for functional update, incurring long delay and service interruption. Addressing the fundamental reasons for such inflexibility, we design a new In-situ Programmable Switch Architecture (IPSA) and the corresponding design flow using rP4, a P4 language extension, as a fix. The compiler contains algorithms to support efficient resource mapping for both base design and incremental updates. To manifest the in-situ programming feasibility, we demonstrate several practical use cases on both a software switch, ipbm, and an FPGA-based prototype. Our experiments and analysis show that IPSA incurs moderate hardware cost which can be justified by its benefits and compensated by newer chip technologies. The in-situ programmability enabled by IPSA and rP4 advances the state of the art of programmable networks and opens a promising new design space.
papers.abstract_zh: 原位可编程性是指网络设备在运行时更新数据平面功能和协议处理逻辑而不中断服务的能力，由面向自治网络的动态和交互式网络操作驱动。现有的可编程交换机架构（例如PISA）和编程语言（例如P4）都是为单片和静态实现而设计的，这需要完整的编程和部署周期来进行功能更新，从而导致较长的延迟和服务中断。针对这种不灵活性的根本原因，我们设计了一种新的原位可编程交换机架构 (IPSA) 以及使用 P4 语言扩展 rP4 的相应设计流程作为修复。该编译器包含支持基本设计和增量更新的高效资源映射的算法。为了证明现场编程的可行性，我们在软件交换机、ipbm 和基于 FPGA 的原型上演示了几个实际用例。我们的实验和分析表明，IPSA 会产生适中的硬件成本，这可以通过其优势来证明是合理的，并可以通过更新的芯片技术进行补偿。 IPSA 和 rP4 实现的原位可编程性推进了可编程网络的最先进水平，并开辟了充满希望的新设计空间。

papers.title: Enabling IoT Self-Localization Using Ambient 5G Signals.
papers.abstract: This paper presents ISLA , a system that enables low power IoT nodes to self-localize using ambient 5G signals without any coordination with the base stations. ISLA operates by simply overhearing transmitted 5G packets and leverages the large bandwidth used in 5G to compute high-resolution time of flight of the signals. Capturing large 5G bandwidth consumes a lot of power. To address this, ISLA leverages recent advances in MEMS acoustic resonators to design a RF filter that can stretch the effective localization bandwidth to 100 MHz while using 6.25 MHz receivers, improving ranging resolution by 16x. We implement and evaluate ISLA in three large outdoors testbeds and show high localization accuracy that is comparable with having the full 100 MHz bandwidth.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文提出了 ISLA 系统，该系统使低功耗物联网节点能够使用环境 5G 信号进行自我定位，而无需与基站进行任何协调。 ISLA 通过简单地监听传输的 5G 数据包来运行，并利用 5G 中使用的大带宽来计算信号的高分辨率飞行时间。获取大的 5G 带宽会消耗大量电量。为了解决这个问题，ISLA 利用 MEMS 声学谐振器的最新进展来设计射频滤波器，该滤波器可以在使用 6.25 MHz 接收器时将有效定位带宽扩展到 100 MHz，从而将测距分辨率提高 16 倍。我们在三个大型户外测试台中实施和评估 ISLA，并显示出与 100 MHz 完整带宽相当的高定位精度。

papers.title: Evolvable Network Telemetry at Facebook.
papers.abstract: Network telemetry is essential for service availability and performance in large-scale production environments. While there is recent advent in novel measurement primitives and algorithms for network telemetry, a challenge that is not well studied is Change. Facebook runs fast-evolving networks to adapt to varying application requirements. Changes occur not only in the data collection and processing stages but also when interpreted and consumed by applications. In this paper, we present PCAT, a production change-aware telemetry system that handles changes in fast-evolving networks. We propose to use a change cube abstraction to systematically track changes, and an intent-based layering design to confine and track changes. By sharing our experiences with PCAT, we bring a new aspect to the monitoring research area: improving the adaptivity and evolvability of network telemetry.
papers.abstract_zh: 网络遥测对于大规模生产环境中的服务可用性和性能至关重要。虽然最近出现了用于网络遥测的新颖测量原语和算法，但尚未充分研究的挑战是变化。 Facebook 运行快速发展的网络来适应不同的应用程序需求。变化不仅发生在数据收集和处理阶段，而且还发生在应用程序解释和使用时。在本文中，我们提出了 PCAT，一种生产变化感知遥测系统，可处理快速发展的网络中的变化。我们建议使用变更立方体抽象来系统地跟踪变更，并使用基于意图的分层设计来限制和跟踪变更。通过分享我们与 PCAT 的经验，我们为监测研究领域带来了一个新的方面：提高网络遥测的适应性和可进化性。

papers.title: Exploiting Digital Micro-Mirror Devices for Ambient Light Communication.
papers.abstract: There is a growing interest in exploiting ambient light for wireless communication. This new research area has two key advantages: it utilizes a free portion of the spectrum and does not require modifications of the lighting infrastructure. Most existing designs, however, rely on a single type of optical surface at the transmitter: liquid crystal displays (LCDs). LCDs have two inherent limitations, they cut the optical power in half, which affects the range; and they have slow time responses, which affects the data rate. We take a step back to provide a new perspective for ambient light communication with two novel contributions. First, we propose an optical model to understand the fundamental limits and opportunities of ambient light communication. Second, based on the insights of our model, we build a novel platform, dubbedPhotoLink, that exploits a different type of optical surface: digital micro-mirror devices (DMDs). Considering the same scenario in terms of surface area and ambient light conditions, we benchmark the performance of PhotoLink using two types of receivers, one optimized for LCDs and the other for DMDs. In both cases, PhotoLink outperforms the data rate of equivalent LCD-transmitters by factors of 30 and 80: 30kbps & 80 kbps vs. 1 kbps, while consuming less than 50 mW. Even when compared to a more sophisticated multi-cell LCD platform, which has a surface area that is 500 times bigger than ours, PhotoLink’s data rate is 10-fold: 80 kbps vs. 8 kbps. To the best of our knowledge this is the first work providing an optical model for ambient light communication and breaking the 10 kbps barrier for these types of links.
papers.abstract_zh: 人们对利用环境光进行无线通信越来越感兴趣。这个新的研究领域有两个关键优势：它利用光谱的免费部分，并且不需要修改照明基础设施。然而，大多数现有设计都依赖于发射器上的单一类型光学表面：液晶显示器 (LCD)。 LCD 有两个固有的限制，它们将光功率减半，这会影响范围；它们的时间响应速度较慢，这会影响数据速率。我们退后一步，通过两项新颖的贡献为环境光通信提供了新的视角。首先，我们提出了一个光学模型来了解环境光通信的基本限制和机会。其次，根据我们模型的见解，我们构建了一个名为 PhotoLink 的新颖平台，它利用了不同类型的光学表面：数字微镜器件 (DMD)。考虑到表面积和环境光条件方面的相同场景，我们使用两种类型的接收器对 PhotoLink 的性能进行基准测试，一种针对 LCD 进行优化，另一种针对 DMD 进行优化。在这两种情况下，PhotoLink 的数据速率均优于同等 LCD 发射器 30 倍和 80 倍：30kbps 和 80 kbps 与 1 kbps，而功耗不到 50 mW。即使与表面积比我们大 500 倍的更复杂的多单元 LCD 平台相比，PhotoLink 的数据速率也是其 10 倍：80 kbps 与 8 kbps。据我们所知，这是第一项为环境光通信提供光学模型并突破此类链路 10 kbps 障碍的工作。

papers.title: FlexTOE: Flexible TCP Offload with Fine-Grained Parallelism.
papers.abstract: FlexTOE is a flexible, yet high-performance TCP offload engine (TOE) to SmartNICs. FlexTOE eliminates almost all host data-path TCP processing and is fully customizable. FlexTOE interoperates well with other TCP stacks, is robust under adverse network conditions, and supports POSIX sockets. FlexTOE focuses on data-path offload of established connections, avoiding complex control logic and packet buffering in the NIC. FlexTOE leverages fine-grained parallelization of the TCP data-path and segment reordering for high performance on wimpy SmartNIC architectures, while remaining flexible via a modular design. We compare FlexTOE on an Agilio-CX40 to host TCP stacks Linux and TAS, and to the Chelsio Terminator TOE. We find that Memcached scales up to 38% better on FlexTOE versus TAS, while saving up to 81% host CPU cycles versus Chelsio. FlexTOE provides competitive performance for RPCs, even with wimpy SmartNICs. FlexTOE cuts 99.99th-percentile RPC RTT by 3.2× and 50% versus Chelsio and TAS, respectively. FlexTOE's data-path parallelism generalizes across hardware architectures, improving single connection RPC throughput up to 2.4× on x86 and 4× on BlueField. FlexTOE supports C and XDP programs written in eBPF. It allows us to implement popular data center transport features, such as TCP tracing, packet filtering and capture, VLAN stripping, flow classification, firewalling, and connection splicing.
papers.abstract_zh: FlexTOE 是一种灵活且高性能的 SmartNIC TCP 卸载引擎 (TOE)。 FlexTOE 消除了几乎所有主机数据路径 TCP 处理，并且完全可定制。 FlexTOE 与其他 TCP 堆栈具有良好的互操作性，在不利的网络条件下也具有鲁棒性，并且支持 POSIX 套接字。 FlexTOE 专注于已建立连接的数据路径卸载，避免 NIC 中的复杂控制逻辑和数据包缓冲。 FlexTOE 利用 TCP 数据路径的细粒度并行化和段重新排序，在微弱的 SmartNIC 架构上实现高性能，同时通过模块化设计保持灵活性。我们将 Agilio-CX40 上的 FlexTOE 与主机 TCP 堆栈 Linux 和 TAS 以及 Chelsio Terminator TOE 进行比较。我们发现，与 TAS 相比，Memcached 在 FlexTOE 上的扩展能力提高了 38%，同时与 Chelsio 相比节省了高达 81% 的主机 CPU 周期。 FlexTOE 为 RPC 提供了具有竞争力的性能，即使智能网卡性能较差。与 Chelsio 和 TAS 相比，FlexTOE 将 99.99% 的 RPC RTT 分别降低了 3.2 倍和 50%。 FlexTOE 的数据路径并行性遍及硬件架构，将 x86 上的单连接 RPC 吞吐量提高至 2.4 倍，在 BlueField 上提高至 4 倍。 FlexTOE 支持用 eBPF 编写的 C 和 XDP 程序。它使我们能够实现流行的数据中心传输功能，例如 TCP 跟踪、数据包过滤和捕获、VLAN 剥离、流分类、防火墙和连接拼接。

papers.title: Gearbox: A Hierarchical Packet Scheduler for Approximate Weighted Fair Queuing.
papers.abstract: Bandwidth allocation and performance isolation are crucial to achieving network virtualization and guaranteeing service quality in data centers as well as other network systems. Weighted Fair Queuing (WFQ) can achieve customized bandwidth allocation and flow isolation; however, its implementation in large-scale high-speed network systems is very challenging due to the high complexity of the scheduling and the large number of queues required. This paper proposes Gearbox, a scheduler primitive for next-generation programmable switches and smart NICs that practically approximates WFQ. Gearbox consists of a logical hierarchy of queuing levels, which accommodate a wide range of packet departure times using a relatively small number of FIFOs. Gearbox's enqueue and dequeue operations have O(1) time complexity, which makes it suitable to cope with high-speed line rates. Gearbox provides its simplicity and performance advantages by allowing slight discrepancies in packet departure time from strict WFQ. We show that Gearbox's normalized departure time discrepancy is bounded and has a negligible impact on bandwidth allocation and flow completion time (FCT). We implement Gearbox in NS2 and in VHDL, targeted to a Xilinx Alveo U250 card with an XCVU13P FPGA. The NS2 evaluation results show that Gearbox closely approximates WFQ and achieves weighted max-min fairness in bandwidth allocation as well as flow isolation. Gearbox provides FCT performance comparable to ideal WFQ. The Gearbox FPGA prototype runs at 350MHz and achieves full line rate for 100GbE with packets larger than 123 bytes. Gearbox consumes less than 1% of the FPGA's logic resources and less than 4% of its internal block memory.
papers.abstract_zh: 带宽分配和性能隔离对于数据中心及其他网络系统实现网络虚拟化和保证服务质量至关重要。加权公平队列（WFQ）可以实现定制化的带宽分配和流量隔离；然而，由于调度复杂度高、需要大量队列，其在大规模高速网络系统中的实现非常具有挑战性。本文提出了 Gearbox，一种用于下一代可编程交换机和智能 NIC 的调度器原语，实际上类似于 WFQ。 Gearbox 由排队级别的逻辑层次结构组成，它使用相对较少数量的 FIFO 来适应各种数据包出发时间。 Gearbox的入队和出队操作具有O(1)的时间复杂度，这使得它适合应对高速线速率。 Gearbox 通过允许数据包离开时间与严格的 WFQ 略有差异，提供了简单性和性能优势。我们表明 Gearbox 的标准化出发时间差异是有界的，并且对带宽分配和流完成时间 (FCT) 的影响可以忽略不计。我们在 NS2 和 VHDL 中实现 Gearbox，目标是带有 XCVU13P FPGA 的 Xilinx Alveo U250 卡。 NS2 评估结果表明，Gearbox 非常接近 WFQ，并在带宽分配和流量隔离方面实现了加权最大最小公平性。 Gearbox 提供与理想 WFQ 相当的 FCT 性能。 Gearbox FPGA 原型运行频率为 350MHz，可实现 100GbE 的全线速，且数据包大于 123 字节。 Gearbox 消耗的 FPGA 逻辑资源不到 1%，其内部块存储器不到 4%。
